declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalModuleCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 071H.** The source's equation: global module cohomology is
canonically the cohomology of the sectionwise global sections of any injective resolution,
over the ring `Γ(C, O)`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineCover.isZero_cohomology_of_degree_ge_separatedCoverBound
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`X = U₁ ∪ … ∪ Uₙ` be an open covering by quasi-compact separated opens — for example affine ones.
If `d = max_{I} (|I| + t(⋂_{i ∈ I} Uᵢ) - 1)`, where `t` is the affine covering number, then the
cohomology of every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module vanishes in every degree at least `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_degree_ge_separatedCoverBound {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {n d : ℕ} (U : Fin n → X.Opens) (hU : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (hU_compact : ∀ i, IsCompact (U i : Set X))
    (hU_separated : ∀ i, Scheme.IsSeparated (U i : Scheme))
    (hd : d = Finset.univ.sup fun I : Finset (Fin n) ↦
      I.card + minimalAffineCoverCardinality (⨅ i ∈ I, U i) - 1)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) (hp : d ≤ p) :
    IsZero ((((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).cohomologyPresheaf p).obj
      (op (⊤ : X.Opens)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_cohomology_of_coverDegreeBound_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 071L.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and let
`X = U 1 ∪ … ∪ U n` be an open covering with each `U i` quasi-compact and with affine
diagonal — for instance separated, or affine. Set

`d = max { |I| + t(⋂_{i ∈ I} U i) - 1 : ∅ ≠ I ⊆ {1, …, n} }`,

the `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.coverDegreeBound` of the covering, where `t(U)` is the minimal
number of affine opens needed to cover `U`. Then `H^p(X, F) = 0` for all `p ≥ d` and every
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_coverDegreeBound_le [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → X.Opens) (hcov : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (hUc : ∀ i, IsCompact (U i : Set X))
    (hUinf : ∀ (i : Fin n) (A B : X.Opens), A ≤ U i → B ≤ U i → IsAffineOpen A →
      IsAffineOpen B → IsAffineOpen (A ⊓ B))
    (p : ℕ) (hp : X.coverDegreeBound U ≤ p) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_cohomology_of_coverDegreeBound_le_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 071L**, with the covering hypothesis in the source's form: each `U i`
is quasi-compact and separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_coverDegreeBound_le_of_isSeparated [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] {n : ℕ} (U : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hcov : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (hUc : ∀ i, IsCompact (U i : Set X))
    (hUsep : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme.IsSeparated)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : X.coverDegreeBound U ≤ p) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.higherDirectImageAssociatedModuleIso
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : T ⟶ S` of schemes of a big étale site whose underlying morphism of
schemes is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and every degree `i`, there is a canonical
isomorphism

`R ⁱ f_{small, *}(𝓕ᵃ) ≅ (R ⁱ f_* 𝓕)ᵃ`

natural in the quasi-coherent `𝒪_T`-module `𝓕`, where `f_small = ε_f` is the morphism of small
étale ringed sites of [Stacks, Tag 070R] (2), `R ⁱ f_{small, *}` is the right derived functor of
its direct image of sheaves of modules, `R ⁱ f_*` that of the direct image of `𝒪_T`-modules, and
`𝓖 ↦ 𝓖ᵃ` the associated module of [Stacks, Tag 03DU] (4) at `τ = étale`.
declarations.statement:
def higherDirectImageAssociatedModuleIso (i : ℕ) :
    associatedModuleOnQuasicoherent B (X := X) ⋙
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (smallEtaleStructureMapRing B a)).rightDerived i ≅
      Stacks.Cohomology.AffineBase.quasicoherentInclusion X.obj ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (schemeHom B a)).rightDerived i ⋙
          associatedModule B Y.obj Y.property
declarations.comment: the ÉTALE topology of the two the tag states ("for either the étale or Zariski topology"): for f quasi-compact and quasi-separated, in every degree i, as an isomorphism of functors on the quasi-coherent O_T-modules (hence natural in F). The ZARISKI topology is SmallZariski.higherDirectImageAssociatedModulePlusIntIso

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.higherDirectImageAssociatedSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Descent, Lemma 071N, for the étale topology**: for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism `a` of the big étale site and a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `𝓕`,
`R^p a_{small,*}(𝓕^a) ≅ (R^p a_* 𝓕)^a` on the small étale site of `Y`, assembled by
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.higherDirectImageAssociatedSheafIsoOfZariski` from
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.baseChangeCohomologyIso` and its naturality.
declarations.statement:
def higherDirectImageAssociatedSheafIso (𝓕 : X.obj.Modules) [𝓕.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) :
    ((Stacks.HigherDirectImage.pushforward.{u, u} B a).rightDerived p).obj
        ((associatedSheaf B X).obj 𝓕) ≅
      (associatedSheaf B Y).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (schemeHom B a)).rightDerived p).obj 𝓕)
declarations.comment: the étale topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.higherDirectImageAssociatedModulePlusIntIso
declarations.doc:
**The Zariski half of [Stacks, Tag 071N] at an arbitrary integer degree.**  For every `i : ℤ`,

`R ⁱ f_{small, *}(𝓕^a) ≅ (R ⁱ f_* 𝓕)^a`,

naturally in `𝓕`, in the `ℤ`-indexed derived-category convention of [Stacks, Tag 05U4] that the
tag is read in.

In degrees `0 ≤ i` this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski.higherDirectImageAssociatedModulePlusIntIsoOfNonneg`, which is
where the content is.  In degrees `i < 0` both sides are zero objects and this is the unique
isomorphism between them; the statement is true there but says nothing, so a consumer that wants
the comparison should prefer the nonnegative-degree form.

No hypothesis is placed on `f` or on `𝓕`.  [Stacks, Tag 071N] states the comparison for `f`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `𝓕` quasi-coherent; those are what the tag needs in order
that `(R ⁱ f_* 𝓕)^a` be formed on the *étale* site, where `𝓕 ↦ 𝓕^a` is only defined on the
quasi-coherent modules.  On the Zariski site it is defined on all of `Mod(𝒪_T)` and the comparison
holds with nothing assumed, so this is the tag's Zariski clause with its hypotheses dropped, not
weakened.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def higherDirectImageAssociatedModulePlusIntIso (i : ℤ) :
    associatedModule B T.1 T.property ⋙
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} (structureMapRing B f)).rightDerivedPlus i ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (schemeHom B f)).rightDerivedPlus i ⋙
        associatedModule B S.1 S.property
declarations.comment: the ZARISKI topology of the two the tag states ("for either the étale or Zariski topology"), at every integer degree and naturally in the module, with the tag's hypotheses on f and on the module dropped rather than weakened. The ÉTALE topology, at the tag's hypotheses (f quasi-compact and quasi-separated, F quasi-coherent), in every degree and naturally in F, is SmallEtale.higherDirectImageAssociatedModuleIso

registrations.name: isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage
registrations.comment: quasi-coherence of the higher direct images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedAssociatedModule_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071Q.**  For a scheme `S`, the functor `ε^* : D_QCoh(𝒪_S) ⟶ D_QCoh(S_étale, 𝒪)`
induced by the exact functor `ε^*` of Stacks 08H8 is an equivalence.

The quasi-inverse is `Rε_*`, `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallEtale.derivedRestrictModuleQcoh`, as in the
source: the adjunction `ε^* ⊣ Rε_*` restricts to the two derived categories with quasi-coherent
cohomology, where its unit and counit are isomorphisms because `H^q(Rε_* E) = ε_* H^q(E)` for
`E` with quasi-coherent cohomology (Stacks 03DW, 01XB and 0BKZ) and `ε^*` and `ε_*` are mutually
inverse on quasi-coherent modules (Stacks 03DX).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedAssociatedModule_isEquivalence :
    (derivedAssociatedModule.{w} B S hS).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_orbitQuotientSheaf_points_of_free
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071S** for an action on an object of a big fppf site over `S`: the quotient of `V`
by a free action of an abstract group `G`, formed as in the source as the fppf sheafification
of the presheaf `T ↦ V(T)/G` of pointwise orbits, is an algebraic space over `S`.

That quotient is the quotient sheaf of the graph relation of the action, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isoOrbitQuotientActionQuotient`, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_actionQuotient_of_actsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_orbitQuotientSheaf_points_of_free
    (ha : ActsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj V) G a) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (orbitQuotientSheaf B S hS G
      (Stacks.Groupoids.points (Over.post B.inclusion)
        ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj V)) hnat).obj
declarations.comment: for an action of the abstract group on an object of the big fppf site in place of an arbitrary algebraic space, and with freeness read on the points over the test schemes with nonempty underlying space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_actionQuotient_of_actsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071S** for an action on an object of a big fppf site over `S`: the quotient of `V`
by a free action of an abstract group `G` is an algebraic space over `S`.

The graph relation of a free action is an étale equivalence relation, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.actsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints_iff` and Tag 02Z2, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_actionQuotient` with its descent hypothesis
discharged.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_actionQuotient_of_actsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints
    (a : G →* Aut (underlyingOver B hS V))
    (ha : ActsFreelyOnNonemptyPoints (underlyingOver B hS V) G a) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (actionQuotient G B hS V a)
declarations.comment: for an action of the abstract group on an object of the big fppf site in place of an arbitrary algebraic space, the quotient being the sheaf quotient of the graph relation of the action, and freeness being read on the points over the test schemes with nonempty underlying space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_orbitQuotientSheaf_of_isFreeOnNonemptyPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071S.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` an algebraic space over `S` and `G` an abstract
group acting on `X` by a natural pointwise action. If the action is free then the quotient
`X/G`, the fppf sheafification of the presheaf `T ↦ X(T)/G` of pointwise orbits, is an
algebraic space over `S`.

Freeness is read on the points over the test objects with nonempty underlying scheme
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFreeOnNonemptyPoints`); over a test object with empty underlying
scheme a sheaf is terminal, so asking it there would force `G` to be trivial, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.forall_isCancelSMul_iff_subsingleton`.

The proof is the source's. At a surjective étale chart `φ : U ⟶ X` the relation
`R = ∐_{g ∈ G} U ×_{φ, X, g • φ} U` is an object of the site — freeness bounds the index set
by the points of `U ×_S U` — and it is the kernel pair of `U ⟶ X/G`, so it is an étale
equivalence relation, `U/R` is an algebraic space by Tag 02WW, and `X/G ≅ U/R` because both
are the coequalizer of `h_R ⇉ h_U` in fppf sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_orbitQuotientSheaf_of_isFreeOnNonemptyPoints
    (hnat : IsNaturalAction B S hS G X) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hfree : IsFreeOnNonemptyPoints B S hS G X) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (orbitQuotientSheaf B S hS G X hnat).obj
declarations.comment: with freeness read on the points over the test objects with nonempty underlying scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasicoherentDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071X.** The category `D_QCoh(𝒪_F)`: the full subcategory of the unbounded derived
category of `𝒪_F`-modules whose objects have quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves in every
degree.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev QuasicoherentDerivedCategory
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    [HasSheafify (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).J AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [(smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_moduleHigherPushforwardEtaleBaseChangeComparison_etaleSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 071Z read as a statement about the canonical maps, in the étale case.**  For a
cartesian square of algebraic spaces whose bottom arrow `g` is étale, the canonical base-change
comparison

`(R^n f_*F)|_{Y'} ⟶ R^n f'_*(F|_{X'})`

is an isomorphism in every degree `n`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_moduleHigherPushforwardEtaleBaseChangeComparison` with its
underived hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_moduleEtaleBaseChangeComparison`.  The injective-preservation
input of the comparison map — part (1) of Stacks 03F3 for étale restriction of modules along `i`,
which is étale by Stacks 03FU — is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.preservesInjectiveObjects_etaleModulePullback` and is used, not assumed.
So nothing is assumed here beyond the cartesian square and the étaleness of `g`.

**This is the étale case and not Stacks 073K, part (1)**, for the same reason as the underived
statement: `hg` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtale`, and étale is strictly stronger than the
flatness of `g` that Stacks 073K assumes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_moduleHigherPushforwardEtaleBaseChangeComparison_etaleSquare
    (sq : IsPullback i f' f g) (hg : IsEtale B S hS g.hom) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (moduleHigherPushforwardEtaleBaseChangeComparison B S hS i f' f g sq hg
      (preservesInjectiveObjects_etaleModulePullback B S hS i
        (isEtale_of_isPullback B S hS f' i g f sq.flip hg)) n)
declarations.comment:
for the CANONICAL comparison map and for an ÉTALE square: g étale, not merely
flat, so this is a special case of Stacks 073K part (1) and not that tag.  The existing 071Z
attribute carries an isomorphism with the right endpoints that is not identified with the
canonical map

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleHigherPushforwardChartBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
For a representable morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic
spaces and an étale scheme chart `V` of `Y`, the higher direct images of `𝒪_X`-modules commute
with restriction to the chart:

`R^n f'_*(F|_U) = (R^n f_*F)|_V`,

naturally in the `𝒪_X`-module `F`, where `U = V ×_Y X` is the pullback chart of `X` and
`f' : U ⟶ V` is the base change of `f`. The morphism `f` is not assumed quasi-compact or
quasi-separated, `V ⟶ Y` is not assumed surjective and `F` is not assumed quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleHigherPushforwardChartBaseChangeIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable f.hom) (V : SmallEtale B S hS Y.1) (n : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS
      (chartSpace B S hS X ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).obj V)).1
      (chartSpace B S hS X ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).obj V)).2
    etaleModulePullback B S hS
          (chartToSpace B S hS X ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).obj V))
          (isEtale_chartToSpace B S hS X ((smallBaseChange B S hS f hf).obj V)) ⋙
        (modulePushforward B S hS (smallBaseChangeChartMap B S hS f hf V)).rightDerived n ≅
      (modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived n ⋙
        etaleModulePullback B S hS (chartToSpace B S hS Y V)
          (isEtale_chartToSpace B S hS Y V)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasicoherentOnSite_rightDerived_modulePushforward'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0720.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on the small
étale site of `X`. Then the higher direct image `R^i f_*F` is quasi-coherent for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_rightDerived_modulePushforward' {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom) (hfqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (i : ℕ) :
    have := hasInjectiveResolutions_modules B S hS X.1 X.2
    (((modulePushforward B S hS f).rightDerived i).obj F).IsQuasicoherentOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.extensionByZeroConstant_preservesBinaryCoproduct
declarations.doc:
The two canonical maps induced by the inclusions into a binary coproduct of the
spaces-étale site give a direct-sum decomposition of extensions by zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZeroConstant_preservesBinaryCoproduct
    (U₁ U₂ U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (i₁ : U₁ ⟶ U) (i₂ : U₂ ⟶ U)
    (hU : IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk i₁ i₂)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (BinaryCofan.mk
      (extensionByZeroConstantMap B S hS X i₁)
      (extensionByZeroConstantMap B S hS X i₂)))
declarations.comment: coproduct_sum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.extensionByZeroConstantTensorIso
declarations.doc:
The tensor product of the extensions by zero of the constant sheaf `ℤ` from two objects of
the spaces-étale site of `X` is the extension by zero from their product.
declarations.statement:
def extensionByZeroConstantTensorIso (U₁ U₂ U₁₂ : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p₁ : U₁₂ ⟶ U₁)
    (p₂ : U₁₂ ⟶ U₂) (h : IsLimit (BinaryFan.mk p₁ p₂)) :
    abelianSheafTensor B S hS X (extensionByZeroConstant B S hS X U₁)
        (extensionByZeroConstant B S hS X U₂) ≅
      extensionByZeroConstant B S hS X U₁₂
declarations.comment: product_tensor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.extensionByZeroConstantTensorIso_hom_generator
declarations.doc:
The tensor-product isomorphism sends the pure tensor of the generators indexed by `φ₁` and
`φ₂` to the generator indexed by their pairing into the product.
declarations.statement:
theorem extensionByZeroConstantTensorIso_hom_generator (U₁ U₂ U₁₂ : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (p₁ : U₁₂ ⟶ U₁) (p₂ : U₁₂ ⟶ U₂) (h : IsLimit (BinaryFan.mk p₁ p₂))
    (V : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (φ₁ : V ⟶ U₁) (φ₂ : V ⟶ U₂) :
    ((extensionByZeroConstantTensorIso B S hS X U₁ U₂ U₁₂ p₁ p₂ h).hom.hom.app
        (Opposite.op V))
      (((toSheafify (topology B S hS X)
        (presheafTensor (extensionByZeroConstant B S hS X U₁).obj
          (extensionByZeroConstant B S hS X U₂).obj)).app (Opposite.op V))
        (TensorProduct.tmul ℤ (extensionByZeroConstantGenerator B S hS X U₁ V φ₁)
          (extensionByZeroConstantGenerator B S hS X U₂ V φ₂))) =
      extensionByZeroConstantGenerator B S hS X U₁₂ V (h.lift (BinaryFan.mk φ₁ φ₂))
declarations.comment: product_tensor on generators

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.koszulAugmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0723.** The augmentation `K^• ⟶ ℤ[0]` of the complex `K^•` attached to an object
of the spaces-étale site of `X`: the trace in degree `0` and zero in higher degrees.
declarations.statement:
def koszulAugmentation (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) :
    koszulComplex B S hS X U ⟶
      (ChainComplex.single₀ (Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
        (constantIntSheaf B S hS X)
declarations.comment: the augmentation K^• ⟶ ℤ[0]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.koszulAugmentation_quasiIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0723.** For an algebraic space `U` étale and surjective over `X`, the augmentation
`K^• ⟶ ℤ[0]` of the Koszul complex of the trace `j_{U!} ℤ ⟶ ℤ` is a quasi-isomorphism: `K^•`
is a resolution of the constant sheaf `ℤ` on the spaces-étale site of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem koszulAugmentation_quasiIso (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS U.obj.hom.hom) :
    QuasiIso (koszulAugmentation B S hS X U)
declarations.comment: the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism for a surjective cover

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.alternatingCechComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0724.** The alternating Čech complex `Č^•_alt(f, F)` associated to an abelian
sheaf `F` on the spaces-étale site of `X` and an object `U` of that site: the complex
`Hom(K^0, F) → Hom(K^1, F) → Hom(K^2, F) → …` with Hom groups computed in `Ab(X_étale)` and
`K^p = ∧^{p+1} j_{U!} ℤ`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.alternatingCechToDerivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : U ⟶ X` be a surjective étale morphism of algebraic spaces over
`S` and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on the spaces-étale site of `X`. There is a canonical map

`Č^•_alt(f, ℱ) ⟶ RΓ(X, ℱ)`

in `D(Ab)`, where `Č^•_alt(f, ℱ)` is the alternating Čech complex of [Stacks 0724] and
`RΓ(X, ℱ)` is represented by the global sections of an injective resolution of `ℱ`, so that
`H^n(RΓ(X, ℱ)) = H^n(X, ℱ)` by `derivedGlobalSectionsHomologyAddEquivSheafH`.

It is the composite of the map into the total complex of the Hom bicomplex `Hom(K^p, I^q)` with
the inverse of the quasi-isomorphism `Γ(X, I^•) ⟶ Tot(Hom(K^•, I^•))` of [Stacks 0133].

The other assertion of [Stacks 0725], the spectral sequence with `E₁^{p,q} = Ext^q(K^p, ℱ)`
converging to `H^{p+q}(X, ℱ)`, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.exists_alternatingCechCohomologySpectralSequence`.
declarations.statement:
def alternatingCechToDerivedGlobalSections (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS U.obj.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (alternatingCechComplexExtend B S hS X U F) ⟶
      derivedGlobalSections B S hS X F
declarations.comment: the canonical map Č^•_alt(f, ℱ) ⟶ RΓ(X, ℱ) in D(Ab)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.exists_alternatingCechExtSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0725, the first page of the spectral sequence.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over
a scheme `S`, let `U` be an algebraic space étale over `X` and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on the
spaces-étale site of `X`. There is a cohomological spectral sequence, starting on page one, with
`E₁^{p,q} = Ext^q_{Ab(X_étale)}(K^p, ℱ)` for `K^p = ∧^{p+1} j_{U!} ℤ` the terms of the Koszul
complex, abutting to the hyper-`Ext` groups `Ext^{p+q}(K^•, ℱ)` of the Koszul complex.

It is the spectral sequence of the total complex of the Hom bicomplex `Hom(K^p, I^q)` filtered
by the Koszul degree, for `I^•` an injective resolution of `ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_alternatingCechExtSpectralSequence (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 2} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p) F q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of
        (DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (koszulCochainComplex B S hS X U))
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0).obj F) n))
declarations.comment: the spectral sequence with E₁^{p,q} = Ext^q(K^p, ℱ), abutting to Ext^{p+q}(K^•, ℱ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.exists_alternatingCechCohomologySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0725.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S`, let `U` be an algebraic
space étale and *surjective* over `X` and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on the spaces-étale site
of `X`. There is a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence, starting on page one, with
`E₁^{p,q} = Ext^q_{Ab(X_étale)}(K^p, ℱ)` for `K^p = ∧^{p+1} j_{U!} ℤ` the terms of the Koszul
complex, abutting to the sheaf cohomology `H^{p+q}(X, ℱ)`.

The abutment is written as the `Ext` group out of the constant sheaf `ℤ`, which is Mathlib's
definition of sheaf cohomology; the last conjunct records that identification.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_alternatingCechCohomologySpectralSequence (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS U.obj.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 2} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p) F q))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E
        (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H F n) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F (n : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: the abutment is the cohomology of X, for a surjective cover

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isIso_signTwistToKoszul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The canonical map `ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p` from the sign twist of `W_p` to the
`(p+1)`-st exterior power of the extension by zero of `ℤ` from `U` is an isomorphism: it is the
sheafification of a map of presheaves which is both locally injective and locally
surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_signTwistToKoszul (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom) :
    IsIso (signTwistToKoszul B S hS X U p hsep)
declarations.comment: the canonical map ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.bijective_koszulHomToSignSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The canonical map from `Hom(K^p, ℱ)` to the `S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant
sections of `ℱ` over `W_p` is bijective: it is precomposition with the isomorphism
`ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p` followed by the identification of maps out of `ℤ(sign)` with anti-invariant
sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_koszulHomToSignSections (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    Function.Bijective (koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F).hom
declarations.comment: bijectivity of the map Hom(K^p, F) ⟶ anti-invariant sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.koszulHomSignSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The identification of `Hom(K^p, ℱ)` with the group of
`S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant sections of `ℱ` over `W_p`, as an isomorphism of abelian groups.
declarations.statement:
def koszulHomSignSectionsEquiv (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p ⟶ F) ≃+
      characterSections (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep)
        (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep) Equiv.Perm.sign F.obj
declarations.comment: the map Hom(K^p, F) ⟶ anti-invariant sections is an isomorphism of groups

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.freeAction_and_bijective_koszulHomToSignSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** For `U` étale and separated over `X` the space
`W_p = U ×_X ⋯ ×_X U ∖ (all diagonals)` with `p + 1` factors carries a free action of the
symmetric group on `p + 1` letters over `X`, and for every abelian sheaf `ℱ` on the
spaces-étale site of `X` the canonical map from `Hom(K^p, ℱ)` to the `S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant
sections of `ℱ` over `W_p` is bijective, functorially in `ℱ`.

Freeness is stated in the shape a site asks for: a morphism `φ : V ⟶ W_p` fixed by `σ` forces
`σ = 1` unless the empty sieve covers `V`.  Surjectivity of `U ⟶ X`, which Stacks 0726 also
assumes, is not used: it is what makes the Koszul complex a resolution.
declarations.statement:
theorem freeAction_and_bijective_koszulHomToSignSections (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom) :
    (∀ (V : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (φ : V ⟶ diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep)
        (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 1))),
        φ ≫ (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep σ).asIso.hom = φ →
          (⊥ : Sieve V) ∈ topology B S hS X V ∨ σ = 1) ∧
      (∀ F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
        Function.Bijective (koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F).hom) ∧
      (∀ (F F' : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (k : F ⟶ F')
        (g : (koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p ⟶ F),
        (((koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F').hom (g ≫ k)).1 :
            F'.obj.obj (op (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))) =
          k.hom.app (op (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))
            (((koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F).hom g).1))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.diagonalComplement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The space `W = U ×_X ⋯ ×_X U ∖ (all diagonals)` with `n` factors, as an
object of the spaces-étale site of `X`: the complement of the diagonals is an open subspace of
`U^n`, and an open subspace of an object of the site is again one.
declarations.statement:
def diagonalComplement (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (n : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom) : SpacesEtale B S hS X
declarations.comment: the space W_p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.diagonalComplementAut
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The action of the symmetric group on `n` letters on `W` by permuting the
factors of `U^n`.  It is an action over `X` because `W` and the permutations of the factors
live in the spaces-étale site of `X`.
declarations.comment: the action of S_{p+1} on W_p over X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isEmpty_points_of_comp_diagonalComplementAut
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The action of the symmetric group on `W` is free: an object of the site
carrying a morphism to `W` fixed by a permutation `σ ≠ 1` has no points.

Pick `i` with `σ⁻¹ i ≠ i`.  A point of `V` would give a point of `U^n` at which the factors of
index `i` and `σ⁻¹ i` agree, whereas the points of `W` avoid all the diagonals.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEmpty_points_of_comp_diagonalComplementAut (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (n : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom) {V : SpacesEtale B S hS X}
    (φ : V ⟶ diagonalComplement B S hS X U n hsep) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (hσ : σ ≠ 1)
    (hφ : φ ≫ (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U n hsep σ).asIso.hom = φ) :
    IsEmpty (points B S hS (underlying B S hS X V).1)
declarations.comment: freeness of the action of S_{p+1} on W_p: a fixed morphism has empty source

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.eq_one_of_comp_diagonalComplementAut
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The action of the symmetric group on `W` is free, in the shape the
site-theoretic notion of a torsor asks for: a morphism `φ : V ⟶ W` fixed by `σ` forces `σ = 1`
unless the empty sieve covers `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_one_of_comp_diagonalComplementAut (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (n : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom) {V : SpacesEtale B S hS X}
    (φ : V ⟶ diagonalComplement B S hS X U n hsep) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (hφ : φ ≫ (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U n hsep σ).asIso.hom = φ) :
    (⊥ : Sieve V) ∈ topology B S hS X V ∨ σ = 1
declarations.comment: freeness of the action of S_{p+1} on W_p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.signTwistToKoszul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The canonical map `ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p` from the sign twist of `W_p` to the
`(p+1)`-st exterior power of the extension by zero of `ℤ` from `U`: the sheafification of the
map sending the class of a morphism `V ⟶ W_p` to the wedge of its `p + 1` components.
declarations.comment: the canonical map ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.koszulHomToSignSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The canonical map from `Hom(K^p, ℱ)` to the `S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant
sections of `ℱ` over `W_p`: precompose with `ℤ(sign) ⟶ K^p` and use that a map out of
`ℤ(sign)` is the same thing as an anti-invariant section over `W_p`.

Stacks 0726 asserts in addition that this map is bijective, which is not proved here.
declarations.statement:
def koszulHomToSignSections (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    AddCommGrpCat.of ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p ⟶ F) ⟶
      AddCommGrpCat.of (characterSections (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep)
        (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep) Equiv.Perm.sign F.obj)
declarations.comment: the map Hom(K^p, F) ⟶ S_{p+1}-anti-invariant sections of F over W_p

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.koszulHomToSignSections_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0726.** The map from `Hom(K^p, ℱ)` to the `S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant sections of `ℱ`
over `W_p` is functorial in `ℱ`: composing a map `K^p ⟶ ℱ` with `ℱ ⟶ ℱ'` takes the
corresponding section to its image over `W_p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem koszulHomToSignSections_naturality (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X) (p : ℕ)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.1.hom.hom)
    {F F' : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}} (k : F ⟶ F')
    (g : (koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p ⟶ F) :
    (((koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F').hom (g ≫ k)).1 :
        F'.obj.obj (op (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))) =
      k.hom.app (op (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))
        (((koszulHomToSignSections B S hS X U p hsep F).hom g).1)
declarations.comment: functoriality in F of the map Hom(K^p, F) ⟶ anti-invariant sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.freeActionChartSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0727], the sections half, for the quotient of an object of a big fppf site by
a free action.**  The `χ`-semi-invariant sections of an abelian sheaf `ℱ` on the spaces-étale
site of the quotient `U = V/G` over the chart `h_V` are the global sections over `U` of the
twist `ℱ ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ)`.

The chart is a `G`-torsor over the final object of that site, which is what
`CategoryTheory.IsTorsorObject.twistTensorSectionsEquiv` asks for; the final object is terminal
by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.final_isTerminal`.
declarations.statement:
def freeActionChartSectionsEquiv
    (F : Sheaf (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    characterSections (freeActionQuotientChart G B S hS V a ha)
        (freeActionChartAut G B S hS V a ha) χ F.obj ≃+
      (characterTwistTensor F.obj (freeActionChartAut G B S hS V a ha) χ
        (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha))).obj.obj
        (op (SpacesEtale.final B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha)))
declarations.comment: the identification of the chi-semi-invariant sections over the chart with the global sections of the twist, for the quotient of an object of a big fppf site by a free action of a u-small group. The source's group is finite; finiteness is not used here. The locally free rank one half is freeActionChartTwistOverIso

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.freeActionChartTwistOverIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0727], the local freeness half, for the quotient of an object of a big fppf
site by a free action.**  The twist `ℤ(χ)` on the spaces-étale site of the quotient `U = V/G`
restricts to the constant sheaf `ℤ` on the site localized at the chart `h_V`, which is the
sheaf-theoretic form of being locally free of rank one.
declarations.statement:
def freeActionChartTwistOverIso :
    (constantSheaf ((SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha)).over
        (freeActionQuotientChart G B S hS V a ha)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) ≅
      ((SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha)).overPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (freeActionQuotientChart G B S hS V a ha)).obj
        (characterTwist (freeActionQuotientChart G B S hS V a ha)
          (freeActionChartAut G B S hS V a ha) χ
          (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (actionQuotientSpace G B S hS V a ha)))
declarations.comment: the twist is locally free of rank one, for the quotient of an object of a big fppf site by a free action of a u-small group: it restricts to the constant sheaf Z on the site localized at the chart. The sections half is freeActionChartSectionsEquiv

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.characterTwistOfOrbitQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0727.** Let `W` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S` carrying a free action of
a group `G`, let `U = W/G` be the quotient of [Stacks 071S] and let `χ : G → ℤˣ` be a
character. Then there is a sheaf of `ℤ`-modules `ℤ(χ)` on the spaces-étale site of `U` which is
locally free of rank one — trivial over the covering of `U` by `W` — and satisfies

```
H⁰(W, F|_W)^χ = H⁰(U, F ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ))
```

for every abelian sheaf `F` on that site.

This is `CategoryTheory.characterTwistOfQuotient` at the spaces-étale site of `U`: the action
of `G` on `W` is free there and the quotient morphism exhibits the final object as `W/G`.
declarations.statement:
def characterTwistOfOrbitQuotient (χ : G →* ℤˣ) :
    CharacterTwistOfQuotient (orbitQuotientEtaleSource hnat hW hfree)
      (orbitQuotientAut hnat hW hfree) χ
      (SpacesEtale.topology B S hS (orbitQuotientSpace hnat hW hfree))
      (SpacesEtale.final B S hS (orbitQuotientSpace hnat hW hfree))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.IsTorsorObject.twistTensorSectionsEquiv
declarations.doc:
For a torsor `W` under a group `G` over the final object of a site and a character
`χ : G → ℤˣ`, the sections of an abelian sheaf `F` over `W` that transform according to `χ` are
the global sections of `F ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ)`, where `ℤ(χ)` is the twisted free abelian sheaf on `W`.
declarations.statement:
def twistTensorSectionsEquiv (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    characterSections W act χ F.obj ≃+ (characterTwistTensor F.obj act χ J).obj.obj (op T)
declarations.comment: the sections transforming according to the character

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.characterTwistOverIso
declarations.doc:
**The twist `ℤ(χ)` becomes constant on the localized site `Over W`**: its pullback along
`Over.forget W` is the constant sheaf with value `ℤ`. This is the sheaf-theoretic form of the
freeness of rank one of `ℤ(χ)` over a torsor.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def characterTwistOverIso (h : IsTorsorObject act J) (χ : G →* ℤˣ) :
    (constantSheaf (J.over W) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{v} ℤ)) ≅
      (J.overPullback AddCommGrpCat.{v} W).obj (characterTwist W act χ J)
declarations.comment: the twist is locally free of rank one

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.characterTwistOfQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0727.** Let `C` be a site with final object `T`, let a group `G` act freely by
automorphisms on an object `W` of `C`, let `q : W ⟶ T` exhibit `T` as the quotient `W/G` and
let `χ : G → ℤˣ` be a character. Then there is a sheaf of `ℤ`-modules `ℤ(χ)` on the base which
is locally free of rank one — trivial over the covering of the base by `W` — and satisfies
`H⁰(W, F|_W)^χ = H⁰(T, F ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ))` for every abelian sheaf `F` on the base.

That `W` is a `G`-torsor over the base is *not* assumed: it is the first sentence of the
source's proof, and is proved from freeness and the quotient identification in
`CategoryTheory.IsOrbitQuotient.isTorsorObject`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def characterTwistOfQuotient {T : C} {q : W ⟶ T} (hfree : ActsFreelyOnObject act J)
    (hq : IsOrbitQuotient act J q) (hT : IsTerminal T) (χ : G →* ℤˣ) :
    CharacterTwistOfQuotient W act χ J T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.exists_alternatingCechSignTwistedSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0728.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : U ⟶ X` be a surjective, étale and separated
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on the spaces-étale site
of `X`.  The spectral sequence of [Stacks 0725] is concentrated in the first quadrant, the row
`q = 0` of its first page is the group of `S_{p+1}`-anti-invariant sections of `ℱ` over
`W_p = U ×_X ⋯ ×_X U ∖ (all diagonals)`, and it converges to the sheaf cohomology
`H^{p+q}(X, ℱ)`.

The group of anti-invariant sections is what [Stacks 0727] identifies with
`H^0(U_p, ℱ|_{U_p} ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ_p))` for `U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}`; the higher rows of the first page are
stated here as the `Ext` groups out of `K^p` of [Stacks 0725], the quotient `U_p` of an
algebraic space by a free action of a finite group not being available.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_alternatingCechSignTwistedSpectralSequence (U : SpacesEtale B S hS X)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS U.obj.hom.hom)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS U.obj.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 2} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p) F q))) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), 0) ≃+
        characterSections (diagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep)
          (diagonalComplementAut B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep) Equiv.Perm.sign F.obj)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E
        (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H F n) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F (n : ℤ)))
declarations.comment: the row q = 0 of the E₁-page, as the S_{p+1}-anti-invariant sections of ℱ over W_p, and the convergence to H^{p+q}(X, ℱ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.exists_alternatingCechQuotientSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0728.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `f : U ⟶ X` be a surjective, étale and separated
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `ℱ` be an abelian sheaf on the spaces-étale site
of `X`. Write `W_p = U ×_X ⋯ ×_X U ∖ (all diagonals)` with `p + 1` factors, let
`U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}` and let `ℤ(χ_p)` be the rank one twist of [Stacks 0727] attached to the
sign character of `S_{p+1}`. The spectral sequence of [Stacks 0725] is concentrated in the
first quadrant, its first page is

`E₁^{p,q} = H^q(U_p, ℱ|_{U_p} ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ_p))`

in every degree `q`, and it converges to the sheaf cohomology `H^{p+q}(X, ℱ)`.

Cohomology is written as the `Ext` group out of the constant sheaf `ℤ` read in the derived
category; two conjuncts identify those groups with Mathlib's sheaf cohomology, on `X` for the
abutment and on `U_p` for the first page, and the last one identifies the coefficient sheaf on
`U_p` with the tensor product of `ℱ|_{U_p}` against the twist of [Stacks 0727]. The first
conjunct records the first page in the `Ext` form of [Stacks 0725] out of the terms
`K^p = ∧^{p+1} j_{U!} ℤ` of the Koszul complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_alternatingCechQuotientSpectralSequence
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS U.1.hom.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 2} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (zExt ((koszulComplex B S hS X U).X p) F q))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≃+
        zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS (diagonalComplementQuotient B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))
          (diagonalComplementTwistedRestriction B S hS X U hsep p F) (q : ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E
        (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of (zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F n)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H F n) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS X) F (n : ℤ)))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty (AddCommGrpCat.of
          (Sheaf.H (diagonalComplementTwistedRestriction B S hS X U hsep p F) q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of
          (zExt (constantIntSheaf B S hS (diagonalComplementQuotient B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))
            (diagonalComplementTwistedRestriction B S hS X U hsep p F) (q : ℤ)))) ∧
      ∀ p : ℕ, Nonempty (diagonalComplementTwistedRestriction B S hS X U hsep p F ≅
        (presheafToSheaf (topology B S hS (diagonalComplementQuotient B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.presheafTensor
            ((diagonalComplementQuotientRestriction B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep).obj F).obj
            (characterTwistOfDiagonalComplement B S hS X U (p + 1) hsep
              (diagonalComplementSignCharacter (p + 1))).twist.obj))
declarations.comment: the E₁-page is H^q(U_p, F|_{U_p} ⊗ Z(χ_p)) in every degree q, and the convergence to H^{p+q}(X, F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SignTwistSetup.isQuasicoherentOnSite_twist
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 072A.** With `S`, `W`, `G`, `U`, `χ` as in Stacks 0727: if `F` is a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module, then so is `F ⊗_ℤ ℤ(χ)`.

Quasi-coherence may be checked étale locally, and `ℤ(χ)` is free of rank one on a covering of
`U`; on each member of that covering a trivializing section identifies the twist with `F`
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherentOnSite_twist
    (F : Modules.{u, u + 1} B S hS h.quotient.1 h.quotient.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    (h.twist F).IsQuasicoherentOnSite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isZero_sheafH_of_isEmpty_diagonalComplement
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` and let `c : W ⟶ X` be a
surjective, étale and separated morphism from a scheme whose fibres are universally bounded in the
sense of [Stacks, Tag 03JL].  If the rows `q > 0` of the first page of the alternating Čech
spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 0728] vanish, then `H^n(X, ℱ) = 0` above the fibre bound of
`c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_sheafH_of_isEmpty_diagonalComplement (W : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (c : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.obj) (hc : IsEtale B S hS c)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS c) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS c)
    (hbound : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS W c)
    (F : Sheaf (topology B S hS X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hUpVanishing : ∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), 0 < q →
      IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt
        ((koszulComplex B S hS X (chartObj B S hS X W c hc)).X p) F q))) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, d ≤ n → IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H F n))
declarations.comment: the vanishing H^n(X, F) = 0 above the fibre bound of the chart. The bound used is the degree bound of Stacks 03JL on the fibres of the chart, which is what empties W_p and so what the source's proof uses, rather than the source's stated bound on the cardinality of the topological fibres of the chart; the degree is existentially quantified because the predicate of Stacks 03JL hides its own bound, and the emptiness of W_p above it is proved here. What the source draws from the quasi-compactness and separatedness of X and the affineness of the chart is the vanishing of the rows q > 0 of the E_1-page of Stacks 0728; that rests on the affineness of the quotients U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}, hence on Stacks 071S for a free action of a finite group on an arbitrary algebraic space, which this subtree does not state in any shape, and it is the binder hUpVanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_rightDerived_globalSectionsFunctor_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 072B.**  Let `X` be a separated algebraic space, `U` an affine scheme and
`f : U → X` a surjective étale morphism whose base changes to fields are finite locally free of
degree at most `d`.  Then `Hᵠ(X, ℱ) = 0` for every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and every
`q ≥ d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_globalSectionsFunctor_of_isSeparated
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hsepX : IsAbsolutelySeparated B S hS hZ X.1)
    (W : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hW : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj W))
    (c : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X.obj) (hc : IsEtale B S hS c) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS c)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : ∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] (T : BigFppfOver B S hS),
      ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T ≅ Spec (.of k)) →
      ∀ ξ : yoneda.obj T ⟶ X.obj,
        ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (p : V ⟶ T) (i : yoneda.obj V ⟶ yoneda.obj W) (r : ℕ),
          r ≤ d ∧ Stacks.Morphisms.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
              ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map p) r ∧
            IsPullback i (yoneda.map p) c ξ)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (q : ℕ) (hq : d ≤ q) :
    IsZero (((Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u}
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O)).rightDerived q).obj F)
declarations.comment: The reading of d as a degree bound: the base changes of f to fields have degree at most d, which is what the source's proof uses and what Lemma 69.7.3 (Tag 072C) supplies. The literal reading (at most d points in each fibre of |U| → |X|) is neither proved nor refuted here; for it the proof's step W_p = ∅ for p ≥ d fails (Spec k' → Spec k with k'/k separable quadratic: one point per fibre, degree 2), although the conclusion holds in that example. Quasi-compactness of X is implied by the affine surjection and not assumed.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient
declarations.doc:
**The choices (1)–(5) of Stacks 072C.** On a quasi-compact, quasi-separated algebraic space
`Y` over an arbitrary base scheme `S` one may choose an affine scheme `U`, a surjective étale
morphism `f : U ⟶ Y` and a universal bound on the degrees of its fibres — and then, for *every*
`p`, an affine scheme `V_p`, a surjective étale morphism `V_p ⟶ U_p` onto the quotient
`U_p = W_p/S_{p+1}` of [Stacks, Tag 0726], and a universal bound on the degrees of *its*
fibres.

The separatedness of `f`, under which `W_p` and `U_p` are formed, is produced here rather than
assumed. The source restricts `p` to `0 ≤ p ≤ d`; the restriction is dropped, which is
stronger.

Choices (1)–(3) are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers'`, and
(4)–(5) are that same statement applied to `U_p`, which is quasi-compact by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isQuasiCompactSpace_diagonalComplementQuotient` and
quasi-separated because it is *separated*, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isAbsolutelySeparated_diagonalComplementQuotient` and
[Stacks, Tag 02X3]. Separatedness of `U_p` is what the source itself records — "since `U` is
separated, the schemes `W_p` are separated, hence `U_p` is separated" — and it needs nothing of
the base, which is why the base here is an arbitrary scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ Y) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y)
        (het : IsEtale B S hS g) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS g),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U g ∧
        ∀ p : ℕ, ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
            (f : yoneda.obj V ⟶ (SpacesEtale.diagonalComplementQuotient B S hS
              ⟨Y, hY⟩ (SpacesEtale.chartObj B S hS ⟨Y, hY⟩ U g het)
              (p + 1) hsep).obj),
          IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) ∧
            (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
              (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf f ∧
            IsEtale B S hS f ∧
            HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS V f
declarations.comment: parts (4)-(5), together with parts (1)-(3) restated, for Y a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over an arbitrary base scheme S: an affine scheme V_p, a surjective etale morphism V_p -> U_p onto the quotient U_p = W_p/S_{p+1} of Tag 0726, and an integer bounding the degrees of its fibres, for every p -- the source's range 0 <= p <= d being dropped, which is stronger. The integer max(d_p + p) is formed at AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_bound_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient; the vanishing these choices feed is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafH_of_boundsFibreDegrees_of_diagonalComplementQuotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafH_of_boundsFibreDegrees_of_diagonalComplementQuotient
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 072C]: the vanishing from the choices (1)–(5).**  Let `S` be a scheme and let
`X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S`.  Suppose given

1. an affine scheme `U`,
2. a surjective étale morphism `f : U ⟶ X`,
3. an integer `d` bounding the degrees of the fibres of `f`,
4. for every `p = 0, 1, …, d` a surjective étale morphism `V_p ⟶ U_p` from an affine scheme
   `V_p`, where `U_p = W_{p+1}/S_{p+1}` is the quotient of [Stacks, Tag 0726], and
5. an integer `d_p` bounding the degrees of the fibres of `V_p ⟶ U_p`.

Then `H^q(X, ℱ) = 0` for every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and every `q ≥ max (d_p + p)`.

The bounds `d` and `d_p` are integers, as in the source, and the condition `q ≥ max (d_p + p)` is
stated as `d_p + p ≤ q` for every `0 ≤ p ≤ d`.  The vanishing is read on the spaces-étale site
of `X`, as the sheaf cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf of `ℱ`.

The quotients `U_p` are formed under the separatedness of `f`, so the choices (4)–(5) in
`hdata` are stated for every proof `hsep` of it.  This assumes nothing: `f` is separated because
`U` is affine, and the proof derives `hsep` itself, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_isEtale_of_scheme_isSeparated`, before using `hdata`.
No hypothesis is a result of the source; the choices (1)–(5) themselves exist by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient`.

The proof is the source's: the alternating Čech spectral sequence of [Stacks, Tag 0728] for `f`
has its `E₁`-page zero in the columns `p ≥ d`, because `W_{p+1}` is empty there, and its column
`p < d` zero in the degrees `q ≥ d_p`, by [Stacks, Tag 072B] applied to the separated space
`U_p` through
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SpacesEtale.isZero_zExt_koszulComplex_X_of_chart_over_quotient`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_sheafH_of_boundsFibreDegrees_of_diagonalComplementQuotient
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.obj)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.obj)
    (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (hU : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
    (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f) (hfsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f)
    (d : ℤ) (hd : BoundsFibreDegrees B S hS U f d) (dp : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hdata : ∀ (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f) (p : ℕ), (p : ℤ) ≤ d →
      ∃ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS)
        (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ (SpacesEtale.diagonalComplementQuotient B S hS X
          (SpacesEtale.chartObj B S hS X U f hf) (p + 1) hsep).obj),
        IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V) ∧
          IsEtale B S hS g ∧ IsSurjective B S hS g ∧
          BoundsFibreDegrees B S hS V g (dp p))
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (SpacesEtale.spacesEtaleRing B S hS X))
    (hM : M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : ∀ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) ≤ d → dp p + p ≤ n) :
    IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (SpacesEtale.spacesEtaleRing B S hS X)).obj M) n))
declarations.comment: the moreover clause, with the source's explicit bound: for X a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over a scheme S and any choices (1)-(5) -- an affine U with a surjective etale U -> X, an integer d bounding its fibre degrees, and for each 0 <= p <= d an affine V_p with a surjective etale V_p -> U_p = W_{p+1}/S_{p+1} and an integer d_p bounding its fibre degrees -- H^q(X, F) = 0 for every quasi-coherent O_X-module F and every q >= max(d_p + p). Cohomology is that of the underlying abelian sheaf of F on the spaces-etale site of X. The existence of the choices (1)-(5) is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_forall_isZero_sheafH_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_072C
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 072C], end to end.**  Let `S` be a scheme and let `X` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated algebraic space over `S`.  Then there is a single degree `N` beyond which the
cohomology of `X` with quasi-coherent coefficients vanishes:

`H^q(X, ℱ) = 0` for every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and every `q ≥ N`.

The base is an arbitrary scheme, as in the source.  This is the five choices of the tag,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_diagonalComplementQuotient`, fed
into the vanishing they give,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafH_of_data_072C`, with `N` the source's `max (d_p + p)`
over `0 ≤ p ≤ d`; the two fibre bounds are produced as integers by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasUniversallyBoundedFibers` and enlarged to natural numbers by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.BoundsFibreDegrees.mono`.  The uniformity in `ℱ` — one degree for all
quasi-coherent coefficients at once — is what the tag asserts and is what makes the Euler
characteristic of a coherent module a finite alternating sum.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_forall_isZero_sheafH_of_isQuasiCompactSpace_072C
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.obj)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X.obj) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (SpacesEtale.spacesEtaleRing B S hS X)),
      M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite → ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
        IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} (SpacesEtale.spacesEtaleRing B S hS X)).obj M) n))
declarations.comment: the tag end to end, over an arbitrary base scheme S: for X a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over S there is a single degree N beyond which the sheaf cohomology on the spaces-etale site of X of the underlying abelian sheaf of every quasi-coherent module vanishes. N is constructed in the proof as the source's max(d_p + p) for the choices (1)-(5) made there; the statement quantifies N existentially, and the vanishing at that maximum, for any choices (1)-(5), is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_sheafH_of_boundsFibreDegrees_of_diagonalComplementQuotient

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers
declarations.doc:
**The choices (1)–(3) of Stacks 072C.** A quasi-compact, quasi-separated algebraic space
carries a surjective étale morphism from an affine scheme whose fibres are universally bounded
in the sense of Stacks 03JL.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hA X)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B (Spec (.of A)) hA hZ X) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hA) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B (Spec (.of A)) hA).obj U) ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B (Spec (.of A)) hA)).presheaf g ∧
        IsEtale B (Spec (.of A)) hA g ∧
        HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B (Spec (.of A)) hA U g
declarations.comment: parts (1)-(3): an affine scheme U, a surjective étale morphism U ⟶ X, and an integer bounding the degrees of its fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers'
declarations.doc:
**The choices (1)–(3) of Stacks 072C.** A quasi-compact, quasi-separated algebraic space
over an arbitrary base scheme `S` carries a surjective étale morphism from an affine scheme
whose fibres are universally bounded in the sense of Stacks 03JL.

The base is an arbitrary scheme, as in the source: nothing in the two inputs — the affine étale
chart of [Stacks, Tag 03H6] and the chain `(η) ⇒ (ζ) ⇒ (ε) ⇒ (δ)` of [Stacks, Tag 03JX] —
restricts it, and quasi-separatedness is taken in the absolute form of [Stacks, Tag 03BS]
part (3), which does not mention `S` either.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_affine_etale_surjective_cover_hasUniversallyBoundedFibers'
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X)
    (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
      IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) ∧
        (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
          (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf g ∧
        IsEtale B S hS g ∧
        HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS U g
declarations.comment: parts (1)-(3): an affine scheme U, a surjective étale morphism U ⟶ X, and an integer bounding the degrees of its fibres, for X a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over an arbitrary base scheme S

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exists_pushforwardSpectralSequenceData
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳` and `g : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be `1`-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids over the
big fppf site of `S`, with `f` faithful, with equalizers in `𝒰` and with the image of `f` covering
`𝒳` locally for the topology `τ`. For an abelian sheaf `𝓕` on `𝒳_τ` there is a first-quadrant
spectral sequence of abelian sheaves on `𝒴_τ` with first page `E₁^{i,j} = Rʲ(g ∘ fᵢ)_* fᵢ⁻¹𝓕`
abutting to `Rⁱ⁺ʲ g_* 𝓕`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_pushforwardSpectralSequenceData
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hr : r.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f) (hg : q.IsFibredOneMorphism r g)
    [f.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒰]
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (k : y ⟶ x), R k → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS r τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasSheafify
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) τ)
        AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [∀ P : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a},
      g.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension P]
    [∀ (n : ℕ) (P : (Tuple q f n)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}),
      (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension P]
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}) :
    Nonempty (PushforwardSpectralSequenceData (B := B) (S := S) (hS := hS)
      (q := q) (r := r) (f := f) (g := g) (τ := τ) 𝓕)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.nonempty_modulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 072E.** Let `f : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳` and `g : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be `1`-morphisms of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`, with `f` faithful, with equalizers in `𝒰` and with the
image of `f` covering `𝒳` locally for the topology `τ`. For a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules `𝓕` on
`𝒳_τ` there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence of sheaves of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules on `𝒴_τ` with
first page `E₁^{i,j} = Rʲ(g ∘ fᵢ)_* fᵢ⁻¹𝓕` abutting to `Rⁱ⁺ʲ g_* 𝓕`, all higher direct images
being computed in the `τ`-topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_modulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData
    [f.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒰]
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (k : y ⟶ x), R k → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    (𝓕 : SheafOfModules.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a} (moduleRingSheaf B S hS q hq τ)) :
    Nonempty (ModulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData.{u, v₁, v₂, v₃, w₁, w₂, w₃, a}
      B S hS p q r f g τ hp hq hr hf hg 𝓕)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeCech.exists_modulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒰 ⥤ 𝒳` and `g : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be `1`-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids over the
big fppf site of `S`, with `f` faithful, with equalizers in `𝒰` and with the image of `f` covering
`𝒳` locally for the topology `τ`. For a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules `𝓕` on `𝒳_τ` there is a
first-quadrant spectral sequence of sheaves of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules on `𝒴_τ` with first page
`E₁^{i,j} = Rʲ(g ∘ fᵢ)_* fᵢ⁻¹𝓕` abutting to `Rⁱ⁺ʲ g_* 𝓕`, all higher direct images being computed
in the `τ`-topology.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_modulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData
    [f.Faithful] [HasEqualizers 𝒰]
    (hcover : ∀ x : 𝒳, ∃ R : Presieve x,
      Sieve.generate R ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ x ∧
        ∀ ⦃y : 𝒳⦄ (k : y ⟶ x), R k → ∃ z : 𝒰, Nonempty (y ≅ f.obj z))
    (hRightAdjoint : ∀ n : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.pushforward.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.ringStructureSheafCoreHom B S hS
        (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) q (Tuple.projection q f n) (B.baseTopology τ)
        (tupleProjection_comp_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p q f hp hq hf n) hq rfl
        (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ)).hom).IsRightAdjoint)
    [∀ (n : ℕ) (G : (Tuple q f n)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}),
      (Tuple.projection q f n).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension G]
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [(AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS q τ).WEqualsLocallyBijective
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS r τ)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [(AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS r τ).WEqualsLocallyBijective
      AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [∀ n : ℕ, HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
      (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) τ) AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [∀ n : ℕ, (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
      (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q) τ).WEqualsLocallyBijective
        AddCommGrpCat.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}]
    [∀ n : ℕ, EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a}
      (moduleRingSheaf B S hS (Tuple.projection q f n ⋙ q)
        (tupleProjection_comp_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p q f hp hq hf n) τ))]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a} (moduleRingSheaf B S hS q hq τ))]
    (𝓕 : SheafOfModules.{max u v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a} (moduleRingSheaf B S hS q hq τ)) :
    Nonempty (ModulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData.{u, v₁, v₂, v₃, w₁, w₂, w₃, a}
      B S hS p q r f g τ hp hq hr hf hg 𝓕)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_etaleDirectImageSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` and `g : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be composable `1`-morphisms of algebraic stacks and assume `f`
is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and smooth. For an abelian sheaf `𝓕` on the étale
site of `𝒳` there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence of abelian sheaves on the étale site of `𝒴`
`E₁^{p,q} = R^q (g ∘ fₚ)_* fₚ⁻¹𝓕 ⇒ R^{p+q} g_* 𝓕`,
all higher direct images computed in the étale topology, where `𝒰ₚ` is the degree `p` term of the
relative Čech nerve of `f`, that is the `(p+1)`-fold fibre product of `𝒰` over `𝒳`, and `fₚ` its
projection to `𝒳`. The first page, the first-quadrant vanishing and the abutment are the fields of
`Stacks.RelativeCech.PushforwardSpectralSequenceData`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleDirectImageSpectralSequence
    (hrep : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hsmooth : IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p SiteKind.etale)
      AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.RelativeCech.PushforwardSpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom) SiteKind.etale 𝓕)
declarations.comment: part (1)(a): spectral sequence in Ab(𝒴_étale) along a smooth surjective presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_etaleModuleDirectImageSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` and `g : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be composable `1`-morphisms of algebraic stacks and assume `f`
is representable by algebraic spaces, surjective and smooth. For a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules `𝓕` on
the étale site of `𝒳` there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence of sheaves of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules on
the étale site of `𝒴`
`E₁^{p,q} = R^q (g ∘ fₚ)_* fₚ⁻¹𝓕 ⇒ R^{p+q} g_* 𝓕`,
all higher direct images computed in sheaves of modules for the étale topology, where `𝒰ₚ` is the
degree `p` term of the relative Čech nerve of `f` and `fₚ` its projection to `𝒳`. The first page,
the first-quadrant vanishing and the abutment are the fields of
`Stacks.RelativeCech.ModulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleModuleDirectImageSpectralSequence
    (hrep : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hsmooth : IsSmooth B S hS f)
    (𝓕 : SheafOfModules.{max (u + 1) a} (Stacks.RelativeCech.moduleRingSheaf B S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.etale)) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.RelativeCech.ModulePushforwardSpectralSequenceData.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1,
      u, u, u, a} B S hS 𝒰.val.val.p 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)
      SiteKind.etale 𝒰.val.isFiberedInGroupoids 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
      𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
      (Functor.isFibredOneMorphism_of_isFiberedInGroupoids 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
        f.hom.hom.w)
      (Functor.isFibredOneMorphism_of_isFiberedInGroupoids 𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
        g.hom.hom.w) 𝓕)
declarations.comment: part (1)(b): spectral sequence in Mod(𝒴_étale, 𝒪_𝒴) along a smooth surjective presentation
