declarations.name: Algebra.IsCentralSimple.isSquare_finrank
declarations.doc: The dimension of a central simple algebra is a perfect square.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSquare_finrank [IsSimpleRing A] [Algebra.IsCentral K A] [FiniteDimensional K A] :
    IsSquare (Module.finrank K A)

declarations.name: skolemNoether
declarations.doc:
**Skolem–Noether**: two algebra homomorphisms from a simple algebra to a
finite-dimensional central simple algebra are conjugate by a unit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem skolemNoether (K : Type u) (A B : Type v) [Field K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A]
    [Module.Finite K A] [Algebra.IsCentral K A] [IsSimpleRing A]
    [Ring B] [Algebra K B] [IsSimpleRing B] (f g : B →ₐ[K] A) :
    ∃ x : Aˣ, ∀ b : B, g b = x * f b * x⁻¹

declarations.name: skolemNoether'
declarations.statement:
public theorem skolemNoether' (K : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A]
    [Module.Finite K A] [Algebra.IsCentral K A] [IsSimpleRing A] (e : A ≃ₐ[K] A) :
    ∃ x : Aˣ, ∀ a : A, e a = x * a * x⁻¹

declarations.name: Subalgebra.centralizer_isSimple
declarations.doc:
The centralizer of a simple subalgebra of a finite-dimensional central simple algebra is
simple.
declarations.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.centralizer_isSimple [FiniteDimensional F A] (B : Subalgebra F A)
    [IsSimpleRing B] :
    IsSimpleRing (Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A))
declarations.comment: first part

declarations.name: Subalgebra.finrank_centralizer_mul_finrank
declarations.doc:
The dimension of the centralizer of a simple subalgebra `B` of a finite-dimensional
central simple algebra `A` satisfies `dim C_A(B) * dim B = dim A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.finrank_centralizer_mul_finrank [FiniteDimensional F A]
    (B : Subalgebra F A) [IsSimpleRing B] :
    Module.finrank F (Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A)) * Module.finrank F B =
      Module.finrank F A
declarations.comment: second part

declarations.name: Subalgebra.centralizer_centralizer
declarations.doc:
The double centralizer theorem: in a finite-dimensional central simple algebra `A`, the
centralizer of the centralizer of a simple subalgebra `B` is `B` itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.centralizer_centralizer [FiniteDimensional F A] (B : Subalgebra F A)
    [IsSimpleRing B] :
    Subalgebra.centralizer F (Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A) : Set A) = B
declarations.comment: third part

declarations.name: Subalgebra.tensorCentralizerEquiv
declarations.doc:
A finite-dimensional central simple algebra decomposes as the tensor product of any
central simple subalgebra and its centralizer.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def Subalgebra.tensorCentralizerEquiv [FiniteDimensional F A]
    (B : Subalgebra F A) [IsSimpleRing B] [Algebra.IsCentral F B] :
    A ≃ₐ[F] B ⊗[F] Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A)

declarations.name: Subalgebra.isCentral_isSimpleRing_centralizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 074U**, parenthetical claim: the centralizer `C` of a central simple subalgebra `B`
of a finite-dimensional central simple algebra `A` is central simple. Together with
`Subalgebra.tensorCentralizerEquiv` (`A ≅ B ⊗[F] C`) this is the whole lemma.
declarations.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.isCentral_isSimpleRing_centralizer (B : Subalgebra F A) [IsSimpleRing B]
    [Algebra.IsCentral F B] :
    Algebra.IsCentral F (Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A)) ∧
      IsSimpleRing (Subalgebra.centralizer F (B : Set A))
declarations.comment: the centralizer is central simple

declarations.name: Subalgebra.maximal_comm_iff_self_centralizer
declarations.statement:
lemma Subalgebra.maximal_comm_iff_self_centralizer (L : Subalgebra k A) :
    Maximal (fun S : Subalgebra k A ↦ IsMulCommutative S) L ↔
      Subalgebra.centralizer k L = L
declarations.comment: (ii) ↔ (iii)

declarations.name: Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank
declarations.statement:
lemma Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank [Module.Finite F A] (L : Subalgebra F A)
    [IsMulCommutative L] [IsSimpleRing L] :
    Subalgebra.centralizer F (L : Set A) = L ↔
      Module.finrank F A = Module.finrank F L * Module.finrank F L

declarations.name: Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank
declarations.statement:
lemma Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank [Module.Finite F A] (L : Subalgebra F A)
    [IsMulCommutative L] [IsSimpleRing L] :
    Subalgebra.centralizer F (L : Set A) = L ↔
      Module.finrank F A = Module.finrank F L * Module.finrank F L

declarations.name: Subalgebra.finrank_eq_finrank_sq_of_maximal_isField
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 074W**: the dimension of a finite-dimensional central division algebra `D` over
`k` is the square of the dimension of any maximal subfield `K ⊆ D`.

A subfield is a subalgebra that is a field, and `K` is maximal among those. Every commutative
subalgebra of `D` is a field (`Subalgebra.isField_iff_isMulCommutative`), so `K` is a maximal
commutative subalgebra, hence self-centralizing (074V (iii) ⇒ (ii),
`Subalgebra.maximal_comm_iff_self_centralizer`), and 074V (ii) ⇒ (i)
(`Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank`) gives the dimension count.
declarations.statement:
theorem Subalgebra.finrank_eq_finrank_sq_of_maximal_isField [FiniteDimensional k D]
    [Algebra.IsCentral k D] (K : Subalgebra k D)
    (hK : Maximal (fun S : Subalgebra k D ↦ IsField S) K) :
    Module.finrank k D = Module.finrank k K ^ 2
declarations.comment: maximal subfield: `K` maximal among subalgebras of `D` that are fields; the conclusion `[D : k] = [K : k]^2` as `finrank k D = finrank k K ^ 2`

declarations.name: Algebra.IsSplit
declarations.doc:
A field extension `L` of `K` *splits* a `K`-algebra `A` if `L ⊗[K] A` is isomorphic
to a (nontrivial) matrix algebra over `L`.
declarations.statement: def IsSplit (L : Type w) [CommRing L] [Algebra K L] : Prop

declarations.name: Algebra.IsSplit.exists_embedding
declarations.doc:
**Every finite splitting field embeds into a representative of the Brauer class**: if a
finite extension `L/K` splits the central simple algebra `A`, then the class of `A` has a
representative `B` of dimension `[L : K]²` receiving a `K`-algebra embedding of `L`. This is
the converse of `Algebra.IsCentralSimple.split_of_finrank`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_embedding {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra K A] [FiniteDimensional K A]
    [IsSimpleRing A] [Algebra.IsCentral K A] [FiniteDimensional K L]
    (hs : Algebra.IsSplit K A L) :
    ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : Ring B) (_ : Algebra K B) (_ : FiniteDimensional K B)
      (_ : IsSimpleRing B) (_ : Algebra.IsCentral K B) (_ : L →ₐ[K] B),
      BrauerGroup.mk K B = BrauerGroup.mk K A ∧
      Module.finrank K B = Module.finrank K L ^ 2

declarations.name: Algebra.isSplit_iff_exists_similar
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 074Z**, in full. For a *finite* extension `L/K` and a finite central simple
`K`-algebra `A`, the following are equivalent:

1. `L` splits `A`;
2. some finite central simple algebra `B` similar to `A` contains `L` and has
   `[B : K] = [L : K]²`.

Forwards is `Algebra.IsSplit.exists_embedding`. Backwards combines
`Algebra.IsCentralSimple.split_of_finrank` — which gives that `L` splits the *representative*
`B` it is embedded in — with `Algebra.isSplit_congr`, which transports splitting along the
similarity `B ∼ A`. Note the `pow_two` shuffle: the tag writes the dimension as a square,
`split_of_finrank` as a product.
declarations.statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.isSplit_iff_exists_similar {A : Type u} [Ring A] [Algebra K A]
    [FiniteDimensional K A] [IsSimpleRing A] [Algebra.IsCentral K A] [FiniteDimensional K L] :
    Algebra.IsSplit K A L ↔
      ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : Ring B) (_ : Algebra K B) (_ : FiniteDimensional K B)
        (_ : IsSimpleRing B) (_ : Algebra.IsCentral K B) (_ : L →ₐ[K] B),
        BrauerGroup.mk K B = BrauerGroup.mk K A ∧
        Module.finrank K B = Module.finrank K L ^ 2

declarations.name: DivisionRing.isSplit_of_maximal_comm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0750**: a maximal subfield of a finite central division algebra `D` over `k` is a
splitting field for `D`.

"Maximal subfield" is rendered as a subalgebra maximal among the *commutative* subalgebras.
That is the same notion here: every subalgebra of a finite-dimensional division algebra is a
division ring, and every commutative one is a field (`Subalgebra.fieldOfIsMulCommutative`), so
the commutative subalgebras of `D` are exactly its subfields.

Maximality is stated with `Maximal` rather than through the numerical criterion
`Subalgebra.isMaximal_comm_iff_finrank`; the latter is 074V/074W content, and using it here
would make the statement circular with its own proof.
declarations.statement:
theorem DivisionRing.isSplit_of_maximal_comm (L : Subalgebra k D) [IsMulCommutative L]
    (hL : Maximal (fun S : Subalgebra k D ↦ IsMulCommutative S) L) :
    Algebra.IsSplit k D L

declarations.name: Algebra.IsSplit.degree_dvd_finrank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0751**: for a finite central division algebra `D` over `k` with `d² = [D : k]`,
the degree `d` *divides* `[L : k]` for every finite splitting field `L` of `D`.

Note this is genuinely stronger than `d ≤ [L : k]`. The divisibility is what the dimension
count actually produces — the cofactor is `finrank D (Fin m → L)` for the column module of
the splitting — so the `≤` form is the corollary, not the other way round.

The division hypothesis is essential, as for `DivisionRing.split_iff_finrank`: `M₂(k)` is
split by `L = k` with `degree k M₂(k) = 2` and `finrank k k = 1`, and `2 ∤ 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Algebra.IsSplit.degree_dvd_finrank {D : Type*} [DivisionRing D] [Algebra k D]
    [Module.Finite k D] [Algebra.IsCentral k D] [Module.Finite k L]
    (h : Algebra.IsSplit k D L) : degree k D ∣ Module.finrank k L

declarations.name: DivisionRing.exists_separable_maxSubfield
declarations.doc:
**Koethe's theorem**: a finite-dimensional central division algebra `D` over a field `k`
contains a *separable maximal subfield*, stated here as: there is a commutative subalgebra
`L` that is self-centralizing — equivalently maximal commutative, by
`Subalgebra.maximal_comm_iff_self_centralizer` — and separable over `k`. Commutativity of
`L` follows from self-centralizing-ness via `Subalgebra.le_centralizer_iff_isMulCommutative`.

Proof strategy:

1. By Zorn's lemma, pick `L` maximal among commutative separable subalgebras of `D`
   (directed suprema preserve both properties).
2. Suppose `L` is not self-centralizing and let `C ≠ L` be its centralizer. Then `C` is a
   division ring (`Subalgebra.divisionRingOfFinite`), finite-dimensional over the field `L`
   (`Subalgebra.fieldOfIsMulCommutative`), and *central* over `L`: by the double centralizer
   theorem, `Z(C) = C ∩ C_D(C) = C ∩ L = L` (the scoped instance
   `Subalgebra.isCentral_centralizer`).
3. By the Jacobson–Noether theorem (`exists_separable_and_not_isCentral'`) applied to the
   noncommutative division algebra `C` over `L`, there is `x ∈ C \ L` separable over `L`.
4. `L' := k[L, x]` is commutative (since `x` centralizes `L`) and separable over `k` — it is
   generated over `L` by the single separable element `x`, and separability is transitive in
   the tower `k ⊆ L ⊆ L'` (`JacobsonNoether.adjoin_insert_mem_S`).
5. So `L'` is a member of the Zorn family strictly containing `L`, contradicting maximality.
declarations.statement:
theorem DivisionRing.exists_separable_maxSubfield [FiniteDimensional k D]
    [Algebra.IsCentral k D] :
    ∃ L : Subalgebra k D, Subalgebra.centralizer k (L : Set D) = L ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable k L
declarations.comment: the separable maximal subfield

declarations.name: Algebra.IsCentralSimple.exists_finite_sep_split
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0752**, the "in particular" clause: every Brauer class has a finite separable
splitting field. Concretely, every finite central simple `k`-algebra is split by a finite
separable subextension of any chosen algebraic closure.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IsCentralSimple.exists_finite_sep_split :
    ∃ K : IntermediateField k k_bar, Module.Finite k K ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable k K ∧ Algebra.IsSplit k A K
declarations.comment: in particular: every Brauer class has a finite separable splitting field

declarations.name: Algebra.IsSplit.matrix_size_eq_degree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0753**, closing sentence: the matrix size in *any* splitting of `A` is the degree
of `A`. This is what licenses calling it "the" integer `d` — clauses (3), (4) and (5) of
`Algebra.isCentralSimple_tfae` each quantify their own witness, and this identifies them all
with `Algebra.IsCentralSimple.degree k A`.

No central-simple hypotheses are needed: a splitting already forces `finrank k A = n * n`,
and `degree` is by definition `Nat.sqrt` of that. In the tag's setting `A` is of course
central simple, but the identification of the witness does not depend on it.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IsSplit.matrix_size_eq_degree (L : Type w) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    {n : ℕ} (e : L ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[L] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) L) :
    n = Algebra.IsCentralSimple.degree k A
declarations.comment: the integer d is called the degree of A

declarations.name: Algebra.isCentralSimple_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0753**: for a `k`-algebra `A` the following are equivalent.

1. `A` is a finite central simple `k`-algebra.
2. `A` is a finite-dimensional `k`-vector space, `k` is the centre of `A`, and `A` has no
   nontrivial two-sided ideal.
3. `A ⊗ k̄` is a matrix algebra over `k̄`.
4. `A ⊗ kˢᵉᵖ` is a matrix algebra over `kˢᵉᵖ`.
5. `A ⊗ k'` is a matrix algebra over `k'` for some finite Galois `k'/k`.
6. `A ≅ Mat(n, K)` for some `n ≥ 1` and some finite central division algebra `K` over `k`.

The proof is a star around (1): each of (2)–(6) is proved equivalent to (1) directly. The
forward directions are the splitting constructions of §11.08; the return directions
(3) ⇒ (1), (4) ⇒ (1), (5) ⇒ (1) all factor through
`Algebra.IsSplit.finite_central_simple`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.isCentralSimple_tfae (k_bar : Type w) [Field k_bar] [Algebra k k_bar]
    [IsAlgClosed k_bar] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k k_bar] :
    [ Module.Finite k A ∧ Algebra.IsCentral k A ∧ IsSimpleRing A,
      Module.Finite k A ∧ Subalgebra.center k A = ⊥ ∧ IsSimpleOrder (TwoSidedIdeal A),
      Algebra.IsSplit k A k_bar,
      Algebra.IsSplit k A (separableClosure k k_bar),
      ∃ K : IntermediateField k k_bar, Module.Finite k K ∧ IsGalois k K ∧ Algebra.IsSplit k A K,
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : NeZero n) (D : Type v) (_ : DivisionRing D) (_ : Algebra k D)
        (_ : Module.Finite k D) (_ : Algebra.IsCentral k D),
        Nonempty (A ≃ₐ[k] Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) D) ].TFAE

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0754**, conditions (1)–(4): a *weak Serre subcategory* is a strictly full subcategory
which contains `0` and is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions.

`prop_obj₂_of_exact` shows this satisfies the definition in 02MO (2).
declarations.statement:
class IsWeakSerreClass : Prop extends P.ContainsZero, P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms,
    P.IsClosedUnderKernels, P.IsClosedUnderCokernels, P.IsClosedUnderExtensions
declarations.comment: conditions (1)-(4), as the definition

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.abelian_of_isWeakSerreClass
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0754**, "moreover": a weak Serre subcategory is an abelian category.
declarations.statement: lemma abelian_of_isWeakSerreClass : Nonempty (Abelian P.FullSubcategory)
declarations.comment: moreover: a weak Serre subcategory is abelian

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0754**, "moreover": the inclusion functor is exact, here its left exactness.
declarations.statement: lemma preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass : PreservesFiniteLimits P.ι
declarations.comment: moreover: the inclusion functor preserves finite limits

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0754**, "moreover": the inclusion functor is exact, here its right exactness.
declarations.statement: lemma preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass : PreservesFiniteColimits P.ι
declarations.comment: moreover: the inclusion functor preserves finite colimits

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isWeakSerreClass_iff_prop_obj₂_of_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0754.** The closure conditions defining `IsWeakSerreClass` are equivalent to the
definition of a weak Serre subcategory in 02MO (2): being nonempty and containing the middle term
of every five term exact sequence whose other four terms belong to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerreClass_iff_prop_obj₂_of_exact :
    P.IsWeakSerreClass ↔ (∃ X, P X) ∧
      ∀ S : ComposableArrows C 4, S.Exact → P (S.obj' 0) → P (S.obj' 1) →
        P (S.obj' 3) → P (S.obj' 4) → P (S.obj' 2)

declarations.comment: topology_parasitic_vanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohomology_isZero_of_isParasiticFor_fppf
declarations.doc:
Vanishing on objects flat and locally of finite presentation over the
base in the big fppf site.
declarations.statement:
public theorem cohomology_isZero_of_isParasiticFor_fppf
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {𝒪 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) RingCat.{u}}
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} 𝒪)
    (hG : ∀ E : Covering (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS),
      IsIso (((Over.post B.inclusion).obj E.1).hom) →
      AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsCovering B S hS E →
      ∀ i : E.2.I₀, Subsingleton (G.val.obj (Opposite.op (E.2.X i))))
    (U : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hU : Flat ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj U).hom ∧
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj U).hom)
    (p : ℕ) :
    IsZero (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj G).H' p U)
declarations.comment: topology_parasitic_vanishing

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasitic
declarations.doc:
**A morphism of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big fppf site over `S` whose kernel and
cokernel are parasitic induces isomorphisms `H^p(U, ℱ) → H^p(U, 𝒢)` at every object `U` flat
over `S`.**

This is the step of Stacks 0756 which rests on Stacks 0755: the kernel and the cokernel have
vanishing cohomology at `U` by `AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_isZero_of_isParasitic`, and
a morphism with that property is an isomorphism on cohomology. The source lemma then identifies
`H^p(U, ℱ)` with the small-site cohomology `H^p(U, 𝒢|_{U_τ})` by Stacks 03DW, which this
statement does not assert.

The parasitic hypotheses are the pointwise expansion of `AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasitic`, as in
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_isZero_of_isParasitic`, and the kernel and cokernel are
those of the category of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules.

The clause string says which step this is.  Its hypotheses are part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 06ZL] —
vanishing at every object flat over `S`, finite presentation not assumed — whereas 0756 derives
part (1), vanishing at the objects flat *and locally of finite presentation* over `S`.  The step
in that second form is `AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasiticFor`
below, which carries the same tag with a clause string naming it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasitic
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [(AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {𝒪 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) RingCat.{u}}
    {F G : SheafOfModules.{u} 𝒪} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hker : ∀ X : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS,
      Flat ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj X).hom →
        Subsingleton ((kernel φ).val.obj (Opposite.op X)))
    (hcoker : ∀ X : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS,
      Flat ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj X).hom →
        Subsingleton ((cokernel φ).val.obj (Opposite.op X)))
    (U : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hU : Flat ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj U).hom) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Stacks.Cohomology.LongExactSequence.map.{w}
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf 𝒪).map φ) p U)
declarations.comment: cohomology comparison step, from Tag 0755

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasiticFor
declarations.doc:
**A morphism of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big fppf site over `S` whose kernel and
cokernel are parasitic for the fppf topology induces isomorphisms `H^p(U, ℱ) → H^p(U, 𝒢)` at
every object `U` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`.**

This is the step of [Stacks, Tag 0756] which rests on [Stacks, Tag 0755], in the form 0756 uses
it: the kernel and the cokernel have vanishing cohomology at `U` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.cohomology_isZero_of_isParasiticFor_fppf`, which is part (1) of 0755, and a
morphism with that property is an isomorphism on cohomology by
`Stacks.Cohomology.LongExactSequence.bijective_map_of_subsingleton_kernel_cokernel`.

The hypotheses are `AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasiticFor`, part (2) of [Stacks, Tag 06ZL], for the
fppf coverings of `S`: vanishing on the members of fppf coverings of the base, which are exactly
the objects flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`.  They are what 0756 derives from
its assumptions (1) and (2), and they are weaker than the `AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasitic` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasitic`, which asks for vanishing at
every flat object, finite presentation not assumed.  Correspondingly the conclusion here is at
the objects flat and locally of finite presentation, which is where 0756 states it.

This is the form with parasiticity hypothesised, which is what an arbitrary morphism needs.  For
a morphism which is an isomorphism on sections over every such object the two hypotheses are
themselves theorems, and the resulting statement is
`AlgebraicGeometry.bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isIso_sections`
(`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Descent.Parasitic.FlatCohomologySectionwiseIso`).  The
identification of `H^p(U, ℱ)` with the small-site cohomology `H^p(U, 𝒢|_{U_τ})`, which is the
conclusion of 0756, is established at `τ = Zariski` and `U = S` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.zariskiSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv`
(`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Descent.Parasitic.FlatCohomologySmallSiteComparison`).
declarations.statement:
public theorem bigFppfCohomology_map_bijective_of_isParasiticFor
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [(AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    {𝒪 : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) RingCat.{u}}
    {F G : SheafOfModules.{u} 𝒪} (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hker : AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasiticFor S (Over.post B.inclusion)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsCovering B S hS) (kernel φ).val)
    (hcoker : AlgebraicGeometry.IsParasiticFor S (Over.post B.inclusion)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.IsCovering B S hS) (cokernel φ).val)
    (U : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hU : Flat ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj U).hom ∧
      LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((Over.post B.inclusion).obj U).hom) (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (Stacks.Cohomology.LongExactSequence.map.{w}
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf 𝒪).map φ) p U)
declarations.comment: cohomology comparison step, from Tag 0755, at the objects flat and locally of finite presentation over S, which is the shape 0756 uses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallEtaleSiteCohomologyAddEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0756] at `τ = étale`.**  Let `B` be a big fppf site, `S` a
scheme below its cutoff and `𝒢` a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules on `(Sch/S)_fppf` such that

1. `𝒢|_{S_étale}` is quasi-coherent on the small étale site of `S`, and
2. for every object of `(Sch/S)_fppf` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`, with
   structure morphism `g : X ⟶ S`, the canonical map `ε_g^*(𝒢|_{S_étale}) ⟶ 𝒢|_{X_étale}` of
   `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.etaleClause2Map` is an isomorphism; this is the adjoint
   transpose of the restriction map `𝒢|_{S_étale} ⟶ ε_{g,*}(𝒢|_{X_étale})` by
   `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.etaleClause2Map_eq_homEquiv_symm`.

Then for **every** object `U` of `(Sch/S)_fppf` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`,
with scheme `X`, and every `p`,

```
H^p(U, 𝒢)  ≅  H^p(U, 𝒢|_{U_étale}).
```

The left-hand side is global cohomology of `𝒢|_{(Sch/X)_fppf}` on the big fppf site of `X`,
which is the reading of cohomology over an object that
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv` fixes at `τ = Zariski`; the
right-hand side is the cohomology of the size-bounded small étale site of `X` of
[Stacks, Tag 021B] with values in the restriction of `𝒢` along
`a_X : ((Sch/X)_fppf, 𝒪) ⟶ (X_étale, 𝒪)`.

The attribute records the topology: this is the tag at `τ = étale`.  See
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv` for the tag at
`τ = Zariski`.
declarations.statement:
public def flatSmallEtaleSiteCohomologyAddEquiv (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheaf B (objScheme B S hS U)
        (contains_objScheme B S hS U))).obj ((objRestrict B S hS U).obj G)) p ≃+
      Sheaf.H.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (SmallEtale.structureSheaf B.toBigEtaleSite
        (objScheme B S hS U) (contains_objScheme B S hS U))).obj
          (objSmallEtaleRestrict B S hS U G)) p
declarations.comment: étale topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0756] at `τ = Zar`.**  Let `B` be a big fppf site, `S` a
scheme below its cutoff and `𝒢` a sheaf of `𝒪`-modules on `(Sch/S)_fppf` such that

1. `𝒢|_{S_Zar}` is quasi-coherent, and
2. for every object of `(Sch/S)_fppf` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`, with
   structure morphism `g : X ⟶ S`, the canonical map `g^*(𝒢|_{S_Zar}) ⟶ 𝒢|_{X_Zar}`,
   `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.zariskiClause2Map`, is an isomorphism; this is the adjoint
   transpose of the restriction map `𝒢|_{S_Zar} ⟶ g_*(𝒢|_{X_Zar})` by
   `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.zariskiClause2Map_eq_homEquiv_symm`, and it is an isomorphism
   exactly when the transpose of restriction along `g^{-1}V ⟶ V` is, by
   `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isIso_zariskiClause2Map_iff`.

Then for **every** object `U` of `(Sch/S)_fppf` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`,
with scheme `X`, and every `p`,

```
H^p(U, 𝒢)  ≅  H^p(U, 𝒢|_{U_Zar}).
```

The left-hand side is global cohomology of `𝒢|_{(Sch/X)_fppf}` on the big fppf site of `X`, the
localization of `(Sch/S)_fppf` at `U` by [Stacks, Tag 06WI]; the right-hand side is the cohomology
of the site of opens of `X` with values in the restriction of `𝒢` along the inclusion of the small
Zariski site of `X`.  See `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallZariskiSiteCohomologyAddEquiv`
for the same statement with that side read on the site `AlgebraicGeometry.SmallZariski` of
[Stacks, Tag 020T] (2).

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.zariskiSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv` — the conclusion at
the base of a big site — applied at the base `X` to `𝒢|_{(Sch/X)_fppf}`.  Its two hypotheses
there are clause (1) over `X`, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isQuasicoherent_objZariskiRestrict`, and clause (2) over `X`,
which is `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.isIso_zariskiClause2Map_objRestrict` and rests on the
mate square `AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.mateSquare_objRestrictCounit`.

The attribute records the topology: this is the tag at `τ = Zariski`, and nothing here claims the
étale half; that is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallEtaleSiteCohomologyAddEquiv`, in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Descent/Parasitic/FlatCohomologyEtaleConclusion.lean`.
declarations.statement:
public def flatSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheaf B (objScheme B S hS U)
        (contains_objScheme B S hS U))).obj ((objRestrict B S hS U).obj G)) p ≃+
      Sheaf.H.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (objScheme B S hS U).ringCatSheaf).obj
        ((restrictModule B (objScheme B S hS U) (contains_objScheme B S hS U)).obj
          ((objRestrict B S hS U).obj G))) p
declarations.comment: Zariski topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallZariskiSiteCohomologyAddEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 0756] at `τ = Zar`, with the right-hand side on the small
Zariski site.**  Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.flatSmallSiteCohomologyAddEquiv`, for every object `U` of
`(Sch/S)_fppf` flat and locally of finite presentation over `S`, with scheme `X`, and every `p`,

```
H^p(U, 𝒢)  ≅  H^p(X_Zar, (𝒢|_{X_Zar})^a),
```

the right-hand side being the cohomology of the small Zariski site of [Stacks, Tag 020T] (2)
with values in the associated sheaf of [Stacks, Tag 03DU] (4) at `τ = Zariski`.  This is the
previous statement composed with the small Zariski link of [Stacks, Tag 03DW] clause (2),
`AlgebraicGeometry.smallZariskiQuasiCoherentSiteCohomologyAddEquiv`.

The big Zariski site `BZ` carrying `X_Zar` is unrelated to the big fppf site `B`: the restriction
`𝒢|_{X_Zar}` is produced as an `𝒪_X`-module and only then read on `X_Zar`.

The attribute records the topology: this is the tag at `τ = Zariski`.
declarations.statement:
public def flatSmallZariskiSiteCohomologyAddEquiv (BZ : BigZariskiSite.{u})
    (hXZ : BZ.Contains (objScheme B S hS U)) (p : ℕ) :
    Sheaf.H.{u} ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheaf B (objScheme B S hS U)
        (contains_objScheme B S hS U))).obj ((objRestrict B S hS U).obj G)) p ≃+
      Sheaf.H.{u} (@smallZariskiAssociatedSheaf BZ (objScheme B S hS U) hXZ
        ((restrictModule B (objScheme B S hS U) (contains_objScheme B S hS U)).obj
          ((objRestrict B S hS U).obj G))
        (isQuasicoherent_objZariskiRestrict B S hS U G hqc (hcl2 U hU₁ hU₂))) p
declarations.comment: Zariski topology, with the small site read as in 020T (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.injective_smallEtaleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758.** Restriction of an injective abelian sheaf
from the big étale site over `S` to the small étale site of `S` is injective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem injective_smallEtaleRestriction
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (I : Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1})
    [Injective I] :
    Injective (((SmallEtale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
      Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (1)(b): restriction to the small étale site preserves injective abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.injective_smallEtaleRestrictionAlong
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758.** Restriction to the small étale site of an
object of the big étale site preserves injectivity of abelian sheaves.
declarations.statement:
public theorem injective_smallEtaleRestrictionAlong
    (T S : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S)
    (I : Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1})
    [Injective I] :
    Injective
      (((smallEtaleToBigEtaleFunctor B T S f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (1)(a): restriction along a morphism of the big étale site preserves injective abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isKInjective_smallEtaleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758.** Restriction of a K-injective complex of
abelian sheaves from the big étale site to the small étale site is K-injective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isKInjective_smallEtaleRestriction
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS) Ab.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      ((((SmallEtale.inclusion B S hS).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S hS)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (2)(b): restriction to the small étale site preserves K-injective complexes of abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isKInjective_smallEtaleRestrictionAlong
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758.** Restriction to the small étale site of an
object of the big étale site preserves K-injectivity of abelian sheaf complexes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isKInjective_smallEtaleRestrictionAlong
    (T S : B.Scheme) (f : T ⟶ S)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) Ab.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      ((((smallEtaleToBigEtaleFunctor B T S f).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        Ab.{u + 1} (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (2)(a): restriction along a morphism of the big étale site preserves K-injective complexes of abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.not_injective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction_of_mono
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758, the module clause.** Let `S = Spec ℤ`. For an injective
`𝒪`-module `ℐ` on `(Sch/S)_étale` and an injection `α : 𝒪 → ℐ`, the restriction `ℐ|_{S_étale}`
is not an injective `𝒪_S`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_injective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction_of_mono
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B (B.specInt).obj (B.specInt).property))
    (α : bigEtaleModuleUnit B B.specInt ⟶ I) [Mono α] :
    ¬ Injective ((smallEtaleModuleRestriction B B.specInt B.specInt (𝟙 B.specInt)).obj I)
declarations.comment: module counterexample: for S = Spec ℤ, the restriction to S_étale of an injective O-module receiving an injection from O is not injective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_injective_not_injective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758, the module clause, part (1).** Restriction from the big to the
small étale site does not preserve injective modules: for `S = Spec ℤ` there is an injective
`𝒪`-module `ℐ` on `(Sch/S)_étale` such that `ℐ|_{S_étale}` is not an injective `𝒪_S`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_injective_not_injective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction :
    ∃ I : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B (B.specInt).obj (B.specInt).property),
      Injective I ∧
        ¬ Injective ((smallEtaleModuleRestriction B B.specInt B.specInt (𝟙 B.specInt)).obj I)
declarations.comment: module counterexample: parts (1)(a) and (1)(b) do not hold for injective O-modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isKInjective_not_isKInjective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0758, the module clause, part (2).** Restriction from the big to the
small étale site does not preserve K-injective complexes of modules: for `S = Spec ℤ` there is a
K-injective complex `ℐ^•` of `𝒪`-modules on `(Sch/S)_étale` such that `ℐ^•|_{S_étale}` is not a
K-injective complex of `𝒪_S`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isKInjective_not_isKInjective_smallEtaleModuleRestriction :
    ∃ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B (B.specInt).obj (B.specInt).property)) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective ∧
        ¬ ((smallEtaleModuleRestrictionComplex B B.specInt B.specInt (𝟙 B.specInt)).obj
          I).IsKInjective
declarations.comment: module counterexample: parts (2)(a) and (2)(b) do not hold for K-injective complexes of O-modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
For a sheaf `ℱ` on the big étale site over `T` with values in any category, the restriction
`(f_{big, *}ℱ)|_{S_étale}` of its direct image along `f` agrees naturally with the direct image
`f_{small, *}(ℱ|_{T_étale})` of its restriction.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardIso (A : Type w) [Category.{w'} A] :
    (Over.pullback f).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property) ⋙
      (SmallEtale.inclusion B S.obj S.property).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) ≅
    (SmallEtale.inclusion B T.obj T.property).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property) ⋙
      (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
declarations.comment: arbitrary_coefficients

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleRestrictionPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
The direct image along the morphism of topoi `f_big` followed by restriction along the
projection `π_S` agrees naturally with restriction along `π_T` followed by the direct image along
`f_small`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigEtaleRestrictionPushforwardIso :
    (bigEtaleMorphism B T S f).pushforward ⋙
        (bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism B S.obj S.property).pushforward ≅
      (bigEtaleToSmallEtaleMorphism B T.obj T.property).pushforward ⋙
        (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
declarations.comment: direct_images_of_topoi

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardModules_eq
declarations.doc:
Restriction to the small étale site of `S` of the direct image along `f_big` of a sheaf of
`𝒪`-modules is the direct image along `f_small` of its restriction to the small étale site of
`T`:
`(f_{big,*}ℱ)|_{S_étale} = f_{small,*}(ℱ|_{T_étale})`, as an equality of functors.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardModules_eq :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImage.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
          (SmallEtale.inclusion B T.obj T.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B T.obj T.property) ⋙
        smallEtaleModulePushforward B T S f =
      bigEtaleModulePushforward B T S f ⋙
        Stacks.SheafOfModules.inverseImage.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (SmallEtale.inclusion B S.obj S.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B S.obj S.property)
declarations.comment: sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big and small étale sites of schemes, at the module universe `u + 1` of the étale cohomology comparisons of Stacks 0DDH

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleModulePullbackProjectionIso
declarations.doc:
The mate of `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardModules_eq` on inverse images
of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big and small étale sites of schemes:
`π_T^* ∘ f_small^* ≅ f_big^* ∘ π_S^*`, that is `f_big^{-1}(π_S^*K) ≅ π_T^*(f_small^*K)`, where
`π^*` is the lower shriek of Stacks 0797 along the small étale inclusion and `f_big^*` is the
inverse image of Stacks 04CC part (2).
declarations.statement:
public def smallEtaleModulePullbackProjectionIso :
    smallEtaleModulePullbackLarge B T S f ⋙
        Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriek.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
          (SmallEtale.inclusion B T.obj T.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B T.obj T.property) ≅
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriek.{u + 1}
          (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property)
          (SmallEtale.inclusion B S.obj S.property)
          (BigEtaleOver.structureSheaf B S.obj S.property) ⋙
        bigEtaleInverseImageModules B T S f
declarations.comment: inverse images of sheaves of `𝒪`-modules on the big and small étale sites of schemes, at the module universe `u + 1` of the étale cohomology comparisons of Stacks 0DDH

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtalePullbackProjectionPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**The inverse-image square of Stacks 0759.** Pulling a sheaf on the small étale site of `S`
back to the big étale site over `S` and then restricting along `f` agrees with pulling it back to
the small étale site of `T` and then up to the big étale site over `T`:
`f_{big}^{-1}π_S^{-1} ≅ π_T^{-1}f_{small}^{-1}`.

This is the mate of `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleRestrictionPushforwardIso`: all four functors are
left adjoints of the four restrictions appearing there, and uniqueness of left adjoints transports
the isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public def bigEtalePullbackProjectionPullbackIso :
    (SmallEtale.inclusion B S.obj S.property).sheafPullback A
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) ⋙
      (Over.map f).sheafPushforwardContinuous A
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B S.obj S.property) ≅
    (smallEtaleBaseChange B f).sheafPullback A
        (SmallEtale.topology B S.obj S.property)
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property) ⋙
      (SmallEtale.inclusion B T.obj T.property).sheafPullback A
        (SmallEtale.topology B T.obj T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology B T.obj T.property)
declarations.comment: inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleDerivedPushforwardBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc: Base change for the derived direct image of abelian sheaves on big étale sites.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def bigEtaleDerivedPushforwardBaseChangeIso
    (D : CartesianBaseChangeSituation.{u})
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property) Ab.{u + 1}]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wT} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wT'} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS'} (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property) Ab.{u + 1})]
    [(Over.map D.g.hom).IsContinuous
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property)]
    [(Over.map D.g').IsContinuous
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property)]
    [((Over.map D.f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous Ab.{u + 1}
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property)).Additive]
    [((Over.map D.f').sheafPushforwardCocontinuous Ab.{u + 1}
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property)).Additive]
    [((Over.map D.g.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u + 1}
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property)).Additive]
    [((Over.map D.g').sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u + 1}
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property)
      (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property)).Additive]
    (Rf : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property) Ab.{u + 1}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (Rf' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property) Ab.{u + 1}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (Rg : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property) Ab.{u + 1}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (Rg' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property) Ab.{u + 1}) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Sheaf (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property) Ab.{u + 1}))
    (αf : homotopyToDerived
      ((Over.map D.f).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous Ab.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property)) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf)
    (αf' : homotopyToDerived
      ((Over.map D.f').sheafPushforwardCocontinuous Ab.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property)) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf')
    (αg : homotopyToDerived
      ((Over.map D.g.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S'.obj D.S'.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.S.obj D.S.property)) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rg)
    (αg' : homotopyToDerived
      ((Over.map D.g').sheafPushforwardContinuous Ab.{u + 1}
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T'.obj D.T'.property)
        (BigEtaleOver.topology D.B D.T.obj D.T.property)) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rg')
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rf'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αf' (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Rg'.IsRightDerivedFunctor αg' (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Rf ⋙ Rg ≅ Rg' ⋙ Rf'
declarations.comment: big_site_base_change_abelian

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleDerivedPushforwardRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : T ⟶ S` of schemes and `K` in the unbounded derived category
`D((Sch/T)_étale)` of abelian sheaves on the big étale site,
`(Rf_{big, *}K)|_{S_étale} = Rf_{small, *}(K|_{T_étale})` in `D(S_étale)`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleDerivedPushforwardInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes, `g : S' ⟶ S` an object of `(Sch/S)_étale` and
`T' = T ×_S S'` with projections `f' : T' ⟶ S'` and `g' : T' ⟶ T`. For `K` in `D((Sch/T)_étale)`,
`g_big^{-1}(Rf_{big, *}K) = Rf'_{big, *}((g'_big)^{-1}K)` in `D((Sch/S')_étale)`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def bigEtaleDerivedPushforwardInverseImageIso :
    bigEtaleDerivedPushforward D.B D.f ⋙
        (bigEtaleAbelianInverseImage D.B D.gHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigEtaleAbelianInverseImage D.B D.g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        bigEtaleDerivedPushforward D.B D.f'
declarations.comment: part (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleDerivedPushforwardRestrictionAlongIso
declarations.doc:
In the situation of part (5), for `K` in `D((Sch/T)_étale)`,
`i_g^{-1}(Rf_{big, *}K) = Rf'_{small, *}(i_{g'}^{-1}K)` in `D(S'_étale)`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def smallEtaleDerivedPushforwardRestrictionAlongIso :
    bigEtaleDerivedPushforward D.B D.f ⋙
        (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionAlong D.B D.gHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionAlong D.B D.g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        smallEtaleDerivedPushforward D.B D.f'
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigSmallEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : T ⟶ S` of schemes and `K` in the unbounded derived category
`D((Sch/T)_étale, 𝒪)` of `𝒪`-modules on the big étale site,
`(Rf_{big, *}K)|_{S_étale} = Rf_{small, *}(K|_{T_étale})` in `D(Mod(S_étale, 𝒪_S))`, naturally in
`K`.
declarations.statement:
def bigSmallEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardRestrictionIso :
    Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward (X := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos B T)
        (Y := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos B S) (bigEtaleRingedToposHom B f) ⋙
        (bigToSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B S).pushforwardModules.mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigToSmallEtaleRingedToposHom B T).pushforwardModules.mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos B T)
          (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S) (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B f)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.bigEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
Let `f : T ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes, `g : S' ⟶ S` an object of `(Sch/S)_étale` and
`T' = T ×_S S'` with projections `f' : T' ⟶ S'` and `g' : T' ⟶ T`. For `K` in
`D((Sch/T)_étale, 𝒪)`, `g_big^*(Rf_{big, *}K) = Rf'_{big, *}((g'_big)^*K)` in
`D((Sch/S')_étale, 𝒪)`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def bigEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardInverseImageIso :
    Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward (X := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.T)
        (Y := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.S) (bigEtaleRingedToposHom D.B D.f) ⋙
        (bigEtaleModuleInverseImage D.B D.gHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (bigEtaleModuleInverseImage D.B D.g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward
          (X := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.T') (Y := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.S')
          (bigEtaleRingedToposHom D.B D.f')
declarations.comment: part (6)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardRestrictionAlongIso
declarations.doc:
In the situation of part (6), for `K` in `D((Sch/T)_étale, 𝒪)`,
`i_g^*(Rf_{big, *}K) = Rf'_{small, *}(i_{g'}^*K)` in `D(Mod(S'_étale, 𝒪_{S'}))`, naturally in `K`.
declarations.statement:
def smallEtaleDerivedModulePushforwardRestrictionAlongIso :
    Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward (X := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.T)
        (Y := bigEtaleOverRingedTopos D.B D.S) (bigEtaleRingedToposHom D.B D.f) ⋙
        (smallEtaleModuleRestrictionAlong D.B D.gHom).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (smallEtaleModuleRestrictionAlong D.B D.g').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPushforward
          (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos D.B D.T') (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos D.B D.S')
          (smallEtaleRingedToposHom D.B D.f')
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianPresheafBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075B at abelian coefficients.** For the canonical 2-cartesian square of categories
fibred in groupoids over `𝒞`, the base-change transformation `g⁻¹f_* ⟶ f'_*(g')⁻¹` of
presheaves of abelian groups is an isomorphism, naturally in the presheaf.

Direct image of presheaves is right Kan extension along the opposite functor and inverse image
is restriction, so the transformation is `CategoryTheory.TwoSquare.ranBaseChange` of the
opposite square, which is invertible because the square is Guitart exact. The library's
`CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.isIso_presheafRanBaseChange` is the same statement at
coefficients in `Type t`; both are instances of the one coefficient-free input
`CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.guitartExact_twoFibreProductSquare`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def abelianPresheafBaseChangeIso
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hfc : f ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒳) (hgc : g ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒴')
    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a}, f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [∀ G : (TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a},
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    f.op.ran ⋙ (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{a}).obj g.op ≅
      (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{a}).obj
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op ⋙
        (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op.ran
declarations.comment: abelian coefficients

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.modulePresheafBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075B at module coefficients.** For the canonical 2-cartesian square of categories
fibred in groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` and any topology `τ` on `B.Schemes`, the
two composites `f_* ⋙ g⁻¹` and `(g')⁻¹ ⋙ f'_*` of inverse- and direct-image functors of sheaves
of modules are isomorphic on underlying abelian presheaves, naturally in the sheaf of modules.

Inverse image of sheaves of modules is objectwise restriction and direct image is the right Kan
extension along the opposite 1-morphism, both on underlying abelian presheaves
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.modulePullbackCompToPresheafIso` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleSheafPushforwardCompToPresheafIso`), so both composites become
the two ways round the square of a right Kan extension and a restriction, where they are
identified by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianPresheafBaseChangeIso`. Nothing here is special to
modules: the Guitart exactness that identification rests on is coefficient-free.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def modulePresheafBaseChangeIso
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hfc : f ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒳) (hgc : g ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒴')
    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a},
      f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [∀ G : (TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a},
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    ((moduleSheafPushforward.{u, v₁, w₁, max (u + 1) v₂ w₂ a, v₃, w₃}
          B S hS p𝒳 p𝒴 h𝒳 h𝒴 f hfc τ hτ) ⋙
        (modulePullback.{u, v₂, w₂, max (u + 1) v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a, v₃, w₃}
          B S hS p𝒴' p𝒴 h𝒴' h𝒴 g hgc τ hτ)) ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.forget (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p𝒴' h𝒴' τ hτ) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p𝒴' h𝒴' τ hτ).obj) ≅
      ((modulePullback.{u, max (u + 1) v₁ v₂ w₃, max u w₁ w₂,
              max (u + 1) v₁ w₁ v₂ w₂ v₃ w₃ a, v₁, w₁}
          B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒳
          (TwoFibreProductOver.isFiberedInGroupoids p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g h𝒳 h𝒴' h𝒴 hfc hgc)
            h𝒳 (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)
            TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq τ hτ) ⋙
        (moduleSheafPushforward.{u, max (u + 1) v₁ v₂ w₃, max u w₁ w₂,
              max v₃ a, v₂, w₂}
          B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒴'
          (TwoFibreProductOver.isFiberedInGroupoids p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g h𝒳 h𝒴' h𝒴 hfc hgc)
            h𝒴' (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)
            TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq τ hτ)) ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.forget (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p𝒴' h𝒴' τ hτ) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p𝒴' h𝒴' τ hτ).obj)
declarations.comment: module coefficients, on underlying abelian presheaves

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.isIso_presheafRanBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075B**: in a 2-cartesian square of categories fibred in groupoids, the canonical
base-change transformation `g⁻¹ f_* ⟶ f'_* (g')⁻¹` for presheaves is an isomorphism, naturally in
the presheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_presheafRanBaseChange
    (pX : X ⥤ C) (pY' : Y' ⥤ C) (pY : Y ⥤ C)
    (f : X ⥤ Y) (g : Y' ⥤ Y)
    (hX : pX.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hY' : pY'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hY : pY.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : f ⋙ pY = pX) (hg : g ⋙ pY = pY')
    [∀ (F : Xᵒᵖ ⥤ Type t), f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F]
    [∀ (F : (TwoFibreProductOver pX pY' pY f g)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type t),
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd pX pY' pY f g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension F] :
    IsIso ((TwoSquare.mk
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst pX pY' pY f g)
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd pX pY' pY f g) f g
      (TwoFibreProductOver.psiIso pX pY' pY f g).hom).op.ranBaseChange
        (D := Type t))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.smallEtaleStructureComparison_app_comp
declarations.doc:
The map `a_{small}^♯` of structure sheaves below `φ`, applied after the map `b_{small}^♯`
below `ψ`, is the map below `ψ ∘ φ` followed by restriction along the identification of the two
base changes.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleStructureComparison_app_comp
    (W : (SmallEtale E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z))ᵒᵖ)
    (r : (SmallEtale.structureSheaf E (p.obj z).left.1
      (contains_base B E h S hS p z)).obj.obj W) :
    (smallEtaleStructureComparison B E h S hS p hp φ τ hτ).app
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).op.obj W)
        ((smallEtaleStructureComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ τ hτ).app W r) =
      (SmallEtale.structureSheaf E (p.obj x).left.1
          (contains_base B E h S hS p x)).obj.map
        ((smallEtaleBaseChangeCompIso B E h S hS p φ ψ).hom.app W.unop).op
        ((smallEtaleStructureComparison B E h S hS p hp (φ ≫ ψ) τ hτ).app W r)
declarations.comment: part (1), for the maps of structure sheaves below an arrow

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictModulePushforwardComparison_app_comp
declarations.doc:
The direct-image comparison of a presheaf of modules below `φ`, applied after the
comparison below `ψ`, is the comparison below `ψ ∘ φ` followed by restriction along the
identification of the two base changes.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictModulePushforwardComparison_app_comp
    (F : PresheafOfModules.{m} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp τ hτ).obj)
    (W : (SmallEtale E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z))ᵒᵖ)
    (n : (restrictModuleToSmallEtale B E h S hS p hp z τ hτ F).obj W) :
    (restrictModulePushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp φ τ hτ F).app
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).op.obj W)
        ((restrictModulePushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ τ hτ F).app W n) =
      (restrictModuleToSmallEtale B E h S hS p hp x τ hτ F).presheaf.map
        ((smallEtaleBaseChangeCompIso B E h S hS p φ ψ).hom.app W.unop).op
        ((restrictModulePushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp (φ ≫ ψ) τ hτ F).app W n)
declarations.comment: part (1), for the direct-image comparison of a presheaf of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictModulePullbackComparison_comp
declarations.doc:
**The comparison map `c_φ` of Stacks 06WC is functorial in the arrow.** For arrows `φ : x ⟶ y`
and `ψ : y ⟶ z` of `𝒳` lying over morphisms of schemes `a : U ⟶ V` and `b : V ⟶ W`, the pullback
along `a_{small}^♯` of the comparison map below `ψ`, followed by the comparison map below `φ`, is
the composition law `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.smallEtalePullbackComparisonCompIso` for the pullbacks
followed by the comparison map below `ψ ∘ φ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem restrictModulePullbackComparison_comp :
    (PresheafOfModules.pullback.{u}
          (smallEtaleStructureComparison B E h S hS p hp φ τ hτ)).map
        (restrictModulePullbackComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ τ hτ F) ≫
      restrictModulePullbackComparison B E h S hS p hp φ τ hτ F =
    (smallEtalePullbackComparisonCompIso B E h S hS p hp τ hτ φ ψ).hom.app
        (restrictModuleToSmallEtale B E h S hS p hp z τ hτ F) ≫
      restrictModulePullbackComparison B E h S hS p hp (φ ≫ ψ) τ hτ F
declarations.comment: part (1), for the pullback comparison map of a presheaf of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075D (1) through the evaluation maps.** For arrows `φ : x ⟶ y` and `ψ : y ⟶ z` of
`𝒳`, the composite of the two comparison maps of Stacks 06W2, precomposed with the evaluation
map over `z`, is restriction of `F` along `ψ ∘ φ` followed by the evaluation map over `x`.

Read this way the composition statement of Stacks 075D (1) leaves no comparison of base changes
over: both the composite `c_φ ∘ c_ψ` and the single `c_{ψ ∘ φ}` become restriction along
`ψ ∘ φ`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp_eq_app_comp` recovers
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_comp` from this form.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp {A : Type t} [Category.{s} A]
    (F : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (φ : x ⟶ y) (ψ : y ⟶ z)
    (W : SmallEtale E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z)) :
    restrictToSmallEtaleEval B E h S hS p hp z F W ≫
        (restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ F).app (op W) ≫
          (restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp φ F).app (op
            ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).obj W)) =
      F.map (φ ≫ ψ).op ≫ restrictToSmallEtaleEval B E h S hS p hp x F
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p φ)).obj
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).obj W))
declarations.comment: part (1), the direct-image comparisons read through the evaluation maps of the restriction of Stacks 06W1, so that no comparison of base changes is left over

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictModulePushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075D (1) for the module comparison of Stacks 06WC, through the evaluation maps.**
The module form of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictModulePushforwardComparison_app_eval_comp
    (F : PresheafOfModules.{m} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp τ hτ).obj)
    (φ : x ⟶ y) (ψ : y ⟶ z)
    (W : SmallEtale E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z))
    (n : F.presheaf.obj (op z)) :
    (restrictModulePushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp φ τ hτ F).app
        (op ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).obj W))
        ((restrictModulePushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ τ hτ F).app (op W)
          (restrictToSmallEtaleEval B E h S hS p hp z F.presheaf W n)) =
      restrictToSmallEtaleEval B E h S hS p hp x F.presheaf
        ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p φ)).obj
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).obj W))
        (F.presheaf.map (φ ≫ ψ).op n)
declarations.comment: part (1), for the direct-image comparison of a presheaf of modules read through the evaluation maps of the restriction of Stacks 06W1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
Restriction to a small étale site commutes canonically with inverse image along a 1-morphism
of categories fibred in groupoids: the restriction at `y` of the inverse image of `F` is the
restriction of `F` at `G y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hG : (G ⋙ p).IsFibredOneMorphism p G) (y : 𝒴)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type t)) :
    letI : (G ⋙ p).IsFibered := hGp.isFibered
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI := (hG.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS))).1
    restrictToSmallEtale B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp y
        ((G.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type t)
          (associatedTopology B S hS (G ⋙ p) (etaleTopology B))
          (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B))).obj F).obj ≅
      restrictToSmallEtale B E h S hS p hp (G.obj y) F.obj
declarations.comment: part (3), the identification

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.existsUnique_inverseImageComparisonLift
declarations.doc:
Over a small étale object there is exactly one arrow of `𝒳` from the cartesian lift at `G y` to
the image of the cartesian lift at `y` compatible with the structure morphisms and lying over the
canonical comparison of their bases.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_inverseImageComparisonLift {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids) (y : 𝒴)
    (W : SmallEtale E (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y))) :
    let P := Over.post (X := G.obj y) (p ⋙ Over.forget (B.obj hS))
    let Q := Over.post (X := y) ((G ⋙ p) ⋙ Over.forget (B.obj hS))
    letI : P.IsEquivalence := isEquivalence_overPost B S hS p hp (G.obj y)
    letI : Q.IsEquivalence := isEquivalence_overPost B S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp y
    let V := (smallEtaleInclusion B E h (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1
      (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y))).obj W
    let a := P.inv.obj V
    let b := Q.inv.obj V
    ∃! φ : a.left ⟶ G.obj b.left,
      (φ ≫ G.map b.hom = a.hom) ∧
      ((p.map φ).left ≫ (Q.objObjPreimageIso V).hom.left =
        (P.objObjPreimageIso V).hom.left)
declarations.comment: part (3), the unique comparison arrow

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso_app
declarations.doc:
On sections over a small étale object, the identification
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso` is restriction of `F` along the
unique comparison arrow of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.existsUnique_inverseImageComparisonLift`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso_app {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hG : (G ⋙ p).IsFibredOneMorphism p G) (y : 𝒴)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type t))
    (W : SmallEtale E (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y))) :
    letI : (G ⋙ p).IsFibered := hGp.isFibered
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI := (hG.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS))).1
    let P := Over.post (X := G.obj y) (p ⋙ Over.forget (B.obj hS))
    let Q := Over.post (X := y) ((G ⋙ p) ⋙ Over.forget (B.obj hS))
    letI : P.IsEquivalence := isEquivalence_overPost B S hS p hp (G.obj y)
    letI : Q.IsEquivalence := isEquivalence_overPost B S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp y
    let V := (smallEtaleInclusion B E h (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1
      (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y))).obj W
    let a := P.inv.obj V
    let b := Q.inv.obj V
    ∀ φ : a.left ⟶ G.obj b.left, φ ≫ G.map b.hom = a.hom →
      (p.map φ).left ≫ (Q.objObjPreimageIso V).hom.left =
        (P.objObjPreimageIso V).hom.left →
      (restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso B E h S hS p hp G hGp hG y F).hom.app
          (Opposite.op W) = F.obj.map φ.op
declarations.comment: part (3), the component formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleSheafInverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
The identification `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso`, as an
isomorphism of sheaves.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictToSmallEtaleSheafInverseImageIso {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hG : (G ⋙ p).IsFibredOneMorphism p G) (y : 𝒴)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type (max (u + 1) t))) :
    letI : (G ⋙ p).IsFibered := hGp.isFibered
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI := (hG.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS))).1
    restrictToSmallEtaleSheaf B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp y
        ((G.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max (u + 1) t))
          (associatedTopology B S hS (G ⋙ p) (etaleTopology B))
          (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B))).obj F) ≅
      restrictToSmallEtaleSheaf B E h S hS p hp (G.obj y) F
declarations.comment: part (3), on sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_comp_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
The comparison maps of Stacks 06W2 for `ψ : y' ⟶ y` in `𝒴` and for its image `G ψ` in `𝒳`
agree under the identifications `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionPushforwardComparison_comp_inverseImageIso {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hG : (G ⋙ p).IsFibredOneMorphism p G) {y' y : 𝒴} (ψ : y' ⟶ y)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type t)) :
    letI : (G ⋙ p).IsFibered := hGp.isFibered
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI := (hG.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS))).1
    let F' := (G.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type t)
      (associatedTopology B S hS (G ⋙ p) (etaleTopology B))
      (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B))).obj F
    let b := smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p (G.map ψ))
    (restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso B E h S hS p hp G hGp hG y F).hom ≫
        restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp (G.map ψ) F.obj =
      restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp ψ F'.obj ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft b.op
          (restrictToSmallEtaleInverseImageIso B E h S hS p hp G hGp hG y' F).hom
declarations.comment: part (4), for the direct-image comparison of a presheaf of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionInverseImageComparison_comp_inverseImageIso
declarations.doc:
The comparison maps of Stacks 06W3 for `ψ : y' ⟶ y` in `𝒴` and for its image `G ψ` in `𝒳`
agree under the identifications
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictToSmallEtaleSheafInverseImageIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionInverseImageComparison_comp_inverseImageIso {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    {𝒴 : Type v'} [Category.{w'} 𝒴] (G : 𝒴 ⥤ 𝒳) (hGp : (G ⋙ p).IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hG : (G ⋙ p).IsFibredOneMorphism p G) {y' y : 𝒴} (ψ : y' ⟶ y)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type (max (u + 1) t))) :
    letI : (G ⋙ p).IsFibered := hGp.isFibered
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI := (hG.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology
      ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS))).1
    let F' := (G.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (max (u + 1) t))
      (associatedTopology B S hS (G ⋙ p) (etaleTopology B))
      (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B))).obj F
    let a := smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) ψ)
    letI : a.IsContinuous
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1
          (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y)))
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj (G.obj y')).left.1
          (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y'))) :=
      smallEtaleBaseChange_isContinuous E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) ψ)
    let iy := restrictToSmallEtaleSheafInverseImageIso B E h S hS p hp G hGp hG y F
    let iy' := restrictToSmallEtaleSheafInverseImageIso B E h S hS p hp G hGp hG y' F
    (a.sheafPullback (Type (max (u + 1) t))
          (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj (G.obj y)).left.1
            (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y)))
          (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj (G.obj y')).left.1
            (contains_base B E h S hS p (G.obj y')))).map iy.hom ≫
        restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS p hp (G.map ψ) F =
      restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS (G ⋙ p) hGp ψ F' ≫ iy'.hom
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionInverseImageCompIso
declarations.doc:
The canonical identification, for arrows `φ : x ⟶ y` and `ψ : y ⟶ z` of a category fibred
in groupoids, of the composite of the small étale inverse images along the underlying morphisms
of schemes with the inverse image along the underlying morphism of `ψ ∘ φ`.

This is the identification appearing in **Stacks 075D (1)**. It is the mate of the direct-image
comparison induced by `AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtaleBaseChange_factoredCompIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictionInverseImageCompIso {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) {x y z : 𝒳} (φ : x ⟶ y) (ψ : y ⟶ z) :
    (smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).sheafPullback
        (Type (max (u + 1) t))
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z))
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj y).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p y)) ⋙
      (smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p φ)).sheafPullback
        (Type (max (u + 1) t))
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj y).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p y))
        (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj x).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p x)) ≅
    (smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p (φ ≫ ψ))).sheafPullback
      (Type (max (u + 1) t))
      (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z))
      (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj x).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p x))
declarations.comment: part (1), the identification of successive inverse images

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075D (1)** for the direct-image comparisons of Stacks 06W2: the comparison for a
composite arrow, followed by restriction along the composition comparison of base changes, is
the composite of the two comparisons.

This is the form with content; the inverse-image statement of the source is its mate. It holds
for a presheaf with values in an arbitrary category.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionPushforwardComparison_app_comp {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) {x y z : 𝒳}
    (φ : x ⟶ y) (ψ : y ⟶ z) {A : Type t} [Category.{s} A] (F : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ A)
    (W : SmallEtale E (p.obj z).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p z)) :
    (restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ F).app (Opposite.op W) ≫
        (restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp φ F).app (Opposite.op
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)).obj W)) =
      (restrictionPushforwardComparison B E h S hS p hp (φ ≫ ψ) F).app (Opposite.op W) ≫
        (restrictToSmallEtale B E h S hS p hp x F).map
          ((smallEtaleBaseChange_factoredCompIso E _ _ _
            (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p φ) (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p ψ)
            (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p (φ ≫ ψ))
            (smallEtaleBaseMorphism_comp B E h S hS p φ ψ).symm).hom.app W).op
declarations.comment: part (1), the direct-image form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictionInverseImageComparison_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075D (1).** For an étale sheaf on a category fibred in groupoids, the comparison
map of Stacks 06W3 for a composite arrow is the composite of the two comparison maps, under the
canonical identification of successive small étale inverse images.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionInverseImageComparison_comp {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) {x y z : 𝒳}
    (φ : x ⟶ y) (ψ : y ⟶ z)
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type (max (u + 1) t))) :
    ((smallEtaleBaseChange E (smallEtaleBaseMorphism B E h S hS p φ)).sheafPullback
          (Type (max (u + 1) t))
          (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj y).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p y))
          (SmallEtale.topology E (p.obj x).left.1 (contains_base B E h S hS p x))).map
        (restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS p hp ψ F) ≫
      restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS p hp φ F =
    (restrictionInverseImageCompIso B E h S hS p φ ψ).hom.app
        (restrictToSmallEtaleSheaf B E h S hS p hp z F) ≫
      restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS p hp (φ ≫ ψ) F
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isIso_restrictionInverseImageComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075D**, part (2). If an arrow of `𝒳` lies over an étale morphism of schemes, the
comparison of Stacks 06W3 between the inverse image of the restriction at its target and the
restriction at its source is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictionInverseImageComparison {𝒳 : Type v} [Category.{w} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) {x y : 𝒳} (φ : x ⟶ y)
    (hφ : Etale (B.inclusion.map (p.map φ).left))
    (F : Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p (etaleTopology B)) (Type (max (u + 1) t))) :
    IsIso (restrictionInverseImageComparison B E h S hS p hp φ F)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.cohomologyOverObjectComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075F.** Let `S` be a scheme, `p : 𝒳 ⥤ (Sch/S)_{fppf}` a category fibred in groupoids,
`τ ∈ {Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic, fppf}`, and `x` an object of `𝒳` lying over the scheme
`U`. For every degree `n`:

* for `F` an abelian sheaf on `𝒳_τ`, `H^n_τ(x, F) = H^n((Sch/U)_τ, x^{-1}F)`;
* for `F` a sheaf of `O_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ`, `H^n_τ(x, F) = H^n((Sch/U)_τ, x^{-1}F)`;
* if `τ = étale`, then also `H^n_{étale}(x, F) = H^n(U_{étale}, F|_{U_{étale}})`, for `F` an
  abelian sheaf and for `F` a sheaf of `O_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_{étale}`.

Each identification is a natural isomorphism of functors of `F`; they are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.cohomologyOverObjectIso`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleCohomologyOverObjectIso`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.etaleCohomologyOverObjectIso` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.etaleModuleCohomologyOverObjectIso`, the first two of which are stated
there for any topology on the underlying category of schemes (coarser than the fppf topology, for
modules).

The five topologies are `B.baseTopology τ` for `τ : AlgebraicGeometry.SiteKind`. Cohomology over
`x` is the cohomology of the localized site `𝒳_τ/x` of the restriction of `F` (Stacks 03F3); the
cohomology of a sheaf of modules is computed in the category of sheaves of modules, as `Ext` out
of the structure sheaf; `(Sch/U)_τ` is the big `τ`-site of `U`, identified with `𝒳_τ/x` by the
localization equivalence of Stacks 06W0, compatibly with the structure sheaves by Stacks 06W9;
`x^{-1}F` is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.objectInverseImage`, resp.
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.objectModuleInverseImage`; `U_{étale}` is the small étale site of `U`
for the big étale site carried by `B` (Stacks 03FF); and `F|_{U_{étale}}` is the restriction of
Stacks 06W1, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.objectSmallEtaleRestriction`, resp.
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.objectSmallEtaleModuleRestriction`. Abelian sheaves and sheaves of
modules have their sections in the universe `max v w (u + 1)` containing both sites, as explained
in the module docstring of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Stacks/ObjectCohomologyLocalization.lean`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyOverObjectComparison (τ : SiteKind) (n : ℕ) :
    (
