      haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasSheafify_addCommGrp.{max v w, w, u + 1}
        (J := (associatedTopology B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ)).over x)
      haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasSheafify_addCommGrp.{u + 1, u, max v w}
        (J := (B.baseTopology τ).over (p.obj x).left)
      haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasExt_addCommGrp.{max v w, w, u + 1}
        (J := (associatedTopology B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ)).over x)
      haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasExt_addCommGrp.{u + 1, u, max v w}
        (J := (B.baseTopology τ).over (p.obj x).left)
      haveI := isDenseSubsite_overPost B S hS p hp (B.baseTopology τ) x
      (associatedTopology B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ)).overPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{max v w (u + 1)} x ⋙
          Sheaf.functorH ((associatedTopology B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ)).over x) n ≅
        objectInverseImage B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ) x ⋙
          Sheaf.functorH ((B.baseTopology τ).over (p.obj x).left) n) ×
    (
      SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringStructureSheaf.{u, v, w, u + 1} B S hS p hp
          (B.baseTopology τ) (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ)) x ⋙
          Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteModules.moduleFunctorH.{u + 1, w, max v w}
            ((associatedTopology B S hS p (B.baseTopology τ)).over x)
            ((ringStructureSheaf.{u, v, w, u + 1} B S hS p hp (B.baseTopology τ)
              (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ)).over x) n ≅
        objectModuleInverseImage B S hS p hp (B.baseTopology τ) x
            (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ) ⋙
          Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteModules.moduleFunctorH.{max v w, u, u + 1}
            ((B.baseTopology τ).over (p.obj x).left)
            (baseRingStructureSheafLift.{u, v, w} B (B.baseTopology τ)
              (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ) (p.obj x).left.1 (p.obj x).left.2) n) ×
    (τ = .etale →
      (
        haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasSheafify_addCommGrp.{max v w, w, u + 1}
          (J := (associatedTopology B S hS p B.etaleTopology).over x)
        haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasSheafify_addCommGrp.{u + 1, u, max v w}
          (J := SmallEtale.topology B.toBigEtaleSite (p.obj x).left.1
            (toBigEtaleSite_contains_left B S hS p x))
        haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasExt_addCommGrp.{max v w, w, u + 1}
          (J := (associatedTopology B S hS p B.etaleTopology).over x)
        haveI := Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.site_hasExt_addCommGrp.{u + 1, u, max v w}
          (J := SmallEtale.topology B.toBigEtaleSite (p.obj x).left.1
            (toBigEtaleSite_contains_left B S hS p x))
        (associatedTopology B S hS p B.etaleTopology).overPullback
            AddCommGrpCat.{max v w (u + 1)} x ⋙
            Sheaf.functorH ((associatedTopology B S hS p B.etaleTopology).over x) n ≅
          objectSmallEtaleRestriction B S hS p hp x ⋙
            Sheaf.functorH (SmallEtale.topology B.toBigEtaleSite (p.obj x).left.1
              (toBigEtaleSite_contains_left B S hS p x)) n) ×
      (
        SheafOfModules.overFunctor (ringStructureSheaf.{u, v, w, u + 1} B S hS p hp
            B.etaleTopology (etaleTopology_le_topology B)) x ⋙
            Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteModules.moduleFunctorH.{u + 1, w, max v w}
              ((associatedTopology B S hS p B.etaleTopology).over x)
              ((ringStructureSheaf.{u, v, w, u + 1} B S hS p hp B.etaleTopology
                (etaleTopology_le_topology B)).over x) n ≅
          objectSmallEtaleModuleRestriction B S hS p hp x ⋙
            Stacks.Cohomology.BiggerSiteModules.moduleFunctorH.{max v w, u, u + 1}
              (SmallEtale.topology B.toBigEtaleSite (p.obj x).left.1
                (toBigEtaleSite_contains_left B S hS p x))
              (objectSmallEtaleRing B S hS p x) n))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedDirectImageIsoSheafifyDerivedPresheafDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075G.** Higher direct image of abelian sheaves is the sheafification of the
derived presheaf direct image.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedDirectImageIsoSheafifyDerivedPresheafDirectImage
    [p.IsFibered] [q.IsFibered] (hF : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q F) (n : ℕ)
    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a}, F.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS q τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions (Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a})] :
    letI := (hF.isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous_inheritedTopology (τ.over (B.obj hS))).2
    letI := additive_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous B S hS p q F τ hF
    (F.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS p τ) (associatedTopology B S hS q τ)).rightDerived n ≅
      derivedPresheafDirectImage B S hS p F τ n ⋙
        presheafToSheaf (associatedTopology B S hS q τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}
declarations.comment: abelian sheafification formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.higherDirectImageIsoSheafifyFibreCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075G, abelian sheaves.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over
`S` and `τ` one of the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf topologies. For an abelian sheaf
`ℱ` on `𝒳_τ`, the higher direct image `Rⁿf_*ℱ` is the sheaf associated to the presheaf
`y ↦ H^n_τ((Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_{y, 𝒴} 𝒳, pr⁻¹ℱ)`, `y` an object of `𝒴` lying over the scheme `V`.

The direct image is right Kan extension followed by sheafification, and sheafification is exact
(`abelianHigherDirectImage_iso_sheafify_fibreCohomology`); the derived presheaf direct image is
computed objectwise (`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedFlipObjIso`), and its value at `y` is the
cohomology of the 2-fibre product by Stacks 06W6 and Stacks 06X1
(`derivedPresheafDirectImageEvaluationIso`).
declarations.statement:
def higherDirectImageIsoSheafifyFibreCohomology (n : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf JX AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}) :
    (((g).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a} JX JY).rightDerived n).obj F ≅
      (presheafToSheaf JY AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}).obj
        (objectFibreCohomologyPresheaf.{u, w, a} B S hS f c τ n F)
declarations.comment: abelian sheaves: R^n f_* F is the sheafification of y ↦ H^n((Sch/V) ×_{y,Y} X, pr^{-1} F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleHigherDirectImageIsoSheafifyFibreModuleCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075G, sheaves of modules.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks
over `S` and `τ` one of the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf topologies. For a sheaf `ℱ`
of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ`, the higher direct image `Rⁿf_*ℱ` is, as a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules, the
sheaf associated to the presheaf of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules `y ↦ H^n_τ((Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_{y, 𝒴} 𝒳, pr⁻¹ℱ)`,
`y` an object of `𝒴` lying over the scheme `V`, the cohomology of the sheaf of modules `pr⁻¹ℱ`
being an `𝒪_𝒴(y)`-module through the pullback of functions `𝒪_𝒴(y) ⟶ Γ(…, 𝒪)`.

The direct image is the presheaf direct image followed by sheafification, which is exact
(`moduleHigherDirectImageIsoSheafify`); evaluation at `y` is exact, and the sections over `y` of
the presheaf direct image are the global sections over the 2-fibre product as `𝒪_𝒴(y)`-modules
(`modulePresheafDirectImageEvaluationLinearIso`, Stacks 06W6), whose derived functors are the
cohomology of the 2-fibre product because `pr⁻¹` preserves injectives (Stacks 06X2).
declarations.statement:
def moduleHigherDirectImageIsoSheafifyFibreModuleCohomology (n : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max (u + 1) a} OX) :
    ((moduleSheafPushforward.{u, u + 1, u, a, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids 𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids g
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom) (B.baseTopology τ)
        (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ)).rightDerived n).obj F ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{max (u + 1) a} (𝟙 (OY).obj)).obj
        (objectFibreModuleCohomologyPresheafOfModules.{u, w, a} B S hS f c τ n F)
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules: R^n f_* F is, as an O_Y-module, the sheafification of the presheaf of O_Y-modules y ↦ H^n((Sch/V) ×_{y,Y} X, pr^{-1} F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianDirectImageBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H in degree zero.** For the canonical 2-cartesian square of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` and any topology `τ` on `B.Schemes`, the
base-change map `g⁻¹f_*ℱ ⟶ f'_*(g')⁻¹ℱ` of abelian sheaves on the associated sites is an
isomorphism, naturally in `ℱ`.

This is the identification the source quotes from Stacks 075B at the start of the proof of
Stacks 075H. Both composites become, on underlying presheaves, the two ways round the square of
a right Kan extension and a restriction (Stacks 06NW), where they are identified by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianPresheafBaseChangeIso`; the descent to sheaves is full
faithfulness of `sheafToPresheaf`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def abelianDirectImageBaseChangeIso
    [p𝒳.IsFibered] [p𝒴'.IsFibered] [p𝒴.IsFibered]
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hfc : f ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒳) (hgc : g ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒴')
    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a}, f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [∀ G : (TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a},
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G] :
    letI : (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).IsFibered :=
      isFibered_twoFibreProductStructureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g h𝒳 h𝒴' h𝒴 hfc hgc
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p𝒳 p𝒴 f τ h𝒴 hfc
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p𝒴' p𝒴 g τ h𝒴 hgc
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒳
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ h𝒳 TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒴'
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ h𝒴' TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq
    f.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ) ⋙
        g.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ) (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ) ≅
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS
            (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) ⋙
        (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS
            (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ)
declarations.comment: degree zero, abelian sheaves: g⁻¹f_*ℱ ≅ f'_*(g')⁻¹ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H in every degree.** For the canonical 2-cartesian square of categories fibred
in groupoids over the big fppf category of `S` and any topology `τ` on `B.Schemes`, the
base-change map is an isomorphism
`g⁻¹Rⁱf_*ℱ ≅ Rⁱ(f'_*(g')⁻¹)ℱ`
of abelian sheaves on the associated site of `𝒴'`, naturally in `ℱ`.

The right-hand side is the `i`-th right derived functor of the composite `f'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹`. The
source writes instead `Rⁱf'_*((g')⁻¹ℱ)`, the `i`-th right derived functor of `f'_*` evaluated
at `(g')⁻¹ℱ`; the two differ by whether `(g')⁻¹` sends injective abelian sheaves to
`f'_*`-acyclic ones, which is not available here. See the implementation notes of this file.

The proof uses nothing beyond the degree-zero isomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianDirectImageBaseChangeIso` and exactness of `g⁻¹` (Stacks 06NW):
an exact functor may be pulled out of a right derived functor, so
`(f_* ⋙ g⁻¹).rightDerived i ≅ (f_*).rightDerived i ⋙ g⁻¹`, and the degree-zero isomorphism
rewrites the left-hand side.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def abelianHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso
    [p𝒳.IsFibered] [p𝒴'.IsFibered] [p𝒴.IsFibered]
    (h𝒳 : p𝒳.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (h𝒴' : p𝒴'.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (h𝒴 : p𝒴.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hfc : f ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒳) (hgc : g ⋙ p𝒴 = p𝒴') (n : ℕ)
    [∀ G : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a}, f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [∀ G : 𝒴'ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a}, g.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [∀ G : (TwoFibreProductOver p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g)ᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{a},
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension G]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasSheafify (associatedTopology B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a}]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions
      (Sheaf (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) AddCommGrpCat.{a})] :
    letI : (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).IsFibered :=
      isFibered_twoFibreProductStructureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g h𝒳 h𝒴' h𝒴 hfc hgc
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p𝒳 p𝒴 f τ h𝒴 hfc
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS p𝒴' p𝒴 g τ h𝒴 hgc
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒳
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ h𝒳 TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒴'
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ h𝒴' TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq
    letI : (f.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ)).Additive :=
      additive_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous B S hS p𝒳 p𝒴 f τ (h𝒴.isFibredOneMorphism hfc)
    letI : ((TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS
          (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ)).Additive :=
      additive_sheafPushforwardContinuous B S hS
        (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒳
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ
        (h𝒳.isFibredOneMorphism TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq)
    letI : ((TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS
          (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ)).Additive :=
      additive_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous B S hS
        (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) p𝒴'
        (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ
        (h𝒴'.isFibredOneMorphism TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq)
    (f.sheafPushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
            (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ)
            (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ)).rightDerived n ⋙
        g.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ) (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴 τ) ≅
      ((TwoFibreProductOver.fst p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{a}
            (associatedTopology B S hS
              (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
            (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒳 τ) ⋙
          (TwoFibreProductOver.snd p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
            AddCommGrpCat.{a}
            (associatedTopology B S hS
              (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor p𝒳 p𝒴' p𝒴 f g) τ)
            (associatedTopology B S hS p𝒴' τ)).rightDerived n
declarations.comment: all degrees, abelian sheaves; Rⁱf'_*(g')⁻¹ as the right derived functor of the composite f'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.abelianHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H for abelian sheaves.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be 1-morphisms of
algebraic stacks over `S`, with 2-cartesian square
```
𝒴' ×_𝒴 𝒳 --- g' ---> 𝒳
   |                 |
   f'                f
   v                 v
  𝒴' ------ g -----> 𝒴
```
For every topology `τ` on the schemes of the big fppf site, the base change map is an
isomorphism `g⁻¹Rⁱf_*ℱ ≅ Rⁱf'_*((g')⁻¹ℱ)` of abelian sheaves on `𝒴'_τ`, functorially in the
abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `𝒳_τ`, for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def abelianHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) (n : ℕ) :
    letI : (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)).IsFibered :=
      isFibered_twoFibreProductStructureFunctor _ _ _ _ _ 𝒳.val.property 𝒴'.val.property
        𝒴.val.property (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom)
    letI : 𝒳.val.val.p.IsFibered := 𝒳.val.property.isFibered
    letI : 𝒴'.val.val.p.IsFibered := 𝒴'.val.property.isFibered
    letI : 𝒴.val.val.p.IsFibered := 𝒴.val.property.isFibered
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS _ _
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) τ 𝒴.val.property
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS _ _
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom) τ 𝒴.val.property
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom)
    letI := isContinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS _ _
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom))
      τ 𝒳.val.property TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq
    letI := isCocontinuous_of_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS _ _
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom))
      τ 𝒴'.val.property TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq
    letI : ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p τ)).Additive :=
      additive_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous B S hS _ _ _ τ
        (𝒴.val.property.isFibredOneMorphism (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom))
    letI : ((TwoFibreProductOver.snd 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
        (associatedTopology B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p
          𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)) τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴'.val.val.p τ)).Additive :=
      additive_sheafPushforwardCocontinuous B S hS _ _ _ τ
        (𝒴'.val.property.isFibredOneMorphism TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq)
    ((CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p τ)).rightDerived n ⋙
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴'.val.val.p τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p τ) ≅
      (TwoFibreProductOver.fst 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
          (associatedTopology B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p
            𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)) τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p τ) ⋙
        ((TwoFibreProductOver.snd 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
            AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
            (associatedTopology B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p
              𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
              (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)) τ)
            (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴'.val.val.p τ)).rightDerived n
declarations.comment: abelian sheaves: g⁻¹Rⁱf_*F ≅ Rⁱf'_*((g')⁻¹F) for every i, naturally in F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.moduleHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H for sheaves of modules.** For 1-morphisms `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` of
algebraic stacks over `S` with 2-cartesian square `𝒴' ×_𝒴 𝒳` as in
`AlgebraicStacks.abelianHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso`, and every topology `τ` coarser than the
fppf topology, the base change map is an isomorphism `g^*Rⁱf_*ℱ ≅ Rⁱf'_*((g')^*ℱ)` of sheaves of
`𝒪_{𝒴'}`-modules, functorially in the sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules `ℱ`, for every `i`; the higher
direct images are the right derived functors on sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleHigherDirectImageBaseChangeIso {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (moduleSheafPushforward.{u, u + 1, u, max (u + 1) a} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
          𝒳.val.property 𝒴.val.property (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom) τ hτ).rightDerived n ⋙
        modulePullback B S hS 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.property 𝒴.val.property
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom) τ hτ ≅
      modulePullback B S hS (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p
          𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)) 𝒳.val.val.p
          (TwoFibreProductOver.isFiberedInGroupoids _ _ _ _ _ 𝒳.val.property 𝒴'.val.property
            𝒴.val.property (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom)) 𝒳.val.property
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom))
          TwoFibreProductOver.fst_comp_eq τ hτ ⋙
        (moduleSheafPushforward.{u, u + 1, u, max (u + 1) a} B S hS
          (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom))
          𝒴'.val.val.p
          (TwoFibreProductOver.isFiberedInGroupoids _ _ _ _ _ 𝒳.val.property 𝒴'.val.property
            𝒴.val.property (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom)) 𝒴'.val.property
          (TwoFibreProductOver.snd 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴'.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom))
          TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq τ hτ).rightDerived n
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules: g⁻¹Rⁱf_*F ≅ Rⁱf'_*((g')⁻¹F) in Mod(O) for every i, naturally in F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isIso_abelianDerivedDirectImageBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H for abelian sheaves.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` be 1-morphisms of
algebraic stacks over `S`, with 2-cartesian square
```
𝒴' ×_𝒴 𝒳 --- g' ---> 𝒳
   |                 |
   f'                f
   v                 v
  𝒴' ------ g -----> 𝒴
```
For every topology `τ` on the schemes of the big fppf site, the base change map
`g⁻¹Rf_*ℱ ⟶ Rf'_*(g')⁻¹ℱ` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.abelianDerivedDirectImageBaseChange`, the
map of Stacks 0736 built from the adjunctions `f⁻¹ ⊣ f_*`, `f'⁻¹ ⊣ f'_*` and the 2-commutativity
of the square) is an isomorphism, functorially in `ℱ` in the bounded below derived category of
abelian sheaves on `𝒳_τ`; in particular for `ℱ` an abelian sheaf, placed in degree zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_abelianDerivedDirectImageBaseChange {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) :
    IsIso (abelianDerivedDirectImageBaseChange.{u, a} B S hS _ _ _
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom) τ
      𝒳.val.property 𝒴'.val.property 𝒴.val.property
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom))
declarations.comment: abelian sheaves: the base change map g⁻¹Rf_*F ⟶ Rf'_*(g')⁻¹F is an isomorphism, functorially in F in D⁺(Ab(𝒳_τ))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isIso_moduleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075H for sheaves of modules.** For 1-morphisms `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` of
algebraic stacks over `S` with 2-cartesian square `𝒴' ×_𝒴 𝒳` as in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isIso_abelianDerivedDirectImageBaseChange`, and every
topology `τ` coarser than the fppf topology, the base change map `g^*Rf_*ℱ ⟶ Rf'_*(g')^*ℱ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange`) is an isomorphism, functorially in
`ℱ` in the bounded below derived category of sheaves of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ`; in particular for
`ℱ` a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules, placed in degree zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_moduleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴) (τ : GrothendieckTopology B.Schemes) (hτ : τ ≤ B.topology) :
    IsIso (moduleDerivedDirectImageBaseChange.{u, a} B S hS _ _ _
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom) τ hτ
      𝒳.val.property 𝒴'.val.property 𝒴.val.property
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f.hom)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p g.hom))
declarations.comment: sheaves of modules: the base change map g⁻¹Rf_*F ⟶ Rf'_*(g')⁻¹F is an isomorphism, functorially in F in D⁺(Mod(𝒳_τ, O_𝒳))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representableBy_isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075I.** The equivalence over the base representing `p` by `X` is continuous and
cocontinuous for the associated topologies (Stacks 06TP) of `𝒳` and of the slice `(Sch/S)/X`,
so it is an equivalence of the two sites. It is a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
because the slice is fibred in groupoids over the base, so this is Stacks 06NW.
declarations.statement:
theorem representableBy_isContinuous_and_isCocontinuous :
    e.hom.functor.IsContinuous (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ) ∧
      e.hom.functor.IsCocontinuous (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
        (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)
declarations.comment: the equivalence of the underlying sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.structureSheaf_representableBy
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075I.** The representing equivalence carries the structure sheaf of the slice
`(Sch/S)/X` to the structure sheaf of `𝒳`: restriction along it of the one is the other, as
sheaves of commutative rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem structureSheaf_representableBy
    [e.hom.functor.IsContinuous (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
      (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)] :
    (e.hom.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)).obj
        (structureSheaf B S hS (Over.forget X)
          (Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.over_forget X) τ hτ) =
      structureSheaf B S hS p hp τ hτ
declarations.comment: the structure sheaves agree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.structureSheafRepresentableByIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075I.** The comparison isomorphism of structure sheaves under the representing
equivalence. It is the canonical isomorphism attached to the equality
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.structureSheaf_representableBy`, hence the identity on sections.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def structureSheafRepresentableByIso
    [e.hom.functor.IsContinuous (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
      (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)] :
    (e.hom.functor.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u}
          (associatedTopology B S hS p τ)
          (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)).obj
        (structureSheaf B S hS (Over.forget X)
          (Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.over_forget X) τ hτ) ≅
      structureSheaf B S hS p hp τ hτ
declarations.comment: the comparison of structure sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representingObjectHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The morphism of schemes `X ⟶ Y` over `S` corresponding to a 1-morphism
`F : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` of categories representable by `X` and by `Y`: the morphism carried by the functor
of slices that `F` becomes under the two representing equivalences.
declarations.statement: def representingObjectHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) : X ⟶ Y
declarations.comment: the corresponding morphism of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.eq_map_representingObjectHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** Read through the two representing equivalences, the 1-morphism `F` *is*
postcomposition with the corresponding morphism of schemes `g : X ⟶ Y`, as an equality of
functors `(Sch/S)/X ⥤ (Sch/S)/Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_map_representingObjectHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    e.inv.functor ⋙ F ⋙ d.hom.functor =
      Over.map (representingObjectHom B S hS p q F X Y e d hF)
declarations.comment: the 1-morphism of slices is the one of the morphism of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representableBySquareIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The square formed by `F`, the two representing equivalences and
postcomposition with the corresponding morphism of schemes 2-commutes: its 2-cell is the unit of
the representing equivalence of `X`, whiskered with `F ⋙ d`.
declarations.comment: the square of 1-morphisms 2-commutes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.whiskerRight_representableBySquareIso_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The 2-cell filling the square is a 2-cell *over* `(Sch/S)`: whiskering it
with the projection of `(Sch/S)/Y` gives the identity 2-cell. So the square 2-commutes in the
2-category of categories fibred in groupoids over `(Sch/S)`, which is where the comparison of
Stacks 075I takes place.
declarations.statement:
theorem whiskerRight_representableBySquareIso_hom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (representableBySquareIso B S hS p q F X Y e d hF).hom
        (Over.forget Y) =
      eqToHom (by
        rw [Functor.assoc, d.hom.w, hF, Functor.assoc, Over.mapForget_eq, e.hom.w])
declarations.comment: the 2-cell of the square is over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.representingObjectRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The morphism of ringed topoi
`(Sh((Sch/X)_τ), O_X) → (Sh((Sch/Y)_τ), O_Y)` of the morphism of schemes `g : X ⟶ Y` over `S`
corresponding to `F`: the morphism of ringed topoi of Stacks 06TW of the 1-morphism
`CategoryTheory.Over.map g` of slices.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def representingObjectRingedToposHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    RingedToposHom (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget X) (.over_forget X) τ hτ)
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget Y) (.over_forget Y) τ hτ)
declarations.comment: the morphism of ringed topoi of the morphism of schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.conjugatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The morphism of ringed topoi `F : (Sh(𝒳_τ), O_𝒳) → (Sh(𝒴_τ), O_𝒴)` of
Stacks 06TW, read through the two representing equivalences of Stacks 075I: the composite
`(Sh((Sch/X)_τ), O_X) → (Sh(𝒳_τ), O_𝒳) → (Sh(𝒴_τ), O_𝒴) → (Sh((Sch/Y)_τ), O_Y)` of morphisms of
ringed topoi, whose outer two factors are the morphisms of ringed topoi of the 1-morphisms `e⁻¹`
and `d` of the two representing equivalences.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def conjugatedRingedToposHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    RingedToposHom (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget X) (.over_forget X) τ hτ)
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget Y) (.over_forget Y) τ hτ)
declarations.comment: the morphism of ringed topoi of the 1-morphism, read on the representing sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fSharpInverseImage_conjugatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The two morphisms of ringed topoi agree. The morphism of ringed topoi
`F : (Sh(𝒳_τ), O_𝒳) → (Sh(𝒴_τ), O_𝒴)` of Stacks 06TW, read through the two representing
equivalences of Stacks 075I, and the morphism of ringed topoi
`g : (Sh((Sch/X)_τ), O_X) → (Sh((Sch/Y)_τ), O_Y)` of the corresponding morphism of schemes have
the same inverse image up to the canonical comparison
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.conjugatedRingedToposHomInverseImageIso`, and under that comparison
their structure maps `g⁻¹O_Y ⟶ O_X` coincide as morphisms of sheaves of *commutative rings*: the
comparison of the two inverse images of the structure sheaf of `(Sch/S)/Y` takes the one to the
other.
declarations.statement:
theorem fSharpInverseImage_conjugatedRingedToposHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    haveI : EssentiallySmall.{u} 𝒳 := essentiallySmall_of_representableBy B S hS p X e
    haveI : EssentiallySmall.{u} 𝒴 := essentiallySmall_of_representableBy B S hS q Y d
    (conjugatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d hp hq τ hτ hF).fSharpInverseImage =
      (pullbackCommRingSheafIsoOfNatIso (associatedTopology B S hS (Over.forget X) τ)
          (conjugatedRingedToposHomInverseImageIso B S hS p q F X Y e d hp hq τ hτ hF)
          (structureSheaf B S hS (Over.forget Y)
            (Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.over_forget Y) τ hτ)).hom ≫
        (representingObjectRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d τ hτ hF).fSharpInverseImage
declarations.comment: the two morphisms of ringed topoi agree, structure sheaves included

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fSharp_conjugatedRingedToposHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075J.** The square of morphisms of ringed topoi commutes, in the direct-image form
in which a morphism of ringed topoi (Stacks 01D3) states its structure map: the structure map of
`F` read through the two representing equivalences of Stacks 075I, transported along the adjoint
mate of the comparison of the two inverse images, is the structure map of the morphism of ringed
topoi of the corresponding morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem fSharp_conjugatedRingedToposHom (hF : F ⋙ q = p) :
    haveI : EssentiallySmall.{u} 𝒳 := essentiallySmall_of_representableBy B S hS p X e
    haveI : EssentiallySmall.{u} 𝒴 := essentiallySmall_of_representableBy B S hS q Y d
    (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget Y) (.over_forget Y) τ hτ).forgetRing.map
          (conjugatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d hp hq τ hτ hF).fSharp ≫
        (((conjugatedRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d hp hq τ hτ
              hF).toToposHom.adj.ofNatIsoLeft
            (conjugatedRingedToposHomInverseImageIso B S hS p q F X Y e d hp hq τ hτ
              hF)).rightAdjointUniq
          (representingObjectRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d τ hτ
            hF).toToposHom.adj).hom.app
          ((associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget X) (.over_forget X) τ hτ).forgetRing.obj
            (structureSheaf B S hS (Over.forget X)
              (Functor.IsFiberedInGroupoids.over_forget X) τ hτ)) =
      (associatedRingedTopos B S hS (Over.forget Y) (.over_forget Y) τ hτ).forgetRing.map
        (representingObjectRingedToposHom B S hS p q F X Y e d τ hτ hF).fSharp
declarations.comment: the square of morphisms of ringed topoi commutes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.moduleRestriction
declarations.doc:
The restriction `ℱ|_{X_étale} = i_X^*ℱ = π_{X,*}ℱ` of an `𝒪_𝒳`-module on the inherited étale
site of a category fibred in groupoids representable by the algebraic space `X`, as an
`𝒪_X`-module on the small étale site of `X`: the pushforward along the continuous functor
`u_X : X_étale ⥤ 𝒳` of Stacks 073M, with coefficient homomorphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionStructureHom`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def moduleRestriction :
    SheafOfModules.{m} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .etale) ⥤
      Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2
declarations.comment: the restriction of a module to the small étale site of the representing space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.projectionRingedToposHom_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 073M, equation 075K.** The direct image of `π_F` is restriction along the functor
`F_étale ⥤ 𝒳`, that is, `π_{F,*}ℱ(U) = ℱ(u(U))`.

This is the right-hand identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = π_{F, *}ℱ` of equation 075K: the
right-hand side here is the term that `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor` names
`ℱ|_{F_étale}`. The left-hand identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = i_F^{-1}ℱ` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionToposHom_inverseImage`; together they give the chain.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionRingedToposHom_pushforward (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) :
    letI := restrictionFunctor_isContinuous B S hS F p hp e
    (projectionRingedToposHom B S hS F p hp hF e).toToposHom.pushforward =
      (restrictionFunctor B S hS F p e).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale)
declarations.comment: the identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = π_{F, *}ℱ`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionToposHom_inverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 073M, equation 075K.** The inverse image of `i_F` is restriction along the functor
`F_étale ⥤ 𝒳`. This is the source's `π_{F,*} = i_F^{-1}`: both send a sheaf `ℱ` to
`U ↦ ℱ(u(U))`.

It is also the left-hand identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = i_F^{-1}ℱ` of equation 075K, the
right-hand side of this statement being the term that
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor` names `ℱ|_{F_étale}`. The right-hand
identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = π_{F, *}ℱ` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.projectionRingedToposHom_pushforward`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionToposHom_inverseImage (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) :
    letI := restrictionFunctor_isContinuous B S hS F p hp e
    (restrictionToposHom B S hS F p hp e).inverseImage =
      (restrictionFunctor B S hS F p e).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale)
declarations.comment: the identification `ℱ|_{F_étale} = i_F^{-1}ℱ`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 073M, equation 075K.** The restriction `ℱ|_{F_étale} = i_F^{-1}ℱ` of a sheaf on the
inherited étale site of `𝒳` to the small étale site of the algebraic space `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev restrictionSheafFunctor (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) :
    letI := restrictionFunctor_isContinuous B S hS F p hp e
    Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) (Type u) ⥤
      Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) (Type u)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor_obj_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 073M, equation 075K.** The sections of a restriction are the sections of the
original sheaf on the image of the chart: `ℱ|_{F_étale}(U) = ℱ(u(U))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionSheafFunctor_obj_obj (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (𝓕 : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) (Type u))
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS F) :
    ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp e).obj 𝓕).obj.obj (Opposite.op U) =
      𝓕.obj.obj (Opposite.op ((restrictionFunctor B S hS F p e).obj U))
declarations.comment: sections of a restriction

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor_eq_projectionPushforward
registrations.comment: the restriction is the direct image along pi_F

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictionSheafFunctor_eq_restrictionToposHom_inverseImage
registrations.comment: the restriction is the inverse image along i_F

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.projectionPushforward_obj_obj
registrations.comment: sections of the direct image along pi_F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 075L, part (1).** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the
big fppf site of `S` representable by the algebraic space `F`. If `I` is injective in
`Ab(𝒳_étale)`, then `I|_{F_étale}` is injective in `Ab(F_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{t}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) Ab.{t}]
    [∀ G : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{t},
      (restrictionFunctor B S hS F p e).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension G]
    (I : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{t}) [Injective I] :
    Injective ((restrictionAbSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp e).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (1), injective abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isKInjective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 075L, part (2).** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the
big fppf site of `S` representable by the algebraic space `F`. If `I` is a K-injective complex
in `Ab(𝒳_étale)`, then `I|_{F_étale}` is a K-injective complex in `Ab(F_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isKInjective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{t}]
    [HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) Ab.{t}]
    [∀ G : (SmallEtale B S hS F)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Ab.{t},
      (restrictionFunctor B S hS F p e).op.HasPointwiseLeftKanExtension G]
    (I : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{t}) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      (((restrictionAbSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp e).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (2), K-injective complexes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075L, part (1), with no size hypothesis.** For abelian sheaves with values in the
universe of the schemes, the sheafifications and Kan extensions that
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj` asks for exist: `𝒳` is
essentially small, being equivalent to the scheme charts of `F`, and so is the small étale site
of `F`. So the restriction of an injective abelian sheaf on `𝒳_étale` to `F_étale` is injective,
with no hypothesis beyond the source's.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj_univ (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (I : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{u}) [Injective I] :
    Injective ((restrictionAbSheafFunctor.{u} B S hS F p hp e).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (1), injective abelian sheaves, with no size hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isKInjective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075L, part (2), with no size hypothesis.** The degreewise restriction of a
K-injective complex of abelian sheaves on `𝒳_étale` to `F_étale` is K-injective, for sheaves with
values in the universe of the schemes. The abelian structures on the two categories of sheaves
are the ones given by sheafification, which exists on both sites because both are essentially
small (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essentiallySmall_of_equivalenceOver` for `𝒳`); the statement
introduces it from the presentation `e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isKInjective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj_univ (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (e : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) :
    letI := essentiallySmall_of_equivalenceOver B S hS F p e
    letI : HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{u} :=
      GrothendieckTopology.hasSheafify_addCommGrpCat_of_essentiallySmall.{u} _
    letI : HasSheafify (SmallEtale.topology B S hS F) Ab.{u} :=
      GrothendieckTopology.hasSheafify_addCommGrpCat_of_essentiallySmall.{u} _
    ∀ (I : CochainComplex
      (Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) Ab.{u}) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective],
    CochainComplex.IsKInjective
      (((restrictionAbSheafFunctor.{u} B S hS F p hp e).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: part (2), K-injective complexes, with no size hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restriction_modules_not_preserves_injectives
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075L, the failure for modules.** Restriction of abelian sheaves from an algebraic
stack representable by an algebraic space `F` to `F_étale` preserves injectives and K-injective
complexes (parts (1) and (2), `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj`
and `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isKInjective_restrictionAbSheafFunctor_obj`), but **the same does
not hold for modules**: on every big fppf site, the algebraic stack `Spec ℤ`, represented by the
algebraic space `h_{Spec ℤ}`, carries an injective `𝒪`-module `I` with `I|_{F_étale}` not an
injective `𝒪_F`-module, and a K-injective complex of `𝒪`-modules whose restriction is not
K-injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem restriction_modules_not_preserves_injectives (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) :
    (∃ I : SheafOfModules.{u} (specIntEtaleRingSheaf B),
      Injective I ∧ ¬ Injective ((specIntModuleRestriction B).obj I)) ∧
    ∃ I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (specIntEtaleRingSheaf B)) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective ∧ ¬ CochainComplex.IsKInjective
        (((specIntModuleRestriction B).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I)
declarations.comment: the final sentence: the same does not hold for modules, for neither part

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedDirectImageChartEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Equation 075M, left-hand side.** The sections of the restriction `(f_*ℱ)|_{G_étale}` of a
direct image to the small étale site of the algebraic space `G` representing `𝒴`, at a chart `V`
of `G`, are the global sections of the pullback of `ℱ` to the 2-fibre product
`(Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_{u_G V, 𝒴} 𝒳`.

This is the opening display of the source's proof of Stacks 073N, from which equation 075M is
drawn: `π_{G,*}f_*ℱ(V) = f_*ℱ(V/G) = Γ((Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_𝒴 𝒳, pr^{-1}ℱ)`. The first step is
equation 075K, that restriction is evaluation at `u_G V`; the second is Stacks 06W6.

Only the left-hand side of 075M is covered. Identifying these sections with those of
`f_{small,*}(ℱ|_{F_étale})` is the content of Stacks 073N, which is not proved in this library;
the implementation notes of this file say which input to the identification is still
missing.
Accordingly `𝒳` is an arbitrary category fibred in groupoids here, with no representability
assumed of it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictedDirectImageChartEquiv (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (eG : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver q (presheafOfCategories (G ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (f : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴) (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f) (c : q.ChoiceOfPullbacks)
    [∀ H : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u, f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension H]
    (ℱ : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) (Type u))
    (V : SmallEtale B S hS G) :
    ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS G q hq eG).obj
        ((etaleDirectImage B S hS p q hp f hf).obj ℱ)).obj.obj (op V) ≃
      Presheaf.globalSections
        ((TwoFibreProductOver.snd (Over.forget ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS G).obj V)) p q
          (c.sliceFunctor (chartFiberObj B S hS G q eG V)) f).op ⋙ ℱ.obj)
declarations.comment: the left-hand side, as sections over the 2-fibre product at a chart

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedDirectImageComparison
declarations.doc:
**Equation 075M.** The comparison of the two direct images around the square of
Stacks 073N: the canonical map `π_{G,*}f_*ℱ ⟶ f_{small,*}(ℱ|_{F_étale})`, natural in `ℱ`, whose
source is the left-hand side `(f_*ℱ)|_{G_étale}` of equation 075M and whose target is its
right-hand side.

Its value on sections over a diagram of étale scheme charts is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedDirectImageComparisonSections`. That it is an isomorphism,
which is what the displayed equality of the source asserts, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison` of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Stacks/RestrictionDirectImageComparisonIso.lean`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def restrictedDirectImageComparison :
    (restrictionSquareFibredLeg B S hS G p q hp hq hG eG f hf).toToposHom.pushforward ⟶
      (restrictionSquareSpaceLeg B S hS F G p hp hF hG eF fSpace).toToposHom.pushforward
declarations.comment:
the comparison map between the two sides, natural in the sheaf: both sides of the
  equation are present -- the left-hand side `(f_*F)|_{G_etale}` as the direct image of
  `restrictionSquareFibredLeg` and the right-hand side `f_{small,*}(F|_{F_etale})` as that of
  `restrictionSquareSpaceLeg` -- together with the canonical map from the first to the second and
  its naturality in the sheaf. That this map is an ISOMORPHISM, which is what the displayed
  equality asserts, is `isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison` of
  StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Stacks/RestrictionDirectImageComparisonIso.lean, which reduces it
  by `isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison_of_bijective` to a bijection on sections over one
  etale scheme chart of G at a time.
  The compatibility `ha` of the 1-morphism f with the morphism fSpace of algebraic spaces through
  the two chosen presentations is a hypothesis; it is realized for every fSpace by
  `exists_comparisonChartFunctorIso`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonTarget_equalizer
declarations.doc:
**The right-hand side of equation 075M at a chart, as an equalizer.**  The target of the
comparison map is `f_{small,*}(ℱ|_{F_étale})`; its sections over an étale scheme chart `V` of
`G` are the equalizer of the sections of `ℱ|_{F_étale}` over an étale scheme chart `W` of `F`
covering `F ×_G V` and over a chart `W'` presenting the self-fibre product of `W` over
`F ×_G V`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_smallEtaleDirectImageChartEqualizerEquiv` — Tag 03H7 for
the direct image on the small étale sites — specialized at the chart of equation 075M.  The
target of the comparison is that direct image on the nose: the direct image of the geometric
morphism underlying `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleRingedToposHom` is the spaces-étale
direct image of Stacks 03G2 conjugated by the comparison equivalences of Stacks 03G1, which is
how `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleDirectImage` is defined.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonTarget_equalizer
    (ℱ : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) (Type u))
    (V : SmallEtale B S hS G) :
    ∃ (W W' : SmallEtale B S hS F) (a b : W' ⟶ W),
      Nonempty (((smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS fSpace).toToposHom.pushforward.obj
            ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp eF).obj ℱ)).obj.obj (op V) ≃
        {y : ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp eF).obj ℱ).obj.obj (op W) //
          ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp eF).obj ℱ).obj.map a.op y =
            ((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS F p hp eF).obj ℱ).obj.map b.op y})
declarations.comment: the right-hand side f_{small,*}(F|_{F_etale}), as an equalizer of sections of F|_{F_etale} over two etale scheme charts of F, at a chart V of G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison
declarations.doc:
**Equation 075M.** The canonical comparison map of equation 075M,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedDirectImageComparison`, is an **isomorphism**: the two sides
of the equation,
```
(f_*ℱ)|_{G_étale} = f_{small,*}(ℱ|_{F_étale}),
```
agree, naturally in the sheaf, through that canonical map.

Invertibility is reduced to a bijection on sections over each étale scheme chart `V` of `G` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison_of_bijective`, and there:

* **injectivity** is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_restrictedDirectImageComparisonHom_app`. A section of
  `f_*ℱ` over `u_G V` is determined by its values at the pairs `(Z, κ : f(Z) ⟶ u_G V)` (Stacks
  06W6), the chart correspondence of Stacks 03G8 determines those values at the morphisms out of
  the image of an étale chart of `F`, and the factorization lemma together with the sheaf
  condition on `ℱ` carries that to all of them.
* **surjectivity** is
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.surjective_restrictedDirectImageComparisonHom_app`. The canonical
  restrictions of a section of the right-hand side to the diagrams of étale scheme charts over
  `V` form a family which the refinement of two chart diagrams shows compatible, the sheaf
  condition on `ℱ` glues that family to a value at every pair `(Z, κ)`, and those values are the
  components of a global section over the 2-fibre product `(Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_𝒴 𝒳` — a section of
  the left-hand side. It is carried to the given section because a section of the right-hand side
  is determined by its restriction to one diagram whose chart covers the cartesian base change
  `F ×_G V`, which is Properties of Spaces 03H7.

The choice of pullbacks that the pushforward formula of Stacks 06W6 needs is not a hypothesis: a
category fibred in groupoids admits one.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_restrictedDirectImageComparison :
    IsIso (restrictedDirectImageComparison B S hS F G p q hp hq hF hG eF eG f hf fSpace ha)
declarations.comment: the displayed equality itself: the canonical comparison map between the two sides is an isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonSource_equalizer
declarations.doc:
**Equation 075M, the left-hand side at a chart, as an equalizer.** The sections of
`(f_*ℱ)|_{G_étale}` over an étale scheme chart `V` of `G` are the equalizer of the sections of `ℱ`
over two objects of the 2-fibre product `(Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_𝒴 𝒳`, namely an object `A` coming from
an étale scheme chart of an algebraic space representing that 2-fibre product and the object
presenting the self-product of `A`.

This is the counterpart of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonTarget_equalizer`, which presents
the *right*-hand side at the same chart as an equalizer of sections of `ℱ|_{F_étale}` over two
étale scheme charts of `F`. With both sides presented, the comparison map of equation 075M is a map
between two equalizer diagrams, which is the shape in which the source proves it invertible.

The hypotheses are those of equation 075M itself: `𝒳` and `𝒴` are presented by the algebraic
spaces `F` and `G` and `f` is a 1-morphism of fibred categories between them. The
representability of the 2-fibre product that the equalizer presentation needs — the identification
the source makes in its proof of Stacks 073N — is supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAlgebraicSpace_twoFibreProductStructureFunctor`, and the
equalizer itself by `exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonSource_equalizer_of_equivalenceOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonSource_equalizer
    (Fpsh : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hFpsh : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Fpsh)
    (eFpsh : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver p
      (presheafOfCategories (Fpsh ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (hf : p.IsFibredOneMorphism q f)
    [∀ H : 𝒳ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u, f.op.HasPointwiseRightKanExtension H]
    (ℱ : Sheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .etale) (Type u))
    (V : SmallEtale B S hS G) :
    ∃ (A A' : TwoFibreProductOver (Over.forget ((SmallEtale.toOver B S hS G).obj V)) p q
          (c.sliceFunctor (chartFiberObj B S hS G q eG V)) f) (a b : A' ⟶ A),
      Nonempty (((restrictionSheafFunctor B S hS G q hq eG).obj
            ((etaleDirectImage B S hS p q hp f hf).obj ℱ)).obj.obj (op V) ≃
        {y : ℱ.obj.obj (op ((twoFibreProductSnd B S hS G p q eG f c V).obj A)) //
          ℱ.obj.map ((twoFibreProductSnd B S hS G p q eG f c V).map a).op y =
            ℱ.obj.map ((twoFibreProductSnd B S hS G p q eG f c V).map b).op y})
declarations.comment: the left-hand side (f_*F)|_{G_etale}, as an equalizer of sections of F over two objects of the 2-fibre product (Sch/V)_fppf x_Y X, at a chart V of G. This is the counterpart of exists_restrictedDirectImageComparisonTarget_equalizer, which is the right-hand side at the same chart; with both sides presented the comparison map is a map of equalizer diagrams. The representability of the 2-fibre product by an algebraic space over S -- the identification of (Sch/V)_fppf x_Y X with the split category fibred in groupoids of V x_G F that the source's proof of Tag 073N makes -- is supplied by exists_isAlgebraicSpace_twoFibreProductStructureFunctor from the presentations of X and Y alone

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.restrictedTotalDerivedDirectImageIsoClauses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075N.** Let `S` be a scheme in a big fppf site, let `f : 𝒳 ⥤ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of
categories fibred in groupoids over `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` with `𝒳` presented by an algebraic space `F`
and `𝒴` by an algebraic space `G`, and let `f : F ⟶ G` be the induced morphism of algebraic
spaces. Then

1. for an abelian sheaf `ℱ` on `𝒳_étale`, `(Rf_*ℱ)|_{G_étale} = Rf_{small,*}(ℱ|_{F_étale})` in
   `D(G_étale)`;
2. for a complex `ℱ` of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules, the same identity in `D(𝒪_G)`.

Here `Rf_*` and `Rf_{small,*}` are the total right derived direct images
`derivedAbelianDirectImageFibred`, `derivedAbelianDirectImageSpace`, `derivedDirectImageFibred`
and `derivedDirectImageSpace`, which exist because the four sites are essentially small — `𝒳`
and `𝒴` by their presentations — so that K-injective resolutions exist (Stacks 079P). The
restrictions `(-)|_{F_étale}`, `(-)|_{G_étale}` are exact and appear underived, as in the source.
Each component is the canonical comparison of the two derived composites around the square of
Stacks 073N, shown invertible.
declarations.comment: Both clauses, with the four derived direct images constructed: (1) for abelian sheaves (Rf_*F)|_{G_etale} = Rf_{small,*}(F|_{F_etale}) in D(G_etale), (2) the same identity in D(O_G) for sheaves of modules. Rf_* and Rf_{small,*} are the total right derived functors of degreewise direct image, which exist by K-injective resolutions (Tag 079P) on the four essentially small sites; the inputs are S, the 1-morphism and the two presentations.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.inducedSquareSpacesHom
declarations.doc:
**The morphism of algebraic spaces `f' : F' ⟶ G'` of Stacks 075P.**  For a 2-fibre product
square over the cospan `(g, f)`, with the apex represented by an algebraic space `F'` and the
base `𝒴'` of `g` represented by an algebraic space `G'`, the left-hand leg `f'` of the square
induces a morphism `F' ⟶ G'` of algebraic spaces: an element of `F'` over `U` is an object of
the apex over `U`, whose image under `f'` is an object of `𝒴'` over `U`, hence an element of
`G'` over `U`.

This is the construction of **Stacks 0GQA**, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.inducedSpacesHom`, read
at the left-hand leg of the square.  Only the two chosen equivalences and the verticality of
the leg over the site enter; representability of the apex, which **Stacks 0300** supplies, is
what makes such an equivalence available in the first place.

The displayed identity of **Stacks 075P**, which is the direct image along this morphism of a
restricted derived direct image, is not proved; see the implementation notes of this module.
declarations.comment:
the induced morphism of algebraic spaces f' : F' ⟶ G' named in the conclusion,
  through chosen equivalences of the apex with F' and of Y' with G'. The displayed base change
  identity of this tag is NOT proved

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.RepresentableBaseChangeSquare.exists_isAlgebraicSpace_apex
declarations.doc:
**The apex of the square is representable by an algebraic space**, when `f` is
representable by algebraic spaces and `𝒴'` is representable by an algebraic space. This is
Stacks 0300, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_twoFibreProduct`, for the
2-fibre product with the factors in the order of the source's square, read through the exchange
of the two factors `CategoryTheory.TwoFibreProductOver.swapEquivalenceOver`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAlgebraicSpace_apex (hf : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (h𝒴' : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace B S hS 𝒴'.val) :
    ∃ F' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F' ∧
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver (apexP B S hS f g)
        (presheafOfCategories (F' ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
declarations.comment: The first assertion: the apex X' of the 2-fibre product square is representable by an algebraic space F', given that f is representable by algebraic spaces and that Y' is representable by an algebraic space.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.RepresentableBaseChangeSquare.restrictedDerivedBaseChangeIsoClauses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075P.** Let `S` be a scheme and let

```
𝒴' ×_𝒴 𝒳 --g'--> 𝒳
    |            |
    f'           f
    v            v
    𝒴' ---g--->  𝒴
```

be the 2-fibre product square of algebraic stacks over `S`. If `𝒴'` is represented by an
algebraic space `G'` and the apex by an algebraic space `F'` — which is the case as soon as `f`
is representable by algebraic spaces, by `exists_isAlgebraicSpace_apex` — and `f' : F' ⟶ G'` is
the induced morphism of algebraic spaces, then

`g⁻¹(Rf_*ℱ)|_{G'_étale} = Rf'_{small,*}((g')⁻¹ℱ|_{F'_étale})`

1. for `ℱ` in `D(𝒳_étale)`, in particular for an abelian sheaf on `𝒳_étale`, and
2. for `ℱ` in `D(𝒪_𝒳)`, in particular for a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules,

as isomorphisms of functors. The derived direct images are the total right derived functors of
Stacks 075N, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedAbelianDirectImageFibred`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedAbelianDirectImageSpace`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedDirectImageFibred` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedDirectImageSpace`.
declarations.statement:
def restrictedDerivedBaseChangeIsoClauses :
    (Space.derivedAbelianDirectImageFibred B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) (𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) f.hom.hom.toFunctor
        ((𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids).isFibredOneMorphism f.hom.hom.w) ⋙
        (inverseImageAb B S hS g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          (restrictionG'Ab B S hS G' hG' eG').mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (fstInverseImageAb B S hS f g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (restrictionF'Ab B S hS f g F' hF' eF').mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          Space.derivedAbelianDirectImageSpace B S hS F' G' (apexP B S hS f g) 𝒴'.val.val.p hF'
            hG' eF' eG' (TwoFibreProductOver.snd _ _ _ f.hom.hom.toFunctor g.hom.hom.toFunctor)
            (snd_isFibredOneMorphism B S hS f g)) ×
    (Space.derivedDirectImageFibred B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p
        (𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) (𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) f.hom.hom.toFunctor
        ((𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids).isFibredOneMorphism f.hom.hom.w) ⋙
        (inverseImageMod B S hS g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
          (Space.projectionRingedToposHom B S hS G' 𝒴'.val.val.p (𝒴'.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
            hG' eG').derivedPushforwardOfExact ≅
      (fstInverseImageMod B S hS f g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (Space.projectionRingedToposHom B S hS F' (apexP B S hS f g)
          (apexP_isFiberedInGroupoids B S hS f g) hF' eF').derivedPushforwardOfExact ⋙
          Space.derivedDirectImageSpace B S hS F' G' (apexP B S hS f g) 𝒴'.val.val.p hF'
            hG' eF' eG' (TwoFibreProductOver.snd _ _ _ f.hom.hom.toFunctor g.hom.hom.toFunctor)
            (snd_isFibredOneMorphism B S hS f g))
declarations.comment: The displayed identity, both clauses, as isomorphisms of functors on the unbounded derived categories: (1) g^{-1}(Rf_*F)|_{G'_etale} = Rf'_{small,*}((g')^{-1}F|_{F'_etale}) for F in D(X_etale), (2) the same identity for F in D(O_X), for any presentations of Y' and of the apex X' by algebraic spaces G' and F'.

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpace_of_isTwoFibreProduct
registrations.comment:
the first assertion of the conclusion: the apex X' of the 2-fibre product
  square is representable by an algebraic space F', given that f is representable by algebraic
  spaces and that Y' is representable by an algebraic space. This is Tag 0300, at hypotheses
  weaker than the source's. The displayed base change identity of this tag is NOT proved; see
  the implementation notes of
  StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Stacks/Sheaves/RepresentableBaseChangeSquare.lean

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isSheaf_fppf_of_lqc_flatLfp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075R, the first assertion.** A presheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules which is locally
quasi-coherent (**Stacks 06WJ**) and whose comparison maps `c_φ` of **Stacks 06WC** are
isomorphisms along the arrows lying over flat morphisms locally of finite presentation is a sheaf
for the fppf topology of `𝒳`, that is, an `𝒪_𝒳`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSheaf_fppf_of_lqc_flatLfp :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS p .fppf) F.presheaf
declarations.comment: the first assertion: a presheaf of modules satisfying (a) and (b) is an 𝒪_𝒳-module, i.e. a sheaf for the fppf topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_rightDerived_etaleComparisonPushforward_lqcFbcModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075R, clause (1).** Let `ℱ` be a presheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules which is locally
quasi-coherent (**Stacks 06WJ**) and whose comparison maps `c_φ` of **Stacks 06WC** are
isomorphisms along the arrows lying over flat morphisms locally of finite presentation, and let
`ε : 𝒳_{fppf} ⟶ 𝒳_{étale}` be the comparison morphism. Then

`R^iε_*ℱ = 0` for `i > 0`,

that is, `Rε_*ℱ = ε_*ℱ`. Here `ℱ` is the `𝒪_𝒳`-module of the first assertion,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lqcFbcModule`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_etaleComparisonPushforward_lqcFbcModule (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsZero (((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).rightDerived i).obj
      (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc))
declarations.comment: clause (1): `Rε_*ℱ = ε_*ℱ`, i.e. `R^iε_*ℱ = 0` for `i > 0`, for the comparison `ε : 𝒳_fppf ⟶ 𝒳_étale` and a module satisfying (a) and (b)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_fppfCohomologyIso_etaleCohomology_lqcFbcModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075R, clause (2).** Let `ℱ` be a presheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules satisfying (a) and (b) of
Stacks 075R, so an `𝒪_𝒳`-module (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lqcFbcModule`), and let
`ε : 𝒳_{fppf} ⟶ 𝒳_{étale}` be the comparison morphism. The cohomology of `ℱ` computed in the
fppf topology agrees with the cohomology of `ε_*ℱ`, the same presheaf of modules, computed in the
étale topology:

* `H^n_{fppf}(𝒳, ℱ) ≅ H^n_{étale}(𝒳, ε_*ℱ)` for all `n`;
* `H^n_{fppf}(x, ℱ) ≅ H^n_{étale}(x, ε_*ℱ)` for every object `x` of `𝒳` and all `n`;
* `RΓ_{fppf}(𝒳, ℱ) ≅ RΓ_{étale}(𝒳, ε_*ℱ)` and `RΓ_{fppf}(x, ℱ) ≅ RΓ_{étale}(x, ε_*ℱ)`, the
  derived sections being the complexes of sections of injective resolutions, up to homotopy.

As in the source this follows formally from clause (1): `ε_*` is left exact and preserves
injectives, and `ℱ` is `ε_*`-acyclic by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_rightDerived_etaleComparisonPushforward_lqcFbcModule`, so `ε_*`
carries an injective resolution of `ℱ` to one of `ε_*ℱ`, and both cohomologies are computed by
the same complex of sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_fppfCohomologyIso_etaleCohomology_lqcFbcModule :
    (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (((Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalSectionsFunctor.{v, u, u, u}
        (fppfSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)).rightDerived n).obj
        (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
      ((Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalSectionsFunctor.{v, u, u, u}
        (etaleSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)).rightDerived n).obj
        ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
          (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc)))) ∧
    (∀ (x : 𝒳) (n : ℕ), Nonempty
      (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (fppfSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp) (op x)).rightDerived n).obj
        (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (etaleSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp) (op x)).rightDerived n).obj
        ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
          (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc)))) ∧
    Nonempty ((Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalSectionsFunctor.{v, u, u, u}
        (fppfSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
        (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
      (Stacks.Cohomology.SiteModules.globalSectionsFunctor.{v, u, u, u}
        (etaleSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
        ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
          (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc))) ∧
    (∀ x : 𝒳, Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (fppfSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)
          (op x)).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
        (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (etaleSiteRingSheaf B S hS p hp)
          (op x)).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
        ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
          (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc))))
declarations.comment: clause (2): fppf cohomology `H^p(𝒳, ℱ)`, `H^p(x, ℱ)` and the derived sections `RΓ(𝒳, ℱ)`, `RΓ(x, ℱ)` of a module satisfying (a) and (b) agree with those computed in the étale topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.nonempty_higherDirectImageIso_sheafify_etale_lqcFbcModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075R, clause (3).** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
over `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` and let `ℱ` be a presheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules satisfying (a) and (b) of
Stacks 075R, so an `𝒪_𝒳`-module (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.lqcFbcModule`). Then

* `R^i f_*ℱ`, computed in the fppf topology, is the fppf sheafification of the higher direct image
  `R^i f_{étale,*}(ε_*ℱ)` computed in the étale topology, for every `i`;
* similarly for the derived direct image: `Rf_*ℱ` is `ε⁻¹(Rf_{étale,*}(ε_*ℱ))`, the direct images
  being those of injective resolutions, up to homotopy, and `ε⁻¹` the fppf sheafification of
  étale modules (`Stacks.SheafOfModules.comparisonPullbackIso`).

The source deduces this from (2) and Stacks 075G. Here it is deduced from (1) directly:
`f_{fppf,*} ≅ ε⁻¹ ∘ f_{étale,*} ∘ ε_*` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleDirectImageIsoEtale`),
`ε_*` carries an injective resolution of the `ε_*`-acyclic module `ℱ` to one of `ε_*ℱ`, and
`ε⁻¹` is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_higherDirectImageIso_sheafify_etale_lqcFbcModule :
    (∀ i : ℕ, Nonempty (((moduleDirectImageSmall B S hS p q hp hq f hf .fppf).rightDerived i).obj
        (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
      (PresheafOfModules.sheafification.{u} (𝟙 (fppfSiteRingSheaf B S hS q hq).obj)).obj
        (((moduleDirectImageSmall B S hS p q hp hq f hf .etale).rightDerived i).obj
          ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
            (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc))).val)) ∧
    Nonempty
      ((moduleDirectImageSmall B S hS p q hp hq f hf .fppf).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
          (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc) ≅
        ((etaleComparisonPullback B S hS q hq).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          ((moduleDirectImageSmall B S hS p q hp hq f hf .etale).rightDerivedToHomotopyCategory.obj
            ((etaleComparisonPushforward B S hS p hp).obj
              (lqcFbcModule B E h S hS p hp F hlqc hbc))))
declarations.comment: clause (3): for a 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 → 𝒴` of categories fibred in groupoids and a module `ℱ` satisfying (a) and (b), `R^if_*ℱ` is the fppf sheafification of the higher direct image computed in the étale topology, and similarly for the derived direct image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactMorphism_of_isQuasiCompactStack_absolute
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075S, part (1).** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks with `𝒳` quasi-compact
and `𝒴` quasi-separated in the absolute sense of Stacks 050D part (8) is quasi-compact. Nothing is
asked of the base scheme of the big fppf site.

Quasi-compactness of a 1-morphism is Stacks 050U, so what has to be shown is quasi-compactness of
each base change of `f` by a quasi-compact algebraic stack. Over the terminal scheme the relative
statement `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactMorphism_of_isQuasiCompactStack` applies with no
hypothesis — the terminal scheme is affine, hence quasi-separated — to the views of `f` and of the
test stack, whose quasi-compactness is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactStack_changeBaseAlgebraicStack_iff`; and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack`
`.isQuasiCompactStack_twoFibreProductAlgebraicStack_of_viewOverIntegers` brings the resulting
quasi-compact 2-fibre product back to `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactMorphism_of_isQuasiCompactStack_absolute
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒳 : IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property)
    (h𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒴) :
    IsQuasiCompactMorphism.{u, w} B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactMorphism_and_isQuasiSeparated_absolute
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075S, part (2).** A 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks with `𝒳` quasi-compact
and quasi-separated and `𝒴` quasi-separated, both in the absolute sense of Stacks 050D part (8),
is quasi-compact and quasi-separated.

Quasi-compactness is part (1). Quasi-separatedness is Stacks 050N part (8), whose two inputs are
the over-the-base readings of the two absolute hypotheses, supplied by Stacks 050N part (4).
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactMorphism_and_isQuasiSeparated_absolute
    {𝒳 𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒳qc : IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property)
    (h𝒳qs : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒳)
    (h𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒴) :
    IsQuasiCompactMorphism.{u, w} B S hS f ∧
      AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactStack_and_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_twoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075S, part (3).** A 2-fibre product `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵` of algebraic stacks, with `𝒳`, `𝒵`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated and `𝒴` quasi-separated, all in the absolute sense of
Stacks 050D part (8), is quasi-compact and quasi-separated in that same absolute sense. Nothing is
asked of the base scheme of the big fppf site.

The projection to `𝒵` is a base change of `f`, which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by
part (2), hence is itself quasi-compact (Stacks 050V) and quasi-separated (Stacks 050F). A
quasi-compact 1-morphism into the quasi-compact `𝒵` has quasi-compact source, and Stacks 050L
part (8) carries absolute quasi-separatedness from `𝒵` to the apex.

The absolute conclusion is what the next application of part (1) needs of its target, which the
over-the-base conclusion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiCompactStack_and_isQuasiSeparatedOver_twoFibreProduct` is not.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompactStack_and_isAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated_twoFibreProduct
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (h𝒳qc : IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳.val 𝒳.property)
    (h𝒳qs : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒳)
    (h𝒵qc : IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒵.val 𝒵.property)
    (h𝒵qs : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒵)
    (h𝒴 : AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ 𝒴) :
    IsQuasiCompactStack.{u, w} B S hS
        (twoFibreProductAlgebraicStack B S hS f g).val
        (twoFibreProductAlgebraicStack B S hS f g).property ∧
      AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated.{u, w} B S hS hZ
        (twoFibreProductAlgebraicStack B S hS f g)
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075U.** A 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is *smooth* when it passes the
existential smooth-diagram test of Stacks 06FM at smoothness of morphisms of algebraic spaces:
there are algebraic spaces `U`, `V` over `S`, a smooth 1-morphism `a` from the category fibred in
groupoids of `U` to the source which is surjective on objects, a smooth 1-morphism `b` from the
one of `V` to the target, and a morphism `h : U ⟶ V` making the square 2-commute, with `h` a
smooth morphism of algebraic spaces.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSmooth {𝒳 𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSmooth_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075V.** The composite of two smooth 1-morphisms of algebraic stacks over `S` is
smooth: the composition remark Stacks 06FP at smoothness of morphisms of algebraic spaces, which
is smooth local on the source-and-target by the smooth case of Stacks 06FC and stable under
composition by Stacks 03ZD.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵)
    (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) (hg : IsSmooth B S hS g) :
    IsSmooth B S hS (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSmooth_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 075W.** A base change of a smooth 1-morphism of algebraic stacks over `S` is
smooth: for `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` smooth and `g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴` arbitrary, the projection to `𝒴'` of any
2-fibre product square over the cospan `(g, f)` is smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSmooth_baseChange {𝒳 𝒴 𝒴' : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS}
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴) (g : 𝒴' ⟶ 𝒴)
    (Q : Bicategory.TwoCommSq g f) (hQ : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct Q)
    (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) :
    IsSmooth B S hS Q.fst
