The instance argument `HasExt.{t}` is not a hypothesis on `ℱ`: `fppfModuleCohomology.{u, w, t}`
is only defined in its presence. At `t = u` it is supplied by the Grothendieck abelian structure
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isGrothendieckAbelian_fppfModules`), which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_fppfModuleCohomology_of_isParasitic_ofGrothendieck`.

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fppfModuleCohomologyULiftIso` this is the vanishing of `Ext^i` out of
the lifted structure sheaf of the universe lift of `ℱ`, which is parasitic as `ℱ` is, and that
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_uliftUnit_of_isParasitic`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_fppfModuleCohomology_of_isParasitic_atSchemeUniverse
    {𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} [HasExt.{t} (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)]
    (N : fppfModules B S hS 𝒳) (hN : IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf N.val) (i : ℕ) :
    IsZero ((FlatFppf.fppfModuleCohomology.{u, w, t} B S hS 𝒳 i).obj N)
declarations.comment: part (1) for τ = fppf at the module universe u of the schemes: H^i(𝒳, ℱ) = 0 for a parasitic ℱ, with H^i = Ext^i(𝒪_𝒳, -) as in FlatFppf.fppfModuleCohomology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_unit_of_isParasitic_atSchemeUniverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0775** part (1), for `τ` the étale or the fppf topology, at the module universe `u` of
the schemes. Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack and `ℱ` a parasitic sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ`
(**Stacks 0773**). Then `H^i_τ(𝒳, ℱ) = Ext^i(𝒪_𝒳, ℱ) = 0` for every `i`, for `Ext`-groups in any
universe `t`.

The instance argument `HasExt.{t}` is not a hypothesis on `ℱ`: it is what makes `Ext`-groups in
the universe `t` exist at all, and it is always available at `t = u`, the category of modules
being Grothendieck abelian (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isGrothendieckAbelian_moduleRingSheaf`, see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_unit_of_isParasitic_atSchemeUniverse_ofGrothendieck`).

By `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_unit_iff_isZero_ext_uliftUnit` this is the vanishing of
`Ext^i` out of the lifted structure sheaf of the universe lift of `ℱ`, which is parasitic as `ℱ`
is, and that is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_uliftUnit_of_isParasitic`.
declarations.comment: part (1) for τ the étale or the fppf topology, at the module universe u of the schemes: H^i_τ(𝒳, ℱ) = Ext^i(𝒪_𝒳, ℱ) = 0 for a parasitic ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_ext_uliftUnit_of_isParasitic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0775** part (1). Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack, let `τ` be the étale or the fppf
topology, and let `ℱ` be a parasitic sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ` (**Stacks 0773**). Then
`H^i_τ(𝒳, ℱ) = 0` for all `i`.

The modules have their sections in the universe `u + 1` of the objects of the site, where the
structure sheaf `𝒪_𝒳` is a module through its universe lift `Stacks.SheafOfModules.uliftUnit`
and `H^i_τ(𝒳, -) = Ext^i(𝒪_𝒳, -)`, in any universe `t` of `Ext`-groups. By **Stacks 03FD** this
is the cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf
(`Stacks.Cohomology.ULiftUnitComparison.extULiftUnitIso`), which vanishes because that sheaf
vanishes at the flat objects (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_functorH_of_subsingleton_flatObject`,
from the cohomology comparison of **Stacks 07AK** along the inclusion of the flat objects).
declarations.comment: part (1), for τ the étale or the fppf topology, with no hypothesis: H^i_τ(𝒳, ℱ) = 0 for a parasitic ℱ, at the module universe u + 1 of the objects of the site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_moduleSheafHigherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0775 (2) at the module universe `u + 1` of the objects of the site.** Let
`f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks, `τ` the étale or the fppf topology, and `ℱ` a
parasitic sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ` (**Stacks 0773**). Then every higher direct image
`R^nf_*ℱ` (**Stacks 06WE**, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.moduleSheafHigherDirectImage`) is a
parasitic sheaf of `𝒪_𝒴`-modules.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_rightDerived_stackModuleDirectImageSucc` moved along
`AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicStacks.moduleDirectImageRightDerivedIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isParasitic_moduleSheafHigherDirectImage (hτ : τ = .etale ∨ τ = .fppf)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (Stacks.RelativeCech.moduleRingSheaf B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids τ)) (hN : IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 τ N.val) (n : ℕ) :
    IsParasitic B S hS 𝒴 τ ((moduleSheafHigherDirectImage.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1, u} B S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒴.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids 𝒴.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor k.hom) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p k.hom)
      (B.baseTopology τ) (B.baseTopology_le_topology τ) n).obj N).val
declarations.comment: part (2), for τ the étale or the fppf topology, at the module universe u + 1 of the objects of the site: R^if_*ℱ is parasitic for a parasitic ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_stackModuleHigherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0775 (2)**, for `τ` the étale or the fppf topology, at the module universe `u` of the
schemes. Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks and `ℱ` a parasitic sheaf of
`𝒪_𝒳`-modules on `𝒳_τ` (**Stacks 0773**). Then every higher direct image `R^nf_*ℱ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.stackModuleHigherDirectImage`) is parasitic.

The universe lift carries `R^nf_*ℱ` to `R^nf_*` at `u + 1` of the lift of `ℱ`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.stackModuleHigherDirectImageULiftIso`), the lift of a parasitic module
is parasitic, and at `u + 1` this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_moduleSheafHigherDirectImage`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isParasitic_stackModuleHigherDirectImage (hτ : τ = .etale ∨ τ = .fppf)
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.RelativeCech.moduleRingSheaf B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids τ)) (hN : IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 τ N.val) (n : ℕ) :
    IsParasitic B S hS 𝒴 τ ((stackModuleHigherDirectImage B S hS k τ n).obj N).val
declarations.comment: part (2), for τ the étale or the fppf topology, at the module universe u of the schemes: R^if_*ℱ is parasitic for a parasitic ℱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_fppfModulesHigherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0775 (2) for the fppf topology at the module universe `u`**: for every 1-morphism
`f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks, the higher direct images
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fppfModulesHigherDirectImage` of a parasitic module are parasitic. This
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isParasitic_stackModuleHigherDirectImage` at `τ = fppf`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isParasitic_fppfModulesHigherDirectImage
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.RelativeCech.moduleRingSheaf B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids .fppf)) (hN : IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf N.val) (n : ℕ) :
    IsParasitic B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ((fppfModulesHigherDirectImage B S hS k n).obj N).val
declarations.comment: part (2) for τ = fppf at the module universe u of the schemes: R^if_*ℱ is parasitic for a parasitic ℱ, with R^if_* as in fppfModulesHigherDirectImage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.tfae_exact_isParasitic_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0776.** Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack and let `α : 𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖` and `β : 𝓖 ⟶ 𝓗` be maps in
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` with `β ∘ α = 0`. The following are equivalent:

1. in the abelian category `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` the complex `𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖 ⟶ 𝓗` is exact at `𝓖`;
2. `Ker(β)/Im(α)` computed in `Mod(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` is parasitic;
3. `Ker(β)/Im(α)` computed in `Mod(𝒳_fppf, 𝒪_𝒳)` is parasitic.

The abelian structure of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.instAbelianQuasicoherentModules`; `Ker(β)/Im(α)`
computed in `Mod(𝒳_τ, 𝒪_𝒳)` is the homology of the complex `𝓕 ⟶ 𝓖 ⟶ 𝓗` regarded as a complex of
sheaves of modules on the site of `τ` (**Stacks 06TP**), and parasitic is **Stacks 0773**.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_exact_isParasitic_homology {F G H : quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳} (α : F ⟶ G)
    (β : G ⟶ H) (w : α ≫ β = 0) :
    List.TFAE [(ShortComplex.mk α β w).Exact,
      IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .etale ((ShortComplex.mk α β w).map
        (FibredSite.toSiteModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
          .etale)).homology.val,
      IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ((ShortComplex.mk α β w).map
        (FibredSite.toSiteModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
          .fppf)).homology.val]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator
declarations.doc:
**The coherator on `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.** The right adjoint of the inclusion
`i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`: it sends a locally quasi-coherent module with the flat base
change property to the terminal quasi-coherent module equipped with a map to it.
declarations.statement:
def flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator
    (hinc : ∀ F : FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp,
      IsLocallyQuasicoherentWithFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp
        ((FibredSite.toSiteModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp .etale).obj F).val)
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hpres : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp hinc))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hlsD : LocallySmall.{u}
      (locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeModules.{u, u + 1, u} B E h S hS p hp))
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeModules.{u, u + 1, u} B E h S hS p hp ⥤
      FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp
declarations.comment: the right adjoint Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.flatBaseChangeQuasicoheratorAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**The coherator on `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` is right adjoint to the inclusion.** The adjunction is
the universal property of the terminal objects the coherator is built from.
declarations.statement:
def flatBaseChangeQuasicoheratorAdjunction
    (hinc : ∀ F : FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp,
      IsLocallyQuasicoherentWithFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp
        ((FibredSite.toSiteModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp .etale).obj F).val)
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hpres : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp hinc))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hlsD : LocallySmall.{u}
      (locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeModules.{u, u + 1, u} B E h S hS p hp))
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp hinc ⊣
      flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator B E h S hS p hp hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep
declarations.comment: the adjunction between the inclusion and the right adjoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.flatBaseChangeQuasicoheratorCompInclusionIsoId
declarations.doc:
**`Q ∘ i` is the identity functor** of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, for the coherator `Q` on
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` and the inclusion `i`.
declarations.statement:
def flatBaseChangeQuasicoheratorCompInclusionIsoId
    (hinc : ∀ F : FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp,
      IsLocallyQuasicoherentWithFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp
        ((FibredSite.toSiteModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp .etale).obj F).val)
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hpres : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp hinc))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hlsD : LocallySmall.{u}
      (locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeModules.{u, u + 1, u} B E h S hS p hp))
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS p hp hinc ⋙
        flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator B E h S hS p hp hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep ≅
      𝟭 (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: the composite of the right adjoint with the inclusion is the identity functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcCoherator
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0778: the right adjoint `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`.**
declarations.statement:
abbrev lqcohFbcCoherator :
    (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).FullSubcategory ⥤
      quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the right adjoint Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) of the inclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcCoheratorAdjunction
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0778: `Q` is right adjoint to the inclusion `i`.**
declarations.statement:
def lqcohFbcCoheratorAdjunction :
    quasicoherentToLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳 ⊣ lqcohFbcCoherator B E h S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the inclusion QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) is left adjoint to Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcCoheratorCompIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0778: `Q ∘ i` is the identity functor of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`.**
declarations.comment: Q ∘ i is the identity functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcCoheratorAdjunctionAndCompIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0778, the whole statement.**  For an algebraic stack `𝒳`, the inclusion
`i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` has the right adjoint `Q`, and `Q ∘ i` is the identity functor
of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
def lqcohFbcCoheratorAdjunctionAndCompIso :
    (quasicoherentToLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳 ⊣ lqcohFbcCoherator B E h S hS 𝒳) ×
      (quasicoherentToLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙ lqcohFbcCoherator B E h S hS 𝒳 ≅
        𝟭 (quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳))
declarations.comment: the whole statement: i has a right adjoint Q, and Q ∘ i is the identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isZero_coherator_obj_iff_isParasitic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0779** (1). An object of `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` is killed by the coherator
`Q : Mod(𝒪_𝒳) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of **Stacks 0778** exactly when it is parasitic: the kernel of `Q` on
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` is exactly the collection of its parasitic objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_coherator_obj_iff_isParasitic (F : Stack.fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    (hF : lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳 F) :
    IsZero ((coherator B S hS 𝒳).obj F) ↔ IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf F.val
declarations.comment: part (1): for F in LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), Q(F) = 0 if and only if F is parasitic, so the kernel of Q is exactly the parasitic objects of LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isParasitic_kernel_and_cokernel_coheratorAdjunction_counit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0779** (2). For `𝓕` in `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` both the kernel and the cokernel of the
adjunction map `Q(𝓕) ⟶ 𝓕` are parasitic.
declarations.statement:
theorem isParasitic_kernel_and_cokernel_coheratorAdjunction_counit
    (F : Stack.fppfModules B S hS 𝒳) (hF : lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳 F) :
    IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf (kernel ((coheratorAdjunction B S hS 𝒳).counit.app F)).val ∧
      IsParasitic B S hS 𝒳 .fppf
        (cokernel ((coheratorAdjunction B S hS 𝒳).counit.app F)).val
declarations.comment: part (2): for F in LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), the kernel and the cokernel of the adjunction map Q(F) → F, computed in Mod(𝒪_𝒳), are parasitic

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.preservesLimitsOfSize_lqcohSheafFbc_ι_comp_coherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0779** (3), limits: the coherator `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` commutes with all
limits, being right adjoint to the inclusion `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.comment: part (3): Q on LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) commutes with all u-small limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.preservesColimitsOfShape_lqcohSheafFbc_ι_comp_coherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0779** (3), colimits: the coherator `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` commutes with
all colimits of `u`-small shapes, which are computed in `Mod(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_lqcohSheafFbc_ι_comp_coherator (J : Type u) [Category.{u} J] :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape J
      ((lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙ coherator B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: part (3): Q on LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) commutes with all u-small colimits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.preservesFiniteLimits_and_preservesFiniteColimits_lqcohSheafFbc_ι_comp_coherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0779** (3), exactness: the coherator `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is exact, it
preserves finite limits and finite colimits.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesFiniteLimits_and_preservesFiniteColimits_lqcohSheafFbc_ι_comp_coherator :
    PreservesFiniteLimits
        ((lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙ coherator B S hS 𝒳) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits
        ((lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙ coherator B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: part (3): Q on LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) is exact, preserving finite limits and finite colimits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentPullbackDirectImageAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077A, the first assertion: `f^* : QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` has the right adjoint
`f_{QCoh,*}`**, defined as the composite of the inclusion, the direct image of modules
(**Stacks 06WE**) and the coherator (**Stacks 0778**, **Stacks 0781** part (2)).

It holds for every 1-morphism; the source states it for quasi-compact and quasi-separated ones,
for which the direct image of a quasi-coherent module lies in `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)`, where the
coherator is the one of **Stacks 0778**.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentPullbackDirectImageAdjunction :
    quasicoherentPullback B S hS f ⊣ quasicoherentDirectImage B S hS f
declarations.comment: first assertion: f^* on quasi-coherent modules has the right adjoint f_{QCoh,*} = Q ∘ f_* ∘ i, for every 1-morphism of algebraic stacks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentDirectImageIsoComposite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077A**: `f_{QCoh,*}` is the composite
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` of the inclusion, the direct image
of **Stacks 0771** and the coherator `Q` of **Stacks 0778**, the restriction of the coherator to
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)`.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDirectImageIsoComposite :
    quasicoherentDirectImage B S hS f ≅
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).lift (quasicoherentInclusion B S hS 𝒳)
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules_quasicoherentInclusion B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        lqcohSheafFbcDirectImage B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
          ((lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒴).ι ⋙ coherator B S hS 𝒴)
declarations.comment: f_{QCoh,*} is the composite QCoh(O_X) → LQCoh^fbc(O_X) → LQCoh^fbc(O_Y) → QCoh(O_Y) of the inclusion, f_* of Stacks 0771 and Q of Stacks 0778

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentHigherDirectImageIsoComposite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077A**: `Rⁱf_{QCoh,*}` is the composite
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) → LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) → QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` of the inclusion, the higher direct
image `Rⁱf_*` of **Stacks 0771** and the coherator `Q` of **Stacks 0778**.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentHigherDirectImageIsoComposite (i : ℕ) :
    quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS f i ≅
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒳).lift (quasicoherentInclusion B S hS 𝒳)
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules_quasicoherentInclusion B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        lqcohSheafFbcHigherDirectImage B E h S hS f hqc hqs i ⋙
          ((lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u} B E h S hS 𝒴).ι ⋙ coherator B S hS 𝒴)
declarations.comment: R^i f_{QCoh,*} is the composite QCoh(O_X) → LQCoh^fbc(O_X) → LQCoh^fbc(O_Y) → QCoh(O_Y) of the inclusion, R^i f_* of Stacks 0771 and Q of Stacks 0778

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentHigherDirectImageDeltaFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077A, the second assertion: `{Rⁱf_{QCoh,*}}_{i ≥ 0}` is a cohomological δ-functor**
(**Stacks 010Q**) `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)`, for a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism
`f` of algebraic stacks.  Its degree-`i` functor is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentHigherDirectImage` (by `rfl`), the
composite `Q ∘ Rⁱf_* ∘ i`.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentHigherDirectImageDeltaFunctor :
    DeltaFunctor (quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) (quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒴)
declarations.comment: second assertion: {R^i f_{QCoh,*}}_{i ≥ 0} forms a cohomological δ-functor QCoh(O_X) ⥤ QCoh(O_Y), for f quasi-compact and quasi-separated

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.RadicalTower.exists_not_isEquivalence_fppfTorsors_toPrincipal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 077B.**  The stack `G-Principal` of principal homogeneous `G`-spaces
(Stacks 04UN) and the stack `G-Torsors` of fppf `G`-torsors (Stacks 04UR) are not equivalent in
general: there are a big fppf site, a scheme `S` in it and a group scheme `G` over `S` in it,
regarded as a group algebraic space over `S`, for which the canonical functor
`G-Torsors ⥤ G-Principal` is not essentially surjective, hence not an equivalence.  One may take
`S = Spec ℚ` and `G = ∏ᵢ μ_{i+2}`, over any big fppf site: this is
`Stacks.Examples.RadicalTower.not_essSurj_toPrincipal`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_not_isEquivalence_fppfTorsors_toPrincipal :
    ∃ (𝒞 : BigFppfSite.{0}) (S : Scheme.{0}) (hS : 𝒞.Contains S)
      (G : BigFppfOver 𝒞 S hS) (hG : GrpObj ((toSchemeOver 𝒞 S hS).obj G)),
      ¬ (FppfTorsors.toPrincipal (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda 𝒞 S hS (BigFppfOver.mk 𝒞 S hS hS (𝟙 S)))
          (GroupAlgebraicSpace.ofGroupSchemeInSite 𝒞 S hS _ _ G hG)).EssSurj ∧
      ¬ (FppfTorsors.toPrincipal (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda 𝒞 S hS (BigFppfOver.mk 𝒞 S hS hS (𝟙 S)))
          (GroupAlgebraicSpace.ofGroupSchemeInSite 𝒞 S hS _ _ G hG)).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: G-Principal and G-Torsors are not equivalent in general: for S = Spec ℚ and the group scheme G = ∏ᵢ μ_{i+2} the canonical functor G-Torsors ⥤ G-Principal is not essentially surjective, hence not an equivalence, over every big fppf site

declarations.name: integralClosure_carrier_eq
declarations.doc:
If the structure map respects the gradings, an element of `S` is integral over `R` exactly
when all of its homogeneous components are.
declarations.statement:
theorem integralClosure_carrier_eq
    (hφ : RespectsGrading ℛ 𝒮) :
    (integralClosure R S : Set S)
      = {s : S | ∀ d : ℕ, GradedRing.proj 𝒮 d s ∈ integralClosure R S}

declarations.name: quasiFiniteAt_localization_away_iff
declarations.doc:
Stacks tag 077H (Lemma 10.122.6). For a finite type ring map `R → S`, a prime
`𝔮 ⊂ S` lying over `𝔭 ⊂ R`, an element `f ∈ R` with `f ∉ 𝔭` and an element
`g ∈ S` with `g ∉ 𝔮`, with `R_f = Localization.Away f` and
`S_{fg} = Localization.Away ((algebraMap R S f) * g)` and the induced
`R_f`-algebra structure on `S_{fg}`, the map `R → S` is quasi-finite at `𝔮` iff
`R_f → S_{fg}` is quasi-finite at `Q = 𝔮 S_{fg}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasiFiniteAt_localization_away_iff
    {R S Rf Sfg : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing Rf] [CommRing Sfg]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R Rf] [Algebra R Sfg] [Algebra S Sfg] [Algebra Rf Sfg]
    [IsScalarTower R S Sfg] [IsScalarTower R Rf Sfg]
    (f : R) (g : S)
    [IsLocalization.Away f Rf]
    [IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R S f * g) Sfg]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R S]
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    (hf : f ∉ p) (hg : g ∉ q)
    (Q : Ideal Sfg) (hQ : Q = Ideal.map (algebraMap S Sfg) q) [Q.IsPrime] :
    Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt R q ↔ Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt Rf Q

declarations.name: stacks077I_counit_isIso
declarations.doc:
If `u : C ⥤ D` is continuous, cocontinuous and fully faithful, then for every abelian sheaf
`F` on `C` the counit `ε_F : g⁻¹ (g_* F) → F` of the adjunction `g⁻¹ ⊣ g_*` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem stacks077I_counit_isIso
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCocontinuous J K] [u.Full] [u.Faithful]
    (F : Sheaf J (AbCat.{v₁, u₁})) :
    IsIso ((adjStar u J K).counit.app F)
declarations.comment: counit

declarations.name: stacks077I_unit_isIso
declarations.doc:
If `u : C ⥤ D` is continuous, cocontinuous and fully faithful, then for every abelian sheaf
`F` on `C` the unit `η_F : F → g⁻¹ (g_! F)` of the adjunction `g_! ⊣ g⁻¹` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem stacks077I_unit_isIso
    [u.IsContinuous J K] [u.IsCocontinuous J K] [u.Full] [u.Faithful]
    (F : Sheaf J (AbCat.{v₁, u₁})) :
    IsIso ((adjShriek u J K).unit.app F)
declarations.comment: unit

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_resolutionByDirectSumsExtensionsByZero
declarations.doc:
A complex of modules on a ringed site admits a compatible resolution by direct
sums of extensions by zero, whose colimit is quasi-isomorphic to the complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_resolutionByDirectSumsExtensionsByZero
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) ℤ) :
    Nonempty (ResolutionByDirectSumsExtensionsByZero X G)

declarations.name: SheafOfModules.IsCardinalGenerated
declarations.doc:
A sheaf of modules is `κ`-generated if it has local generating families indexed by types
of cardinality at most `κ`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsCardinalGenerated {C : Type u'} [Category.{v} C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}}
    [∀ X : C, HasWeakSheafify (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [∀ X : C, (J.over X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (κ : Cardinal.{u}) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.CardinalGenerated.essentiallySmall_isCardinalGenerated
declarations.doc:
The `κ`-generated modules on a ringed space have a set of isomorphism
classes.
declarations.statement:
theorem essentiallySmall_isCardinalGenerated (X : RingedSpace.{v, u})
    (κ : Cardinal.{v})
    [∀ U : Opens X, HasWeakSheafify
        ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U) AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    [∀ U : Opens X,
        ((Opens.grothendieckTopology X).over U).WEqualsLocallyBijective
          AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    [(Opens.grothendieckTopology X).HasSheafCompose
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{v} RingCat.{v})] :
    ObjectProperty.EssentiallySmall.{max u v}
      (fun M : SheafOfModules.{v}
          ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{v} RingCat.{v})).obj X.sheaf) ↦
        SheafOfModules.IsCardinalGenerated M κ)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CardinalGeneration.isColimit_cardinalGeneratedQuasicoherentSubobjectCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077N, the colimit assertion.** Every quasi-coherent module on a scheme is the
colimit of the canonical diagram of its quasi-coherent subobjects generated by at most
`cardinalBound X` local sections.
declarations.comment: colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CardinalGeneration.cardinalBound
declarations.doc: The cardinal attached to a scheme `X` in Gabber's theorem: the size `X.size` of `X`.
declarations.statement: public def cardinalBound (X : Scheme.{u}) : Cardinal.{u}
declarations.comment: cardinal

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CardinalGeneration.cardinalGeneratedQuasicoherentSubobject_isFiltered
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 077N.**  For the common cardinal bound of a scheme, the category of
bounded quasi-coherent subobjects of every quasi-coherent module is filtered.
declarations.statement:
instance cardinalGeneratedQuasicoherentSubobject_isFiltered (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsFiltered (CardinalGeneratedQuasicoherentSubobject F (cardinalBound X))
declarations.comment: directedness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentModules_abelian
declarations.doc: The category of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme is abelian.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance quasicoherentModules_abelian (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    Abelian (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: grothendieck_qcoh

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentInclusion_isLeftAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**The inclusion of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules into all `𝒪_X`-modules has a right
adjoint**, the coherator.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentInclusion_isLeftAdjoint (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).ι.IsLeftAdjoint
declarations.comment: coherator_adjoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentModules_hasLimitsOfSize
declarations.doc: **The category of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme has all limits.**
declarations.comment: all_limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_coheratorCounit_app
declarations.doc: **The counit of the coherator adjunction is an isomorphism at a quasi-coherent module.**
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coheratorCounit_app (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI := quasicoherentInclusion_isLeftAdjoint X
    IsIso ((Adjunction.ofIsLeftAdjoint
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).ι).counit.app M)
declarations.comment: coherator_counit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentModules_enoughInjectives
declarations.doc: **The category of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme has enough injectives.**
declarations.statement:
instance quasicoherentModules_enoughInjectives (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: enough_injectives

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentModules_isGrothendieckAbelian
declarations.doc:
**The category of quasi-coherent modules on a scheme is Grothendieck abelian.**  This is
the second assertion of [Stacks, Tag 077P]: the separator above together with the reduction
`AlgebraicGeometry.quasicoherentModules_isGrothendieckAbelian_of_hasSeparator`.
declarations.comment: grothendieck_qcoh

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.QuasicoherentModule.alpha_isIso
declarations.doc: The descent morphism of a quasi-coherent module on a groupoid scheme is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement: instance alpha_isIso (M : QuasicoherentModule G) : IsIso M.alpha

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.instHasColimits
declarations.doc: The category of quasi-coherent modules on a groupoid scheme admits all colimits.
declarations.statement:
instance instHasColimits {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme S) :
    HasColimits (Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.QuasicoherentModule G)

declarations.name: Stacks.Groupoids.GroupoidScheme.QuasicoherentModule.abelian
declarations.doc:
**Let `S` be a scheme and let `G` be a groupoid scheme over `S` whose source and target are
flat.  Then the category of quasi-coherent modules on `G` is abelian.**
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance abelian : Abelian (QuasicoherentModule G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.essentiallySmall_isCardinalGenerated
declarations.doc:
The `κ`-generated quasi-coherent modules on a groupoid scheme have only a set of
isomorphism classes.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidCardinalGeneration.cardinalBound
declarations.doc:
**The cardinal of Stacks 077U.**  For a groupoid scheme it is the maximum of the cardinals
Gabber's theorem attaches to the object scheme and to the arrow scheme; the closure construction
producing the bounded submodules uses exactly that it is infinite and dominates the numbers of
affine opens of the two schemes.
declarations.statement: def cardinalBound {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S) : Cardinal.{u}
declarations.comment: cardinal

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidCardinalGeneration.cardinalGeneratedSubobject_isFiltered
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077U, the directedness assertion**, at the cardinal the tag attaches to the groupoid
scheme.
declarations.statement:
instance cardinalGeneratedSubobject_isFiltered (M : QuasicoherentModule G) :
    IsFiltered (CardinalGeneratedSubobject M (cardinalBound G))
declarations.comment: directedness

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidCardinalGeneration.isColimit_cardinalGeneratedSubobjectCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077U, the colimit assertion.**  Every quasi-coherent module on a groupoid scheme with
flat source and target is the colimit of the canonical diagram of its quasi-coherent submodules
whose underlying module is generated by at most `cardinalBound G` local sections.
declarations.statement:
def isColimit_cardinalGeneratedSubobjectCocone (M : QuasicoherentModule G) :
    IsColimit (cardinalGeneratedSubobjectCocone M (cardinalBound G))
declarations.comment: colimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentSheaves_isGrothendieckAbelian_enoughInjectives_hasLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077V, part (1).**  Let `F` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S`.  The category
`QCoh(𝒪_F)` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_F`-modules is a Grothendieck abelian category; consequently it
has enough injectives and all limits.

The abelian structure is the one given by the kernel and cokernel clauses of Stacks 03M1.  The
three conditions of a Grothendieck abelian category are: colimits, which exist and agree with
those of `𝒪_F`-modules by Stacks 03M1; exactness of filtered colimits; and a generator, which
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasSeparator_quasicoherentSheaves`, built from a presentation
`F = U/R` through Stacks 03M3 and 077U.  The assertions on injectives and limits hold in every
Grothendieck abelian category (Stacks 079H, 07D8).
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentSheaves_isGrothendieckAbelian_enoughInjectives_hasLimits :
    letI := isClosedUnderKernels_quasicoherentSheaves_schemeUniverse B S hS F hF
    letI := isClosedUnderCokernels_quasicoherentSheaves B S hS F hF
    letI := quasicoherentSheaves_abelian_of_closure B S hS F hF
    IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS F hF) ∧
      EnoughInjectives (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS F hF) ∧
      HasLimitsOfSize.{u, u} (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS F hF)
declarations.comment: (1) QCoh(𝒪_X) is a Grothendieck abelian category; consequently it has enough injectives and all limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_coherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077V, part (2).**  Let `F` be an algebraic space over a scheme `S`.  The inclusion
functor `QCoh(𝒪_F) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_F)` has a right adjoint `Q`, the *coherator*, such that for every
quasi-coherent `𝒪_F`-module `𝓕` the adjunction morphism `Q(𝓕) ⟶ 𝓕` is an isomorphism.

The right adjoint exists by the special adjoint functor theorem applied to the Grothendieck
abelian category of part (1),
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLeftAdjoint_ι_quasicoherentSheaves`; the inclusion is fully
faithful, so the counit is an isomorphism exactly on its essential image,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_quasicoherentCoheratorCounit_app`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_coherator :
    ∃ (Q : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF ⥤ QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS F hF)
      (adj : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS F hF).O))).ι ⊣ Q),
      ∀ (M : Modules.{u, u} B S hS F hF), M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite → IsIso (adj.counit.app M)
declarations.comment: (2) the inclusion QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ Mod(𝒪_X) has a right adjoint Q whose adjunction morphism Q(F) ⟶ F is an isomorphism for every quasi-coherent F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasicoherentModule.isIso_alpha
declarations.doc:
The transition morphism `α : t^*ℱ ⟶ s^*ℱ` of a quasi-coherent module on a groupoid in
algebraic spaces is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement: theorem isIso_alpha (M : QuasicoherentModule 𝒞 S hS G) : IsIso M.alpha

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentModule_hasColimits_of_closure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077X.**  The category of quasi-coherent modules on a groupoid in algebraic spaces
has colimits, indexed by the categories of the universe of the schemes.

A colimit is computed on the underlying `𝒪_U`-modules, where it exists because the sheaves of
modules on the small étale ringed site of an algebraic space are cocomplete, and it is
quasi-coherent by the arbitrary-colimit clause of Stacks 03M1,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedUnderColimitsOfShape_quasicoherentSheaves_schemeUniverse`.
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentModule_hasColimits_of_closure (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {A : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (G : GroupoidInAlgebraicSpaces B S hS A) :
    HasColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (QuasicoherentModule B S hS G)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Crystals.isColimit_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystalCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077Z, the colimit assertion.**  For the cardinal `cardinalBound D`, which depends
only on the system of schemes and not on the crystal, every crystal in quasi-coherent modules on
a flat system of schemes is the colimit of its `cardinalBound D`-generated submodules.

Together with `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Crystals.isFiltered_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystal`, which
says that those submodules form a directed system, this is the whole of the tag: there is a
cardinal `κ` such that every object of `CQC(X)` is the directed colimit of its `κ`-generated
submodules.
declarations.statement:
def isColimit_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystalCocone (D : SchemeSystem.{u}) [D.IsFlat]
    (M : Crystal D) : IsColimit (cardinalGeneratedSubcrystalCocone M (cardinalBound D))
declarations.comment: the colimit

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Crystals.isFiltered_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 077Z, the directedness half.**  For the cardinal `cardinalBound D`, which depends
only on the system of schemes and not on the crystal, the `cardinalBound D`-generated submodules
of every crystal on a flat system form a directed system.

This is one of the two declarations carrying the tag; the other,
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Crystals.isColimit_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystalCocone`, says that the
crystal is the colimit of that system.  Together they are the whole statement: for this `κ`
every object of `CQC(X)` is the directed colimit of its `κ`-generated submodules.
declarations.statement:
instance isFiltered_cardinalGeneratedSubcrystal (D : SchemeSystem.{u}) [D.IsFlat]
    (M : Crystal D) : IsFiltered (CardinalGeneratedSubcrystal M (cardinalBound D))
declarations.comment: the directed system

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasicoherentModule.exists_small_generating_family
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0780.**  Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid in algebraic spaces with `s` and `t`
flat.  There is a family `F : T → QCoh(U, R, s, t, c)` indexed by a type `T` of the universe of
the schemes, that is by a set, such that every quasi-coherent module on the groupoid is the
directed colimit of those of its submodules which are isomorphic to a member of the family: the
subobjects isomorphic to a member of the family form a filtered category, and the cocone of their
inclusions is a colimit cocone.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_small_generating_family (hs : IsFlat B S hS G.source.hom)
    (ht : IsFlat B S hS G.target.hom) :
    ∃ (T : Type u) (F : T → QuasicoherentModule B S hS G),
      ∀ M : QuasicoherentModule B S hS G,
        IsFiltered (IsomorphicGeneratorSubobject T F M) ∧
          Nonempty (IsColimit (isomorphicGeneratorSubobjectCocone T F M))
declarations.comment: The index type `T` lives in the universe `u` of the schemes of the site, so the family is a set. The proof goes through a separating family of bounded submodules, built on an étale chart of the arrows over a presentation of the space of objects, and the Grothendieck property of `QCoh(U, R, s, t, c)`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quasicoherentModules_isGrothendieckAbelian_enoughInjectives_hasLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0781, part (1).**  Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S`.  The category
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of quasi-coherent modules on `𝒳` is a Grothendieck abelian category; consequently
it has enough injectives and all limits.

Through a presentation `[U/R] → 𝒳` whose space of objects is a scheme, `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is
equivalent to `QCoh(U, R, s, t, c)` (Stacks 06WV (1)), which is Grothendieck abelian: colimits
exist, filtered colimits are exact because they and kernels are computed on `𝒪_U`-modules, and
there is a separator by the argument of Groupoids in Spaces, Lemma 0780
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.QuasicoherentModule.isGrothendieckAbelian_of_objects_eq`).  The
assertions on injectives and limits hold in every Grothendieck abelian category (Stacks 079H,
07D8).
declarations.statement:
theorem quasicoherentModules_isGrothendieckAbelian_enoughInjectives_hasLimits :
    IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS
        𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) ∧
      EnoughInjectives (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS
        𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids) ∧
      HasLimitsOfSize.{u, u} (FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS
        𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
declarations.comment: part (1): QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) is a Grothendieck abelian category; consequently it has enough injectives and all limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_quasicoherentCoherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0781, part (2).**  Let `𝒳` be an algebraic stack over `S`.  The inclusion
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → Mod(𝒪_𝒳)` has a right adjoint `Q`, the *coherator*, such that for every
quasi-coherent `𝒪_𝒳`-module `𝓕` the adjunction morphism `Q(𝓕) → 𝓕` is an isomorphism.

The right adjoint exists by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLeftAdjoint_quasicoherentInclusion`.
The inclusion is fully faithful, so the counit is an isomorphism exactly on its essential image,
which contains the quasi-coherent modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentCoherator :
    ∃ (Q : SheafOfModules.{u} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
          𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids .fppf) ⥤
        FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
          𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
      (adj : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
          .fppf)).ι ⊣ Q),
      ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
          𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids .fppf),
        M.IsQuasicoherentOnSite → IsIso (adj.counit.app M)
declarations.comment: part (2): the inclusion QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) → Mod(𝒪_𝒳) has a right adjoint Q such that Q(F) → F is an isomorphism for every quasi-coherent F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.isGrothendieckAbelian_quasicoherentModules
declarations.doc:
The category `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of quasi-coherent modules on the associated fppf site of a category
fibred in groupoids is a Grothendieck abelian category, provided quasi-coherence is closed under
colimits (`hclosed`), `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is locally small (`hls`), its filtered colimits are exact
(`hab5`) and it has a separator (`hsep`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isGrothendieckAbelian_quasicoherentModules
    [Abelian (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)]
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hab5 : ∀ (K : Type u) [Category.{u} K] [IsFiltered K]
      [HasColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)],
      HasExactColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: part (1): QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) is Grothendieck abelian, over local smallness, the exactness of filtered colimits, and the separator the source gets from a groupoid presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.enoughInjectives_quasicoherentModules
declarations.doc:
Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.isGrothendieckAbelian_quasicoherentModules`, `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` has
enough injectives.
declarations.statement:
theorem enoughInjectives_quasicoherentModules
    [Abelian (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)]
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hab5 : ∀ (K : Type u) [Category.{u} K] [IsFiltered K]
      [HasColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)],
      HasExactColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    EnoughInjectives (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: part (1), its consequence: QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) has enough injectives

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.hasLimitsOfSize_quasicoherentModules
declarations.doc:
Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.isGrothendieckAbelian_quasicoherentModules`, `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` has all
limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasLimitsOfSize_quasicoherentModules
    [Abelian (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)]
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hab5 : ∀ (K : Type u) [Category.{u} K] [IsFiltered K]
      [HasColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)],
      HasExactColimitsOfShape K (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    HasLimitsOfSize.{u, u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: part (1), its consequence: QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) has all limits

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoherator
declarations.doc:
**The coherator on `Mod(𝒪_𝒳)`.** The right adjoint of the inclusion of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` into all
modules on the associated fppf site of `𝒳`: it sends a module `A` to the terminal quasi-coherent
module equipped with a map to `A`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoherator
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hlsD : LocallySmall.{u} (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf)))
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf) ⥤
      quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp
declarations.comment: part (2): the coherator Q : Mod(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoheratorAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**The coherator on `Mod(𝒪_𝒳)` is right adjoint to the inclusion.** The adjunction is the
universal property of the terminal objects the coherator is built from.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoheratorAdjunction
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))

    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf)).ι ⊣
      moduleCoherator B S hS p hp hclosed hls hlsD hwp hsep
declarations.comment: part (2): the adjunction between the inclusion and the coherator

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoheratorCompInclusionIsoId
declarations.doc:
**The coherator fixes the quasi-coherent modules.** The composite of the inclusion with the
coherator is the identity functor of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`: `Q 𝓕 ≅ 𝓕` for quasi-coherent `𝓕`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoheratorCompInclusionIsoId
    (hclosed : SheafOfModules.ClosedUnderColimitsOfSize.{u, u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf))
    (hls : LocallySmall.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp))
    (hlsD : LocallySmall.{u} (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf)))
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)) :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf)).ι ⋙
        moduleCoherator B S hS p hp hclosed hls hlsD hwp hsep ≅
      𝟭 (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: part (2): the coherator composed with the inclusion is the identity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoheratorSucc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0781, part (2), at section universe `u + 1`: the coherator on `Mod(𝒪_𝒳)`.**  The
right adjoint of the inclusion of `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` into all modules on the associated fppf site: it
sends a module `A` to the terminal quasi-coherent module equipped with a map to `A`.

`AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoherator` is the same construction at section universe `u`;
`u + 1` is the universe the direct images of **Stacks 06WE** along a 1-morphism of algebraic
stacks live in, and so the universe **Stacks 077A** needs the coherator in.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoheratorSucc
    (hclosed : QuasicoherentClosedUnderColimitsSucc B S hS p hp)
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u + 1} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)) :
    SheafOfModules.{u + 1} (ringStructureSheafCore B S hS p hp .fppf) ⥤
      quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp
declarations.comment: part (2): the coherator Q : Mod(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), at section universe u + 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoheratorSuccAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0781, part (2): the coherator is right adjoint to the inclusion.**  The adjunction
is the universal property of the terminal objects the coherator is built from.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoheratorSuccAdjunction
    (hclosed : QuasicoherentClosedUnderColimitsSucc B S hS p hp)
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u + 1} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)) :
    quasicoherentInclusion B S hS p hp ⊣ moduleCoheratorSucc B S hS p hp hclosed hwp hsep
declarations.comment: part (2): the adjunction between the inclusion and the coherator, at section universe u + 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FibredSite.moduleCoheratorSuccCompInclusionIsoId
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0781, part (2): the coherator fixes the quasi-coherent modules.**  The inclusion is
fully faithful, so the unit of the adjunction is an isomorphism; this is the source's assertion
that `Q 𝓕 → 𝓕` is an isomorphism for quasi-coherent `𝓕`.
declarations.statement:
def moduleCoheratorSuccCompInclusionIsoId
    (hclosed : QuasicoherentClosedUnderColimitsSucc B S hS p hp)
    (hwp : WellPowered.{u + 1} (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)ᵒᵖ)
    (hsep : HasSeparator (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)) :
    quasicoherentInclusion B S hS p hp ⋙ moduleCoheratorSucc B S hS p hp hclosed hwp hsep ≅
      𝟭 (quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u + 1} B S hS p hp)
declarations.comment: part (2): the coherator composed with the inclusion is the identity, at section universe u + 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_quasicoherentLeraySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0782.** Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism of
algebraic stacks and `ℱ` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_𝒳`-module.  There is a spectral sequence with
`E_2^{p,q} = H^p(𝒴, R^q f_{QCoh,*} ℱ)` converging to `H^{p+q}(𝒳, ℱ)`.

The second page is identified for `p, q ≥ 0`, vanishes outside the first quadrant, and the
sequence abuts to `H^n(𝒳, ℱ)`.  Here `R^q f_{QCoh,*}` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentHigherDirectImage` (**Stacks 077A**), and
`H^p` is the right derived functor of `Hom(𝒪, -)` on modules at the universe `u` of the schemes,
with values in `AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentLeraySpectralSequence
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f) (hqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (F : quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 0,
      (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty ((E.page 2 zero_le_two).X ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≅
        ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (SheafOfModules.unit _))).rightDerivedPlus
          (p : ℤ)).obj ((quasicoherentInclusion B S hS 𝒴).obj
            ((quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS f q).obj F)))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 2 zero_le_two).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n =>
        ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (SheafOfModules.unit _))).rightDerivedPlus n).obj
          ((quasicoherentInclusion B S hS 𝒳).obj F))
declarations.comment: for f qcqs and F quasi-coherent, a first quadrant spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = H^p(𝒴, R^q f_{QCoh,*} F) ⇒ H^{p+q}(𝒳, F); modules have sections in the universe u of the schemes, and H^p = R^p Hom(𝒪, -) takes values in AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_quasicoherentRelativeLeraySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0783: the relative Leray spectral sequence for the quasi-coherent direct image.**
Let `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵` be quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphisms of algebraic
stacks and let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_𝒳`-module. There is a spectral sequence of
quasi-coherent `𝒪_𝒵`-modules, from its second page on, with

`E_2^{p,q} = R^p g_{QCoh,*}(R^q f_{QCoh,*} ℱ)`

(zero outside the first quadrant) converging to `R^{p+q}(g ∘ f)_{QCoh,*} ℱ`: it abuts to
`n ↦ R^n(g ∘ f)_{QCoh,*} ℱ`, zero in negative degrees. Here `R^i (-)_{QCoh,*}` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.quasicoherentHigherDirectImage`, the composite
`Q ∘ R^i(-)_* ∘ i` of **Stacks 077A**, and `QCoh(𝒪_𝒵)` carries its abelian structure
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.instAbelianQuasicoherentModules`; modules have sections
in the universe `u` of the schemes.

The proof is the source's: the Grothendieck spectral sequence of `(g ∘ f)_* = g_* ∘ f_*` on fppf
modules (Stacks 0734 for stacks), pushed along the coherator `Q_𝒵`, which is exact on
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒵)` (Stacks 0779 (3)) where all of its terms lie from the second page on
(Stacks 0771 (2), (4)(b)); the second page is identified through the counit
`Q_𝒴(R^q f_*ℱ) ⟶ R^q f_*ℱ`, whose kernel and cokernel are parasitic (Stacks 0779 (1)), hence
carried by `R^p g_*` to parasitic modules (Stacks 0775 (2)) which `Q_𝒵` kills.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentRelativeLeraySpectralSequence
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f) (hfqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (hgqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS g) (hgqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS g)
    (ℱ : quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence (quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒵) 2,
      (∀ p q : ℕ, Nonempty ((E.page 2 le_rfl).X ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≅
        (quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS g p).obj
          ((quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS f q).obj ℱ))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 2 le_rfl).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (extendNatByZero fun n =>
        (quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS (f ≫ g) n).obj ℱ)
declarations.comment: the spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = R^p g_{QCoh,*}(R^q f_{QCoh,*} F) converging to R^{p+q}(g ∘ f)_{QCoh,*} F for qcqs morphisms of algebraic stacks, modules at the universe u of the schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Leray.exists_quasicoherentRelativeLeraySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0783, the relative Leray spectral sequence for the quasi-coherent direct image.**
Let `f : (Sh(C), 𝒪_C) → (Sh(D), 𝒪_D)` and `g : (Sh(D), 𝒪_D) → (Sh(E), 𝒪_E)` be morphisms of
ringed topoi standing for quasi-compact quasi-separated morphisms `f : 𝒳 → 𝒴` and `g : 𝒴 → 𝒵` of
algebraic stacks, with `g ∘ f` presented as their composite by a comparison `τ` of the geometric
direct images, and let `K` be a bounded below complex of `𝒪_C`-modules, standing for the
quasi-coherent sheaf `ℱ` placed in degree zero.  Suppose given

* a coreflection `inclY ⊣ coheratorY` of `Mod(𝒪_D)` onto a category `𝒬_Y`: this is the coherator
  of **Stacks 0778**, `Q_𝒴 : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)`, with its adjunction, whose counit
  `Q_𝒴 𝓖 ⟶ 𝓖` is the adjunction map the source's proof uses;
* an exact functor `coheratorZ` from `Mod(𝒪_E)` to a category `𝒬_Z`: the coherator of
  **Stacks 0778** on `𝒵`, exact by **Stacks 0779** part (3), which is the functor the source
  applies to the whole spectral sequence;
* a class `Parasitic` of modules on `D`: the parasitic modules of **Stacks 0773**;
* `hker` and `hcoker`: the kernel and the cokernel of the counit are parasitic, which is
  **Stacks 0779** part (2);
* `hvanish`: `Q_𝒵 ∘ R^p g_*` kills a parasitic module, which is **Stacks 0775** part (2)
  followed by **Stacks 0779** part (1).

Then there is a spectral sequence with

`E_2^{p,q} = R^p g_{QCoh,*}(R^q f_{QCoh,*} ℱ)`

converging to `R^{p+q}(g ∘ f)_{QCoh,*} ℱ`, where the two quasi-coherent higher direct images are
`Stacks.Cohomology.Leray.quasicoherentRelativeHigherDirectImage` and
`Stacks.Cohomology.Leray.quasicoherentHigherDirectImage`, the composites of **Stacks 077A**, and
the abutment is `Q_𝒵` applied to `R^{p+q}(g ∘ f)_*ℱ`, which is the same composite in degree
`p + q`.

See the module documentation for why the coherators and the cited lemmas are carried as
hypotheses rather than instantiated.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentRelativeLeraySpectralSequence {𝒬Y : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} 𝒬Y]
    {𝒬Z : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} 𝒬Z] [Abelian 𝒬Z]
    (inclY : 𝒬Y ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O))
    (coheratorY : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O) ⥤ 𝒬Y)
    (adjY : inclY ⊣ coheratorY)
    (coheratorZ : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Z.O) ⥤ 𝒬Z)
    [coheratorZ.Additive] [coheratorZ.PreservesHomology] [coheratorZ.PreservesMonomorphisms]
    (Parasitic : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O)))
    (hvanish : ∀ P : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O),
      Parasitic P → ∀ p : ℕ,
        IsZero (coheratorZ.obj (((pushforwardModules g).rightDerivedPlus (p : ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hker : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O),
      Parasitic (kernel (adjY.counit.app M)))
    (hcoker : ∀ M : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Y.O),
      Parasitic (cokernel (adjY.counit.app M)))
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence 𝒬Z 0,
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 2 zero_le_two).X (p, q) ≅
        (quasicoherentRelativeHigherDirectImage g inclY coheratorZ p).obj
          ((quasicoherentHigherDirectImage f coheratorY q).obj K))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n => coheratorZ.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf Z.O)) n).obj
            ((pushforwardModules gf).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K)))
declarations.comment: the E₂ page R^p g_{QCoh,*}(R^q f_{QCoh,*} ℱ) and convergence, FOR RINGED TOPOI, not algebraic stacks, hence NOT a generalization: 0734 is proved at RingedTopos.{u,u,u}, a stack's is {u,u+1,u}. Carried: the 0778 coherators, 0779(3)(2)(1) and 0775(2), the last absent here; 077A is proved for algebraic stacks, not for these ringed topoi, so only its recipe Q ∘ R^i(-)_* ∘ i is reused. See the module docstring

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_fppfSpectralSequenceData_module
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0784.** Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` be a `1`-morphism of algebraic stacks which is
representable by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, and let
`F` be a sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules. Then there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence
`E₁^{p,q} = H^q_fppf(𝒰ₚ, fₚ^*F) ⇒ H^{p+q}_fppf(𝒳, F)`, where `𝒰ₚ` is the degree `p` term of the
relative Čech nerve of `f` and `fₚ` its projection to `𝒳`; the identification of the first page
is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pageOneIsoModule`.

The source assumes `F` quasi-coherent; the spectral sequence needs no such hypothesis, so it is
stated here for an arbitrary sheaf of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules, which contains the source's statement.
No hypothesis that `𝒰` has equalizers is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fppfSpectralSequenceData_module
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max (u + 1) a} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf)) :
    Nonempty (Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) SiteKind.fppf
      (fppfAbelianSheaf B S hS F))
declarations.comment: the E₁ form, which is what Sheaves on Stacks 06XJ gives and what makes the first differential the Čech differential; the tag's own text writes E₂. Stated for an arbitrary sheaf of modules rather than only a quasi-coherent one. Carries the hypothesis that `𝒰` has equalizers, as Tag 06XJ does

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pageOneIsoModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0784**, the first page. The term of the spectral sequence of a flat presentation in
position `(p, q)` is the degree `q` fppf cohomology, on the degree `p` term `𝒰ₚ` of the relative
Čech nerve, of the inverse image `fₚ^*F` of the module `F`.
declarations.statement:
def pageOneIsoModule
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max (u + 1) a} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf))
    (data : Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) SiteKind.fppf
      (fppfAbelianSheaf B S hS F)) (i j : ℕ) :
    letI := data.continuous i
    (data.sequence.page 1).X ((i : ℤ), (j : ℤ)) ≅
      (Sheaf.functorH (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
        (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf) j).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictAlongContinuous
            (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
              (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i)
            (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
              𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf)).obj F))
declarations.comment: the reading of the E₁ page as the cohomology of the inverse image of the module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_fppfModuleCechSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` be a `1`-morphism of algebraic stacks which is representable by algebraic
spaces, surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation, and let `F` be a sheaf of
`𝒪_𝒳`-modules (for instance a quasi-coherent one). Then there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence
`E₁^{p,q} = H^q(𝒰ₚ, fₚ^*F) ⇒ H^{p+q}(𝒳, F)`, where `𝒰ₚ = 𝒰 ×_𝒳 ⋯ ×_𝒳 𝒰` (`p + 1` factors) is the
degree `p` term of the relative Čech nerve of `f` and `fₚ : 𝒰ₚ ⟶ 𝒳` its projection.

The spectral sequence, its first-quadrant vanishing and its convergence to the cohomology of `F` on
`𝒳` are the fields of `Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData` for the abelian sheaf underlying
`F`; the condition on that datum identifies its `E₁` term at `(p, q)` with the degree `q`
cohomology of the inverse image `fₚ^*F` of the module `F` on `𝒰ₚ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fppfModuleCechSpectralSequence
    (hrep : Stack.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max (u + 1) a} (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf)) :
    ∃ data : Stacks.RelativeCech.SpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) SiteKind.fppf
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F),
      ∀ p q : ℕ, letI := data.continuous p
        Nonempty ((data.sequence.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), (q : ℤ)) ≅
          (Sheaf.functorH (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
            (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
              (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) p ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf) q).obj
            ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.restrictAlongContinuous
                (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
                  (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) p)
                (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
                  𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf)).obj F)))
declarations.comment: for an arbitrary sheaf of modules, which contains the quasi-coherent case; the equalizers of `𝒰` needed by Tag 06XJ are Tag 06WY (3), proved for algebraic stacks

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.exists_quasicoherentCoveringSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0785.** Let `f : 𝒰 ⟶ 𝒳` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks which is representable
by algebraic spaces, surjective, flat, locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and
quasi-separated, and let `g : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism of
algebraic stacks. For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_𝒳`-module `𝓕` there is a spectral sequence in
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` with `E₁^{p,q} = R^q (g ∘ fₚ)_{QCoh,*} fₚ^* 𝓕`, vanishing outside the first
quadrant and abutting to `R^{p+q} g_{QCoh,*} 𝓕`, where `fₚ : 𝒰ₚ ⟶ 𝒳` is the projection of the
degree `p` term `𝒰ₚ = 𝒰 ×_𝒳 ⋯ ×_𝒳 𝒰` of the Čech nerve of `f`.

The source writes the first page as `E₂`; its proof applies the coherator to the `E₁` spectral
sequence of **Stacks 072G**, whose first differential is the Čech differential, and that is the
page on which the stated terms appear.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasicoherentCoveringSpectralSequence
    (hrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom.hom)
    (hsurj : Stack.IsSurjective B S hS f) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f)
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS f)
    (hfqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f) (hfqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (hgqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS g) (hgqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS g)
    (𝓕 : quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) :
    ∃ D : CohomologicalSpectralSequence (quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒴) 1,
      (∀ i j : ℕ, Nonempty ((D.page 1 le_rfl).X ((i : ℤ), (j : ℤ)) ≅
        (quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS (cechNerveProjection B S hS f i ≫ g) j).obj
          ((quasicoherentPullback B S hS (cechNerveProjection B S hS f i)).obj 𝓕))) ∧
      (∀ i j : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ j < 0 → IsZero ((D.page 1 le_rfl).X (i, j))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo D (fun n : ℤ => if n < 0 then 0 else
        (quasicoherentHigherDirectImage B S hS g n.toNat).obj 𝓕)
declarations.comment: the stated terms sit on the first page: the proof applies Q_𝒴 to the E₁ spectral sequence of 072G, whose first differential is the Čech differential

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.pushforwardPageOneIsoQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0785**, the first page. The term of the covering pushforward spectral sequence of a
flat presentation in position `(p, q)` is the degree `q` higher direct image along `g ∘ fₚ` of
the inverse image `fₚ^*𝓕` of the quasi-coherent module `𝓕` on the degree `p` term `𝒰ₚ` of the
relative Čech nerve of `f`, the inverse image being taken as a sheaf of modules.
declarations.statement:
def pushforwardPageOneIsoQuasicoherent
    (𝓕 : FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, max (u + 1) a} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids)
    (data : Stacks.RelativeCech.PushforwardSpectralSequenceData B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
      𝒴.val.val.p (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom) SiteKind.fppf
      (fppfAbelianSheaf B S hS (fppfQuasicoherentSiteModule B S hS 𝓕))) (i j : ℕ) :
    letI := data.continuous i
    letI := data.cocontinuous i
    letI := data.gCocontinuous
    letI := data.enoughInjectives i
    letI : (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙
        CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom).IsCocontinuous
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
          (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p SiteKind.fppf) :=
      isCocontinuous_comp (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i)
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
          (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf)
        (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p SiteKind.fppf)
    letI := Stacks.RelativeCech.additive_pushforwardCocontinuous AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
        (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf)
      (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p SiteKind.fppf)
      (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
        (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙
        CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom)
    (data.sequence.page 1).X ((i : ℤ), (j : ℤ)) ≅
      (((Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙
          CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor g.hom).sheafPushforwardCocontinuous
            AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) a}
            (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS
              (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
                (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i ⋙ 𝒳.val.val.p) SiteKind.fppf)
            (BigFppfOver.associatedTopology B S hS 𝒴.val.val.p SiteKind.fppf)).rightDerived
          j).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
          ((SheafOfModules.restrictAlongContinuous
            (Stacks.RelativeCech.Tuple.projection 𝒳.val.val.p
              (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom) i)
            (FibredSite.ringStructureSheafCore B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
              𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids SiteKind.fppf)).obj
            (fppfQuasicoherentSiteModule B S hS 𝓕)))
declarations.comment: the reading of the E₁ page as the higher direct image of the inverse image of the quasi-coherent module, the inverse image being taken as a sheaf of modules and the higher direct image being the abelian one along the morphism of sites

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0787**, `flat_fppf_site`. The full subcategory of the flat objects of an algebraic
stack over `S`.
declarations.statement: abbrev FlatFppf
declarations.comment: the flat-fppf site: its underlying category of flat objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.IsCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0787**, `flat_fppf_site`. A family of morphisms of flat objects of an algebraic
stack covers when its image in the big fppf category of `S` is a chosen covering family
there.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsCovering (E : Covering (FlatFppf B S hS 𝒳)) : Prop
declarations.comment: the flat-fppf site: its coverings

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.topology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0787**, `flat_fppf_site`. The Grothendieck topology of the flat-fppf site: the one
generated by the inherited fppf covering families between flat objects.
declarations.statement: abbrev topology : GrothendieckTopology (FlatFppf B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the flat-fppf site: its Grothendieck topology

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale
declarations.doc: The full subcategory of the smooth objects of an algebraic stack over `S`.
declarations.statement: abbrev LisseEtale
declarations.comment: the lisse-etale site: its underlying category of smooth objects

declarations.doc:
A family of morphisms of smooth objects of an algebraic stack covers when the family of
schemes underneath it is a chosen étale covering family of the big site.

declarations.comment: the lisse-etale site: its coverings
