functorial termwise monomorphic quasi-isomorphism such that postcomposing any map from one
of the given complexes makes that map null-homotopic.

theorem exists_functorial_termwise_mono_quasiIso_homotopy_zero
    {I : Type w} (K : I → CochainComplex C ℤ) (hK : ∀ i, (K i).Acyclic) :
    ∃ (F : CochainComplex C ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex C ℤ)
      (j : Functor.id (CochainComplex C ℤ) ⟶ F),
      (∀ (M : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ), Mono ((j.app M).f n)) ∧
      (∀ M : CochainComplex C ℤ, QuasiIso (j.app M)) ∧
      ∀ (M : CochainComplex C ℤ) (i : I) (f : K i ⟶ M),
        homotopic C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (f ≫ j.app M) 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackTensor.derivedPullbackTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 079U: derived pullback is monoidal.**  For a morphism of ringed spaces
`f : (X, 𝒪_X) ⟶ (Y, 𝒪_Y)` there is a canonical isomorphism

`Lf^*(K ⊗^L_{𝒪_Y} L) ≅ Lf^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_X} Lf^*L`,

bifunctorial in `K, L ∈ D(𝒪_Y)`.

It is constructed the way the source constructs it.  On K-flat representatives both sides are
computed by ordinary total tensor complexes — the K-flat comparison of Stacks 06YU and the
fact that a K-flat complex computes `Lf^*` — and there the comparison is the degreewise
isomorphism `f^*(K^p ⊗_{𝒪_Y} L^q) ≅ f^*K^p ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^*L^q` of Stacks 01CD assembled on total
complexes.  Since `D(𝒪_Y)` is the localization of the K-flat objects of the homotopy category
at the quasi-isomorphisms (Stacks 06YS), the product of two copies of that localization
descends the comparison from K-flat representatives to all of `D(𝒪_Y) × D(𝒪_Y)`, which is
what makes the statement bifunctorial.
declarations.statement: def derivedPullbackTensorIso : pullbackOfTensor f ≅ tensorOfPullbacks f

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedAdjunction_unit_fac

theorem derivedAdjunction_unit_fac

    (derivedAdjunction f).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj M) ≫
        (derivedPushforward f).map ((derivedPullbackComparison f).app M) =
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((homotopyPullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).unit.app M) ≫
        (derivedPushforwardUnit f).app
          (((modulePullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)
declarations.comment: canonical unit

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedAdjunction_counit_fac
declarations.doc:
The derived counit agrees with the ordinary counit after applying the canonical comparison
maps.

    (derivedPullback f).map ((derivedPushforwardUnit f).app K) ≫

declarations.comment: canonical counit

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.exists_firstQuadrant_cechNerveSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 079Z.** Let `𝒞` be a site and `K' → K` a map of presheaves of sets
whose sheafification is surjective (here: which is locally surjective, the same condition by
`Stacks.Cohomology.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi_presheafToSheaf_map`). For every abelian sheaf `𝓕`
there is a first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence, starting on page one, with

```
E₁^{p,q} = H^q(K'_p, 𝓕)   (p ≥ 0),    E₁^{p,q} = 0   (p < 0 or q < 0),
```

where `K'_p = K' ×_K … ×_K K'` is the fibre power with `p + 1` factors, abutting to
`H^{p+q}(K, 𝓕)`.

Cohomology over a presheaf of sets is `Ext` out of the free abelian sheaf it generates, as in
[Stacks, Tag 079X] and [Stacks, Tag 072Y]; see `Stacks.Cohomology.cohomologyOverSheafEquivZExt`.
Abutment is `CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.AbutsTo`: the spectral sequence has an infinity page
everywhere and its terms are the graded pieces of a finite decreasing filtration of each
`H^n(K, 𝓕)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_firstQuadrant_cechNerveSpectralSequence (hf : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f)
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt
          ((Presheaf.freeAbelianSheaf J).obj (cechFibrePower f p)) F q))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Abelian.zExt ((Presheaf.freeAbelianSheaf J).obj K) F n))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.exists_firstQuadrant_cechNerveSpectralSequence_of_epi_sheafify
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 079Z**, with the hypothesis in the source's own words: if the
sheafification of `K' → K` is surjective, i.e. an epimorphism of sheaves of sets, then for every
abelian sheaf `𝓕` there is a first-quadrant spectral sequence with `E₁^{p,q} = H^q(K'_p, 𝓕)` for
`p ≥ 0`, `E₁^{p,q} = 0` for `p < 0` or `q < 0`, abutting to `H^{p+q}(K, 𝓕)`.

This is `Stacks.Cohomology.exists_firstQuadrant_cechNerveSpectralSequence` read through
`Stacks.Cohomology.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi_presheafToSheaf_map`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_firstQuadrant_cechNerveSpectralSequence_of_epi_sheafify [HasSheafify J (Type u)]
    (hf : Epi ((presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).map f)) (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 1,
      (∀ (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Nonempty ((E.page 1).X ((p : ℤ), q) ≅
        AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt
          ((Presheaf.freeAbelianSheaf J).obj (cechFibrePower f p)) F q))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p < 0 ∨ q < 0 → IsZero ((E.page 1).X (p, q))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n ↦ AddCommGrpCat.of
        (Abelian.zExt ((Presheaf.freeAbelianSheaf J).obj K) F n))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SheafOfSets.cohomologyOnSheafIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A0, the cohomology comparison.** For a sheaf of sets `K` on a small site `(C, J)`,
cohomology over `K` — that is, `Ext` out of the free abelian sheaf on `K` — is the cohomology of
the site of elements of `K` with coefficients in the inverse image:

  `Ext^p_{Sh(C, J)}(ℤ_K, -) ≅ j⁻¹ ⋙ H^p(C/K, -)`,

naturally in the abelian sheaf of coefficients.
declarations.comment: the cohomology comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.Sites.LocalizationShriek.preservesInjectiveObjects_sheafLocalizationInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A0, first assertion.** For a *sheaf* of sets `K`, the projection `j` from the site
of elements of `K` is continuous for the restricted topology (Stacks 0791), so that restriction of
abelian sheaves along it is the inverse image of the localization morphism of topoi
`j : Sh(C/K) ⟶ Sh(C)`; that inverse image preserves injective abelian sheaves.

The continuity instance is the one Stacks 0791 provides, so the functor here is literally the
inverse image of the localization morphism and not merely isomorphic to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesInjectiveObjects_sheafLocalizationInverseImage
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}] (K : Sheaf J (Type v)) :
    letI : (CostructuredArrow.proj yoneda K.obj).IsContinuous
        ((CostructuredArrow.proj yoneda K.obj).restrictedTopology J) J :=
      (K.property.exists_sheafEquivalence_costructuredArrow_yoneda).2.2.choose
    ((CostructuredArrow.proj yoneda K.obj).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{v}
        ((CostructuredArrow.proj yoneda K.obj).restrictedTopology J)
        J).PreservesInjectiveObjects
declarations.comment: the inverse image preserves injectives

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isTotallyAcyclic_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒞` be a site and `𝓕` an abelian sheaf on it. Then `𝓕` is
totally acyclic ([Stacks, Tag 072Y]) if and only if

1. `H^p(U, 𝓕) = 0` for `p > 0` and every object `U` of `𝒞` — `VanishesOnObjects`; and
2. for every surjection `K' ⟶ K` of sheaves of sets the extended Čech complex
   `0 → H^0(K, 𝓕) → H^0(K', 𝓕) → H^0(K' ×_K K', 𝓕) → …` is exact — `CechComplexExact`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isTotallyAcyclic_iff (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    IsTotallyAcyclic.{w} J F ↔ (VanishesOnObjects.{w} J F ∧ CechComplexExact J F)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SimplicialSiteSituation.componentDerivedTensorIso
declarations.doc:
**The derived tensor comparison at the inclusion of a simplicial component.** The canonical
bifunctorial isomorphism

`g_n^*(A ⊗^L_O B) ≅ g_n^*A ⊗^L_{O_n} g_n^*B`

for the derived restriction `Lg_n^*` of sheaves of modules to the degree-`n` component of a
simplicial-site situation, stated between the two uncurried bifunctors on `D(O) × D(O)`, so that
naturality in both variables is part of its type.

Its value on a pair of K-flat complexes with flat terms is
`Stacks.DerivedTensor.ExactFunctorTensor.modelIso`, and the passage to arbitrary objects of `D(O)`
is the descent of that value along the localization of pairs of models.
declarations.statement:
def componentDerivedTensorIso :
    Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor
          (S.totalRingedTopos O).O) ⋙
        S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O n ≅
      (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O n).prod
          (S.derivedComponentModuleRestriction O n) ⋙
        Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor
          (S.componentRingedTopos O n).O)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.UnboundedComplexes.ringedSite_unboundedComplexes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A5.** Let `(C, O)` be a ringed site.

* `Mod(O)` is a Grothendieck abelian category: it has all colimits, filtered colimits are exact,
  and `⨁_{U ∈ Ob(C)} j_{U!}O_U` is a generator.
* There is a functor `T` on complexes of `O`-modules with a natural transformation `id ⟶ T`
  which at every complex `F^•` is a quasi-isomorphism, injective in every degree, into the
  K-injective complex `T(F^•)`.
* (1) Every exact functor `F : K(Mod(O)) ⥤ D` into a triangulated category has a right derived
  functor `RF : D(O) ⥤ D`; every right derived functor `RF` of `F` is exact, and
  `RF(F^•) = F(T(F^•))`.
* (2) The same holds for the functor `K(Mod(O)) ⥤ D(A)` induced by an additive functor
  `F : Mod(O) ⥤ A` into an abelian category.
* The examples: `RΓ(C, -) : D(O) ⥤ D(Γ(C, O))`, `RΓ(U, -) : D(O) ⥤ D(O(U))` for every object
  `U`, and `Rf_* : D(O) ⥤ D(O')` for every morphism of ringed topoi
  `f : (Sh(C), O) ⟶ (Sh(D), O')` exist.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringedSite_unboundedComplexes
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))] :
    (HasColimitsOfSize.{u, u}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ∧
      AB5OfSize.{u, u} (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ∧
      IsSeparator (∐ fun U : X.C =>
        (SheafOfModules.extensionByZero.{u, u, u, u}
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O) U).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).over U))) ∧
      IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))) ∧
    ∃ (T : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ℤ)
      (η : 𝟭 _ ⟶ T),
      (∀ K, QuasiIso (η.app K) ∧ (∀ n, Mono ((η.app K).f n)) ∧ (T.obj K).IsKInjective) ∧
      (∀ (D : Type uD) [Category.{vD} D] [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ] [Preadditive D]
          [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive] [Pretriangulated D]
          (F : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O))
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated],
        F.HasRightDerivedFunctor (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
        ∀ (RF : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ⥤ D)
          (α : F ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
          [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
          (letI := Functor.IsRightDerivedFunctor.commShift RF α
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
          RF.IsTriangulated) ∧
          ∀ K, IsIso (α.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T.obj K))) ∧
            IsIso (RF.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (η.app K)))) ∧
      (∀ (A : Type uA) [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} A]
          (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O) ⥤ A) [F.Additive],
        (F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧
        ∀ (RF : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)) ⥤ DerivedCategory A)
          (α : F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶
            DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
          [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))],
          (letI := Functor.IsRightDerivedFunctor.commShift RF α
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ℤ
          RF.IsTriangulated) ∧
          ∀ K, IsIso (α.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj (T.obj K))) ∧
            IsIso (RF.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (η.app K)))) ∧
      (∀ [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} (globalSectionsRing X))],
        ((globalSectionsModule X).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ (U : X.C)
          [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u}
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O).obj.obj (op U)))],
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.O)
            (op U)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.Qh).HasRightDerivedFunctor
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))) ∧
      (∀ (Y : RingedTopos.{u, u, u})
          (f : RingedToposHom ({ C := X.C, J := X.J, O := X.O } : RingedTopos.{u, u, u}) Y),
        (DerivedPushforward.pushforwardOnHomotopy f).HasRightDerivedFunctor
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackOnRingedTopoi.derivedAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A6 along an arbitrary morphism of ringed topoi.**  The unbounded derived
pullback `Lf^*` is left adjoint to the unbounded derived pushforward `Rf_*`.

This is `derivedPullbackPushforwardAdjunctionOfKFlat` with its one deferred input supplied by
`pullbackInvertsQuasiIso_isKFlat`.  An `Adjunction` is exactly the bifunctorial bijection
`Hom_{D(𝒪_C)}(Lf^*G, F) = Hom_{D(𝒪_D)}(G, Rf_*F)` that the source states: its `homEquiv` is
the bijection and `Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left`, `homEquiv_naturality_right` are its
naturality in the two arguments.

The only input is `hmos`, and it is not an assumption beyond the source's.  `RingedToposSiteHom`
records continuity of `f.u` and nothing else, so `f` alone is a morphism of ringed *sites*;
`hmos : f.u.IsMorphismOfSites Y.J X.J` adds the exactness of `f^{-1}` that Stacks 00X1 demands,
which is what makes `f` a morphism of ringed *topoi* (Stacks 00XC,
`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsMorphismOfSites.morphismOfTopoi`).  Everything else the construction
needed has been discharged: the deferred exactness input is `pullbackInvertsQuasiIso_isKFlat`,
which holds along every morphism of ringed topoi, and the `HasLeftDerivedFunctor` binder is a
`Prop` class discharged by `hasLeftDerivedFunctor_pullbackOnHomotopy`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def derivedAdjunction : derivedPullback f ⊣ derivedPushforward f
declarations.comment:
for a morphism of ringed topoi presented by a morphism of the underlying sites,
at RingedTopos.{u, u, u}

declarations.doc:

`Hom_{D(𝒪)}(Lf^*𝒢, ℱ) = Hom_{D(𝒪')}(𝒢, Rf_*ℱ)`, bifunctorially in the unbounded derived
categories.

This is `Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforward.derivedPullbackPushforwardAdjunction`, Stacks 07A6
relative to the Stacks 06YY datum, at the datum `kFlatLeftDerivedPullback`; the hypothesis for
whose sake the attribute is withheld there is discharged, so there is none left.
declarations.statement:
def derivedAdjunction (f : RingedToposHom X Y) :
    derivedPullback f ⊣ derivedPushforward (X := X) (Y := Y) f
declarations.comment:
for a morphism of ringed topoi in the two-field sense of Tag 01D3, part (2) --

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
For a commutative square of morphisms of ringed topoi

```
                g'
  (Sh(C'), 𝒪_{C'}) --→ (Sh(C), 𝒪_C)
        |  f'                |  f
        v                    v
  (Sh(D'), 𝒪_{D'}) --→ (Sh(D), 𝒪_D)
                g
```

and an object `K` of the unbounded derived category `D(𝒪_C)`, the canonical base change map

`Lg^* Rf_* K ⟶ Rf'_* L(g')^* K`

in `D(𝒪_{D'})`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedBaseChangeMap (h : g.comp f' = f.comp g')
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{wC} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := X.J)) X.O))) :
    (derivedPullback g).obj ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ⟶
      (derivedPushforward f').obj ((derivedPullback g').obj K)
declarations.comment:
the canonical derived base change map `Lg^* Rf_* K ⟶ Rf'_* L(g')^* K` of a
commutative square of morphisms of ringed topoi in the two-field sense of Tag 01D3, part (2) --
a morphism of the underlying topoi together with the map of structure sheaves, with no continuous
functor between the underlying sites -- at the twelve free universes of the four ringed topoi

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedBaseChangeOfToposHom.derivedBaseChangeMap_adjoint
declarations.doc:
**The adjoint characterization of the base change map.** Under the derived adjunction
`L(f')^* ⊣ Rf'_*`, the base change map of a commutative square of morphisms of ringed topoi is
`L(g')^*` of the derived counit `Lf^* Rf_* K ⟶ K`, transported across the two composition
isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedBaseChangeMap_adjoint (h : g.comp f' = f.comp g')
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (SheafOfModules.{wC} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (J := X.J)) X.O))) :
    ((derivedAdjunction f').homEquiv
        ((derivedPullback g).obj ((derivedPushforward f).obj K))
        ((derivedPullback g').obj K)).symm
        (derivedBaseChangeMap f g' f' g h K) =
      (derivedPullbackCompIsoLeft f' g).hom.app ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPullbackCompIsoRight f g' f' g h).inv.app ((derivedPushforward f).obj K) ≫
        (derivedPullback g').map ((derivedAdjunction f).counit.app K)
declarations.comment:
the adjoint characterization which the source gives of the base change map
of a commutative square of morphisms of ringed topoi in the two-field sense of Tag 01D3,
part (2), and which pins the map down: its adjunct under `L(f')^* ⊣ Rf'_*` is `L(g')^*` of the
derived counit, across the two composition isomorphisms of Tag 0D6D

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE_of_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07A8], first conclusion, with no hypothesis beyond the source's.** The image
`A'` of `A` under `ε_*` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(R_τ')`. This is
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE` with its dévissage hypothesis
`hdev` discharged by `exact_map_pushforward_of_vanishing`.

theorem isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE_of_vanishing [A.IsWeakSerreClass] :

declarations.comment: the weak Serre subcategory for the coarser topology, with the dévissage step discharged

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07A8], second conclusion.** Let `J' ≤ S.J` be two topologies on the category
of a ringed site `S`, so that the identity functor of that category is the comparison morphism
of ringed sites `ε : (C_τ, 𝒪_τ) ⟶ (C_τ', 𝒪_τ')`. Let `A` be a weak Serre subcategory of
`Mod(𝒪_τ)` and let `B` be a set of objects such that every object has a `τ'`-covering by members
of `B` and `H^p_τ(U, F)` vanishes for `U` in `B`, `p > 0` and `F` in `A`. Then derived pullback
and derived pushforward are quasi-inverse equivalences of the unbounded derived categories

`D_{A'}(𝒪_τ') ≌ D_A(𝒪_τ)`,

where `A'` is the image class of the first conclusion,
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.imageOfLE`.

The five assumptions of [Stacks, Tag 0D7W] are discharged as described in the module docstring.
Nothing is carried: the hypotheses above are exactly the source's own, the dévissage hypothesis
`hdev` of `Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE` being proved rather than
assumed, as `exact_map_pushforward_of_vanishing`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE
    [HasSheafify J' AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [J'.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O))]
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O).ofLE h))]
    [J'.HasSheafCompose (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    [A.IsWeakSerreClass] (B : Set S.C)
    (hB : ∀ U : S.C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{u} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ U : S.C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p →
      ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O), A F →
      IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) U p F)) :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (imageOfLE h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).FullSubcategory ≌
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the equivalence of derived categories given by ε^* and Rε_*

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE_functor_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
**The equivalence of [Stacks, Tag 07A8] is given by `ε^*`**: its forward functor, followed by
the inclusion of `D_A(𝒪_τ)` into `D(𝒪_τ)`, is the inclusion of `D_{A'}(𝒪_τ')` followed by the
derived pullback `Lε^* = ε^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE_functor_comp_ι :
    letI : (pullbackOnHomotopy (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom).HasLeftDerivedFunctor
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (S.ofLe h).ringedTopos.O))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :=
      S.hasLeftDerivedFunctor_pullbackOnHomotopy_coarseningHom h
    (derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).functor ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).ι =
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (imageOfLE h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).ι ⋙
        derivedPullback (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom
declarations.comment: the forward functor of the equivalence is the derived pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE_inverse_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-inverse of the equivalence of [Stacks, Tag 07A8] is `Rε_*`**: it, followed by the
inclusion of `D_{A'}(𝒪_τ')` into `D(𝒪_τ')`, is the inclusion of `D_A(𝒪_τ)` followed by the
derived pushforward `Rε_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE_inverse_comp_ι :
    (derivedPullbackEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).inverse ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (imageOfLE h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).ι =
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).ι ⋙
        derivedPushforward (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse of the equivalence is the derived pushforward

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A8, second conclusion.**  Under the hypotheses of
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE`, that equivalence
`D_A(𝒪_τ) ≌ D_{A'}(𝒪_τ')`, where `A' = ε_*A`, is an equivalence of triangulated categories, and it
is given by `ε^*` and `Rε_*`:

* it is a triangulated equivalence, for the shift structure of `Lε^*` on its quasi-inverse and the
  compatible one on its functor;
* its functor, read in `D(𝒪_τ')`, is the derived pushforward `Rε_*`;
* its quasi-inverse, read in `D(𝒪_τ)`, is the derived pullback `Lε^*`, compatibly with the shift;
* since `ε^*` is exact, that quasi-inverse is `ε^*` applied termwise to complexes.

That `A'` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(𝒪_τ')`, which is what makes `D_{A'}(𝒪_τ')` a
triangulated subcategory of `D(𝒪_τ')`, is the first conclusion,
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE_of_univLE`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE_spec :
    haveI : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (imageOfLE.{u, u, u, u} h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).IsTriangulated :=
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB_isTriangulated _ (isWeakSerre_imageOfLE_of_univLE h
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A (WeakSerre.isWeakSerre_of_isWeakSerreClass A)
        B hB hvan)
    letI := (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos_preservesFiniteLimits
      (S.coarseningHom h).isMorphismOfSites_toRingedToposSiteHom
      (S.isFlatMapULift_fSharp_auxHomH_coarseningHom h)
    letI := (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos_preservesFiniteColimits
    letI := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products
      (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos
    letI := pullbackOnHomotopy_hasLeftDerivedFunctor_of_exact
      (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom
    letI := derivedPullbackRestrictionCommShift S h A B hB hvan
    letI := derivedEquivalenceImageOfLEInverseCommShift S h A B hB hvan
    letI := (derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).commShiftFunctor ℤ
    haveI := (derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).commShift_of_inverse ℤ
    (derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).IsTriangulated ∧
      (derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).functor ⋙
          (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (imageOfLE.{u, u, u, u} h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).ι =
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).ι ⋙
          derivedPushforward.{u} (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom ∧
      ∃ e : (derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).inverse ⋙
          (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).ι =
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (imageOfLE.{u, u, u, u} h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).ι ⋙
          derivedPullback.{u} (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom,
        NatTrans.CommShift (eqToIso e).hom ℤ ∧
      Nonempty ((derivedEquivalenceImageOfLE S h A B hB hvan).inverse ⋙
          (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB A).ι ≅
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (imageOfLE.{u, u, u, u} h (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf S.O) A)).ι ⋙
          (S.coarseningHom h).toRingedToposSiteHom.pullbackTopos.mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment:
second conclusion: the equivalence of triangulated categories
`D_A(𝒪_τ) ≌ D_{A'}(𝒪_τ')` given by `ε^*` and `Rε_*`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE
declarations.doc:
Let `J' ≤ J` be two topologies on `C` and let `R` be a sheaf of rings for the finer topology
`J`, so that the identity functor of `C` is the comparison morphism of ringed sites
`ε : (C_τ, R_τ) ⟶ (C_τ', R_τ')`. Let `A` be a class of sheaves of `R`-modules for `J` — the
source's assumption (1), that every object of `A` is a sheaf for the finer topology, is this — and
let `B` be a set of objects of `C`. Assume

1. `A` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(R_τ)`,
2. every object of `C` has a `J'`-covering whose members lie in `B`,
3. for every `U` in `B` the cohomology `H^p_τ(U, F)` vanishes for `p > 0` and `F` in `A`.

Then the image `A'` of `A` under `ε_*` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(R_τ')`.

The hypothesis `hdev` is the step of the source's proof that assumptions (2) and (3) above force
`ε_*` to carry an exact short complex with terms in `A` to an exact short complex. In the source
that step is Stacks 072W, identifying `R^pε_*` with the sheafification of `U ↦ H^p_τ(U, F)`,
followed by a dévissage.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerre_imageOfLE [HasSheafify J' AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [J'.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [EnoughInjectives (_root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R)]
    (hA : WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre A) (B : Set C)
    (hB : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
      IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F))
    (hdev : (∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i)) →
      (∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
        IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F)) →
      ∀ S : ShortComplex (_root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R), S.Exact →
        A S.X₁ → A S.X₂ → A S.X₃ → (S.map (pushforward.{u, v, r, m} h R)).Exact) :
    WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre (imageOfLE.{u, v, r, m} h R A)
declarations.comment: the weak Serre subcategory for the coarser topology

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE
declarations.doc:
The same statement as `Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE`, with the
conclusion phrased in the closure form `CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass` of
Stacks 0754.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE [HasSheafify J' AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [J'.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{m}]
    [EnoughInjectives (_root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R)]
    (hA : WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre A) (B : Set C)
    (hB : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
      IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F))
    (hdev : (∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i)) →
      (∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
        IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F)) →
      ∀ S : ShortComplex (_root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R), S.Exact →
        A S.X₁ → A S.X₂ → A S.X₃ → (S.map (pushforward.{u, v, r, m} h R)).Exact) :
    (imageOfLE.{u, v, r, m} h R A).IsWeakSerreClass
declarations.comment: the same conclusion in the closure form of Stacks 0754

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE_of_univLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A8, first conclusion.**  Let `J' ≤ J` be two topologies on `C` and let `R` be a
sheaf of rings for the finer topology `J`, so that the identity functor of `C` is the comparison
morphism of ringed sites `ε : (C_τ, R_τ) ⟶ (C_τ', R_τ')`.  Let `A` be a class of sheaves of
`R`-modules for `J` — the source's assumption (1), that every object of `A` is a sheaf for the
finer topology, is this — and let `B` be a set of objects of `C`.  Assume

1. `A` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(R_τ)`,
2. every object of `C` has a `J'`-covering whose members lie in `B`,
3. for every `U` in `B` the cohomology `H^p_τ(U, F)` vanishes for `p > 0` and `F` in `A`.

Then the image `A'` of `A` under `ε_*` is a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(R_τ')`.

The modules live in a universe containing those of the objects and morphisms of `C` and of the
rings; in it sheafification exists for both topologies, inverts exactly the locally bijective
morphisms, and sheaves of `R`-modules have enough injectives, so that `H^p_τ(U, -)` is defined.
Assumptions 2 and 3 enter through
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.exact_map_pushforward_of_prop`, which proves from them that
`ε_*` carries an exact short complex with terms in `A` to an exact short complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerre_imageOfLE_of_univLE (hA : WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre A) (B : Set C)
    (hB : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
      IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F)) :
    WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre (imageOfLE.{u, v, r, m} h R A)
declarations.comment:
first conclusion: the image of `A` is a weak Serre subcategory of
`Mod(𝒪_τ')`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE_of_univLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07A8, first conclusion, in the closure form of Stacks 0754.**  The same statement as
`Stacks.Cohomology.CompareTopologies.isWeakSerre_imageOfLE_of_univLE`, with the conclusion
phrased as `CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.IsWeakSerreClass`, the form in which the derived
category results consume it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerreClass_imageOfLE_of_univLE (hA : WeakSerre.IsWeakSerre A) (B : Set C)
    (hB : ∀ U : C, ∃ 𝒰 : PreZeroHypercover.{max u v} U, 𝒰.sieve₀ ∈ J' U ∧ ∀ i, B (𝒰.X i))
    (hvan : ∀ U : C, B U → ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∀ F : _root_.SheafOfModules.{m} R, A F →
      IsZero (Stacks.Cohomology.moduleCohomology R U p F)) :
    (imageOfLE.{u, v, r, m} h R A).IsWeakSerreClass
declarations.comment: first conclusion, in the closure form of Stacks 0754

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_cohomologyExtSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07AA, the hyper-`Ext` spectral sequence.** Let `C` be an abelian
category with enough injectives, let `K^•` be a bounded above complex of `C` and let `F` be an
object of `C`. There is a cohomological spectral sequence, starting on page two, with
`E₂^{i,j} = Extⁱ(H⁻ʲ(K^•), F)`, abutting to `Extⁱ⁺ʲ(K^•, F)`.

It is the spectral sequence of the total complex of the Hom bicomplex `Hom_C(K⁻ᵖ, Iᑫ)` filtered
by the second coordinate, for `I^•` an injective resolution of `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_cohomologyExtSpectralSequence (K : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.minus C K) (F : C) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} 2,
      (∀ i j : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.page 2).X (i, j) ≅
          AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (K.homology (-j)) F i))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n ↦
        AddCommGrpCat.of
          (DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj F) n))
declarations.comment: cohomology_ext

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_termwiseExtSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07AA, the termwise `Ext` spectral sequence.** Let `C` be an abelian
category with enough injectives, let `K^•` be a bounded above complex of `C` and let `F` be an
object of `C`. There is a cohomological spectral sequence, starting on page one, with
`E₁^{i,j} = Extʲ(K⁻ⁱ, F)`, abutting to `Extⁱ⁺ʲ(K^•, F)`.

It is the spectral sequence of the total complex of the Hom bicomplex `Hom_C(K⁻ᵖ, Iᑫ)` filtered
by the first coordinate, for `I^•` an injective resolution of `F`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_termwiseExtSpectralSequence (K : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hK : CochainComplex.minus C K) (F : C) :
    ∃ E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence AddCommGrpCat.{max u v} 1,
      (∀ i j : ℤ, Nonempty
        ((E.page 1).X (i, j) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Abelian.zExt (K.X (-i)) F j))) ∧
      SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n ↦
        AddCommGrpCat.of
          (DerivedCategory.Ext (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
            ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj F) n))
declarations.comment: termwise_ext

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.derivedLowerShriek_spec
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07AC.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous functor of sites, let
`g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, let `O_D` be a sheaf of rings on `D`
and set `O_C = g^{-1} O_D`. Then the functor `g_! : Mod(O_C) ⥤ Mod(O_D)` of Stacks 0797 has a
left derived functor `Lg_! : D(O_C) ⥤ D(O_D)`, which is left adjoint to `g^*`, and for every
object `U` of `C`

`Lg_!(j_{U!} O_U) = g_! j_{U!} O_U = j_{u(U)!} O_{u(U)}`.

Continuity of `u` in the sense of the source (Stacks 00WV) is `Functor.IsContinuous` together with
its covering-pullback clause `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks`. The derived functor is
`derivedLowerShriek`, the total left derived functor of `SheafOfModules.pullback` along the
identity of `O_C`, which is the lower shriek of Stacks 0797 up to the canonical isomorphism
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriekIsoPullback`; `g^*` on derived categories is
`derivedRestriction`, induced by the exact restriction functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriek_spec :
    (lowerShriekOnHomotopy J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh).HasPointwiseLeftDerivedFunctor
      (sourceQuasiIso J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ∧
    (derivedLowerShriek J K f
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
      (derivedLowerShriekComparison J K f
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O))
      (sourceQuasiIso J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ∧
    Nonempty (derivedLowerShriek J K f
      (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) ⊣
      derivedRestriction J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ∧
    ∀ U : C,
      Nonempty ((derivedLowerShriek J K f
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (extensionByZeroUnit
            (inverseImageRing J K f
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) U)) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriek.{u} J K f
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).obj
            (extensionByZeroUnit (inverseImageRing J K f
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) U))) ∧
      Nonempty ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriek.{u} J K f
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).obj
          (extensionByZeroUnit (inverseImageRing J K f
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) U) ≅
        extensionByZeroUnit
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) (f.obj U))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.pullbackExtensionByZeroUnitIso
declarations.doc:
**`g_! (j_{V!} O'_V) ≅ j_{u(V)!} O_{u(V)}` for an arbitrary structure morphism of sheaves
of rings.** For a continuous functor of sites `u : C ⥤ D`, a sheaf of rings `O` on `D`, a sheaf
of rings `O'` on `C`, *any* morphism `phi : O' ⟶ u_* O` whose module pushforward has a left
adjoint, and every object `V` of `C`,

`g_! (j_{V!} O'_V) ≅ j_{u(V)!} O_{u(V)}`,

where `g_! = SheafOfModules.pullback phi` and both extensions by zero are the sheafified free
modules `Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnit`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackExtensionByZeroUnitIso (V : C) :
    (SheafOfModules.pullback.{max u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ w t} phi).obj
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnit.{u₁, v₁, w, max u₂ v₂ t} O' V) ≅
      Stacks.SheafOfModules.extensionByZeroUnit.{u₂, v₂, w, max u₁ v₁ t} O (u.obj V)
declarations.comment: the second equality of the displayed chain, `g_! j_{U!} O_U = j_{u(U)!} O_{u(U)}`, on sheaves of modules, for an arbitrary structure morphism of sheaves of rings `O' ⟶ u_* O` and for the sheafified-free spelling of the extensions by zero. The first equality and the existence and adjointness of `Lg_!` are NOT covered: no unbounded total left derived functor of the module-level `g_!` is constructed in this library

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriekForget_not_isomorphic
declarations.doc:
The lower shriek of modules may differ, even as an abelian sheaf, from lower
shriek of the underlying abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem lowerShriekForget_not_isomorphic :
    ∃ (J : GrothendieckTopology PUnit) (K : GrothendieckTopology Bool)
      (F : PUnit ⥤ Bool) (R : Sheaf K RingCat.{0})
      (hF : F.IsContinuous J K) (_hFc : F.IsCocontinuous J K),
      letI : F.IsContinuous J K := hF
      let S : Sheaf J RingCat.{0} :=
        (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{0} J K).obj R
      let φ : S ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{0} J K).obj R := 𝟙 S
      ∃ (hAb : (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{0} J K).IsRightAdjoint)
        (hMod : (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{0} φ).IsRightAdjoint),
      letI : (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{0} J K).IsRightAdjoint := hAb
      letI : (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{0} φ).IsRightAdjoint := hMod
      ∃ M : SheafOfModules.{0} S,
        ¬ Nonempty
          (((SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{0} S ⋙
              F.sheafPullback AddCommGrpCat.{0} J K).obj M) ≅
            ((SheafOfModules.pullback.{0} φ ⋙
              SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{0} R).obj M))
declarations.comment: underived noncommutation

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_acyclic
declarations.doc:
**The comparison transformation**, conditional only on the acyclicity statement of Stacks 0794
for lower shriek: there is exactly one natural transformation `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!`
compatible with the counits of the two left derived functors and the comparison of Stacks 0798.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_acyclic [Small.{w} C]
    [∀ U : C, (_root_.SheafOfModules.pushforward.{w} (F := Over.forget U)
      (𝟙 ((inverseImageRing J K f O).over U) :
        (inverseImageRing J K f O).over U ⟶ (inverseImageRing J K f O).over U)).IsRightAdjoint]
    (hFP : ∀ (a : ℤ)
      (Lc : CochainComplex (_root_.SheafOfModules.{w} (inverseImageRing J K f O)) ℤ),
      Lc.IsStrictlyLE a →
      (∀ n, IsSumOfExtensionByZeroUnits (inverseImageRing J K f O) (Lc.X n)) → Lc.Acyclic →
      (((lowerShriekModules J K f O).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Lc).Acyclic) :
    ∃! t : (forgetSourceModules J K f O).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedLowerShriekAbelian J K f ⟶
      derivedLowerShriek J K f O ⋙ (forgetTargetModules K O).mapDerivedCategory,
      Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh t ≫ derivedLowerShriekForgetCounit J K f O =
        derivedForgetComparisonCounit J K f O
declarations.comment: the comparison transformation `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.exists_isIso_forgetComparison_not_isIso_derivedForgetComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07AE, the warning.** Let `u : C ⥤ D`, `g`, `O_D` and `O_C = g^{-1} O_D`
be as in Stacks 07AC. In general the square

```
D(O_C) --Lg_!--> D(O_D)
  |                 |
forget            forget
  v                 v
D(C) --Lg_!^{Ab}--> D(D)
```

does **not** commute, and this can happen even if `g_! = g_!^{Ab}`.

Stated as an existence: there are small sites `C`, `D`, a functor `u : C ⥤ D` satisfying the
hypotheses of Stacks 07AC (continuous in the sense of Stacks 00WV, which is
`Functor.IsContinuous` together with `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks`, and
cocontinuous) and a sheaf of rings `O_D` on `D` such that

* `g_! = g_!^{Ab}`: the canonical comparison `g_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ g_!` of Stacks 0798
  (`forgetComparison`) is an isomorphism, and yet
* the canonical comparison `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!` of Stacks 07AE
  (`derivedForgetComparison`, characterised by
  `existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_continuous`) is not an isomorphism, and indeed the
  two composites `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget` and `forget ∘ Lg_!` are not isomorphic by any natural
  isomorphism whatsoever.

The example: `C` is the cospan category `left ⟶ one ⟵ right` and `D` is `Bool` ordered by
`false ≤ true`, both with the trivial topology, `u` sends the legs to `false ≤ true`, and `O_D`
is `ℤ` at `true` and the zero ring at `false`. Every `O_C`-module vanishes at `left` and `right`,
which forces `g_! = g_!^{Ab}` (`isIso_forgetComparison`); but the underlying abelian sheaf of
`j_{one!} O_one = O_C` has a nonzero `Ext^1` into the restriction of an injective abelian sheaf
of `D` (`not_subsingleton_ext_unit`), which is the homotopy pushout `0 ← ℤ → 0` computing
`Lg_!^{Ab}` at `false` having nonzero `H^{-1}`, so the comparison is not invertible
(`not_isIso_derivedForgetComparison`, via the criterion of this tag,
`extAcyclic_forget_extensionByZeroUnit`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isIso_forgetComparison_not_isIso_derivedForgetComparison :
    ∃ (C D : Type) (_ : SmallCategory C) (_ : SmallCategory D)
      (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D) (f : C ⥤ D)
      (_ : f.IsContinuous J K) (_ : f.IsCocontinuous J K)
      (_ : Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks J f) (O : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{0}),
      IsIso (forgetComparison J K f
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ∧
        ¬ IsIso (derivedForgetComparison J K f
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ∧
        ¬ Nonempty ((forgetSourceModules J K f
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
              derivedLowerShriekAbelian J K f ≅
          derivedLowerShriek J K f
              (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) ⋙
            (forgetTargetModules K (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (targetRingedSite K O).O)).mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: the warning: the square `forget ∘ Lg_!` vs `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget` need not commute even when `g_! = g_!^{Ab}` -- an example of sites, a functor satisfying the hypotheses of Stacks 07AC and a sheaf of rings for which the comparison of Stacks 0798 is an isomorphism and the comparison `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!` is not, nor are the two composites isomorphic by any natural isomorphism; the example lives in universe 0, an existence statement needing one

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.isIso_derivedForgetComparison_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07AE, the criterion.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and
cocontinuous functor of sites, `g` the corresponding morphism of topoi, `O_D` a sheaf of rings on
`D` and `O_C = g^{-1}O_D`. Then `Lg_!` agrees with `Lg_!^{Ab}`, in the sense that the canonical
comparison `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!` is an isomorphism, if and only if the canonical
maps `Lg_!^{Ab} j_{U!}O_U ⟶ j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)}` are isomorphisms in `D(D)` for all objects `U`
of `C`.

The comparison is `derivedForgetComparison`, the unique transformation compatible with the two
counits and the comparison of Stacks 0798
(`existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_continuous`). The canonical map at `U` is
`derivedForgetComparisonGenerator`: the component of the comparison at `j_{U!}O_U` in degree
zero, followed by the identification `Lg_!(j_{U!}O_U) = g_!j_{U!}O_U = j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)}` of
Stacks 07AC. The hypotheses are those of Stacks 07AC; continuity in the sense of Stacks 00WV is
`Functor.IsContinuous` with `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks`. The forward implication
is `isIso_derivedForgetComparisonGenerator`, the converse
`isIso_derivedForgetComparison_of_isIso_generator`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedForgetComparison_iff :
    IsIso (derivedForgetComparison J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (targetRingedSite K O).O)) ↔
      ∀ U : C, IsIso (derivedForgetComparisonGenerator J K f
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) U)
declarations.comment: the criterion: `Lg_!` agrees with `Lg_!^{Ab}` (the comparison `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!` is invertible) iff every canonical map `Lg_!^{Ab} j_{U!}O_U ⟶ j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)}` is invertible in D(D); both directions, under the hypotheses of Stacks 07AC only, in the library's convention for it: small sites with objects, morphisms and module sections in one universe, and a sheaf of (commutative) rings

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedLowerShriek.existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_continuous
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07AE.** Let `u : C ⥤ D` be a continuous and cocontinuous functor of
sites, let `g : Sh(C) ⟶ Sh(D)` be the corresponding morphism of topoi, let `O_D` be a sheaf of
rings on `D` and set `O_C = g^{-1}O_D`. There is exactly one natural transformation

`Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!`

compatible with the counits exhibiting the two functors as left derived functors and with the
comparison `g_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ g_!` of Stacks 0798.

That is all the warning allows: the undifferentiated functors already need not agree, which is
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.lowerShriekForget_not_isomorphic`, and the square commutes exactly when
the canonical maps `Lg_!^{Ab} j_{U!}O_U ⟶ j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)}` are isomorphisms, which they need
not be. Uniqueness is what makes this *the* comparison of the warning rather than some
transformation between the two composites: a left derived functor is a right Kan extension along
the localization, so a transformation into `Lg_! ⋙ forget` is the same thing as one out of
`Q_h ⋙ (forget ⋙ Lg_!^{Ab})` into degreewise `g_! ⋙ forget` followed by `Q_h`, and the lift is
unique.

This is `existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_acyclic` with its inputs discharged; see the
module docstring. The hypotheses are exactly those of Stacks 07AC: `[f.IsContinuous J K]` and
`[Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks J f]` together are continuity of `u` in the sense of
Stacks 00WV, `[f.IsCocontinuous J K]` is cocontinuity, and `O` is the sheaf of rings `O_D`. The
acyclicity statement of Stacks 0794 that the conditional form takes as `hFP`, the left adjoints
`g_!` and `g_!^{Ab}` of restriction, and the existence of both derived functors are all found by
instance search from the instances proved in `ModuleDerivedLowerShriek.lean`,
`AbelianAcyclicityFromContinuity.lean` and `AdjointExistence.lean`; the transformation itself is
`derivedForgetComparison`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_derivedForgetComparison_of_continuous :
    ∃! t : (forgetSourceModules J K f
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        derivedLowerShriekAbelian J K f ⟶
      derivedLowerShriek J K f (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) ⋙
        (forgetTargetModules K
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)).mapDerivedCategory,
      Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Qh t ≫
          derivedLowerShriekForgetCounit J K f
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O) =
        derivedForgetComparisonCounit J K f
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (targetRingedSite K O).O)
declarations.comment: the comparison transformation `Lg_!^{Ab} ∘ forget ⟶ forget ∘ Lg_!`, with no hypothesis beyond those of Stacks 07AC: continuity of u (Stacks 00WV) is `Functor.IsContinuous` with `Stacks.Sites.PreservesCoveringPullbacks`; the existence of `g_!`, `g_!^{Ab}`, `Lg_!` and `Lg_!^{Ab}` is proved, not assumed; the sites are small and the ring sheaf commutative, as in Stacks 07AC
