declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocalization_flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the displayed identification

`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.

The coherator `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of **Stacks 0778** is a localization functor for
the class of morphisms whose kernel and cokernel are parasitic, that is, it exhibits
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` as the quotient of `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` by the Serre subcategory of parasitic objects
(**Stacks 02MS**).

The inclusion `i` is fully faithful and `Q` is its right adjoint (**Stacks 0778**), so `Q` is a
localization functor for the class of morphisms it inverts; by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.parasiticIsoModSerre_eq_inverseImage_isomorphisms` that class is the
one attached to the parasitic part.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalization_flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator :
    (flatBaseChangeQuasicoherator B E h S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
        hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep).IsLocalization
      (parasiticIsoModSerre B E h S hS 𝒳 hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep r hrpar
        hrcounit hreq hrfincolim)
declarations.comment: the displayed identification QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳): the coherator Q of 0778 is a localization functor for the Serre class of parasitic objects; over the hypotheses of 0778 and 0779 and the abelian structures of 06WV (2) and 0771 (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.serreQuotientEquivalenceQuasicoherentModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the displayed identification as an equivalence of categories.  The Serre
quotient `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`, built as the localization of
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` at the morphisms with parasitic kernel and cokernel, is equivalent to
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, the equivalence being the one through which the coherator of **Stacks 0778**
factors.
declarations.statement:
def serreQuotientEquivalenceQuasicoherentModules :
    (parasiticIsoModSerre B E h S hS 𝒳 hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep r hrpar hrcounit
        hreq hrfincolim).Localization ≌
      FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
        𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: the displayed identification read as an equivalence of categories between the Serre quotient of LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) by Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) and QCoh(𝒪_𝒳); over the hypotheses of 0778 and 0779 and the abelian structures of 06WV (2) and 0771 (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.serreQuotientAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the key feature: the inclusion
`i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` is left adjoint to the quotient functor.

Read with `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` identified with the Serre quotient by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.serreQuotientEquivalenceQuasicoherentModules`, this is an adjunction
between `i` and the canonical quotient functor
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.  It is the adjunction of
**Stacks 0778** composed with the adjoint equivalence, transported along the isomorphism which
identifies the quotient functor with the coherator followed by that equivalence.
declarations.statement:
def serreQuotientAdjunction :
    (serreQuotientEquivalenceQuasicoherentModules B E h S hS 𝒳 hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp
          hsep r hrpar hrcounit hreq hrfincolim).functor ⋙
        quasicoherentToFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids hinc ⊣
      (parasiticIsoModSerre B E h S hS 𝒳 hinc hclosed hpres hls hlsD hwp hsep r hrpar hrcounit
        hreq hrfincolim).Q
declarations.comment: the key feature: the inclusion i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) is left adjoint to the quotient functor LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳); over the hypotheses of 0778 and 0779 and the abelian structures of 06WV (2) and 0771 (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocalization_lqcohFbcCoherator
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the displayed identification
`QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`: for an algebraic stack `𝒳`, the
coherator `Q : LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of **Stacks 0778** is a localization functor for the
morphisms whose kernel and cokernel are parasitic, i.e. it exhibits `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` as the Serre
quotient (**Stacks 02MS**) of `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` by its parasitic objects.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocalization_lqcohFbcCoherator :
    (lqcohFbcCoherator B E h S hS 𝒳).IsLocalization
      (parasiticLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳).isoModSerre
declarations.comment: the displayed identification QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳): the coherator Q of 0778 is a localization functor for the Serre class of parasitic objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcSerreQuotientEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the displayed identification as an equivalence of categories between the
Serre quotient `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` (the localization at the
morphisms with parasitic kernel and cokernel) and `QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, the one through which the
coherator of **Stacks 0778** factors.
declarations.statement:
def lqcohFbcSerreQuotientEquivalence :
    (parasiticLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳).isoModSerre.Localization ≌ quasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the displayed identification read as an equivalence of categories between the Serre quotient of LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) by Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) and QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.lqcohFbcSerreQuotientAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B2**, the key feature: the inclusion `i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`, read on the
Serre quotient through `lqcohFbcSerreQuotientEquivalence`, is left adjoint to the quotient
functor `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
def lqcohFbcSerreQuotientAdjunction :
    (lqcohFbcSerreQuotientEquivalence B E h S hS 𝒳).functor ⋙
        quasicoherentToLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳 ⊣
      (parasiticLqcohFbc B E h S hS 𝒳).isoModSerre.Q
declarations.comment: the key feature: the inclusion i : QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) is left adjoint to the quotient functor LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChange_homology_derivedModuleLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B3, part (2).** Let `H` be a quasi-coherent module on the flat-fppf site of an
algebraic stack `𝒳`. For every `p`, the cohomology sheaf `H^p(Lg_! H)` of the derived lower shriek of
Stacks 07AS (4) is a locally quasi-coherent module with the flat base change property on `𝒳`, the
flat base change property of Stacks 0762 being read with the pullback of sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChange_homology_derivedModuleLowerShriek
    (H : flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳) (hH : H.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) (p : ℤ) :
    letI := (SheafOfModules.instAbelian _ : Abelian (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳))
    letI := abelianFlatFppfModulesSpelling B S hS 𝒳
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ p).obj
        ((derivedModuleLowerShriek B S hS 𝒳).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H)))
declarations.comment: part (2): for a quasi-coherent module `H` (Stacks 03DL) on the flat-fppf site of an arbitrary algebraic stack and every `p`, `H^p(Lg_! H)` is a locally quasi-coherent module with the flat base change property, the class `LQCoh^fbc` of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, for the actual derived lower shriek `Lg_!` of Stacks 07AS (4) at the universe of the rings, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.isLocallyQuasicoherentWithSheafFlatBaseChange_homology_derivedModuleLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B3, part (1).** Let `H` be a quasi-coherent module on the lisse-étale site of an
algebraic stack `𝒳`. For every `p`, the cohomology sheaf `H^p(Lg_! H)` of the derived lower shriek `Lg_!` is a locally
quasi-coherent module with the flat base change property on `𝒳`, the flat base change property
being read with the pullback of sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasicoherentWithSheafFlatBaseChange_homology_derivedModuleLowerShriek
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseEtaleModuleRing B S hS 𝒳)) (hH : H.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (p : ℤ) :
    letI := abelianEtaleModules B S hS 𝒳
    letI := abelianLisseEtaleModules B S hS 𝒳
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseEtaleModuleRing B S hS 𝒳))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (SmallModel.targetRing (associatedTopology B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p (etaleTopology B))
        (associatedRingedTopos B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids (etaleTopology B)
          (etaleTopology_le_topology B)).O))
    IsLocallyQuasicoherentWithSheafFlatBaseChange.{u, u + 1, u, u} B E h S hS
      𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ p).obj
        ((derivedModuleLowerShriek B S hS 𝒳).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj H))).val
declarations.comment: part (1): for a quasi-coherent module `H` (Stacks 03DL) on the lisse-étale site of an arbitrary algebraic stack and every `p`, `H^p(Lg_! H)` is a locally quasi-coherent module with the flat base change property, the class `LQCoh^fbc` of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, for the actual derived lower shriek `Lg_!` of Stacks 07AS (2) at the universe of the rings, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.isWeakSerreClass_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B4 (2).** For an algebraic stack `𝒳`, the quasi-coherent modules on the flat-fppf
site `𝒳_{flat,fppf}`, ringed by `𝒪_{𝒳_{flat,fppf}}`, form a weak Serre subcategory of
`Mod(𝒪_{𝒳_{flat,fppf}})`.

The flat objects over affine schemes are a cover-dense subsite of `𝒳_{flat,fppf}` which, with the
arrows over flat, locally finitely presented morphisms, has fibre products along its coverings,
finite covers refining its covering sieves, and flat factorizations of its arrows; so
`Stacks.FlatAffineSite.isWeakSerreClass_isQuasicoherentOnSite_of_affineSubsite` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerreClass_isQuasicoherentOnSite :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (subsiteRingedTopos B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids B.topology le_rfl
        (objectProperty B S hS 𝒳)).O) :
      ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
        (subsiteRingedTopos B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids B.topology le_rfl
          (objectProperty B S hS 𝒳)).O))).IsWeakSerreClass
declarations.comment: part (2): QCoh(O_{X_{flat,fppf}}) is a weak Serre subcategory of Mod(O_{X_{flat,fppf}})

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.isWeakSerreClass_isQuasicoherentOnSite
declarations.doc:
For every algebraic stack `𝒳`, the quasi-coherent modules on the lisse-étale site
`𝒳_{lisse,étale}`, ringed by `𝒪_{𝒳_{lisse,étale}}` (the restriction of the structure sheaf,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.ringedTopos'`), form a weak Serre subcategory of
`Mod(𝒪_{𝒳_{lisse,étale}})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakSerreClass_isQuasicoherentOnSite :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (ringedTopos'.{u, t} B S hS 𝒳).O) :
      ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{u}
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
          (ringedTopos'.{u, t} B S hS 𝒳).O))).IsWeakSerreClass
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B6**: the *derived category of `𝒪_𝒳`-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology
sheaves* `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) / D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of an algebraic
stack `𝒳`, the Verdier quotient of the triangulated subcategory of `D(𝒪_𝒳)` of complexes with
cohomology in `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` (a weak Serre subcategory of `Mod(𝒪_𝒳)`, Stacks 0771) by the one
of complexes with cohomology in `Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)`.

It is the localization at the morphisms whose cone, in `D(𝒪_𝒳)`, lies in
`D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`; `DerivedCategoryB.quotientW_eq_trW` identifies this class with
the one attached to that triangulated subcategory of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.  The flat base change
property is that of Stacks 0762, on sheaves of modules.
declarations.statement: abbrev derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.comment: the Verdier quotient D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) = D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) / D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) of an algebraic stack, with LQCoh^fbc the locally quasi-coherent fppf modules with the flat base change property of 0762 on sheaves of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B6**: the quotient functor `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of the Verdier
quotient `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (lqcFbcFppf B S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the quotient functor D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) of the Verdier quotient, with LQCoh^fbc defined by the flat base change property of 0762 on sheaves of modules

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B7**: the cohomological functor `H^i : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, the functor
`Q ∘ H^i : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` descended to the Verdier quotient (Stacks 05RJ),
`Q` being the coherator of Stacks 0778, which annihilates
`Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` (Stacks 0779).
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf (i : ℤ) :
    derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳 ⥤
      FibredSite.quasicoherentModules.{u, u + 1, u, u} B S hS 𝒳.val.val.p
        𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: the cohomology functor H^i : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), descended from Q ∘ H^i with Q the coherator of 0778

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheafFac
declarations.doc: **Stacks 07B7**: the defining identity `H^i ∘ (quotient functor) ≅ Q ∘ H^i`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheafFac (i : ℤ) :
    toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳 i ≅
      DerivedCategoryB.cohomologyComp (lqcFbcFppf B S hS 𝒳)
        (flatGroupoidPresentation 𝒳).flatBaseChangeCoherator i
declarations.comment: the identity H^i ∘ (quotient functor) = Q ∘ H^i defining the cohomology functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isHomological_cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.doc: **Stacks 07B7**: `H^i : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is a cohomological functor.
declarations.statement:
theorem isHomological_cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf (i : ℤ) :
    (cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳 i).IsHomological
declarations.comment: the descended H^i : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) is a cohomological functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isZero_iff_forall_isZero_cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B7**: an object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is zero exactly when `H^i(E) = 0` for all
`i`, the kernel of `Q` being exactly `Parasitic(𝒪_𝒳) ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` (Stacks 0779 (1)).
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_iff_forall_isZero_cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf
    (X : derivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳) :
    IsZero X ↔ ∀ i : ℤ,
      IsZero ((cohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentSheaf B S hS 𝒳 i).obj X)
declarations.comment: E is zero in D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) iff H^i(E) = 0 for every i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerived
declarations.doc:
**The right-hand vertical arrow of the diagram of Stacks 07B8**, the triangulated functor
`ε^* : D(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳)` induced by the exact functor `ε^*` on modules.
declarations.statement:
def epsilonPullbackDerived :
    DerivedCategory (etaleModules B S hS 𝒳) ⥤ DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the right-hand vertical arrow ε^* : D(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳) of the diagram

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedLocallyQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the middle vertical arrow of the diagram.**  The functor

`ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`,

the corestriction to `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of `ε^*` on the ambient derived categories.
declarations.comment: the middle vertical arrow ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) of the diagram

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedParasitic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the left vertical arrow of the diagram.**  The functor

`ε^* : D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`,

the corestriction to `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of `ε^*` on the ambient derived
categories.
declarations.comment: the left vertical arrow ε^* : D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) of the diagram

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerived_rightSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the right-hand square of the diagram commutes.**  Going along the bottom row
from `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` into `D(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` and then up by `ε^*` is going up by
`ε^*` into `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` and then along the top row into `D(𝒪_𝒳)`.

This is an equality of functors, not merely an isomorphism: the middle vertical arrow is by
construction the corestriction of `ε^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epsilonPullbackDerived_rightSquare :
    (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeEtale B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙
        epsilonPullbackDerived B S hS 𝒳 =
      epsilonPullbackDerivedLocallyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf ⋙
        (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).ι
declarations.comment: the right-hand square of the diagram: the inclusion D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) followed by ε^* is ε^* followed by the inclusion D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerived_leftSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the left-hand square of the diagram commutes.**  Going along the bottom row
from `D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` into `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` and then up by `ε^*` is going up
by `ε^*` into `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` and then along the top row into
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epsilonPullbackDerived_leftSquare :
    ObjectProperty.ιOfLE
          (derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeEtale_le B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        epsilonPullbackDerivedLocallyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf =
      epsilonPullbackDerivedParasitic B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf ⋙
        ObjectProperty.ιOfLE
          (derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_le B E h S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the left-hand square of the diagram: the inclusion D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) followed by ε^* is ε^* followed by the inclusion D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerived_outerRectangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the outer rectangle of the diagram commutes**: the composite of the two
squares, read from `D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` to `D(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epsilonPullbackDerived_outerRectangle :
    (derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeEtale B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙
        epsilonPullbackDerived B S hS 𝒳 =
      epsilonPullbackDerivedParasitic B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf ⋙
        (derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).ι
declarations.comment: the outer rectangle of the diagram, the composite of its two squares

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the last assertion.**  If the middle vertical arrow

`ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`

is an equivalence of triangulated categories and matches the two classes of morphisms the
Verdier quotients invert, then it descends to an equivalence

`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) / D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`.

The two hypotheses are the source's own "moreover": `hG` is "the middle vertical arrow is an
equivalence of triangulated categories", which the source gets from **Stacks 07A8** together
with **Stacks 0D7W** — both of which the library has, but only for a site whose objects and
morphisms share a universe; see the module docstring — and
`hW` is the matching of the inverted classes, which comes from the compatibility of `ε^*` with
the left vertical arrow, the verification the source explicitly omits.

Given them the descent is formal: `ε^*` followed by the quotient functor of **Stacks 07B6** is
again a localization at the étale class, by transport of a localization along an equivalence of
the source category, and two localizations at one and the same class of morphisms are
canonically equivalent.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleEquivalence
    (hG : (epsilonPullbackDerivedLocallyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf).IsEquivalence)
    (hW : derivedQuasicoherentWEtale B E h S hS 𝒳 =
      (derivedQuasicoherentW B E h S hS 𝒳).inverseImage
        (epsilonPullbackDerivedLocallyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒳 hfppfSheaf)) :
    derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtale B E h S hS 𝒳 ≌
      derivedCategoryQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒳
declarations.comment: the last assertion: the induced equivalence D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) / D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), given that the middle vertical arrow is an equivalence matching the two inverted classes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the middle vertical arrow of the diagram**,

`ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`,

with `LQCoh^fbc` read with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 for the pullback of
sheaves: the corestriction of `ε^*` on the ambient derived categories.
declarations.statement:
abbrev epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeEtaleModules B E h S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the middle vertical arrow ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) of the diagram, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the left vertical arrow of the diagram**,

`ε^* : D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`,

with `LQCoh^fbc` read with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 for the pullback of
sheaves: the corestriction of `ε^*` on the ambient derived categories.
declarations.statement:
abbrev epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange :
    (derivedInter (parasiticModules.{u, w, u} B S hS 𝒳 .etale)
        (locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeEtaleModules B E h S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (derivedInter (parasiticModules.{u, w, u} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf)
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the left vertical arrow ε^* : D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) of the diagram, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange_rightSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the right-hand square of the diagram commutes**: the inclusion
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` followed by `ε^*` is `ε^*` followed by the
inclusion `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒳)`, as an equality of functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange_rightSquare :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeEtaleModules B E h S hS 𝒳)).ι ⋙
        epsilonPullbackDerived B S hS 𝒳 =
      epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).ι
declarations.comment: the right-hand square of the diagram, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange_leftSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the left-hand square of the diagram commutes**: the inclusion
`D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` followed by `ε^*` is `ε^*` followed by
the inclusion `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, as an equality of
functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange_leftSquare :
    ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (derivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeEtale_le B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳 =
      epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (derivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange_le B E h S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the left-hand square of the diagram, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isEquivalence_epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the middle vertical arrow is an equivalence of triangulated categories**:

`ε^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`

is an equivalence, and it is a triangulated functor for the triangulated structures of the two
strictly full triangulated subcategories, `LQCoh^fbc` being a weak Serre subcategory on both
sites.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange :
    (epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).IsEquivalence ∧
      (epsilonPullbackDerivedSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).IsTriangulated
declarations.comment: the middle vertical arrow is an equivalence of triangulated categories, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isEquivalence_epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the left vertical arrow is an equivalence of triangulated categories**:

`ε^* : D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`

is an equivalence, and it is a triangulated functor, `Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc` being a weak Serre
subcategory on both sites. This includes the verification the source omits, that the
equivalence of the middle arrow matches the complexes with parasitic cohomology sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange :
    (epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).IsEquivalence ∧
      (epsilonPullbackDerivedParasiticSheafFlatBaseChange B E h S hS 𝒳).IsTriangulated
declarations.comment: the left vertical arrow is an equivalence of triangulated categories, for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleSheafFlatBaseChangeEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B8, the last assertion**: the equivalence

`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) / D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`

induced by `ε^*`, where `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is the Verdier quotient
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) / D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of **Stacks 07B6**,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.ParasiticQuotient.quotient`. The middle vertical arrow is an equivalence
matching the classes of morphisms the two Verdier quotients invert, because it matches the
complexes with parasitic cohomology; see
`DerivedCategory.KernelColocalization.quotientEquivalenceOfExactFunctor`. That it is induced by
`ε^*` is `toQuotientCompDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleSheafFlatBaseChangeEquivalenceIso`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleSheafFlatBaseChangeEquivalence :
    quotient (parasiticModules.{u, w, u} B S hS 𝒳 .etale)
        (locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeEtaleModules B E h S hS 𝒳) ≌
      ParasiticQuotient.quotient B S hS 𝒳
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the last assertion: the induced equivalence D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) / D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) ≌ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (2)(c).  `Lg_!` carries `D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{flat,fppf}})` into `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`,
the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 being read with the pullback of sheaves.

This is the dévissage of the source
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleLowerShriek_of_single`): `Lg_!` is
triangulated, right t-exact and commutes with direct sums, `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` is weak Serre and
closed under colimits of sequences (Stacks 0771 (2), (5)), and on a quasi-coherent module in
degree `0` it is Stacks 07B3 (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleLowerShriek :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    ∀ H : DerivedCategory (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳),
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (flatQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) H →
        DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
          ((derivedModuleLowerShriek B S hS 𝒳).obj H)
declarations.comment: part (2)(c): Lg_! carries D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_flat,fppf}) into D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), for the derived lower shriek of Stacks 07AS (4) and LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedQuasicoherentEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (2)(d).  Restriction `g^*` to the flat-fppf site and `Lg_!` define mutually
inverse equivalences between `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` — the Verdier quotient
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) / D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of Stacks 07B6 — and
`D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{flat,fppf}})`, the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 being read with the
pullback of sheaves.  The functor is the functor `c` induced by `g^*` (Stacks 07B9 (2)(a), (2)(b)),
the inverse is `q ∘ Lg_!` (Stacks 07B9 (2)(c));
see `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedQuasicoherentEquivalenceOfSingle`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedQuasicoherentEquivalence :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    ParasiticQuotient.quotient B S hS 𝒳
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) ≌
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (flatQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: part (2)(d): g^* and Lg_! define mutually inverse equivalences between D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), the Verdier quotient of Stacks 07B6, and D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_flat,fppf}): the functor is induced by g^*, the inverse is q ∘ Lg_!; for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (2)(a).  For `K` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` (with the flat base change property
of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves), the restriction `g^*K` to the flat-fppf site
lies in `D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{flat,fppf}})`: `g^*` is exact, so `H^n(g^*K) = g^*H^n(K)`, which is
quasi-coherent by Stacks 07B1 (2)(b).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleRestriction (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (flatQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳)
      ((derivedModuleRestriction B S hS 𝒳).obj K)
declarations.comment: part (2)(a): for K in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) the restriction g^*K to the flat-fppf site lies in D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_flat,fppf}), for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.isZero_derivedModuleRestriction_iff_derivedParasitic
declarations.doc:
For `K` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` (with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with
the pullback of sheaves), `g^*K = 0` exactly when `K` lies in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`:
`g^*K = 0` exactly when every cohomology module of `K` is parasitic
(`isZero_derivedModuleRestriction_iff_forall_isParasitic`, Stacks 07AR), and the `LQCoh^fbc` half
is the hypothesis on `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedModuleRestriction_iff_derivedParasitic
    (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K) :
    IsZero ((derivedModuleRestriction B S hS 𝒳).obj K) ↔
      ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K
declarations.comment: part (2)(b): for K in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), g^*K = 0 if and only if K lies in D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳), for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.derivedQuasicoherentEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (1)(d).  Restriction `g^*` to the lisse-étale site and `Lg_!` define mutually
inverse equivalences between `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` — the Verdier quotient
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) / D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` of Stacks 07B6 — and
`D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{lisse,étale}})`, the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 being read with the
pullback of sheaves.

As in the source, `D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is identified with
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳) / D_{𝒫_𝒳}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` by Stacks 07B8
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedCategoryQuasicoherentEtaleSheafFlatBaseChangeEquivalence`, induced
by `ε^*`), and on that quotient `g^*` and `q ∘ Lg_!` are mutually inverse
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.etaleQuotientDerivedQuasicoherentEquivalence`).  Stated at the
standard models of the derived categories, where Stacks 07B3 (1) is.
declarations.statement:
def derivedQuasicoherentEquivalence :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseEtaleModuleRing B S hS 𝒳))
    ParasiticQuotient.quotient B S hS 𝒳
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) ≌
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (lisseQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: part (1)(d): g^* and Lg_! define mutually inverse equivalences between D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), the Verdier quotient of Stacks 07B6, and D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_lisse,étale}), through the equivalence of Stacks 07B8; the inverse is q ∘ ε^* ∘ Lg_! (derivedQuasicoherentEquivalenceInverseIso); for LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (1)(a).  For `K` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)` (with the flat base change
property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves), `g^*K` lies in
`D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{lisse,étale}})`: `H^n(g^*K) = g^*H^n(K)` is quasi-coherent by Stacks 07B1 (1)(b).
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleRestriction
    (K : DerivedCategory (etaleModules B S hS 𝒳))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.isZero_derivedModuleRestriction_iff_derivedParasitic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (1)(b).  For `K` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)`, `g^*K = 0` exactly when
`K` lies in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedModuleRestriction_iff_derivedParasitic
    (K : DerivedCategory (etaleModules B S hS 𝒳))
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.LisseEtale.derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleLowerShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07B9** (1)(c).  `Lg_!` carries `D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_{lisse,étale}})` into
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳)`, the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 being read with the
pullback of sheaves.

This is the dévissage of the source (`DerivedCategory.derivedCategoryB_obj_of_isLE_obj`): `Lg_!`
is triangulated, right t-exact (its right adjoint `g^*` is exact) and commutes with direct sums;
`LQCoh^fbc` is a weak Serre subcategory closed under colimits of sequences (Stacks 0771 (2), (5));
and on a quasi-coherent module in degree `0` it is Stacks 07B3 (1)
(`isLocallyQuasicoherentWithSheafFlatBaseChange_homology_derivedModuleLowerShriek`). It is
stated at the standard models of the derived categories, where Stacks 07B3 (1) is.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_derivedModuleLowerShriek :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseEtaleModuleRing B S hS 𝒳))
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseAmbientRing B S hS 𝒳))
    ∀ H : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseEtaleModuleRing B S hS 𝒳)),
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (lisseQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒳) H →
        DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (fun F : SheafOfModules.{u} (lisseAmbientRing B S hS 𝒳) =>
            IsLocallyQuasicoherentWithSheafFlatBaseChange.{u, u + 1, u, u} B E h S hS
              𝒳.val.val.p 𝒳.val.isFiberedInGroupoids F.val)
          ((derivedModuleLowerShriek B S hS 𝒳).obj H)
declarations.comment: part (1)(c): Lg_! carries D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝒳_lisse,étale}) into D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒳_étale, 𝒪_𝒳), for the derived lower shriek of Stacks 07AS (2) and LQCoh^fbc with the flat base change property of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at module universe u, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.leftOrthogonal_sheafParasiticFreePart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA**, the orthogonality: `Hom(Lg_! g^* E, P') = Hom(g^* E, g^* P') = 0` for every
`P'` in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem leftOrthogonal_sheafParasiticFreePart (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) :
    (ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).leftOrthogonal

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.exists_iso_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA, canonicity** ([Stacks, Tag 0CQP]): a distinguished triangle
`E'' ⟶ E ⟶ P'' ⟶ E''[1]` with `E''` left orthogonal to `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` and
`P''` in it is isomorphic to any distinguished triangle on the canonical morphism
`Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E` whose third term lies in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, by an isomorphism of
triangles which is the identity on `E`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle
    (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳))
    (P : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) (b : K ⟶ P)
    (c : P ⟶ (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT : Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)))
    (hP : ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P)
    {E'' P'' : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)} (f'' : E'' ⟶ K) (g'' : K ⟶ P'')
    (h'' : P'' ⟶ E''⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hT'' : Triangle.mk f'' g'' h'' ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)))
    (hE'' : (ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).leftOrthogonal E'')
    (hP'' : ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P'') :
    ∃ e : Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ≅ Triangle.mk f'' g'' h'',
      e.hom.hom₂ = 𝟙 K
declarations.comment: the canonicity of the triangle: a distinguished triangle E'' ⟶ E ⟶ P'' ⟶ E''[1] with E'' left orthogonal to D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) and P'' in it is isomorphic to the triangle on Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E by an isomorphism which is the identity on E (Stacks 0CQP), for the faithful class LQCoh^fbc, any models of the derived categories, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedParasitic_obj₃_of_distTriang_sheafParasiticFreePartHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA**, the cone: for `E` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, every cone `P` on the canonical
morphism `Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E` lies in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedParasitic_obj₃_of_distTriang_sheafParasiticFreePartHom :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)),
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K →
      ∀ (P : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) (b : K ⟶ P)
        (c : P ⟶ (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ∈
          distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) →
        ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P
declarations.comment: the cone: for E' = Lg_! g^* E and E' ⟶ E the counit of Lg_! ⊣ g^*, every distinguished triangle E' ⟶ E ⟶ P ⟶ E'[1] with E in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) has P in D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳), for the faithful class LQCoh^fbc of Stacks 0762 and the actual derived lower shriek of Stacks 07AS (4) at the standard models of the derived categories, with no hypothesis (Stacks 07B9 (2)(a), (2)(c) and 07B3 (2) are proved, not assumed)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.exists_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA**: every `E` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` sits in a distinguished triangle
`E' ⟶ E ⟶ P ⟶ E'[1]` of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, `E' ⟶ E` the canonical morphism
`Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E`, with `P` in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` and `E'` left orthogonal to
`D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)),
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K →
      ∃ (P : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) (b : K ⟶ P)
        (c : P ⟶ (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ∈
            distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) ∧
          DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
            (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K) ∧
          DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P ∧
          ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P ∧
          (ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).leftOrthogonal
            (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K)
declarations.comment: the existence of the triangle: every E in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) sits in a distinguished triangle E' ⟶ E ⟶ P ⟶ E'[1] with E' = Lg_! g^* E and E' ⟶ E the counit, E' and P in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), P in D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) and Hom(E', P') = 0 for every P' in D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳), for the faithful class LQCoh^fbc of Stacks 0762 and the actual derived lower shriek of Stacks 07AS (4) at the standard models of the derived categories, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.exists_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle_unique
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA**: every `E` in `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` sits in a canonical distinguished triangle
`E' ⟶ E ⟶ P ⟶ E'[1]` of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, `E' ⟶ E` the canonical morphism
`Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E`, with `P` in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` and
`Hom_{D(𝒪_𝒳)}(E', P') = 0` for every `P'` in `D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`; canonical in the
sense of the source: every distinguished triangle `E'' ⟶ E ⟶ P'' ⟶ E''[1]` with these two
properties is isomorphic to it by an isomorphism of triangles which is the identity on `E`
([Stacks, Tag 0CQP]).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sheafParasiticColocalizationTriangle_unique :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (flatFppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)),
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) K →
      ∃ (P : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) (b : K ⟶ P)
        (c : P ⟶ (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ∈
            distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) ∧
          DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
            (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K) ∧
          DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P ∧
          ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P ∧
          (ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
            (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).leftOrthogonal
            (sheafParasiticFreePart B S hS 𝒳 K) ∧
          ∀ {E'' P'' : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)} (f'' : E'' ⟶ K) (g'' : K ⟶ P'')
            (h'' : P'' ⟶ E''⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            Triangle.mk f'' g'' h'' ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)) →
            (ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
              (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)).leftOrthogonal E'' →
            ParasiticQuotient.derivedParasitic B S hS 𝒳
              (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳) P'' →
            ∃ e : Triangle.mk (sheafParasiticFreePartHom B S hS 𝒳 K) b c ≅
                Triangle.mk f'' g'' h'', e.hom.hom₂ = 𝟙 K
declarations.comment: the whole lemma: every E in D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) sits in a distinguished triangle E' ⟶ E ⟶ P ⟶ E'[1] of D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), E' = Lg_! g^* E and E' ⟶ E the counit, with P in D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) and Hom(E', P') = 0 for every P' in it, canonical: any other such triangle is isomorphic to it by an isomorphism which is the identity on E (Stacks 0CQP); for the faithful class LQCoh^fbc of Stacks 0762 and the derived lower shriek of Stacks 07AS (4), at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.hasColocalizations_locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeFppfModules
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BA**, in the form of the colocalization hypothesis of the Verdier quotient
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) / D_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` (`D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` of **Stacks 07B6**).
declarations.statement:
theorem hasColocalizations_locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeFppfModules :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (fppfModules B S hS 𝒳)
    DerivedCategoryB.HasColocalizations
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
      (ParasiticQuotient.parasitic B S hS 𝒳 ⊓
        lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, _, u} B E h S hS 𝒳)
declarations.comment: the triangle as the colocalization of D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) by D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳): every object receives Lg_! g^* E ⟶ E, a morphism with cone in D_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) out of an object left orthogonal to it, for the faithful class LQCoh^fbc and the actual Lg_! at the standard models of the derived categories, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus_comp_plusCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the final assertion.** For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism
`f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks, the cohomology functor `Hⁱ` of **Stacks 07B7** composed with
the induced functor `Rf_{QCoh,*} : D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` is the higher direct image of
**Stacks 077A**: precomposed with the quotient functor of `𝒳` it is the middle vertical functor
`Rf_*^{LQCoh}` of the diagram of **Stacks 07BC** followed by `Q ∘ Hⁱ`, which is `Q ∘ Rⁱf_*`.

`Hⁱ` is taken here as any functor on `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` equipped with the defining identity `α`
(104.5.1.1); `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.plusCohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherent` is one.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus_comp_plusCohomology (i : ℤ)
    (H : derivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒴 ⥤
      AlgebraicStacks.fppfQuasicoherentModules B S hS 𝒴)
    (α : toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒴 ⋙ H ≅
      plusCohomologyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒴 hclosed hwp hsep i) :
    toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS f hf hdist hpar ⋙ H ≅
      derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf ⋙
        plusCohomologyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒴 hclosed hwp hsep i
declarations.comment: the final assertion of the tag: the functors Rⁱf_QCoh of Stacks 077A are Hⁱ ∘ Rf_(QCoh,*), read as the identification of Q_𝒳 ⋙ Rf_(QCoh,*) ⋙ Hⁱ with Rf_*^LQCoh ⋙ (Q ∘ Hⁱ) over the defining identity (104.5.1.1) of Hⁱ, at the module universe u + 1 that the derived direct image of Stacks 06WE on an algebraic stack lives in

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus_comp_plusCohomologyDerivedCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the final assertion**, for the cohomology functor
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.plusCohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherent` built here: its defining
identity is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.plusCohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentFac`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus_comp_plusCohomologyDerivedCategory (i : ℤ)
    (hinv : (derivedQuasicoherentWPlus B E h S hS 𝒴).IsInvertedBy
      (plusCohomologyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒴 hclosed hwp hsep i)) :
    toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS f hf hdist hpar ⋙
          plusCohomologyDerivedCategoryQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒴 hclosed hwp hsep i hinv ≅
      derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf ⋙
        plusCohomologyQuasicoherent B E h S hS 𝒴 hclosed hwp hsep i
declarations.comment: the final assertion of the tag for the cohomology functor Hⁱ built as the descent of Q ∘ Hⁱ through the quotient of Stacks 07B6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus_derivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks, if
`LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)` is a weak Serre subcategory and the spectral sequence `Rⁱf_*Hʲ(K) ⇒ Rⁱ⁺ʲf_*K`
has a page in `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)`, then the total derived direct image `Rf_*` carries
`D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` into `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus_derivedPushforward
    [(locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeFppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
      𝒴).IsWeakSerreClass]
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hss : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f → AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f →
      HasPushforwardCohomologySpectralSequence B S hS f
        (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳)
        (locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeFppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒴))
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f)
    (hqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (fppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳))
    (hK : derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K) :
    derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
      ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)
declarations.comment: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated f, the clause `Rf_* carries D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) into D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)`, by the source's own argument over the spectral sequence Rⁱf_*Hʲ(E) ⇒ Rⁱ⁺ʲf_*E with a page in LQCoh^fbc (Stacks 0771) and the weak Serre condition on LQCoh^fbc (Stacks 0771 part (2), fppf half), neither of which this library has

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus_derivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated 1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks, if
`Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)` is a weak Serre subcategory and the spectral sequence
`Rⁱf_*Hʲ(K) ⇒ Rⁱ⁺ʲf_*K` has a page in it, then the total derived direct image `Rf_*` carries
`D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` into `D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus_derivedPushforward
    [(parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ⊓
      locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeFppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
        𝒴).IsWeakSerreClass]
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hss : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f → AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f →
      HasPushforwardCohomologySpectralSequence B S hS f
        (derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳)
        (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ⊓
          locallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangeFppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒴))
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactMorphism B S hS f)
    (hqs : AlgebraicStacks.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (fppfModulesUnivLE.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳))
    (hK : derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K) :
    derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
      ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)
declarations.comment: for a quasi-compact quasi-separated f, the clause `Rf_* carries D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) into D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒴)`, by the source's own argument over the same spectral sequence with a page in Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc (Stacks 0775 with Stacks 0771) and the weak Serre condition on it (Stacks 0774 part (2), which this library has, with Stacks 0771 part (2), which it does not)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The restriction of `Rf_* : D⁺(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺(𝒪_𝒴)` to a functor
`D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`, given that `Rf_*` carries the one into the
other.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the middle vertical functor D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) of the diagram, over the preservation clause it restricts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
The middle vertical functor followed by the inclusion of `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)` into
`D⁺(𝒪_𝒴)` is the inclusion of `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` followed by `Rf_*`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_comp_ι (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf ⋙
        (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴).ι ≅
      (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙
        fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f
declarations.comment: the middle-to-right commuting square of the diagram, READ IN D⁺(𝒪_𝒳) AND NOT IN THE SOURCE'S UNBOUNDED D(𝒪_𝒳): the unbounded right derived direct image is not constructed in this library

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardPlusParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange
declarations.doc:
The restriction of the middle vertical functor to a functor
`D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`, given that `Rf_*` carries
the one into the other.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPlusParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K))
    (hpar : ∀ K, derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    (parasiticInDerivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (parasiticInDerivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the left vertical functor D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒴) of the diagram, over the two preservation clauses it restricts

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardPlusParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
The left vertical functor followed by
the inclusion of `D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)` into `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)` is the inclusion
of `D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` followed by the middle vertical functor.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPlusParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_comp_ι (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K))
    (hpar : ∀ K, derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    derivedPushforwardPlusParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf hpar ⋙
        (parasiticInDerivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴).ι ≅
      (parasiticInDerivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳).ι ⋙
        derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf
declarations.comment: the left-to-middle commuting square of the diagram

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus
declarations.doc:
The derived direct image

`Rf_{QCoh,*} : D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)`

that `Rf_*` induces on the bounded-below Verdier quotients of **Stacks 07B6**: the functor out of
the localization through which `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)`
factors.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K))
    (hdist : DerivedPushforwardMapsDistinguished B S hS f)
    (hpar : ∀ K, derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    derivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒳 ⥤
      derivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒴
declarations.comment: the induced functor Rf_(QCoh,*) : D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) on the Verdier quotients of Stacks 07B6, over the two preservation clauses and over the triangulatedness of Rf_* (a Mathlib TODO for rightDerivedFunctorPlus)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus_comp_derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus
declarations.doc:
The functor `Rf_{QCoh,*}` on the Verdier quotients is induced by `Rf_*`: precomposing it
with the quotient functor of `𝒳` gives the middle vertical functor followed by the quotient
functor of `𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus_comp_derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus
    (f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hf : ∀ K, derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K))
    (hdist : DerivedPushforwardMapsDistinguished B S hS f)
    (hpar : ∀ K, derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒳 K →
      derivedParasiticLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChangePlus B E h S hS 𝒴
        ((fppfDerivedPushforwardPlusOfStacks B S hS f).obj K)) :
    toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS f hf hdist hpar =
      derivedPushforwardPlusLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E h S hS f hf ⋙
        toDerivedCategoryQuasicoherentPlus B E h S hS 𝒴
declarations.comment: the square identifying the induced functor on quotient categories, Q_𝒳 ⋙ Rf_(QCoh,*) = Rf_*^LQCoh ⋙ Q_𝒴

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the middle vertical arrow** `Rf_* : D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`
for a quasi-compact quasi-separated `f`: the restriction of `Rf_*`.
declarations.statement:
def sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
        𝒳)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
          𝒴)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the middle vertical arrow Rf_* : D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) of the diagram, for the faithful LQCoh^fbc (flat base change with the sheaf pullback, Stacks 0762), at module universe u + 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the left vertical arrow**
`Rf_* : D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)` for a quasi-compact
quasi-separated `f`: the restriction of `Rf_*` (the parasitic half is **Stacks 0775** (2)).
declarations.statement:
def parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
      (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ⊓
        lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
          𝒳)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
        (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ⊓
          lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒴)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the left vertical arrow Rf_* : D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)(𝒪_𝒴) of the diagram

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.ιOfLE_comp_sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the left square** of the diagram commutes: the inclusion
`D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc} ⊆ D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}` followed by the middle arrow is the left arrow
followed by the inclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem ιOfLE_comp_sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus :
    ObjectProperty.ιOfLE (derivedCategoryBInPlus_parasiticSheafFlatBaseChange_le B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs =
      parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
        ObjectProperty.ιOfLE
          (derivedCategoryBInPlus_parasiticSheafFlatBaseChange_le B E h S hS 𝒴)
declarations.comment: the left square of the diagram commutes (an equality of functors)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlusCompιIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the right square** of the diagram commutes: the middle arrow followed by the
inclusion `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒴)` is the inclusion `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒳)` followed
by the unbounded `Rf_* : D(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒴)`, up to the canonical isomorphism identifying the
bounded below `Rf_*` with the restriction of the unbounded one.
declarations.statement:
def sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlusCompιIso :
    sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒴)).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ≅
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBInPlus
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒳)).ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ fppfDerivedPushforwardOfStacks B S hS f
declarations.comment: the right square of the diagram, into the unbounded D(𝒪) with the unbounded Rf_*, commutes up to the canonical isomorphism Rf_*⁺ ⋙ ι ≅ ι ⋙ Rf_*

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the induced functor** `Rf_{QCoh,*} : D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` on the
quotients `D⁺_QCoh = D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc} / D⁺_{Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc}` of **Stacks 07B6**, for a
quasi-compact quasi-separated `f`.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus :
    (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
      (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒳)
      (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ⊓
        lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
          𝒳)).Localization ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒴)
        (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ⊓
          lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒴)).Localization
declarations.comment: the induced functor Rf_(QCoh,*) : D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) on the quotient categories D⁺_LQCoh^fbc / D⁺_(Parasitic ∩ LQCoh^fbc)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.toSerreQuotient_comp_quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC: `Rf_{QCoh,*}` is induced by `Rf_*`** — the quotient functor of `𝒳` followed by
`Rf_{QCoh,*}` is the middle arrow followed by the quotient functor of `𝒴`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toSerreQuotient_comp_quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus :
    (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒳)
        (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ⊓
          lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒳)).Q ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs =
      sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒴)
          (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒴 .fppf ⊓
            lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
              𝒴)).Q
declarations.comment: Rf_(QCoh,*) is the functor induced by Rf_* on the quotient categories: the quotient square commutes (an equality of functors)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlusCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the final assertion: `Rⁱf_QCoh = Hⁱ ∘ Rf_{QCoh,*}`.** For a quasi-coherent
`𝓜` on `𝒳`, placed in degree zero of `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, `Hⁱ(Rf_{QCoh,*}(𝓜[0])) ≅ Rⁱf_QCoh(𝓜)`,
naturally in `𝓜`, with `Hⁱ` the cohomology functor of **Stacks 07B7** and `Rⁱf_QCoh` the functor
of **Stacks 077A**.
declarations.statement:
def quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlusCohomologyIso (i : ℕ) :
    ObjectProperty.ιOfLE
          (isQuasicoherentOnSite_le_locallyQuasicoherentSheafFlatBaseChangeFppfModules_succ
            B E h S hS 𝒳) ⋙
        sheafFlatBaseChangeSingleFunctor B E h S hS 𝒳 ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
          (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒳)
          (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ⊓
            lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
              𝒳)).Q ⋙
          quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
            plusQuasicoherentCohomology B E h S hS i ≅
      sheafFlatBaseChangeQuasicoherentHigherDirectImage B E h S hS f hqc hqs i
declarations.comment: the final assertion: the functors Rⁱf_QCoh of Stacks 077A are Hⁱ ∘ Rf_(QCoh,*) with Hⁱ of Stacks 07B7, as a natural isomorphism of functors QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) (𝓜 placed in degree zero)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.toSerreQuotient_comp_quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlusCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07BC, the final assertion on all of `D⁺_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`**: `Hⁱ ∘ Rf_{QCoh,*}`
composed with the quotient functor of `𝒳` is `Q ∘ Hⁱ ∘ Rf_*`, with `Hⁱ` the cohomology functor
of **Stacks 07B7** and `Q` the coherator of **Stacks 0778**.
declarations.statement:
def toSerreQuotient_comp_quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlusCohomologyIso (i : ℤ) :
    (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus
        (lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS 𝒳)
        (parasiticModules.{u, w, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 .fppf ⊓
          lqcohSheafFbcFppfModules.{u, w, u + 1} B E h S hS
            𝒳)).Q ⋙
        quasicoherentDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
          plusQuasicoherentCohomology B E h S hS i ≅
      sheafFlatBaseChangeDerivedPushforwardPlus B E h S hS f hqc hqs ⋙
        sheafFlatBaseChangeHomologyFunctor B E h S hS 𝒴 i ⋙
          coherator (isQuasicoherentOnSite_moduleLowerShriekSucc_moduleInverseImage
            (isQuasicoherentOnSite_moduleLowerShriekSucc B S hS 𝒴)
            (isQuasicoherentOnSite_moduleInverseImage_of_sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc
              B E h S hS 𝒴))
declarations.comment: the final assertion on D⁺_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳): Hⁱ ∘ Rf_(QCoh,*) ∘ (quotient functor) ≅ Q ∘ Hⁱ ∘ Rf_*, the identity the source reads off the definition of Hⁱ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_derivedFppfModulePullback
declarations.doc:
**The first assertion of Stacks 07BE, on objects, at module universe `u`.**  Let
`f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` be a 1-morphism of algebraic stacks and let `K` be an object of
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)`.  Then `f^*K` is an object of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`.

Since `f^*` is exact its cohomology modules are the inverse images of those of `K`, so the
statement reduces degree by degree to the module-level **Stacks 0771** part (3) — that `f^*`
maps `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴)` into `LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳)` —, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLocallyQuasicoherentWithFlatBaseChange_fppfModulesPullback`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange_derivedFppfModulePullback
    (K : DerivedCategory (fppfModules B S hS 𝒴))
    (hK : derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E hE S hS 𝒴 K) :
    derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E hE S hS 𝒳
      ((derivedFppfModulePullback B S hS f).obj K)
declarations.comment: the first assertion, on objects: for a 1-morphism f of algebraic stacks the exact functor f^* : D(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳) carries D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) into D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), at module universe u, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedLocallyQuasicoherentPullback
declarations.doc:
**The first assertion of Stacks 07BE at module universe `u`.**  The induced functor
`f^* : D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)`, the left vertical arrow of the square of the
source.  Its composite with the inclusion of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` into `D(𝒪_𝒳)` is the
composite of the inclusion of `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴)` with `f^* : D(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳)`, which is the
commutativity of the square; see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedLocallyQuasicoherentPullback_comp_ι`.
declarations.comment: the first assertion: the functor D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳) induced by the exact functor f^*, at module universe u, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.derivedLocallyQuasicoherentPullback_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
**The square of Stacks 07BE at module universe `u`.**  Restricting `f^*` to the subcategories of
complexes with locally quasi-coherent cohomology and flat base change and then including into
`D(𝒪_𝒳)` is the same as including into `D(𝒪_𝒴)` and applying `f^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLocallyQuasicoherentPullback_comp_ι :
    derivedLocallyQuasicoherentPullback B E hE S hS f ⋙
        (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E hE S hS 𝒳).ι =
      (derivedLocallyQuasicoherentFlatBaseChange B E hE S hS 𝒴).ι ⋙
        derivedFppfModulePullback B S hS f
declarations.comment: the commutative square of the first assertion: the induced functor on D_LQCoh^fbc followed by the inclusion into D(𝒪_𝒳) is the inclusion into D(𝒪_𝒴) followed by f^*, at module universe u, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc
declarations.doc:
The functor `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳)` induced by the exact functor
`f^* : D(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc :
    (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).FullSubcategory
declarations.comment: the first assertion: the exact functor f^* induces D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒳), with LQCoh^fbc the class of Stacks 0762 (flat base change for the pullback of sheaves), at module universe u + 1, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc_comp_ι
declarations.doc:
The induced functor followed by the inclusion `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒳)` is the inclusion
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⊆ D(𝒪_𝒴)` followed by `f^* : D(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D(𝒪_𝒳)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc_comp_ι :
    derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc B E h S hS f ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).ι =
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)).ι ⋙
        (modulePullbackSucc B S hS f).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the commutative square of the first assertion, at module universe u + 1, for the class of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, for any models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.isLeftDerivable_derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc
declarations.doc:
The composite
`D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) --f^*--> D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒳) --q_𝒳--> D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)` is left derivable with
respect to the localization `D_{LQCoh^fbc}(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` of **Stacks 07B6**, in the sense
of **Stacks 05SV**.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLeftDerivable_derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc :
    (derivedSheafFlatBaseChangePullbackSucc B E h S hS f ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)
          (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).Q).IsLeftDerivable
      (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)
        (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴))
declarations.comment: the second assertion: q_𝒳 ∘ f^* : D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳) is left derivable with respect to D_LQCoh^fbc(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) (Stacks 05SV), at module universe u + 1, for the class of Stacks 0762 read with the pullback of sheaves, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc
declarations.doc:
`Lf^*_QCoh : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`, the left derived functor of
`q_𝒳 ∘ f^*` with respect to the quotient functor of `𝒴` (Stacks 05S9, 05SV).
declarations.statement:
def derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc :
    (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)
        (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)).Localization ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)
        (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).Localization
declarations.comment: Lf^*_QCoh : D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳), the left derived functor of q_𝒳 ∘ f^*, at module universe u + 1, at the standard models of the derived categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.isLeftDerivedFunctor_derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc
declarations.doc: `Lf^*_QCoh` is the left derived functor of `q_𝒳 ∘ f^*`.
declarations.statement:
instance isLeftDerivedFunctor_derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc :
    (derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc B E h S hS f).IsLeftDerivedFunctor
      (derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSuccCounit B E h S hS f)
      (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)
        (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴))
declarations.comment: Lf^*_QCoh is the (total) left derived functor of q_𝒳 ∘ f^*, with counit derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSuccCounit, at module universe u + 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.FlatFppf.derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSuccHomEquiv
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact quasi-separated
1-morphism `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` of algebraic stacks, `A ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)` and `B ∈ D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)`,

`Hom_{D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒳)}(Lf^*_QCoh A, B) ≃ Hom_{D_QCoh(𝒪_𝒴)}(A, Rf_{QCoh,*} B)`,

`D⁺_QCoh` being read inside `D_QCoh` through the functor induced by the inclusion.
declarations.statement:
def derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSuccHomEquiv
    (A : (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientW (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)
      (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)).Localization)
    (Bq : (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientWPlus (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)
      (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).Localization) :
    ((derivedQuasicoherentPullbackSucc B E h S hS f).obj A ⟶
        (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientPlusToSerreQuotient
          (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)
          (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒳)).obj Bq) ≃
      (A ⟶ (DerivedCategoryB.serreQuotientPlusToSerreQuotient
          (sheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)
          (parasiticSheafFlatBaseChangeModulesSucc B E h S hS 𝒴)).obj
        ((derivedPushforwardQuasicoherentPlusSucc B E h S hS f hqc hqs).obj Bq))
