        Pretriangulated.IsDerivedLimit F K' → Nonempty (K ≅ K')) ∧
      ∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R)),
        Pretriangulated.IsDerivedLimit F K →
          let X : ℕ → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) := fun n ↦ F.obj (op n)
          let d : (∏ᶜ X) ⟶ ∏ᶜ X := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
            Pi.π X n - Pi.π X (n + 1) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
          ∃ (a : K ⟶ ∏ᶜ X) (b : (∏ᶜ X) ⟶ K⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            let T := Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk a d b
            T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R)) ∧
              ∀ r : ℤ,
                let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) r
                let H₁ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) (r - 1)
                let homologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{max v u} R := F ⋙ H
                let shiftedHomologySystem : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{max v u} R := F ⋙ H₁
                let P : ModuleCat.{max v u} R :=
                  ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)
                let δ : P ⟶ P := Pi.lift fun n : ℕ ↦
                  Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) n -
                    Pi.π (fun n : ℕ ↦ shiftedHomologySystem.obj (op n)) (n + 1) ≫
                      shiftedHomologySystem.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
                ∃ (e : H₁.obj (∏ᶜ X) ≅ P)
                  (i : cokernel δ ⟶ H.obj K) (q : H.obj K ⟶ limit homologySystem)
                  (w : i ≫ q = 0),
                  e.hom = piComparison H₁ X ∧
                    cokernel.π δ ≫ i = e.inv ≫
                      DerivedCategory.HomologySequence.δ T (r - 1) r ∧
                    (∀ n : ℕ, q ≫ limit.π homologySystem (op n) =
                      H.map a ≫ H.map (Pi.π X n)) ∧
                    (ShortComplex.mk i q w).ShortExact

declarations.name: Crystalline.exists_dividedPowerDifferentialsCompletionEquiv
declarations.doc:
Let `A → B` be a ring map, let `(J, δ)` be a divided power structure on `B`, let `p` be
prime, let `A` be a `ℤ_(p)`-algebra and let `p` be nilpotent in `B / J`.  Then
`lim_e Ω_{B_e/A, δ̄} = lim_e Ω_{B/A, δ} / pᵉ Ω_{B/A, δ}
  = lim_e Ω_{B^∧/A, δ^∧} / pᵉ Ω_{B^∧/A, δ^∧}`.

The conclusion is written out here, with no reference to
`Crystalline.DifferentialsCompletionComparison`.  Beyond a level `N`, each `pᵉ B` lies in `J` and
is stable under the divided powers of `δ` (`level`), so `B_e = B / pᵉ B` carries divided powers
`δ̄` and the modules `Ω_{B_e/A, δ̄} = Crystalline.quotientDifferentials ..` form an inverse system
whose transition maps are those induced on universal differentials (`transition`, and the first
conjunct).  The second and third limits are Mathlib's `AdicCompletion`s of `Ω_{B/A, δ}` and of
`Ω_{B^∧/A, δ^∧}`; `fromOriginal` and `fromCompletion` identify every level of their towers of
quotients with that system, compatibly with all three families of transition maps, which is the
first equality in the strong form of an isomorphism of inverse systems.  `limitEquiv` is the
isomorphism of the second limit with the third that results, and the last conjunct says its
component at each level `N + e` is `fromOriginal` followed by the inverse of `fromCompletion`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_dividedPowerDifferentialsCompletionEquiv
    [Fact p.Prime] [Algebra (DividedPowers.IntegersAtPrime p) A]
    (hp : IsNilpotent (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (p : B))) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ)
      (level : ∀ e, N ≤ e → (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p ^ e ≤ J) ∧
        delta.IsSubDPIdeal (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p ^ e))
      (transition : ∀ e e' : ℕ, e ≤ e' →
        quotientDifferentials (A := A) J delta p (N + e')
            (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e')).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e')).2 →+
          quotientDifferentials (A := A) J delta p (N + e)
            (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
      (fromOriginal : ∀ e : ℕ, differentialsModPow (A := A) J delta p (N + e) ≃ₗ[B]
        quotientDifferentials (A := A) J delta p (N + e)
          (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
      (fromCompletion : ∀ e : ℕ,
        completedDifferentialsModPow (A := A) J delta p hp (N + e) ≃+
          quotientDifferentials (A := A) J delta p (N + e)
            (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
      (limitEquiv : AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p)
            (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A) delta) ≃+
          AdicCompletion
            (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal
              (A := AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) B) p)
            (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A)
              (DividedPowers.completedDividedPowers J delta p hp).1)),
      (∀ (e e' : ℕ) (h : e ≤ e') (b : B),
          transition e e' h
              (dividedPowerDifferential (A := A)
                (DividedPowers.quotientDividedPowers J delta p (N + e')
                  (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e')).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e')).2)
                (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p ^ (N + e')) b)) =
            dividedPowerDifferential (A := A)
              (DividedPowers.quotientDividedPowers J delta p (N + e)
                (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p ^ (N + e)) b)) ∧
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (b : B),
          fromOriginal e
              (Submodule.Quotient.mk (dividedPowerDifferential (A := A) delta b)) =
            dividedPowerDifferential (A := A)
              (DividedPowers.quotientDividedPowers J delta p (N + e)
                (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p ^ (N + e)) b)) ∧
      (∀ (e e' : ℕ) (h : e ≤ e')
          (omega : differentialsModPow (A := A) J delta p (N + e')),
          transition e e' h (fromOriginal e' omega) =
            fromOriginal e
              (AdicCompletion.transitionMap (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p)
                (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A) delta)
                (Nat.add_le_add_left h N) omega)) ∧
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (b : AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) B),
          fromCompletion e
              (Submodule.Quotient.mk
                (dividedPowerDifferential (A := A)
                  (DividedPowers.completedDividedPowers J delta p hp).1 b)) =
            dividedPowerDifferential (A := A)
              (DividedPowers.quotientDividedPowers J delta p (N + e)
                (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).1 (level _ (Nat.le_add_right N e)).2)
              (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) (N + e) b)) ∧
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (b : AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) B)
          (omega : completedDifferentialsModPow (A := A) J delta p hp (N + e)),
          fromCompletion e (b • omega) =
            AdicCompletion.evalₐ (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) (N + e) b •
              fromCompletion e omega) ∧
      (∀ (e e' : ℕ) (h : e ≤ e')
          (omega : completedDifferentialsModPow (A := A) J delta p hp (N + e')),
          transition e e' h (fromCompletion e' omega) =
            fromCompletion e
              (AdicCompletion.transitionMap
                (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal
                  (A := AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) B) p)
                (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A)
                  (DividedPowers.completedDividedPowers J delta p hp).1)
                (Nat.add_le_add_left h N) omega)) ∧
      (∀ (e : ℕ) (omega : AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p)
            (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A) delta)),
          fromCompletion e
              (AdicCompletion.eval
                (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal
                  (A := AdicCompletion (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p) B) p)
                (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A)
                  (DividedPowers.completedDividedPowers J delta p hp).1)
                (N + e) (limitEquiv omega)) =
            fromOriginal e
              (AdicCompletion.eval (DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := B) p)
                (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := A) delta) (N + e) omega))
declarations.comment: the same identification of the limits, read at the divided power envelope D(n)

declarations.name: Crystalline.completedDividedPowerDifferential
declarations.doc:
The universal divided power derivation of the completed envelope, characterized
on the dense image of the original envelope.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completedDividedPowerDifferential
    (s : AffineCrystallineSituation.{u, v}) {ι : Type w}
    (f : MvPolynomial ι s.A →ₐ[s.A] s.C) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    let env := polynomialDividedPowerEnvelope s f
    let E := env.object
    letI : Algebra s.A E := env.structureMap.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    let P := DividedPowers.pAdicIdeal (A := E) s.p
    let Ω := AdicCompletion P (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := s.A) E.dividedPowers)
    Σ' hp : IsNilpotent (Ideal.Quotient.mk E.ideal (s.p : E)),
      let D := DividedPowerRing.of
        (pAdicCompletedDividedPowerEnvelope s f hf)
        (DividedPowers.completionIdeal E.ideal s.p hp)
        (DividedPowers.completedDividedPowers E.ideal E.dividedPowers s.p hp).1
      letI : Algebra s.A D :=
        ((algebraMap E D).comp env.structureMap.toRingHom).toAlgebra
      { d : DividedPowerDerivation s.A D (algebraMap s.A D) Ω //
        ∀ b : E, d (algebraMap E D b) =
          AdicCompletion.of P (dividedPowerDifferentials (A := s.A) E.dividedPowers)
            (dividedPowerDifferential (A := s.A) E.dividedPowers b) }
declarations.comment: the same derivation for the (n+1)-fold tensor-product presentation

declarations.name: Crystalline.existsUnique_ringEquiv_pAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomial_dpow
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 60.17.5, Tag 07L2.** Let `D` and `D(n)` be as in (07J8) and
(07JF).  The coprojection `P → P ⊗_A … ⊗_A P`, `h ↦ h ⊗ 1 ⊗ … ⊗ 1` induces an isomorphism

`D(n) = lim_e D⟨ξ_i(j)⟩/p^e D⟨ξ_i(j)⟩`

of algebras over `D`, with `ξ_i(j) = x_i ⊗ 1 ⊗ … ⊗ 1 - 1 ⊗ … ⊗ 1 ⊗ x_i ⊗ 1 ⊗ … ⊗ 1` for
`j = 1, …, n`, where the second `x_i` is placed in the `(j + 1)`-st slot.

`D(n)` is an algebra over `D` through `Crystalline.pAdicCompletedCoprojection`, the `p`-adic
completion of the divided power morphism of envelopes induced by the coprojection, and the right
hand side through `Crystalline.toPAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomial`.  The map induced by the
coprojection is the map of algebras over `D` sending each divided power `ξ_i(j)^[k]` of the
right hand side to the image in `D(n)` of the divided power `ξ_i(j)^[k]` of the envelope of
`J(n)`; such a map is unique, since these divided power monomials span `D⟨ξ_i(j)⟩` over `D`.
The statement is that there is exactly one ring isomorphism `e` whose inverse is that map:
`e` commutes with the two structure maps from `D`, carries the image of `ξ_i(j)` to `ξ_i(j)`,
and carries the image of each `ξ_i(j)^[k]` to `ξ_i(j)^[k]`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_ringEquiv_pAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomial_dpow (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! e : pAdicCompletedTensorPowerEnvelope s f hf n ≃+*
        pAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomialOverEnvelope s f hf n,
      (∀ y : pAdicCompletedDividedPowerEnvelope s f hf,
          e (pAdicCompletedCoprojection s f hf n y) =
            toPAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomial s f hf n y) ∧
      (∀ q : ι × Fin n,
          e (toPAdicCompletedDividedPowerEnvelope s (tensorPowerPresentation s f n)
            (tensorPowerPresentation_surjective s f hf n) (coprojectionDifference s n q)) =
            coprojectionDifferenceVariable s f hf n q) ∧
      (∀ (q : ι × Fin n) (k : ℕ),
          e (algebraMap (polynomialDividedPowerEnvelope s (tensorPowerPresentation s f n)).object
              (pAdicCompletedTensorPowerEnvelope s f hf n)
              ((polynomialDividedPowerEnvelope s
                (tensorPowerPresentation s f n)).object.dividedPowers.dpow k
                ((polynomialDividedPowerEnvelope s
                  (tensorPowerPresentation s f n)).algebraMap.toRingHom
                  (coprojectionDifference s n q)))) =
            algebraMap (dividedPowerPolynomialOverEnvelope s f hf n)
              (pAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomialOverEnvelope s f hf n)
              (dividedPowerPolynomialVariableMonomial
                (pAdicCompletedDividedPowerEnvelope s f hf) q k))
declarations.comment: `D(n)` is an algebra over `D` through `pAdicCompletedCoprojection`, the completion of the divided power morphism of envelopes induced by the coprojection; the isomorphism is pinned down, uniquely, on every divided power `ξ_i(j)^[k]`

registrations.name: Crystalline.exists_ringEquiv_pAdicCompletedDividedPowerPolynomial_over_coprojection
registrations.comment: equation 60.17.5.1, the display of Lemma 07L2: the isomorphism `e` produced here is `D(n) = lim_e D⟨ξ_i(j)⟩/p^e D⟨ξ_i(j)⟩` as algebras over `D`, for the algebra structure `pAdicCompletedCoprojection` of `D(n)` induced by the coprojection, carrying the image of each `ξ_i(j)` to the divided power variable of the same name

declarations.name: Crystalline.completedEnvelopeThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07L4**, first assertion.  The divided power ring `(D, J̄, γ̄)` of a
surjective polynomial presentation of `C` over `A` is an object of `Cris^∧(C/A)`.  Applied to
the tensor power presentation this is `(D(n), J̄(n), γ̄(n))`, see
`Crystalline.tensorPowerEnvelopeThickening`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def completedEnvelopeThickening
    (g : MvPolynomial ι s.A →ₐ[s.A] s.C) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    CompletedEnvelopeThickening s g hg
declarations.comment: the completed envelopes are objects of the site

declarations.name: Crystalline.completedEnvelope_isCoproduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07L4**, second assertion.  The canonical coprojections exhibit
`D(n)` as the coproduct `∐_{j = 0, …, n} D` of `n + 1` copies of `D` in `Cris^∧(C/A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedEnvelope_isCoproduct
    (g : MvPolynomial ι s.A →ₐ[s.A] s.C) (hg : Function.Surjective g) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (tensorPowerEnvelopeThickening s g hg n).thickening
      (completedEnvelopeCoprojection s g hg n)))
declarations.comment: the canonical coproduct

declarations.name: Crystalline.exists_presentation_retract_pairEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Lemma 60.17.5, Tag 07L5].**  In Situation [Stacks, Tag 07MD], let `A → P' → C` be
ring maps with `A → P'` smooth and `P' → C` surjective with kernel `J'`, and let `D'` be the
`p`-adic completion of `D_{P', γ}(J')` (`Crystalline.completedEnvelopeOfPresentation`).  Then

* **(first assertion)** there are a choice of the data `A → P → C` — a polynomial algebra
  `P = A[x_i]` in finitely many variables with a surjection `q : P ↠ P'`, `P → C` being the
  composite — and homomorphisms of divided power `A`-algebras `a : D → D'`, `b : D' → D`
  between the `p`-adic completions of the divided power envelopes, compatible with the
  augmentations `D → C` and `D' → C`, with `a ∘ b = id_{D'}`;
* **(second assertion)** these maps induce an equivalence of categories between the pairs
  `(M, ∇)` over `D` satisfying (07JB)–(07JE) — `Crystalline.Pair` for the completed one-forms
  `Ω_D` with the coordinates `d x_i` — and the pairs `(M', ∇')` over `D'` satisfying them —
  `Crystalline.RetractPair` for the completed forms `Ω^*_{D'}`: `p`-adically complete, with a
  completed connection whose curvature vanishes, and topologically quasi-nilpotent in the sense
  the proof gives that condition over `D'`, on `G(M', ∇')`.  The functor is the base change `F`
  along `a` and its quasi-inverse the base change `G` along `b`;
* **(last sentence)** consequently a functor towards the pairs over `D` — in particular the
  functor of [Stacks, Proposition 60.17.4, Tag 07JH] — is an equivalence exactly when its
  composite with `F`, towards the pairs over `D'`, is one.  For the functor of
  [Stacks, Tag 07JG] on crystals this is
  `...SmallSite.exists_presentation_retract_crystalPairEquivalence`.

The proof of the second assertion is the source's: `F ∘ G ≅ 𝟭` because `a ∘ b = id`, and
`G ∘ F ≅ 𝟭` by the Taylor comparison `c_{id_D, b ∘ a}`, whose horizontality — which the source
omits — is `Crystalline.coordOp_taylorRoundTrip`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_presentation_retract_pairEquivalence :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : DecidableEq ι) (q : MvPolynomial ι s.A →ₐ[s.A] P')
      (hq : Function.Surjective q)
      (a : DPMorphism (envelopeCompletion (presentationEnvelope s (f'.comp q)) s.p
          (presentationEnvelope_prime_nilpotent s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq))).dividedPowers
        (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf').dividedPowers)
      (b : DPMorphism (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf').dividedPowers
        (envelopeCompletion (presentationEnvelope s (f'.comp q)) s.p
          (presentationEnvelope_prime_nilpotent s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq))).dividedPowers)
      (ha : ∀ c : (s.A : Type u), a (algebraMap (s.A : Type u)
          (envelopeCompletion (presentationEnvelope s (f'.comp q)) s.p
            (presentationEnvelope_prime_nilpotent s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)) : Type u) c) =
          algebraMap (s.A : Type u) (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf' : Type u) c)
      (hb : ∀ c : (s.A : Type u), b (algebraMap (s.A : Type u)
          (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf' : Type u) c) =
          algebraMap (s.A : Type u) (envelopeCompletion (presentationEnvelope s (f'.comp q)) s.p
            (presentationEnvelope_prime_nilpotent s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)) : Type u) c)
      (hab : ∀ x, a (b x) = x)
      (hρ : ∀ y, b (a y) - y ∈ (envelopeCompletion (presentationEnvelope s (f'.comp q)) s.p
          (presentationEnvelope_prime_nilpotent s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq))).ideal),
      a.comp b = DPMorphism.id _ ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation s f' hf').comp a.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq) ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).comp b.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation s f' hf' ∧
        ∃ e : Pair.{u, u, u, u} s.p _
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).forms
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).dx
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).diff ≌
          RetractPair (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq))
            (envelopeRetractData _ s.p _ (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf') a b ha hb
              hab hρ),
          e.functor = retractForwardFunctor _ (envelopeRetractData _ s.p _
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf') a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          e.inverse = retractBackFunctor _ (envelopeRetractData _ s.p _
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation s f' hf') a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          ∀ {𝒞 : Type w} [Category.{w'} 𝒞] (Φ : 𝒞 ⥤ Pair.{u, u, u, u} s.p _
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).forms
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).dx
            (polynomialEnvelopeCoordinates s (f'.comp q) (hf'.comp hq)).diff),
            Φ.IsEquivalence ↔ (Φ ⋙ e.functor).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: both assertions, under exactly the source's hypotheses: for A -> P' smooth and P' -> C surjective, there are a polynomial presentation q : A[x_i] ->> P' with finitely many variables and divided power A-algebra maps a : D -> D', b : D' -> D between the p-adically completed envelopes, compatible with the augmentations to C, with a . b = id; and an equivalence of categories between the pairs (M, nabla) over D satisfying 07JB-07JE (Crystalline.Pair over the completed one-forms of D in the coordinates d x_i) and the pairs (M', nabla') over D' satisfying 07JB-07JE (Crystalline.RetractPair: p-adically complete, a completed connection over the completed forms of D' whose curvature vanishes, and 07JE read on the base change G(M', nabla') along b, as the proof defines it), whose functor is the base change along a and whose inverse is the base change along b; and, for the last sentence, a functor towards the pairs over D is an equivalence exactly when its composite with the base change towards D' is

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.exists_presentation_retract_crystalPairEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Lemma 60.17.5, Tag 07L5], for the crystals of [Stacks, Tag 07JH].**  In the
situation of [Stacks, Section 60.17, Tag 07J7], `X = Spec(C)` and `S = Spec(A)` affine with `p`
nilpotent on `C`, let `A → P' → C` be ring maps with `A → P'` smooth and `P' → C` surjective,
and let `D'` be the `p`-adic completion of `D_{P', γ}(J')`.  Then

* **(first assertion)** there are a choice of the data `A → P → C` — a polynomial algebra
  `P = A[x_i]` in finitely many variables with a surjection `q : P ↠ P'`, the presentation of the
  system of [Stacks, Tag 07JN] being the composite `P → P' → C` — and homomorphisms of divided
  power `A`-algebras `a : D → D'`, `b : D' → D` compatible with the augmentations to `C`, with
  `a ∘ b = id_{D'}`;
* **(second assertion)** these maps induce an equivalence of categories `e` between the pairs over
  `D` and the pairs over `D'` satisfying (07JB)–(07JE), with functor the base change `F` along `a`
  and quasi-inverse the base change `G` along `b`;
* **(last sentence)** the equivalence of [Stacks, Proposition 60.17.4, Tag 07JH] also holds for
  the corresponding functor towards the pairs over `D'`: the functor
  `...SmallSite.crystalRetractPairFunctor` from the crystals in quasi-coherent
  `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)`, which is the functor of [Stacks, Tag 07JG]
  (`...SmallSite.crystalPairFunctor`, for the presentation `P → C`) followed by `F`, is an
  equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_presentation_retract_crystalPairEquivalence (P' : Type u) [CommRing P']
    [Algebra ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) P']
    [Algebra.Smooth ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) P']
    (f' : P' →ₐ[(affineSituation S hp).A] (affineSituation S hp).C)
    (hf' : Function.Surjective f') :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : DecidableEq ι)
      (q : MvPolynomial ι (affineSituation S hp).A →ₐ[(affineSituation S hp).A] P')
      (hq : Function.Surjective q),
      letI : WholeSpacePresentation S hp := ⟨ι, f'.comp q, hf'.comp hq⟩
      ∃ (a : DPMorphism (systemEnvelopeCompletion hp).dividedPowers
          (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf').dividedPowers)
        (b : DPMorphism
          (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf').dividedPowers
          (systemEnvelopeCompletion hp).dividedPowers)
        (ha : ∀ c : ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u),
          a (algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) (systemEnvelopeCompletion hp) c) =
            algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u)
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf' : Type u) c)
        (hb : ∀ c : ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u),
          b (algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u)
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf' : Type u) c) =
            algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) (systemEnvelopeCompletion hp) c)
        (hab : ∀ x, a (b x) = x)
        (hρ : ∀ y, b (a y) - y ∈ (systemEnvelopeCompletion hp).ideal),
        a.comp b = DPMorphism.id _ ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf').comp a.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp)
            (tensorPowerPresentation (affineSituation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) 0)
            (tensorPowerPresentation_surjective (affineSituation S hp)
              (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation_surjective S hp) 0) ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp)
            (tensorPowerPresentation (affineSituation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) 0)
            (tensorPowerPresentation_surjective (affineSituation S hp)
              (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation_surjective S hp) 0)).comp
            b.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf' ∧
        ∃ e : Pair.{u, u, u, u} (affineSituation S hp).p _ (systemEnvelopeCoordinates hp).forms
            (systemEnvelopeCoordinates hp).dx (systemEnvelopeCoordinates hp).diff ≌
          RetractPair (systemEnvelopeCoordinates hp)
            (envelopeRetractData _ (affineSituation S hp).p _
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf') a b ha hb hab hρ),
          e.functor = retractForwardFunctor _ (envelopeRetractData _ (affineSituation S hp).p _
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf') a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          e.inverse = retractBackFunctor _ (envelopeRetractData _ (affineSituation S hp).p _
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f' hf') a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          crystalRetractPairFunctor hp _ a b ha hb hab hρ =
            crystalPairFunctor hp ⋙ pairCatToTensorPowerPairs hp ⋙
              (tensorPowerPairFormsEquivalence (affineSituation S hp)
                (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation_surjective S hp)).functor ⋙
              e.functor ∧
          (crystalRetractPairFunctor hp _ a b ha hb hab hρ).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: all three parts in the situation of 07J7 (X = Spec C, S = Spec A affine, p nilpotent on C), for A -> P' smooth and P' -> C surjective: a polynomial presentation q : A[x_i] ->> P' in finitely many variables, the system of 07JN being presented by A[x_(0,i)] -> P' -> C (WholeSpacePresentation S hp), and divided power A-algebra maps a : D -> D', b : D' -> D compatible with the augmentations, with a . b = id; an equivalence between the pairs over D and the pairs over D' satisfying 07JB-07JE whose functor is the base change along a and whose inverse is the base change along b; and the last sentence: the functor of 07JG for that presentation, from the crystals in quasi-coherent O_{X/S}-modules on Cris(X/S), followed by the base change along a towards the pairs over D' (crystalRetractPairFunctor), is an equivalence

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.exists_presentation_retract_crystalPairEquivalence_of_hasStrongLiftingProperty
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Remark 60.17.6, Tag 07L6]: the equivalence of [Stacks, Proposition 60.17.4,
Tag 07JH] holds if we start with a surjection `P → C` where `P/A` satisfies the strong lifting
property of [Stacks, Tag 07K4].**  In the situation of [Stacks, Section 60.17, Tag 07J7],
`X = Spec(C)` and `S = Spec(A)` affine with `p` nilpotent on `C`, let `f : P ↠ C` be a surjection of
`A`-algebras such that `P/A` has the strong lifting property (`Algebra.HasStrongLiftingProperty`),
and let `D_P` be the `p`-adic completion of `D_{P, γ}(ker f)`
(`Crystalline.completedEnvelopeOfPresentation`).  The source only indicates the proof ("argue as
in the proof of Lemma 07L5"; details are not written out there); this theorem carries it out.
Arguing as in the proof of [Stacks, Tag 07L5]:

* there are a polynomial algebra `A[x_i]` with a surjection `q : A[x_i] ↠ P`, the system of
  [Stacks, Tag 07JN] being presented by `A[x_{(0,i)}] → P → C` (`WholeSpacePresentation S hp`), and
  homomorphisms of divided power `A`-algebras `a : D → D_P`, `b : D_P → D` compatible with the
  augmentations to `C`, with `a ∘ b = id_{D_P}`, `D` being the completed envelope of the system;
* the base changes along `a` and `b` are quasi-inverse equivalences between the pairs `(M, ∇)` over
  `D` and the pairs `(M', ∇')` over `D_P` satisfying (07JB)–(07JE)
  (`Crystalline.CoordinateDualRetractPair`: `p`-adically complete, a completed connection with
  values in the completed one-forms of `D_P` whose curvature vanishes, and (07JE) read on the base
  change along `b`, as the proof of [Stacks, Tag 07L5] defines it);
* and the functor from the crystals in quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)` to the
  pairs over `D_P` — the functor of [Stacks, Tag 07JG] followed by the base change along `a`
  (`...SmallSite.crystalDualRetractPairFunctor`) — is an equivalence of categories.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_presentation_retract_crystalPairEquivalence_of_hasStrongLiftingProperty
    (P : Type u) [CommRing P] [Algebra ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) P]
    (hP : Algebra.HasStrongLiftingProperty ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) P)
    (f : P →ₐ[(affineSituation S hp).A] (affineSituation S hp).C) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : DecidableEq ι)
      (q : MvPolynomial ι (affineSituation S hp).A →ₐ[(affineSituation S hp).A] P)
      (hq : Function.Surjective q),
      letI : WholeSpacePresentation S hp := ⟨ι, f.comp q, hf.comp hq⟩
      ∃ (a : DPMorphism (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp).dividedPowers
          (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf).dividedPowers)
        (b : DPMorphism
          (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf).dividedPowers
          (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp).dividedPowers)
        (ha : ∀ c : ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u),
          a (algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp) c) =
            algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u)
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf : Type u) c)
        (hb : ∀ c : ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u),
          b (algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u)
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf : Type u) c) =
            algebraMap ((affineSituation S hp).A : Type u) (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp) c)
        (hab : ∀ x, a (b x) = x)
        (hρ : ∀ y, b (a y) - y ∈ (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp).ideal),
        a.comp b = DPMorphism.id _ ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf).comp a.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp)
            (tensorPowerPresentation (affineSituation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) 0)
            (tensorPowerPresentation_surjective (affineSituation S hp)
              (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation_surjective S hp) 0) ∧
        (completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp)
            (tensorPowerPresentation (affineSituation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) 0)
            (tensorPowerPresentation_surjective (affineSituation S hp)
              (wholeSpacePresentation S hp) (wholeSpacePresentation_surjective S hp) 0)).comp
            b.toRingHom =
          completedEnvelopeAugmentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf ∧
        ∃ e : Pair.{u, u, u, u} (affineSituation S hp).p (wholeSpaceEnvelopeCompletion hp)
            (wholeSpaceCoordinateDualData hp).forms (wholeSpaceCoordinateDualData hp).dx
            (wholeSpaceCoordinateDualData hp).diff ≌
          CoordinateDualRetractPair (wholeSpaceCoordinateDualData hp)
            (wholeSpaceDualRetractData hp
              (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf) a b ha hb hab hρ),
          e.functor = CoordinateDual.retractForwardFunctor _ (wholeSpaceDualRetractData hp
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf) a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          e.inverse = CoordinateDual.retractBackFunctor _ (wholeSpaceDualRetractData hp
            (completedEnvelopeOfPresentation (affineSituation S hp) f hf) a b ha hb hab hρ) ∧
          crystalDualRetractPairFunctor hp _ a b ha hb hab hρ =
            crystalPairFunctor hp ⋙ pairCatToEnvelopePairs hp ⋙
              (tensorPowerPairsDualEquivalence hp).functor ⋙ e.functor ∧
          (crystalDualRetractPairFunctor hp _ a b ha hb hab hρ).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: in the situation of 07J7 (X = Spec C, S = Spec A affine, p nilpotent on C), for a surjection f : P ->> C with P/A having the strong lifting property of 07K4 (Algebra.HasStrongLiftingProperty) and D_P the p-adic completion of the divided power envelope of ker f: arguing as in 07L5, there are a polynomial presentation q : A[x_i] ->> P (in general in infinitely many variables), the system of 07JN being presented by A[x_(0,i)] -> P -> C, and divided power A-algebra maps a : D -> D_P, b : D_P -> D compatible with the augmentations, with a . b = id; the base changes along a and b are inverse equivalences between the pairs over D and the pairs over D_P satisfying 07JB-07JE (CoordinateDualRetractPair: p-adically complete, a completed connection over the completed forms of D_P with vanishing curvature, and 07JE read on the base change along b, as the proof of 07L5 defines it); and the functor from the crystals in quasi-coherent O_{X/S}-modules on Cris(X/S) to the pairs over D_P, the functor of 07JG followed by the base change along a (crystalDualRetractPairFunctor), is an equivalence of categories

declarations.name: Crystalline.simplexVertexModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07L7, the module.** For a cosimplicial ring `A`, the cosimplicial `A`-module which
in degree `n` is free on the vertices `0, ..., n`; a map `f : [n] ⟶ [m]` sends the free generator
at `i` to the free generator at `f(i)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def simplexVertexModule (A : CosimplicialObject CommRingCat.{u}) :
    CosimplicialModule A
declarations.comment: the cosimplicial module

declarations.name: Crystalline.simplexVertexModuleContractingHomotopy
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07L7, the contraction.** The specified homotopy from the identity endomorphism of the
cosimplicial module freely generated by the vertices to its zero endomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def simplexVertexModuleContractingHomotopy
    (A : CosimplicialObject CommRingCat.{u}) :
    Homotopy (𝟙 (simplexVertexModule A))
      (0 : simplexVertexModule A ⟶ simplexVertexModule A)
declarations.comment: the contracting homotopy

declarations.name: Crystalline.simplexVertexModuleContractingHomotopy_apply_freeMk_objMk₁
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07L7, the formula for the contraction.** On the generator `e_i`, at the simplex
`αʲ : [n] → [1]` which is zero precisely before `j`, the contraction is `e_i` if `i < j`
and zero otherwise.
declarations.statement:
public theorem simplexVertexModuleContractingHomotopy_apply_freeMk_objMk₁
    (A : CosimplicialObject CommRingCat.{u}) (n : SimplexCategory)
    (i : Fin (n.len + 1)) (j : Fin (n.len + 2)) :
    (simplexVertexModuleContractingHomotopy A).app n (SSet.stdSimplex.objMk₁ j)
        (ModuleCat.freeMk (ULift.up i)) =
      if i.castSucc < j then ModuleCat.freeMk (ULift.up i) else 0
declarations.comment: the formula on generators

declarations.name: Crystalline.id_cosimplicialEnvelopeDifferentials_homotopic_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07L9.** With the notation of equation (07L0), the complex

`Ω_{D(0)} → Ω_{D(1)} → Ω_{D(2)} → ⋯`

of `p`-adically completed modules of divided power differentials is homotopic to zero as a
`D(*)`-cosimplicial module: the identity endomorphism of the cosimplicial module `Ω_{D(*)}` over
the cosimplicial ring `D(*)` is homotopic to its zero endomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem id_cosimplicialEnvelopeDifferentials_homotopic_zero
    (E : CosimplicialEnvelope s f hf) :
    Homotopic (𝟙 E.differentials) 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.id_completedTensorCompletedForms_homotopic_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07LA.** With the notation of the equations (07JF) for `D(n)` and
(07L0) for `Ω_{D(n)}`, given any cosimplicial module `M_*` over `D(*)` and any `i > 0`, the
cosimplicial module

`M_0 ⊗̂_{D(0)} Ω^i_{D(0)} → M_1 ⊗̂_{D(1)} Ω^i_{D(1)} → M_2 ⊗̂_{D(2)} Ω^i_{D(2)} → ⋯`

is homotopic to zero, where `Ω^i_{D(n)}` is the `p`-adic completion of the `i`-th exterior power
of `Ω_{D(n)}` and `⊗̂` is the `p`-adic completion of the tensor product.

By Tag 07L9 the identity and the zero endomorphism of `Ω_{D(*)}` are homotopic.  Applying the
functor `∧^i` keeps them homotopic, and for `i > 0` turns the zero endomorphism into the zero
endomorphism, so the identity of `∧^i Ω_{D(*)}` is homotopic to zero; the `p`-adic completion
functor then gives the same for `Ω^i_{D(*)}`, tensoring with `M_*` gives it for
`M_* ⊗_{D(*)} Ω^i_{D(*)}`, and a final `p`-adic completion finishes the proof.
declarations.statement:
public theorem id_completedTensorCompletedForms_homotopic_zero
    (E : CosimplicialEnvelope s f hf) (M : CosimplicialModule E.ring) {i : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) :
    Homotopic (𝟙 ((pAdicCosimplicialIdeal E.ring s.p).completion
      (M ⊗ (pAdicCosimplicialIdeal E.ring s.p).completion
        ((exteriorPowerFunctor E.ring i).functor.obj E.differentials)))) 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.CompletedPoincare.completedDeRham_tensor_augmentation_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07LC, completed case.**  The first map `M → M ⊗̂_A D` of the
completed divided power de Rham complex of `P = A⟨x_w⟩` with coefficients in a `p`-adically
complete `A`-module `M` is injective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedDeRham_tensor_augmentation_injective
    (hM : IsAdicComplete (pAdicIdeal (A := A) p) M) :
    Function.Injective (augmentation p A W (canonicalCompletedDividedPowers p A W) M)
declarations.comment: completed_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.CompletedPoincare.completedDeRham_tensor_exact_augmentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07LC, completed case.**  The completed divided power de Rham complex
of `P = A⟨x_w⟩` with coefficients in a `p`-adically complete `A`-module `M` is exact at
`M ⊗̂_A D`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedDeRham_tensor_exact_augmentation
    (hM : IsAdicComplete (pAdicIdeal (A := A) p) M) :
    Function.Exact (augmentation p A W (canonicalCompletedDividedPowers p A W) M)
      (differential p A W (canonicalCompletedDividedPowers p A W) M 0)
declarations.comment: completed_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.CompletedPoincare.completedDeRham_tensor_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07LC, completed case.**  The completed divided power de Rham complex
of `P = A⟨x_w⟩` with coefficients in a `p`-adically complete `A`-module `M` is exact at
`M ⊗̂_A Ω^{i+1}_D` for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem completedDeRham_tensor_exact
    (_hM : IsAdicComplete (pAdicIdeal (A := A) p) M) (i : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (differential p A W (canonicalCompletedDividedPowers p A W) M i)
      (differential p A W (canonicalCompletedDividedPowers p A W) M (i + 1))
declarations.comment: completed_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.dividedPowerPolynomialDeRham_tensor_augmentation_injective
declarations.doc:
**The divided power Poincaré lemma, exactness at the coefficient module.**  For a ring `A`,
a family of variables `W` and the divided power polynomial algebra `P = A⟨x_w : w ∈ W⟩` with its
canonical divided powers, the first map `M → M ⊗[A] P` of the complex

`0 → M → M ⊗[A] P → M ⊗[A] Ω¹_{P/A,δ} → M ⊗[A] Ω²_{P/A,δ} → ⋯`

is injective for every `A`-module `M`; the degree-zero term of the complex is identified with
`M` by `Crystalline.coefficientLinearEquiv`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dividedPowerPolynomialDeRham_tensor_augmentation_injective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (W : Type w)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] :
    Function.Injective
      ((augmentedDividedPowerDeRhamDifferential A W 0).hom.lTensor M)
declarations.comment: ordinary_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.dividedPowerPolynomialDeRham_tensor_exact
declarations.doc:
**The divided power Poincaré lemma.**  For a ring `A`, a family of variables `W` and the
divided power polynomial algebra `P = A⟨x_w : w ∈ W⟩` with its canonical divided powers, the
complex

`0 → M → M ⊗[A] P → M ⊗[A] Ω¹_{P/A,δ} → M ⊗[A] Ω²_{P/A,δ} → ⋯`

is exact at every term after the first, for every `A`-module `M`.  Injectivity of the first map
is `Crystalline.dividedPowerPolynomialDeRham_tensor_augmentation_injective`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dividedPowerPolynomialDeRham_tensor_exact
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (W : Type w)
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact
      ((augmentedDividedPowerDeRhamDifferential A W n).hom.lTensor M)
      ((augmentedDividedPowerDeRhamDifferential A W (n + 1)).hom.lTensor M)
declarations.comment: ordinary_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.CompletedPoincare.exists_continuousDividedPowers
declarations.doc:
The canonical divided powers of `P` admit a continuous extension to the closure of its
augmentation ideal in `D`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_continuousDividedPowers :
    Nonempty (ContinuousDividedPowers p A W)
declarations.comment: completed_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.CompletedPoincare.continuousDividedPowers_unique
declarations.doc: The continuous extension of the canonical divided powers is unique.
declarations.statement:
public theorem continuousDividedPowers_unique
    (δ ε : ContinuousDividedPowers p A W) : δ = ε
declarations.comment: completed_exactness

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerPolynomial.stacks07LD
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Lemma 60.19.2, Tag 07LD].**

Let `A` be a ring, let `(B, I, δ)` be a divided power ring which is an `A`-algebra, and let
`P = B⟨x_w : w ∈ W⟩` be the divided power polynomial ring over `B` on an arbitrary family `W` of
variables, with divided power ideal `J = IP + B⟨x_w⟩₊`.

1. For every `B`-module `M` with an integrable connection `∇ : M → M ⊗_B Ω¹_{B/A,δ}`, the map of
   de Rham complexes `M ⊗_B Ω^*_{B/A,δ} ⟶ M ⊗_P Ω^*_{P/A,δ}` is a quasi-isomorphism
   (`Crystalline.DividedPowerPolynomial.quasiIso_polyDeRhamComparison`).
2. Let `D`, resp. `D'`, be the `p`-adic completion of `B`, resp. `P`, and `Ω̂^i_D`, resp.
   `Ω̂^i_{D'}`, the `p`-adic completion of `Ω^i_{B/A,δ}`, resp. `Ω^i_{P/A,δ}`.  For every
   `D`-module `M` with an integrable connection `∇ : M → M ⊗̂_D Ω̂¹_D` (the composite
   `M → M ⊗̂_D Ω̂¹_D → M ⊗̂_D Ω̂²_D` vanishes), the map of de Rham complexes
   `M ⊗̂_D Ω̂^*_D ⟶ M ⊗̂_D Ω̂^*_{D'}` is a quasi-isomorphism
   (`Crystalline.DividedPowerPolynomial.quasiIso_completedDeRhamComparison`).

The second clause holds without the source's hypothesis that `M` is `p`-adically complete, so it
is not made.  The variables, and the ring `A`, live in the universe of `B`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem stacks07LD (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (B : DividedPowerRing.{u}) [Algebra A B]
    (W : Type u) :
    (∀ (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module (B : Type u) M]
        (nabla : Connection A (B : Type u) (oneVariableBaseProjection A B) M)
        (hint : Connection.IsIntegrable (oneVariableBaseSource A B)
          (oneVariableBaseProjection A B) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
          (oneVariableBaseGenerationHypothesis A B) nabla),
        QuasiIso (polyDeRhamComparison A B W nabla hint)) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M]
        [Module (completedDividedPowerRing p (B := (B : Type u))) M]
        (nabla : CompletedConnection p (completedDividedPowerRing p (B := (B : Type u)))
          (completedDividedPowerForms p A B.dividedPowers 1)
          (completedFormsDifferential p A B.dividedPowers) M)
        (hint : CompletedDeRham.HasIntegrableConnection p
          (completedDividedPowerRing p (B := (B : Type u)))
          (completedDividedPowerForms p A B.dividedPowers)
          (completedDividedPowerWedge p A B.dividedPowers)
          (completedDividedPowerDeRham p A B.dividedPowers) M nabla
          (isGradedLeibniz_completedDividedPower p A B.dividedPowers)),
        QuasiIso (completedDeRhamComparison A B W p M nabla hint)
declarations.comment: both clauses: the comparison of de Rham complexes for P = B⟨x_w⟩ on any family of variables is a quasi-isomorphism, for a B-module with integrable connection and, over the p-adic completions D and D', for a D-module with integrable connection

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.vanishing07LF
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Lemma 60.19.3, Tag 07LF].**  Let `(p, (S, I, γ), X)` be a global crystalline
situation with `X` and `S` affine, and let `F` be a sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on the small
crystalline site which is locally quasi-coherent and whose comparison morphisms along closed
immersions are surjective — the two hypotheses of [Stacks, Tag 07JN].  Then

`H^j(Cris(X/S), F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0`  for every `i > 0` and every `j ≥ 0`.

The proof is the source's own.  `...SmallSite.vanishing07LF_of_levelCosimplicialSectionsIso`
reduces the statement to the existence, at every `p`-adic level `e`, of a cosimplicial
`D(*)`-module `L_*` and an isomorphism `M(•)_e ≅ L_* ⊗_{D(*)} ⋀^i Ω_{D(*)}` of cosimplicial
abelian groups with the tensor product **uncompleted**; `L_*` is
`...SmallSite.levelSectionsCosimplicialModule` and the isomorphism is
`...SmallSite.levelCosimplicialSectionsFormsIso`.
declarations.statement: theorem vanishing07LF (S : GlobalCrystallineSituation.{u}) : Vanishing07LF S
declarations.comment: the vanishing of the cohomology of F ⊗ Ω^i for i > 0, X and S affine

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crystalPairDeRhamDerivedPlusIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Proposition 60.21.3, Tag 07LG]: the complex `M ⊗^∧_D Ω^*_D` computes
`RΓ(Cris(X/S), ℱ)`**, as an isomorphism in the bounded below derived category `D⁺(Ab)`:

`M ⊗^∧_D Ω^*_D ≅ RΓ(Cris(X/S), ℱ)`.

The situation is that of [Stacks, Proposition 60.20.1, Tag 07JN]: `X` and `S` affine, `p`
nilpotent on `X`, and `D` the completed envelope of a surjective polynomial presentation
`A[x_i : i ∈ ι] → C`, supplied as the instance `...SmallSite.WholeSpacePresentation S hp`, by
default the tautological one.  `ℱ` is a crystal in quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules and `(M, ∇)`
the module with connection over `D` corresponding to it under [Stacks, Lemma 60.17.3, Tag 07JG]
(`...SmallSite.crystalPairFunctor`); the complex `M ⊗^∧_D Ω^*_D` is
`...SmallSite.crystalPairDeRhamComplex`, lifted to the universe of the abelian sheaves on
`Cris(X/S)` and extended by zero to `ℤ`, and `RΓ(Cris(X/S), -)` is
`...SmallSite.derivedGlobalSections`, the right derived functor of global sections.  Read in
`D(Ab)` it is `...SmallSite.crystalPairDeRhamDerivedIso`, the comparison of the proof.
declarations.statement:
def crystalPairDeRhamDerivedPlusIso :
    DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj
        (Stacks.Cohomology.extendPlusObj
          ((AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
            (crystalPairDeRhamComplex hp Fc))) ≅
      (derivedGlobalSections S).obj (abelianSheaf Fc.obj)
declarations.comment: for any surjective polynomial presentation A[x_i : i ∈ ι] → C, supplied as the WholeSpacePresentation instance (by default the tautological one): an isomorphism M ⊗^∧_D Ω*_D ≅ RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) in D⁺(Ab), through the double complex M(b) ⊗^∧_{D(b)} Ω^a_{D(b)} and the comparison of 07JN, for F a crystal in quasi-coherent modules and (M, ∇) its module with connection

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.smoothPresentationPairDerivedPlusIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Lemma 60.21.4, Tag 07LH]**: in the situation of
[Stacks, Proposition 60.21.3, Tag 07LG] (`X` and `S` affine, `p` nilpotent on `X`), let `ℱ` be a
crystal in quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules, `A → P' → C` ring maps with `A → P'` smooth and
`P' → C` surjective with kernel `J'`, `D'` the `p`-adic completion of `D_{P', γ}(J')` and
`(M', ∇')` the pair over `D'` corresponding to `ℱ` (`...SmallSite.smoothPresentationPair`): the
base change of the pair `(M, ∇)` of `ℱ` along any divided power `A`-algebra map `a : D → D'`
compatible with the augmentations to `C` (one exists, `Crystalline.exists_smoothPresentationMap`).
Here `D` is the completed envelope of the presentation `A[x_i : i ∈ ι] → C` of the system, any one
with a variable (the instance `...SmallSite.WholeSpacePresentation S hp`, by default the
tautological `A[x_c : c ∈ C] → C`).  Then the complex `M' ⊗^∧_{D'} Ω^*_{D'}` computes
`RΓ(Cris(X/S), ℱ)`: there is an isomorphism

`M' ⊗^∧_{D'} Ω^*_{D'} ≅ RΓ(Cris(X/S), ℱ)`

in the bounded below derived category `D⁺(Ab)`, the complex lifted to the universe of the
abelian sheaves on `Cris(X/S)` and extended by zero to `ℤ`, and `RΓ(Cris(X/S), -)` being
`...SmallSite.derivedGlobalSections`, the right derived functor of global sections.  Read in
`D(Ab)` it is `...SmallSite.smoothPresentationPairDerivedIso`: the base change
`M ⊗^∧_D Ω^*_D → M' ⊗^∧_{D'} Ω^*_{D'}` inverted, followed by [Stacks, Tag 07LG].
declarations.statement:
def smoothPresentationPairDerivedPlusIso :
    DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj (Stacks.Cohomology.extendPlusObj
        ((AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          (smoothPresentationPair hp Fc f' hf' a ha).complex)) ≅
      (derivedGlobalSections S).obj (abelianSheaf Fc.obj)
declarations.comment: for A -> P' smooth and P' -> C surjective, D' the p-adically completed divided power envelope and (M', nabla') the pair over D' corresponding to F (the base change of the pair of 07JG, for any polynomial presentation A[x_i] -> C of the system with a variable (WholeSpacePresentation S hp, by default the tautological one), along any augmentation-compatible divided power map D -> D'), the complex M' ⊗^∧_{D'} Ω*_{D'} computes RΓ(Cris(X/S), F): an isomorphism M' ⊗^∧_{D'} Ω*_{D'} ≅ RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) in D⁺(Ab), the base change to D inverted followed by 07LG in the derived category

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.completedDifferential_tauForm
declarations.doc:
**`τ` lies in the kernel of the degree zero differential of the complex of
[Stacks, Tag 07LG]**, which is the example's identity `dτ = 0` read through `Ω^0_D = D`.
declarations.statement: theorem completedDifferential_tauForm : completedDifferential p 0 (tauForm p) = 0
declarations.comment: dτ = 0 in Ω_D, the p-adic completion of the divided power differentials of D = D_{P,γ}(J)^∧ over ZZ_p: τ lies in the kernel of the degree zero differential of D → Ω¹_D → Ω²_D → ⋯

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.frobeniusPullback_tauClass_eq_envelopeMapOfLift
declarations.doc:
**`F^*(τ) = σ(τ)`**: for every lift `φ` of Frobenius on `P` and the map `σ` it induces on the
divided power envelope, the class `F^*(τ) ∈ H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is the class defined by
`σ(τ)`: on every object `(U, T, δ)` of `Cris(X/S)` its value is the image of `σ(τ)` under a lift
`E → Γ(T, 𝒪_T)` of the coordinates.
declarations.statement:
theorem frobeniusPullback_tauClass_eq_envelopeMapOfLift
    (φ : polynomial p →ₐ[ℤ_[p]] polynomial p)
    (hφ : ∀ f, φ f - f ^ p ∈ Ideal.span {(p : polynomial p)})
    (A : GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening (situation p)) :
    (cohomologyZeroEquiv p (frobeniusPullback p (tauClass p))).val (op A) =
      toSections (envelopeLift A.obj) (envelopeMapOfLift p φ hφ (envelopeTau p))
declarations.comment: F^*(τ) = σ(τ): for every lift φ of Frobenius on P = ZZ_p[x, y] over ZZ_p, with σ the map it induces on the divided power envelope, the Frobenius pullback of the class of τ in H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is the class defined by σ(τ)

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.frobeniusPullback_tauClass
declarations.doc:
**`F^*(τ) = 0`** for the lift of Frobenius `x ↦ x^p`, `y ↦ y^p`: the class `F^*(τ) = σ(τ)`
vanishes, as `σ(τ) = γ_p(x^{2p}) γ_p(y^{2p}) − γ_p(x^p y^p)² = 0`.
declarations.statement: theorem frobeniusPullback_tauClass : frobeniusPullback p (tauClass p) = 0
declarations.comment: for the lift of Frobenius x ↦ x^p, y ↦ y^p one has F^*(τ) = 0 in H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S})

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.tauClass_ne_zero_and_prime_smul_eq_zero
declarations.doc: **`τ` defines a nonzero `p`-torsion element of `H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})`.**
declarations.statement: theorem tauClass_ne_zero_and_prime_smul_eq_zero : tauClass p ≠ 0 ∧ p • tauClass p = 0
declarations.comment: τ defines a nonzero element of H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) killed by p, for X = Spec(F_p[x, y]/(x^2, xy, y^2)) and S = Spec(ZZ_p) with the divided power ideal (p)

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.exists_ne_zero_prime_smul_eq_zero_cohomologyZero
declarations.doc:
**`H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` has `p`-torsion**, for `X = Spec(𝐅_p[x, y]/(x², xy, y²))` and
`S = Spec(ℤ_p)` with the divided power ideal `(p)` and its divided powers.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_prime_smul_eq_zero_cohomologyZero :
    ∃ a : cohomologyZero p, a ≠ 0 ∧ p • a = 0
declarations.comment: conclusion (1): H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) has p-torsion, for X = Spec(F_p[x, y]/(x^2, xy, y^2)) and S = Spec(ZZ_p) with the divided power ideal (p)

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.not_injective_frobeniusPullback
declarations.doc:
**Pulling back by Frobenius `F^* : H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S}) → H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is not
injective**, for `X = Spec(𝐅_p[x, y]/(x², xy, y²))` and `S = Spec(ℤ_p)` with the divided power
ideal `(p)`.
declarations.statement: theorem not_injective_frobeniusPullback : ¬ Function.Injective (frobeniusPullback p)
declarations.comment: conclusion (2): pulling back by Frobenius F^* : H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) → H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is not injective, for X = Spec(F_p[x, y]/(x^2, xy, y^2)) and S = Spec(ZZ_p) with the divided power ideal (p)

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.quotientRingEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The presentation of [Stacks, Tag 07LJ].**  Coefficient reduction induces a ring
isomorphism

`P/J = ℤ_[p][x, y]/(p, x², xy, y²) ≅ 𝐅_p[x, y]/(x², xy, y²) = C`

carrying the class of `x` to `x` and the class of `y` to `y`, which is the identification the
example writes as `C = P/J`.  Its effect on classes is `quotientRingEquiv_mk`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def quotientRingEquiv : quotientRing p ≃+* residueQuotient p
declarations.comment: the example's presentation C = P/J: reduction of coefficients ZZ_p[x, y] -> F_p[x, y] induces a ring isomorphism ZZ_p[x, y]/(p, x^2, xy, y^2) = F_p[x, y]/(x^2, xy, y^2), carrying the class of each variable to that variable

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.base_dividedPowers_unique
declarations.doc:
**The base of [Stacks, Tag 07LJ] is uniquely divided.**  The divided powers `γ` on the ideal
`(p) ⊆ ℤ_[p]` are the only ones: `ℤ_[p]` is torsion free as a `ℤ`-module, so `n! γ_n(a) = aⁿ`
determines `γ_n(a)`, which is the uniqueness half of [Stacks, Tag 07GM].
declarations.statement:
theorem base_dividedPowers_unique (γ : DividedPowers (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p])})) :
    γ = PadicInt.dividedPowers p
declarations.comment: the example's base: the ideal (p) of ZZ_p has exactly one divided power structure, so gamma is determined

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.prime_mul_tau_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**`p τ = 0`.**  Multiplying `τ` by `p!` gives
`γ̄_p(x²y²) − γ̄_p((xy)(xy)) = 0`, and `p! = p (p − 1)!` with `(p − 1)!` invertible.
declarations.statement: theorem prime_mul_tau_eq_zero : (p : completedEnvelope p) * tau p = 0
declarations.comment: the example's identity p τ = 0 in D, for τ = gammabar_p(x^2) gammabar_p(y^2) - gammabar_p(xy)^2, by the example's own display p! gammabar_p(x^2) gammabar_p(y^2) = x^{2p} gammabar_p(y^2) = gammabar_p(x^2 y^2) = x^p y^p gammabar_p(xy) = p! gammabar_p(xy)^2 together with the invertibility of (p-1)! in D

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.toWitnessRing_envelopeTau
declarations.doc:
**The computation of [Stacks, Tag 07LJ].**  The element
`γ_p(x²) γ_p(y²) − γ_p(xy)²` of the divided power envelope has image `u v` in the witness
thickening `B`.
declarations.statement:
theorem toWitnessRing_envelopeTau :
    (toWitnessRing p).toRingHom (envelopeTau p) = u p * v p
declarations.comment: the example's computation inside its witness thickening: the divided power morphism D_{P, γ}(J) -> B out of the universal property of the envelope sends γ_p(x^2) γ_p(y^2) - γ_p(xy)^2 to uv, which is nonzero in B (u_mul_v_ne_zero of RingTheory.DividedPowers.TorsionWitnessRing), at every prime p

declarations.name: Crystalline.TorsionExample.tau_ne_zero
declarations.doc:
**`τ ≠ 0` in `D`**, the last claim of [Stacks, Tag 07LJ] about `τ`.

Were `τ` zero, its first level in the `p`-adic completion would vanish, so the envelope-level
element `envelopeTau` would be a multiple of `p`.  Its image in the witness thickening `B` would
then be zero, `p` being zero in `B`; but that image is `u v ≠ 0`.
declarations.statement: theorem tau_ne_zero : tau p ≠ 0
declarations.comment: the example's claim that τ ≠ 0 in D, at every prime p, by the source's own witness thickening B = F_p[x, y, u, v]/(x^3, x^2 y, x y^2, y^3, xu, yu, xv, yv, u^2, v^2) with the divided powers of DividedPowers.TorsionWitness on K = ker(B -> C), which send x^2 to u and y^2 to v, in which τ maps to uv ≠ 0, so that the first level of the p-adic completion already sees τ

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.crisCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**`RΓ(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is represented by the complex `D → Ω¹_D → Ω²_D → ⋯ → Ω^r_D`**, for
`X = Spec(𝐅_p[x_1, …, x_r])` over `S = Spec(𝐙_p, (p), γ)` and `D = P^∧`,
`P = 𝐙_p[x_1, …, x_r]`: in every degree `j`, `H^j(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is the `j`-th cohomology
of the completed divided power de Rham complex of `D`
(`Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.deRhamComplexNat`, whose terms vanish above `r`).

This is [Stacks, Lemma 60.21.4, Tag 07LH]
(`...SmallSite.smoothPresentationPair_computesCohomology`) for the crystal `𝒪_{X/S}` and the
example's presentation `P → Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`, which is smooth with
kernel `pP` (`Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.presentation`), through any divided power
map of envelopes compatible with the augmentations (`Crystalline.exists_smoothPresentationMap`):
the pair of `𝒪_{X/S}` is `(D, d)` (`structureModulePairHom`), its base change to the completed
envelope of `P → P/pP` is the structure module of that envelope
(`Crystalline.FormsData.baseChangeUnitHom`), and the envelope of `P → P/pP` is `P`, `pP` having
divided powers by [Stacks, Tag 07H1] (`Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.envelopeEquiv`), so
that the complex is the example's
(`Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.unitBaseChangeComplexIso`).
declarations.statement:
theorem crisCohomologyIso (j : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (T.crisCohomology j ≅
      AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{1, 0}.obj (T.deRhamComplexNat.homology j))
declarations.comment: RΓ(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is represented by the complex D -> Omega^1_D -> ... -> Omega^r_D, D = Z_p[x_1, ..., x_r]^wedge, degreewise: H^j(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is the j-th cohomology of that complex for every j, by 07LG/07LH for the presentation C = P/pP

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.isZero_crisCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Conclusion (1) of [Stacks, Tag 07LK]: the crystalline cohomology of the crystalline
structure sheaf of `X = 𝐀^r_{𝐅_p}` over `S = Spec(𝐙_p)` is zero except in degrees `0, …, r`.**
Cohomology is indexed by `ℕ`, so this is the vanishing above `r`; it holds for every `r` (the
source states its conclusions under `r > 0`).  The term `Ω^i_D` of the complex itself vanishes for
`i > r`.
declarations.statement: theorem isZero_crisCohomology {j : ℕ} (hj : T.r < j) : IsZero (T.crisCohomology j)
declarations.comment: conclusion (1): H^j(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) = 0 for j > r, X = A^r_{F_p}, S = Spec(Z_p)

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.crisCohomologyZeroIso
declarations.doc:
**Conclusion (2) of [Stacks, Tag 07LK]: `H⁰(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S}) = 𝐙_p`**, for every `r` (the
source states its conclusions under `r > 0`): the kernel of `d : D → Ω¹_D` consists of the
constants, an element of `𝐙_p[x_1, …, x_r]^∧` all of whose partial derivatives vanish being a
constant.  The universe lift is the one `H^j(Cris(X/S), -)` is valued in.
declarations.statement:
theorem crisCohomologyZeroIso :
    Nonempty (T.crisCohomology 0 ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{1, 0} T.A))
declarations.comment: conclusion (2): H^0(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) = Z_p

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.infinite_and_not_isAddTorsion_crisCohomology_top
declarations.doc:
**Conclusion (3) of [Stacks, Tag 07LK]: for `r > 0` the cohomology group
`H^r(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is infinite and is not a torsion abelian group.**
declarations.statement:
theorem infinite_and_not_isAddTorsion_crisCohomology_top (hr : 0 < T.r) :
    Infinite (T.crisCohomology T.r) ∧ ¬ IsAddTorsion (T.crisCohomology T.r)
declarations.comment: conclusion (3): for r > 0, H^r(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is infinite and is not a torsion abelian group

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.not_isHausdorff_crisCohomology_top
declarations.doc:
**Conclusion (4) of [Stacks, Tag 07LK]: for `r > 0` the cohomology group
`H^r(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` is not separated for the `p`-adic topology.**
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isHausdorff_crisCohomology_top (hr : 0 < T.r) :
    ¬ IsHausdorff (Ideal.span {(T.p : ℤ)}) (T.crisCohomology T.r)
declarations.comment: conclusion (4): for r > 0, H^r(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) is not separated for the p-adic topology

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.exists_padicInt_crisCohomology_top
declarations.doc:
**The closing remark of [Stacks, Tag 07LK] on `η`, in the sense its argument shows.**  For
`r > 0` the class of `η = ∑_{e > 0} p^e x_1^{p^e - 1} ⋯ x_r^{p^e - 1} dx_1 ∧ ⋯ ∧ dx_r` in
`H^r(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` generates a copy of `𝐙_p` (no nonzero `𝐙_p`-multiple of `η`, in
particular no `p^N η`, is exact), and it is divisible by every power of `p`; but no additive map
`𝐐_p → H^r(Cris(X/S), 𝒪_{X/S})` sends `1` to it.  The source says that `η` "generates" a copy of
`𝐐_p`, in quotation marks, and this theorem formalizes that remark in the sense its argument
shows: an injective `𝐙_p → H^r` through `[η]`, with `[η] ∈ ⋂_t p^t H^r`.  The third clause records
that the quotation marks are needed: there is no additive `𝐐_p → H^r` extending it, because the
elements `x` with `p x = [η]` cannot themselves be divisible by every power of `p`
(`Crystalline.AffineSpaceCrystallineSetup.not_exists_pow_smul_eq_etaTop`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_padicInt_crisCohomology_top (hr : 0 < T.r) :
    ∃ f : ℤ_[T.p] →+ T.crisCohomology T.r, Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ t : ℕ, ∃ y, f 1 = (T.p ^ t) • y) ∧
      ¬ ∃ g : ℚ_[T.p] →+ T.crisCohomology T.r, g 1 = f 1
declarations.comment: closing remark on eta, the quoted 'generates a copy of Q_p' in the sense its argument shows: for r > 0 an injective Z_p -> H^r(Cris(X/S), O_{X/S}) through the class of eta, with [eta] in p^t H^r for every t, and no additive Q_p -> H^r extending it

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.stacks07LM
declarations.doc:
Let `F` be a crystal in quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)`.  The truncation map
of complexes

`(F → F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω¹_{X/S} → F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω²_{X/S} → ⋯) ⟶ F[0]`

becomes a quasi-isomorphism after applying `Ru_{X/S, *}` — it is carried to an isomorphism of
`D⁺(Ab(X_{Zar}))` — and in fact `Ru_{X/S, *}(F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0` for every `i > 0`.

The complex is `(crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).complex`: its terms are the sheaves
`F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}` and its differentials `crystalDeRhamDifferential hF i` are the
extensions `m ⊗ ω ↦ ∇(m) ∧ ω + m ⊗ d ω` of the canonical connection `∇(m) = p₁^* m - p₀^* m` of
[Stacks, Tag 07J6].
declarations.statement:
theorem stacks07LM (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf S)) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    IsIso ((derivedZariskiDirectImageFunctor S).map
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map
          ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient _).map
            (sheafPlusTruncation S (crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).complex
              (CrystalDeRhamSheafData.singleComplex (F := F))
              (crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).truncation)))) ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((derivedZariskiDirectImage S).obj (tensorDifferentialFormsSheaf F i))
declarations.comment: the whole proposition: for F a crystal in quasi-coherent O_{X/S}-modules on Cris(X/S), Ru_{X/S,*} carries the truncation map (F → F ⊗ Ω¹ → F ⊗ Ω² → ⋯) ⟶ F[0] to an isomorphism of D⁺(Ab(X_Zar)), the differentials of the complex being the extensions of the canonical connection of F of 07J6; and Ru_{X/S,*}(F ⊗_{O_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0 for every i > 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crysFormsSheaf_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 60.23.2, Tag 07LN, for the sheaves `Ω^j_{X/S}`.**  For every `j`,
the sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules `Ω^j_{X/S}` on `Cris(X/S)` — `crysFormsSheaf S j`, the sheaf
associated with the presheaf `Ω^j_{X/S} = ⋀^j Ω_{X/S}` (`toCrysFormsSheaf` is locally bijective,
`isLocallyInjective_toCrysFormsSheaf` and `isLocallySurjective_toCrysFormsSheaf`) — satisfies
conditions (1) and (2) of [Stacks, Tag 07JN], and therefore, for every `i > 0`,

`Ru_{X/S, *}(Ω^j_{X/S} ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0`.

Condition (1) is `isLocallyQuasiCoherent_crysFormsSheaf`: the restriction of `Ω^j_{X/S}` to the
ambient scheme `T` of an object is the sheaf associated with the restriction of the presheaf,
that is `Ω^j_{T/S, δ}` ([Stacks, Tag 07IZ]), which is quasi-coherent ([Stacks, Tag 07IY]).
Condition (2) is `isSurjectiveComparison_crysFormsSheaf`: the comparison maps of the presheaf
`Ω^j_{X/S}` are locally surjective ([Stacks, Tag 07KM]), and so are those of its sheaf.  The
vanishing is then `isZero_derivedZariskiDirectImage_of_vanishingHypotheses`.
declarations.statement:
theorem crysFormsSheaf_vanishing (j : ℕ) :
    IsLocallyQuasiCoherent (crysFormsSheaf S j) ∧
      CohomologyRestriction.IsSurjectiveComparison (crysFormsSheaf S j).val ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((derivedZariskiDirectImage S).obj
          (tensorDifferentialFormsSheaf (crysFormsSheaf S j) i))
declarations.comment: the sheaves Ω^j_{X/S}, every j: Ω^j_{X/S} satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of 07JN, hence Ru_{X/S,*}(Ω^j_{X/S} ⊗ Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0 for every i > 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.underlineModules_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 60.23.2, Tag 07LN, for the sheaves `F̲`.**  Let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `F̲` the sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)` with
`F̲(U, T, δ) = F(U)`.  Then `F̲` satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of [Stacks, Tag 07JN] — it is
locally quasi-coherent, and its comparison morphisms `c_f` along the morphisms of `Cris(X/S)`
whose map on ambient schemes is a closed immersion are surjective — and therefore, for every
`i > 0`,

`Ru_{X/S, *}(F̲ ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0`.

Condition (1) is `isLocallyQuasiCoherent_underlineModules`: the restriction of `F̲` to the ambient
scheme `T` of `(U, T, δ)` is the direct image of `F|_U` along the closed immersion `U ↪ T`.
Condition (2) is `isSurjectiveComparison_underlineModules`.  The vanishing is then
`isZero_derivedZariskiDirectImage_of_vanishingHypotheses`.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlineModules_vanishing (F : S.X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    IsLocallyQuasiCoherent (underlineModules S F) ∧
      CohomologyRestriction.IsSurjectiveComparison (underlineModules S F).val ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((derivedZariskiDirectImage S).obj
          (tensorDifferentialFormsSheaf (underlineModules S F) i))
declarations.comment: the sheaves F-underline: for F a quasi-coherent O_X-module, F-underline satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of 07JN, hence Ru_{X/S,*}(F-underline ⊗ Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0 for every i > 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.underlineStructure_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 60.23.2, Tag 07LN, for `𝒪_X̲ = G_a̲`.**  The sheaf `𝒪_X̲` of
`𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)`, whose sections over `(U, T, δ)` are `Γ(U, 𝒪_U)` — the sheaf
`G_a̲`, `underlineModules_unit_presheaf` — satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of
[Stacks, Tag 07JN], and for every `i > 0`

`Ru_{X/S, *}(𝒪_X̲ ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0`.

This is `underlineModules_vanishing` at the quasi-coherent module `𝒪_X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem underlineStructure_vanishing :
    IsLocallyQuasiCoherent (underlineModules S (SheafOfModules.unit S.X.ringCatSheaf)) ∧
      CohomologyRestriction.IsSurjectiveComparison
        (underlineModules S (SheafOfModules.unit S.X.ringCatSheaf)).val ∧
      ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((derivedZariskiDirectImage S).obj
          (tensorDifferentialFormsSheaf (underlineModules S (SheafOfModules.unit S.X.ringCatSheaf))
            i))
declarations.comment: the sheaf O_X-underline = G_a-underline: it satisfies conditions (1) and (2) of 07JN, hence Ru_{X/S,*}(O_X-underline ⊗ Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0 for every i > 0

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.isZero_derivedZariskiDirectImage_of_vanishingHypotheses
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 60.23.2, Tag 07LN.**  For any sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules `F` on the
small crystalline site satisfying conditions (1) and (2) of [Stacks, Proposition 60.19.1,
Tag 07JN] — `F` is locally quasi-coherent, and for every morphism of `Cris(X/S)` whose map on
ambient schemes is a closed immersion the comparison morphism `c_f : f^*F_{T'} ⟶ F_T` is
surjective — and for every `i > 0`,

`Ru_{X/S, *}(F ⊗_{𝒪_{X/S}} Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0`.

This is the conclusion the remark observes holds at that generality rather than only for a
crystal, the proof of [Stacks, Proposition 60.23.1, Tag 07LM] using nothing else about `F`.  It is
the source's own argument: the local-to-global criterion [Stacks, Tag 072W] for `u_{X/S}` reduces
it to an affine open `V` of `X` mapping into an affine open `W` of `S`, over such an open the
right derived functors of `ℋ ↦ Γ(V, u_{X/S, *}ℋ)` are the cohomology of `Cris(V/S|_W)` by
[Stacks, Tag 07KL], the coefficient sheaf transports to the restricted situation together with
conditions (1) and (2), and [Stacks, Tag 07LF] kills that cohomology in every degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedZariskiDirectImage_of_vanishingHypotheses
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf S)) (hqc : IsLocallyQuasiCoherent F)
    (hsurj : CohomologyRestriction.IsSurjectiveComparison F.val) (i : ℕ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsZero ((derivedZariskiDirectImage S).obj (tensorDifferentialFormsSheaf F i))
declarations.comment: the remark's conclusion itself: Ru_{X/S,*}(F ⊗ Ω^i_{X/S}) = 0 for every i > 0 and EVERY sheaf of O_{X/S}-modules F satisfying conditions (1) local quasi-coherence and (2) local surjectivity of the comparison map c_f along a closed immersion, of 07JN -- which is the generality the remark gives the vanishing clause of 07LM, weaker than being a crystal. The proof is the source's: 072W for u_{X/S} reduces to an affine open of X over an affine open of S, 07KL identifies the sections functors there with the cohomology of Cris(V/S|_W), the coefficients transport along that restriction together with the two conditions, and 07LF kills the cohomology

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crystallineToAmbientDeRham
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Equation 07LP.**  In Situation 07MF, let `F` be a crystal in quasi-coherent
modules on `Cris(X/S)` and let `(U, T, δ)` be an object of `Cris(X/S)`.  The canonical map

`RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) ⟶ RΓ(T, F_T ⊗_{𝒪_T} Ω^*_{T/S,δ})`

in `D⁺(Ab)`, constructed as in the source: `RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) = RΓ(Cris(X/S), F ⊗ Ω^*_{X/S})` by
[Stacks, Tag 07LM] (`CrystalDeRhamSheafData.derivedGlobalSectionsIsoDeRham`, the inverse of the
image of the truncation map, invertible after `Ru_{X/S, *}` and hence after `RΓ(Cris(X/S), -)`);
then the restriction of global cohomology classes to `T`
(`...CrystallineThickening.derivedGlobalSectionsToAmbient`); then the identification of the
restriction of `F ⊗ Ω^*_{X/S}` to `T` with `F_T ⊗_{𝒪_T} Ω^*_{T/S,δ}` by [Stacks, Tag 07IZ]
(`restrictCrystalDeRhamComplexIso`).  `truncation_comp_crystallineToAmbientDeRham` records that
it is this composite.  The target is `RΓ(T, -)` of `ambientDeRhamComplex hF A`, read as a bounded
below complex (`CrystalDeRhamSheafData.ambientComplexPlus`).
declarations.statement:
def crystallineToAmbientDeRham :
    (derivedGlobalSections S).obj (abelianSheaf F) ⟶
      (CrystallineThickening.derivedAmbientGlobalSectionsFunctor A).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient _).obj
          ((crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).ambientComplexPlus A)))
declarations.comment: the canonical map RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) ⟶ RΓ(T, F_T ⊗ Ω*_{T/S,δ}) for a crystal in quasi-coherent modules F and an object (U, T, δ), built from 07LM, restriction to T and 07IZ

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.truncation_comp_crystallineToAmbientDeRham
declarations.doc:
**The map of [Stacks, Equation 07LP] is the composite of the source.**  Precomposed with the
image under `RΓ(Cris(X/S), -)` of the truncation map `F ⊗ Ω^*_{X/S} ⟶ F[0]` of
[Stacks, Tag 07LM] — an isomorphism — it is the restriction to `T` of the global cohomology
classes of `F ⊗ Ω^*_{X/S}`, followed by `RΓ(T, -)` of the identification
`(F ⊗ Ω^*_{X/S})_T ≅ F_T ⊗_{𝒪_T} Ω^*_{T/S,δ}` of [Stacks, Tag 07IZ].
declarations.statement:
theorem truncation_comp_crystallineToAmbientDeRham :
    (derivedGlobalSectionsFunctor S).map
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map
          ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient _).map
            (sheafPlusTruncation S (crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).complex
              (CrystalDeRhamSheafData.singleComplex (F := F))
              (crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).truncation))) ≫
      (derivedGlobalSectionsFunctor S).map
          (CrystalDeRhamSheafData.singleFunctorIsoSingleComplex (F := F)).inv ≫
        crystallineToAmbientDeRham hF A =
      (CrystallineThickening.derivedGlobalSectionsToAmbient A).app _ ≫
        (CrystallineThickening.derivedAmbientGlobalSectionsFunctor A).map
          ((crystalDeRhamSheafData hF).derivedRestrictComplexIso A).hom
declarations.comment: the canonical map is the composite of the source: 07LM, restriction of global cohomology classes to T, and 07IZ

declarations.name: Stacks.MappingTelescope.isIso_colimHomComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LR**.
Let `R` be a ring and let `K ∈ D(R)` be such that for every sequence `(E_n)` of objects of `D(R)`
with a coproduct, the canonical map `⨁_n Hom_{D(R)}(K, E_n) → Hom_{D(R)}(K, ⨁_n E_n)` is an
isomorphism. Then for every system of complexes `(L_n, t_n)` over `ℕ` with termwise colimit `L`,
the canonical map `colim_n Hom_{D(R)}(K, L_n) → Hom_{D(R)}(K, L)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_colimHomComparison (K : DMod R) (hK : CommutesWithCountableCoproducts K)
    (L : System R) :
    IsIso (colimHomComparison L K)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.IsCompactObject
declarations.doc:
An object `K` of a preadditive category is *compact* if for every family `E : I → C` whose
direct sum exists, the map `⨁ i, (K ⟶ E i) → (K ⟶ ∐ E)` sending a finitely supported family
`(f i)` to `∑ i, f i ≫ Sigma.ι E i` is bijective; that is, a morphism from `K` into a direct sum
factors through a finite subsum in exactly one way.
declarations.statement: public class IsCompactObject (K : C) : Prop

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_iff_isCompactObject
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LT.** An object of the derived category of modules over a ring is perfect if and
only if it is compact. Perfectness is thus intrinsic to the triangulated category `D(R)` with its
coproducts, referring neither to a representing complex nor to the ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_iff_isCompactObject
    {R : Type u} [Ring R] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) :
    IsPerfect K ↔ IsCompactObject.{u} K

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_of_isPerfect_mod_isNilpotent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LU.** An object of `D(R)` whose derived reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal `I` is
perfect is itself perfect.

A bounded complex of finite projective `R ⧸ I`-modules representing the reduction lifts, by
[stacks 09AR], to a bounded above complex `P` of projective `R`-modules representing `K`. Each
term of `P` is finite because its reduction is, by Nakayama for a nilpotent ideal
(`finite_of_finite_quotient_of_isNilpotent`), and `P` vanishes below the lower bound of the given
complex because a module with vanishing reduction modulo a nilpotent ideal vanishes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPerfect_of_isPerfect_mod_isNilpotent
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R))
    (hK : IsPerfect
      ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, v} (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).functor.obj K))
    (hI : IsNilpotent I) :
    IsPerfect K

declarations.name: Module.exists_projective_quotient_smul_top_linearEquiv_of_isNilpotent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LV.** Let `R` be a ring, let `I ⊆ R` be a nilpotent two-sided ideal and let `Q` be
a projective `R ⧸ I`-module. Then there is a projective `R`-module `P` together with an
isomorphism `P/IP ≅ Q` of `R ⧸ I`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Module.exists_projective_quotient_smul_top_linearEquiv_of_isNilpotent
    {R : Type u} [Ring R] {I : Ideal R} [I.IsTwoSided] {Q : Type v} [AddCommGroup Q]
    [Module (R ⧸ I) Q] [Module.Projective (R ⧸ I) Q] (hI : IsNilpotent I) :
    ∃ (P : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup P) (_ : Module R P),
      Module.Projective R P ∧ Nonempty ((P ⧸ I • (⊤ : Submodule R P)) ≃ₗ[R ⧸ I] Q)

declarations.name: Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_quotientMap_isUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LX**.
For an ideal `I` of `A` and a unit `u` of `A ⧸ I`, there is an étale `A`-algebra `A'` such that
the induced map `A ⧸ I → A' ⧸ IA'` is bijective, together with a unit `u'` of `A'` whose class in
`A' ⧸ IA'` is the image of `u`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_quotientMap_isUnit {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (u : A ⧸ I) (hu : IsUnit u) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A') (u' : A'),
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧ IsUnit u' ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A A')) u' =
        Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map u

declarations.name: Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_quotientMap_isIdempotentElem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LY**.
For an ideal `I` of `A` and an idempotent `e` of `A ⧸ I`, there is an étale `A`-algebra `A'` such
that the induced map `A ⧸ I → A' ⧸ IA'` is bijective, together with an idempotent `e'` of `A'`
whose class in `A' ⧸ IA'` is the image of `e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.exists_etale_bijective_quotientMap_isIdempotentElem {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (e : A ⧸ I) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A') (e' : A'),
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧ IsIdempotentElem e' ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A A')) e' =
        Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map e

declarations.name: exists_etale_lift_of_finite_disjoint_open_cover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07LZ.** A finite disjoint open covering of `Spec(A ⧸ I)` lifts to a finite disjoint
open covering after an étale extension `A → A'` inducing an isomorphism modulo `I`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_lift_of_finite_disjoint_open_cover
