    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) {J : Type v} [Finite J]
    (U : J → Set (PrimeSpectrum (A ⧸ I)))
    (hU_open : ∀ j, IsOpen (U j))
    (hU_disjoint : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U i) (U j))
    (hU_cover : ⋃ j, U j = Set.univ) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (f : A →+* A')
      (U' : J → Set (PrimeSpectrum A')),
      f.Etale ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (Ideal.map f I) f Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      (∀ j, IsOpen (U' j)) ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (U' i) (U' j)) ∧
      (⋃ j, U' j = Set.univ) ∧
      ∀ j,
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map f I)) ⁻¹' U' j =
          PrimeSpectrum.comap
            (Ideal.quotientMap (Ideal.map f I) f Ideal.le_comap_map) ⁻¹' U j

declarations.name: exists_isUnit_quotient_mk_and_etale_away
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M0.** If `A → B` is étale at every prime containing `J`, there is an element
`g : B` whose image in `B ⧸ J` is a unit and such that `B` localized away from `g` is étale
over `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isUnit_quotient_mk_and_etale_away
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (J : Ideal B)
    (h : ∀ (q : Ideal B) [q.IsPrime], J ≤ q →
      ∃ f ∉ q, Algebra.Etale A (Localization.Away f)) :
    ∃ g : B, IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk J g) ∧
      Algebra.Etale A (Localization.Away g)

declarations.name: exists_etale_lift_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_isCoprime_factorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M1.** A coprime factorization modulo an ideal, with invertible leading coefficient
of the first factor, lifts to a factorization over an étale algebra which induces an isomorphism
modulo the extended ideal.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_lift_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_isCoprime_factorization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (f : Polynomial A)
    (gbar hbar : Polynomial (A ⧸ I)) (hf : f.Monic)
    (hgbar : IsUnit gbar.leadingCoeff)
    (hfac : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = gbar * hbar)
    (hcoprime : IsCoprime gbar hbar) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A') (g' h' : Polynomial A'),
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A')
          Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      f.map (algebraMap A A') = g' * h' ∧
      gbar.map
          (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A')
            Ideal.le_comap_map) =
        g'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A A'))) ∧
      hbar.map
          (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A')
            Ideal.le_comap_map) =
        h'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A A')))

declarations.name: counterexample_to_etale_lift_without_isUnit_leadingCoeff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M2.** The monic polynomial `1` factors modulo `4` as `(2X² + 2X + 1)²`, with
coprime factors but non-invertible leading coefficient. Nevertheless there is no étale extension
of `ℤ`, unchanged modulo `4`, carrying a factorization together with the two canonical reduction
equalities asserted in Stacks 07M1. The two completion-theoretic facts giving the obstruction are
recorded as well.
declarations.statement:
theorem counterexample_to_etale_lift_without_isUnit_leadingCoeff :
    let I : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(4 : ℤ)}
    let p : Polynomial (ℤ ⧸ I) := 2 * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 2 * Polynomial.X + 1
    (1 : Polynomial ℤ).Monic ∧
    (1 : Polynomial ℤ).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = p * p ∧
    IsCoprime p p ∧
    ¬ IsUnit p.leadingCoeff ∧
    (∀ (A' : Type v) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra ℤ A'),
      Algebra.Etale ℤ A' →
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap
          (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A'))
          (algebraMap ℤ A') Ideal.le_comap_map) →
      Nonempty
        (AdicCompletion (Ideal.span {(algebraMap ℤ A' 2)}) A' ≃+* ℤ_[2])) ∧
    (∀ g' : Polynomial ℤ_[2],
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        g'.coeff n -
            (2 * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + 2 * Polynomial.X + 1 : Polynomial ℤ_[2]).coeff n ∈
          Ideal.span {(4 : ℤ_[2])}) →
      ¬ IsUnit g') ∧
    ¬ ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra ℤ A')
        (g' h' : Polynomial A'),
      Algebra.Etale ℤ A' ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A')) (algebraMap ℤ A')
          Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      (1 : Polynomial ℤ).map (algebraMap ℤ A') = g' * h' ∧
      p.map
          (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A')) (algebraMap ℤ A')
            Ideal.le_comap_map) =
        g'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A'))) ∧
      p.map
          (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A')) (algebraMap ℤ A')
            Ideal.le_comap_map) =
        h'.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap ℤ A')))

declarations.name: exists_quotient_eq_one_and_map_mem
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 07M3.** If the closure of the image of `V(J)` under `Spec(φ)` is
disjoint from `V(I)`, then there is `f ∈ R` mapping to `1` in `R/I` with `φ(f) ∈ J`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quotient_eq_one_and_map_mem {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal S)
    (h : closure ((PrimeSpectrum.comap φ) '' (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (J : Set S)))
        ∩ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (I : Set R) = ∅) :
    ∃ f : R, (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) f = 1 ∧ φ f ∈ J

declarations.name: exists_etale_baseChange_idempotent_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M4.** An idempotent of `B ⧸ IB`, for an integral `A`-algebra `B`, lifts to
`B ⊗[A] A'` after an étale base change `A → A'` which induces an isomorphism modulo `I`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_baseChange_idempotent_lift
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral A B]
    (I : Ideal A) (e : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)) (he : IsIdempotentElem e) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A'),
      let T := TensorProduct A B A'
      let ι : B →+* T :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom (R := A) (A := B) (B := A')
      let J : Ideal T := (I.map (algebraMap A B)).map ι
      let q : (B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)) →+* T ⧸ J :=
        Ideal.quotientMap J ι Ideal.le_comap_map
      ∃ e' : T,
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧
      Function.Bijective
        (Ideal.quotientMap (I.map (algebraMap A A')) (algebraMap A A')
          Ideal.le_comap_map) ∧
      IsIdempotentElem e' ∧
      q e = Ideal.Quotient.mk J e'

declarations.name: exists_etale_baseChange_finite_projective_lift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M5.** A finite projective module over `A ⧸ I` lifts after an étale base change
`A → A'` which induces an isomorphism `A ⧸ I ≃+* A' ⧸ I A'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_baseChange_finite_projective_lift
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (Pbar : Type v) [AddCommGroup Pbar] [Module (A ⧸ I) Pbar]
    [Module.Finite (A ⧸ I) Pbar] [Module.Projective (A ⧸ I) Pbar] :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A'),
      let J := I.map (algebraMap A A')
      let q : (A ⧸ I) →+* (A' ⧸ J) :=
        Ideal.quotientMap J (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧
      ∃ hq : Function.Bijective q,
      ∃ (P' : Type (max u v)) (_ : AddCommGroup P') (_ : Module A' P')
        (_ : Module.Finite A' P') (_ : Module.Projective A' P'),
        Nonempty
          (Pbar ≃ₛₗ[RingHomClass.toRingHom (RingEquiv.ofBijective q hq)]
            TensorProduct A' (A' ⧸ J) P')

declarations.name: symmetricAlgebra_smooth_iff_finite_projective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M6.** The symmetric algebra of an `A`-module `M` is smooth over `A` if and only if
`M` is finite projective.
declarations.statement:
theorem symmetricAlgebra_smooth_iff_finite_projective
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] :
    Algebra.Smooth A (SymmetricAlgebra A M) ↔
      Module.Finite A M ∧ Module.Projective A M

declarations.name: exists_etale_lift_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07M7.** A map from a smooth `A`-algebra `B` to `A ⧸ I` lifts to an étale
`A`-algebra which induces an isomorphism modulo the extension of `I`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_lift_of_smooth
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    (I : Ideal A) (f : B →ₐ[A] (A ⧸ I)) [Algebra.Smooth A B] :
    ∃ (A' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : Algebra A A'),
      let J := I.map (algebraMap A A')
      let q : (A ⧸ I) →+* (A' ⧸ J) :=
        Ideal.quotientMap J (algebraMap A A') Ideal.le_comap_map
      Algebra.Etale A A' ∧
      Function.Bijective q ∧
      ∃ f' : B →ₐ[A] A',
        q.comp f.toRingHom = (Ideal.Quotient.mk J).comp f'.toRingHom

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.exists_smooth_lift_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
A smooth algebra over a quotient of the base is the special fibre of a smooth algebra over the
base: if `R → R₀` is surjective with kernel `I` and `R₀ → A₀` is smooth, there is a smooth
`R`-algebra `A` together with a ring equivalence `A₀ ≃ A/IA` compatible with the maps from `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_lift_of_surjective
    (R : Type u) (R₀ : Type v) (A₀ : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A₀]
    [Algebra R R₀] [Algebra R₀ A₀]
    (hR : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R R₀))
    (hA₀ : Algebra.Smooth R₀ A₀) :
    ∃ (A : Type (max u w)) (_ : CommRing A) (a : Algebra R A),
      letI := a
      Algebra.Smooth R A ∧
        ∃ e : A₀ ≃+* A ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R A)
          (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R R₀)),
          ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap R₀ A₀ (algebraMap R R₀ r)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R A r)
declarations.comment: smooth lift

declarations.name: Stacks.Smoothing.exists_syntomic_lift_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
A syntomic algebra over a quotient of the base is the special fibre of a syntomic algebra over
the base: if `R → R₀` is surjective with kernel `I` and `R₀ → A₀` is syntomic, there is a syntomic
`R`-algebra `A` together with a ring equivalence `A₀ ≃ A/IA` compatible with the maps from `R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_syntomic_lift_of_surjective
    (R : Type u) (R₀ : Type v) (A₀ : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing R₀] [CommRing A₀]
    [Algebra R R₀] [Algebra R₀ A₀]
    (hR : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R R₀))
    (hA₀ : Algebra.Syntomic R₀ A₀) :
    ∃ (A : Type (max u w)) (_ : CommRing A) (a : Algebra R A),
      letI := a
      Algebra.Syntomic R A ∧
        ∃ e : A₀ ≃+* A ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R A)
          (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R R₀)),
          ∀ r : R, e (algebraMap R₀ A₀ (algebraMap R R₀ r)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap R A r)
declarations.comment: syntomic lift

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.Linear.sectionsToTotalCech
declarations.doc:
Restriction of a section over `U` into Čech degree zero, followed by the inclusion of that
summand of the total complex: the map `Γ(U, K^•) ⟶ Tot(Č^•(Ui, K^•))` of complexes of
`O_X(U)`-modules, natural in `K^•`.
declarations.statement:
def sectionsToTotalCech :
    sectionsComplexFunctor X O U ⟶ totalCechComplexFunctor X O U Ui hU
declarations.comment: the augmentation, with module coefficients

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.globalSectionsToCech
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07M9.** Restriction into Čech degree zero, followed by
inclusion into the total complex.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def globalSectionsToCech :
    globalSectionsComplexFunctor X ⟶ cechTotalComplexFunctor U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.LinearCupProduct.cechCupProduct
declarations.doc:
**The Čech cup product** at coefficients in presheaves of modules over a base ring `R`: the
signed Alexander--Whitney map

`Tot(Tot(Č(W,K)) ⊗_R Tot(Č(W,L))) ⟶ Tot(Č(W,M))`

attached to a pairing `D` of the coefficient complexes.  On the summand on which the first
factor has total degree `n`, the target has Čech degree `p`, and the front face has Čech
degree `r`, its coefficient is `cupProductSign n p r = (-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`.

The source tensors over `R`; the pairing `D` is where the coefficients are tensored, and it is
not required to be a tensor product over `R`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cechCupProduct (D : ComplexPairing R K L M) :
    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj K)
        ((totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj L) (tensorModules R) (up ℤ) ⟶
      (totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj M
declarations.comment: at module coefficients over a base ring, relative to a coefficient pairing

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.LinearCupProduct.cechCupProduct_ι
declarations.doc:
**On homogeneous summands the cup product is the front/back restriction formula** with the
sign `(-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`, the restrictions being paired by `D`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cechCupProduct_ι (D : ComplexPairing R K L M) (r s : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) :
    tensorModulesMap R (ιTotalCech W R K r a) (ιTotalCech W R L s b) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj K)
          ((totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj L) (tensorModules R) (up ℤ)
          ((r : ℤ) + a) ((s : ℤ) + b) (((r : ℤ) + a) + ((s : ℤ) + b)) rfl ≫
        (cechCupProduct W R D).f (((r : ℤ) + a) + ((s : ℤ) + b)) =
      cupProductSign ((r : ℤ) + a) ((r : ℤ) + (s : ℤ)) (r : ℤ) •
        (cechAlexanderWhitney W R (D.μ a b (a + b) rfl) r s ≫
          ιTotalCech W R M (r + s) (a + b) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (((totalCechComplexFunctor W R).obj M).X) (by push_cast; ring)))
declarations.comment: the signed Alexander--Whitney formula at module coefficients over a base ring

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.ModuleCupProduct.cechCupProductA
declarations.doc:
**The Čech cup product at `𝒪_X`-module coefficients.** The signed Alexander--Whitney
cup-product map

`Tot(Tot(Č(U,K)) ⊗_A Tot(Č(U,L))) ⟶ Tot(Č(U,M))`

for `A = 𝒪_X(V)`, attached to a pairing `D` of the coefficient sections presheaves into those
of `M`. On a homogeneous summand it is the front/back restriction formula with the
Alexander--Whitney sign `cupProductSign n p r = (-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev cechCupProductA
    (D : ComplexPairing (CoeffRing O V) ((sectionsComplexFunctor O V).obj K)
      ((sectionsComplexFunctor O V).obj L) ((sectionsComplexFunctor O V).obj M))
declarations.comment: at 𝒪_X-module coefficients over the ring of sections

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.SheafTensorPairing.cechCupProductSheafTensor
declarations.doc:
**The Čech cup product at sheaf-tensor coefficients**: the signed Alexander--Whitney
cup-product map

`Tot(Tot(Č(𝒰,𝒦)) ⊗_A Tot(Č(𝒰,ℳ))) ⟶ Tot(Č(𝒰, Tot(𝒦 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℳ)))`

for a covering `𝒰` of `V` and `A = 𝒪_X(V)`.  This is the left-hand column of the diagram of
Stacks Tag 0FKV: the source tensors the two total Čech complexes over the *ring* `A` of
sections on `V`, while in the target the coefficients are tensored over the *structure sheaf*,
the coefficient pairing being `sheafTensorComplexPairing`.

Its value on a homogeneous summand is the front/back restriction formula with the
Alexander--Whitney sign `cupProductSign n p r = (-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`: see
`Stacks.Cech.LinearCupProduct.cechCupProduct_ι`, which applies by
`Stacks.Cech.ModuleCupProduct.cechCupProductA_eq`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cechCupProductSheafTensor :
    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((totalCechComplexFunctorA O V U hU).obj K)
        ((totalCechComplexFunctorA O V U hU).obj L) (tensorModules (CoeffRing O V)) (up ℤ) ⟶
      (totalCechComplexFunctorA O V U hU).obj
        (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor K L (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ))
declarations.comment:
the sheaf-tensor instantiation: source over the section ring, coefficients over
the structure sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.CupProduct.cechCupProduct
declarations.doc:
The signed Alexander--Whitney cup-product map

`Tot(Tot(Č(U,F)) ⊗_ℤ Tot(Č(U,G))) ⟶ Tot(Č(U,Tot(F ⊗_ℤ G)))`.

On the summand on which `α` has total degree `n`, the target has Čech degree `p`, and
the front face of `α` has Čech degree `r`, its coefficient is
`cupProductSign n p r = (-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cechCupProduct
    (F : CochainComplex (ZPresheaf.{u, max u v w} X) ℤ)
    (G : CochainComplex (ZPresheaf.{u, max u v w'} X) ℤ) :
    HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor ((totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w} X U).obj F)
        ((totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w'} X U).obj G)
        (tensorModules.{max u v w, max u v w'} ℤ) (up ℤ) ⟶
      (totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w w'} X U).obj
        (tensorSheafComplex.{u, max v w, max v w'} X F G)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.CupProduct.cechCupProduct_ι
declarations.doc:
On homogeneous summands the cup product is the front/back restriction formula with
the sign `(-1)^((p+r)n+rp+r)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cechCupProduct_ι (F : CochainComplex (ZPresheaf.{u, max u v w} X) ℤ)
    (G : CochainComplex (ZPresheaf.{u, max u v w'} X) ℤ) (r s : ℕ) (a b : ℤ) :
    tensorModulesMap ℤ (ιTotalCech.{u, v, max u w} X U F r a)
      (ιTotalCech.{u, v, max u w'} X U G s b) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w} X U).obj F)
          ((totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w'} X U).obj G)
          (tensorModules.{max u v w, max u v w'} ℤ)
          (up ℤ) (r + a) (s + b) ((r + a) + (s + b)) rfl ≫
        (cechCupProduct.{u, v, w, w'} X U F G).f ((r + a) + (s + b)) =
      cupProductSign (r + a) (r + s) r •
        (cechAlexanderWhitney.{u, v, max u w, max u w'} X U (F.X a) (G.X b) r s ≫
          cechCochainsMap.{u, v, max u w w'} X U
            (ιTensorSheafComplex.{u, max v w, max v w'} X F G a b) (r + s) ≫
          ιTotalCech.{u, v, max u w w'} X U
            (tensorSheafComplex.{u, max v w, max v w'} X F G) (r + s) (a + b) ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg
            (((totalCechComplexFunctor.{u, v, max u w w'} X U).obj
              (tensorSheafComplex.{u, max v w, max v w'} X F G)).X)
            (by push_cast; ring)))
declarations.comment: the signed Alexander--Whitney formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Cech.Hypercohomology.cup_boundary
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07MC].**  Let `0 ⟶ F₁ ⟶ F₂ ⟶ F₃ ⟶ 0` (the short complex `S`) and
`0 ⟶ G₃ ⟶ G₂ ⟶ G₁ ⟶ 0` (the short complex `T`) be short exact sequences of bounded below
complexes of `𝒪_X`-modules, `H` a bounded below complex and `γᵢ : Tot(Fᵢ ⊗_{𝒪_X} Gᵢ) ⟶ H` maps of
complexes such that the squares

`γ₁ ∘ Tot(1 ⊗ (G₂ → G₁)) = γ₂ ∘ Tot((F₁ → F₂) ⊗ 1)` and
`γ₂ ∘ Tot(1 ⊗ (G₃ → G₂)) = γ₃ ∘ Tot((F₂ → F₃) ⊗ 1)`

commute.  If Čech cohomology agrees with cohomology for the sheaves `Fᵢᵖ` and `Gⱼ^q`, then for
`a₃ ∈ Hⁿ(X, F₃)` and `b₁ ∈ Hᵐ(X, G₁)`

`γ₁(∂a₃ ∪ b₁) = (-1)^{n+1} γ₃(a₃ ∪ ∂b₁)`  in `H^{n+m+1}(X, H)`.

The source states this for complexes of abelian sheaves and `⊗_𝐙`. That is the case where
`𝒪_X` is the constant sheaf of rings `𝐙_X`: sheaves of `𝐙_X`-modules are the abelian sheaves
(`Stacks.Cech.Hypercohomology.isEquivalence_toSheaf_integerRingSheaf`), and `⊗_{𝐙_X}` is `⊗_𝐙`,
since both are the sheafification of presheaves whose stalks are `Fₓ ⊗_𝐙 Gₓ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cup_boundary
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf O))))
    (hS : (toSC S).ShortExact)
    (T : ShortComplex (CochainComplex.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf O))))
    (hT : (toSC T).ShortExact) (H : CochainComplex.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf O)))
    (γ₁ : letI : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
        inferInstance
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor S.X₁.obj T.X₃.obj (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ⟶ H.obj)
    (γ₂ : letI : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
        inferInstance
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor S.X₂.obj T.X₂.obj (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ⟶ H.obj)
    (γ₃ : letI : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
        inferInstance
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor S.X₃.obj T.X₁.obj (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ⟶ H.obj)
    (h₁ : letI : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
        inferInstance
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 S.X₁.obj) T.g.hom (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ≫ γ₁ =
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap S.f.hom (𝟙 T.X₂.obj) (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ≫ γ₂)
    (h₂ : letI : (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
        inferInstance
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 S.X₂.obj) T.f.hom (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ≫ γ₂ =
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap S.g.hom (𝟙 T.X₁.obj) (sheafTensor O) (up ℤ) ≫ γ₃)
    (hF₁ : ∀ p, CechComputesSheaf O (S.X₁.obj.X p)) (hF₂ : ∀ p, CechComputesSheaf O (S.X₂.obj.X p))
    (hF₃ : ∀ p, CechComputesSheaf O (S.X₃.obj.X p)) (hG₁ : ∀ q, CechComputesSheaf O (T.X₃.obj.X q))
    (hG₂ : ∀ q, CechComputesSheaf O (T.X₂.obj.X q)) (hG₃ : ∀ q, CechComputesSheaf O (T.X₁.obj.X q))
    (n m : ℤ) (a₃ : hypercohomology O S.X₃ n) (b₁ : hypercohomology O T.X₃ m) :
    cup O (cechComputes_of_terms O _ hF₁) (cechComputes_of_terms O _ hG₁) (tensorPairing O γ₁)
        (n + 1) m (n + m + 1) (by omega) (boundary O S hS n (n + 1) rfl a₃) b₁ =
      ((n + 1).negOnePow : ℤ) •
        cup O (cechComputes_of_terms O _ hF₃) (cechComputes_of_terms O _ hG₃) (tensorPairing O γ₃)
          n (m + 1) (n + m + 1) (by omega) a₃ (boundary O T hT m (m + 1) rfl b₁)
declarations.comment:
for complexes of modules over an arbitrary sheaf of commutative rings `𝒪_X` and
`⊗_{𝒪_X}`; the source's abelian sheaves and `⊗_𝐙` are the case `𝒪_X = 𝐙_X`, whose modules are
the abelian sheaves (`Stacks.Cech.Hypercohomology.isEquivalence_toSheaf_integerRingSheaf`) and
whose tensor product is `⊗_𝐙`. `cup` is the cup product of Čech cocycles on a common covering
and `boundary` the connecting map of the long exact cohomology sequence

declarations.name: Crystalline.AffineCrystallineSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MD.** The standing affine crystalline situation over a divided
power ring `(A, I, γ)`: the ring `A` is a `ℤ_(p)`-algebra, `I` vanishes in `C`, and `p`
is nilpotent in `C`.
declarations.statement: public structure AffineCrystallineSituation

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerScheme.instHasPullbacksDividedPowerScheme
declarations.doc: Divided power schemes admit fibre products.
declarations.statement:
public instance instHasPullbacksDividedPowerScheme :
    HasPullbacks (DividedPowerScheme.{u})

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerScheme.underlyingPullbackComparison_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
The underlying scheme of the divided power fibre product is a closed subscheme
of the ordinary scheme-theoretic fibre product.
declarations.statement:
public theorem underlyingPullbackComparison_isClosedImmersion :
    IsClosedImmersion (underlyingPullbackComparison f f')
declarations.comment: closed immersion into the ordinary fibre product

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerScheme.closedFiberPullbackComparison_fst
declarations.doc:
The closed-fibre comparison followed by the first projection is the closed fibre of the
first projection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem closedFiberPullbackComparison_fst :
    closedFiberPullbackComparison f f' ≫
      pullback.fst (closedFiberMap f) (closedFiberMap f') =
        closedFiberMap (pullback.fst f f')
declarations.comment: closed-fibre comparison commutes with first projection

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerScheme.closedFiberPullbackComparison_snd
declarations.doc:
The closed-fibre comparison followed by the second projection is the closed fibre of the
second projection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem closedFiberPullbackComparison_snd :
    closedFiberPullbackComparison f f' ≫
      pullback.snd (closedFiberMap f) (closedFiberMap f') =
        closedFiberMap (pullback.snd f f')
declarations.comment: closed-fibre comparison commutes with second projection

declarations.name: Crystalline.DividedPowerScheme.closedFiberPullbackComparison_isIso
declarations.doc: The canonical comparison of closed fibres is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem closedFiberPullbackComparison_isIso :
    IsIso (closedFiberPullbackComparison f f')
declarations.comment: fibre product of closed fibres

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing global crystalline situation: a prime `p`, a divided power scheme `(S, I, γ)`
over `ℤ_(p)`, and a scheme `X` over the closed fibre `S₀ = V(I)` on which `p` is locally
nilpotent.
declarations.statement: structure GlobalCrystallineSituation

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.changeBaseRingedMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MG.**  The morphism of crystalline topoi
`f_CRIS : (X/S)_CRIS ⟶ (Y/S')_CRIS` of [Stacks, Tag 07IC] as a morphism of ringed topoi -- the
top arrow of the square.  Its structure map is invertible, being the identification of the two
routes to the big Zariski topos of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def changeBaseRingedMorphism :
    RingedToposHom (crystallineZariskiRingedTopos S) (crystallineZariskiRingedTopos S')
declarations.comment: the top arrow of the square, as a morphism of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.changeBaseStructureSquareRinged
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MG.**  The square
```
(X/S)_CRIS ──f_CRIS──> (Y/S')_CRIS
    │                      │
    ▼                      ▼
Sh((Sch/S)_Zar) ──────> Sh((Sch/S')_Zar)
```
whose vertical arrows are the structure morphisms is a commutative diagram of *ringed* topoi: the
two composites `(X/S)_CRIS ⟶ Sh((Sch/S')_Zar)` are 2-isomorphic as morphisms of ringed topoi.
It is pasted out of the ringed square of
`Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.changeBaseZariskiSquareRinged` and the ringed big Zariski
triangles along `X ⟶ Y ⟶ S'` and `X ⟶ S ⟶ S'`, which have the same composite.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def changeBaseStructureSquareRinged :
    RingedToposHom.TwoIso.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (RingedToposHom.comp (X := crystallineZariskiRingedTopos S)
        (Y := zariskiOverRingedTopos S.S.scheme) (Z := zariskiOverRingedTopos S'.S.scheme)
        (zariskiOverRingedMorphism f.hom) (structureMorphismRinged S))
      (RingedToposHom.comp (X := crystallineZariskiRingedTopos S)
        (Y := crystallineZariskiRingedTopos S') (Z := zariskiOverRingedTopos S'.S.scheme)
        (structureMorphismRinged S') (changeBaseRingedMorphism S S' f g h))
declarations.comment: the square of structure morphisms is a commutative diagram of ringed topoi

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.changeBaseStructureSquare
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MG.**  The structure morphisms of the big crystalline sites are
compatible with change of divided power base: the composite
`(X/S)_CRIS ⟶ (Y/S')_CRIS ⟶ Sh((Sch/S')_Zar)` is isomorphic to
`(X/S)_CRIS ⟶ Sh((Sch/S)_Zar) ⟶ Sh((Sch/S')_Zar)`, the square of sites underlying it commuting on
the nose.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def changeBaseStructureSquare (S S' : GlobalCrystallineSituation.{u})
    (f : S.S ⟶ S'.S) (g : S.X ⟶ S'.X)
    (h : S.toClosedFiber ≫ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiberMap f = g ≫ S'.toClosedFiber) :
    ((zariskiOverMorphism f.hom).comp (structureMorphism S)).pushforward ≅
      ((structureMorphism S').comp (changeBaseMorphism S S' f g h)).pushforward
declarations.comment: the square of structure morphisms: its underlying square of topoi

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.structureSquareTwoIso
declarations.doc:
**The square of ringed topoi of [Stacks, Tag 07MS] commutes**: the two routes
`f_Zar ∘ τ_{X/S}` and `τ_{X'/S'} ∘ f_cris` from `((X/S)_cris, 𝒪_{X/S})` to `(S'_Zar, 𝒪_{S'})` are
2-isomorphic, by `structureSquarePushforwardIso` on direct images, which carries the structure map
of one to that of the other: both send a function on an open of `S'` to its pullbacks along the
objects of `Cris(X/S)`.

This is also the square of [Stacks, Tag 07MH]: in the situation of [Stacks, Tag 07IK] the top
arrow is `f_cris = π_{X'} ∘ f_CRIS ∘ i_X` (`crisRingedHomComp`, whose underlying morphism of topoi
is `crisMorphism` on the nose) and the vertical arrows are the structure morphisms `τ_{X/S}` and
`τ_{X'/S'}` of [Stacks, Tag 07IM].  The remark displays the big Zariski topoi
`Sh((Sch/S)_Zar)`, `Sh((Sch/S')_Zar)` as the bottom corners; that is a typo, copied from the big
crystalline remark [Stacks, Tag 07MG], for the small Zariski topoi `Sh(S_Zar)`, `Sh(S'_Zar)` in
which the structure morphisms of the small crystalline site land, and it is recorded in
`errata.md`.
declarations.comment:
the square of ringed topoi of the remark, τ_{Y/S'} ∘ f_cris ≅ f_Zar ∘ τ_{X/S} from
  ((X/S)_cris, 𝒪_{X/S}) to (S'_Zar, 𝒪_{S'}), with f_cris = π_Y ∘ f_CRIS ∘ i_X of Tag 07IK on top
  and the structure morphisms τ of Tag 07IM as vertical arrows, for every morphism of divided
  power bases f and every g : X ⟶ Y over the closed fibres; the remark's printed bottom corners
  Sh((Sch/S)_Zar) are a typo for the small Zariski topoi Sh(S_Zar) in which τ lands (errata.md)

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.computes07MK
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ, the displayed equation (07MK).**  For every object
`(U', T', δ')` of `Cris(X'/S')`, with `U = X ×_{X'} U'` and `T = S ×_{S'} T'`,

`(Rf_{cris, *}F)_{T'} ≅ R(T ⟶ T')_*(Rτ_{U/T, *}F_U)`

in `D⁺(Ab(T'_Zar))`, naturally in the abelian sheaf `F` on `Cris(X/S)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem computes07MK
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Sheaf (smallTopology S) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 2} (Sheaf (smallTopology S') AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})] :
    Computes07MK S S' fS fX hf
declarations.comment:
the displayed equation (07MK): (Rf_{cris,*}F)_{T'} ≅ R(T ⟶ T')_*(Rτ_{U/T,*}F_U)
  in D⁺(Ab(T'_Zar)) for every object (U', T', δ') of Cris(X'/S'), naturally in F; stated for
  every abelian sheaf F on Cris(X/S), so in particular for the abelian sheaf underlying an
  O_{X/S}-module

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.pullbackToClosedFiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  The induced morphism `U ⟶ T₀` of the remark: the closed fibre
of `T = S ×_{S'} T'` is `S₀ ×_{S'₀} T'₀` by [Stacks, Tag 07ME], and `U = X ×_{X'} U'` maps to `S₀`
through `X` and to `T'₀ = U'` through `U'`.
declarations.statement: def pullbackToClosedFiber : pullbackSource S S' fX A' ⟶ closedFiber (pullbackBase S S' fS A')
declarations.comment: the induced morphism U ⟶ T₀, for T = S ×_{S'} T' and U = X ×_{X'} U'

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.pullbackSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  The crystalline situation `U/T` of the remark attached to an
object `(U', T', δ')` of `Cris(X'/S')`: the divided power base is the fibre product
`T = S ×_{S'} T'` of [Stacks, Tag 07ME], the scheme is `U = X ×_{X'} U'`, and the structure
morphism to `T₀` is `pullbackToClosedFiber`.  The prime `p` is locally nilpotent on `U` because it
is on `X` and `U ⟶ X` induces maps on local rings.
declarations.statement: def pullbackSituation : GlobalCrystallineSituation.{u}
declarations.comment: the crystalline situation U/T attached to an object (U', T', δ') of Cris(X'/S')

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.isOpenImmersion_pullbackSituationToX
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  `U = X ×_{X'} U'` is an open subscheme of `X`, the morphism
`U' ⟶ X'` of an object of the small crystalline site being an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_pullbackSituationToX :
    IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst fX A'.obj.toX)
declarations.comment: U = X ×_{X'} U' is an open subscheme of X

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.range_pullbackSituationToX
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  The open subscheme `U = X ×_{X'} U'` of `X` is `f⁻¹(U')`: its
image in `X` is the preimage under `f` of the image of `U'` in `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_pullbackSituationToX :
    Set.range (pullback.fst fX A'.obj.toX) = fX ⁻¹' Set.range A'.obj.toX
declarations.comment: U = X ×_{X'} U' is f⁻¹(U')

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.pullbackCrisMorphism
declarations.doc:
The morphism of small crystalline topoi `(U/T)_cris ⟶ (X/S)_cris` induced by `U ⟶ X` over
`T ⟶ S`, [Stacks, Tag 07IK]. It is unconditional, left exactness of `i_!` for `X/S` being
`Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening.preservesFiniteLimits_lowerShriek`.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackCrisMorphism :
    MorphismOfTopoi (smallTopos (pullbackSituation S S' fS fX hf A')) (smallTopos S)
declarations.comment: the morphism (U/T)_cris ⟶ (X/S)_cris

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.pullbackStructureToposMorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  The structure morphism `τ_{U/T} : (U/T)_cris ⟶ Sh(T_Zar)` of
the remark.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackStructureToposMorphism :
    MorphismOfTopoi (smallTopos (pullbackSituation S S' fS fX hf A'))
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (pullbackBase S S' fS A').scheme.carrier)
        (Type (u + 1)))
declarations.comment: the structure morphism τ_{U/T} : (U/T)_cris ⟶ Sh(T_Zar)

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.pullbackSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MJ.**  The pullback `F_U` to `Cris(U/T)` of a sheaf `F` on
`Cris(X/S)`.
declarations.statement: def pullbackSheaf (F : smallTopos S) : smallTopos (pullbackSituation S S' fS fX hf A')
declarations.comment:
the pullback F_U of a sheaf on Cris(X/S) to Cris(U/T); the displayed equation
  (07MK) is Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.computes07MK

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.exists_distinguished_triangle_derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07ML (Mayer--Vietoris for `Rf_{cris, *}`).**  In the situation of
[Stacks, Tag 07MJ] — a morphism `f : X ⟶ X'` over a morphism of divided power schemes
`(S, I, γ) ⟶ (S', I', γ')` over `ℤ_(p)`, `p` locally nilpotent on `X` and `X'` — let
`X = X₁ ∪ X₂` be an open covering (`V₁ ⊔ V₂ = ⊤`) with `X₁₂ = X₁ ∩ X₂`, and let `F` be an
`𝒪_{X/S}`-module on `Cris(X/S)`.  Writing `f₁`, `f₂`, `f₁₂` for the restrictions of `f` to `X₁`,
`X₂`, `X₁₂` (morphisms of situations `X₁/S ⟶ X'/S'` etc. over the same `S ⟶ S'`) and `F₁`,
`F₂`, `F₁₂` for the restrictions of `F` to the crystalline sites `Cris(X₁/S)`, `Cris(X₂/S)`,
`Cris(X₁₂/S)`, there is a distinguished triangle

`Rf_{cris, *}F ⟶ Rf₁_{cris, *}F₁ ⊕ Rf₂_{cris, *}F₂ ⟶ Rf₁₂_{cris, *}F₁₂ ⟶ Rf_{cris, *}F[1]`

in `D(𝒪_{X'/S'})`, the derived category of sheaves of `𝒪_{X'/S'}`-modules on `Cris(X'/S')`.
(The source names the opens `X'`, `X''`, `X'''`, the target of `f` also being `X'`.)

Here `Rf_{cris, *}` is `derivedCrisModuleDirectImage`, the right derived functor of the
module-valued direct image `...SmallSite.crisModuleDirectImage` on `D⁺`, applied to `F` in degree
zero and read in `D(𝒪_{X'/S'})` through `DerivedCategory.Plus.ι`; `X₁/S` is
`Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.openSubspace S V₁`, `f₁` is `V₁.ι ≫ fX` over `fS`, and
`F₁` is `...SmallSite.openSubspaceModuleRestriction S V₁` of `F`.  The statement holds for every
choice of the derived category models.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distinguished_triangle_derivedCrisModuleDirectImage (hV : V₁ ⊔ V₂ = ⊤)
    (F : ModuleSheaf S) :
    ∃ (a : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage hf).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) ⟶
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf V₁)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S V₁).obj F))) ⊞
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf V₂)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S V₂).obj F))))
      (b : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf V₁)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S V₁).obj F))) ⊞
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf V₂)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S V₂).obj F))) ⟶
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf (V₁ ⊓ V₂))).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S (V₁ ⊓ V₂)).obj F))))
      (c : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage
          (openSubspaceRestrictCondition hf (V₁ ⊓ V₂))).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
              ((openSubspaceModuleRestriction S (V₁ ⊓ V₂)).obj F))) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedCrisModuleDirectImage hf).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleSheaf S'))
declarations.comment: the distinguished triangle Rf_{cris,*}F → Rf'_{cris,*}F' ⊕ Rf''_{cris,*}F'' → Rf'''_{cris,*}F''' → Rf_{cris,*}F[1] in D(O_{X'/S'}), for an open covering X = X' ∪ X'' in the situation of 07MJ, with Rf_{cris,*} the right derived functor of the module-valued direct image and F', F'', F''' the restrictions of the O_{X/S}-module F to Cris(X'/S), Cris(X''/S), Cris(X'''/S)

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crisGlobalBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**The base change map (07MT) on global sections**

`RΓ(Cris(X'/S'), F') ⊗^L_{A'} A ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S), F)`   in `D(A)`,

`A = Γ(S, 𝒪_S)`, `A' = Γ(S', 𝒪_{S'})`, for an `𝒪_{X'/S'}`-module `F'`, its pullback
`F = f_cris^*F'` (`crisModuleInverseImage`) and an arbitrary morphism `g : X ⟶ X'` over a
morphism of divided power bases `f`. It is `RΓ(S, -)` of the sheaf-level base change map
`crisSheafBaseChangeMap`, preceded by the canonical map
`RΓ(S', K) ⊗^L_{A'} A ⟶ RΓ(S, L(S ⟶ S')^*K)` at `K = Rτ_{X'/S', *}F'` and read through
`RΓ(S, Rτ_*-) = RΓ(Cris, -)` at both ends.
declarations.statement:
def crisGlobalBaseChangeMap (F' : ModuleSheaf S') :
    (derivedBaseChangeTensor f).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj ((derivedModuleGlobalSections S').obj F')) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
        ((derivedModuleGlobalSections S).obj ((crisModuleInverseImage f g h).obj F'))
declarations.comment:
the base change map RΓ(Cris(X'/S'), F') ⊗^L_{A'} A ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) of (07MT)
in D(A), the sheaf-level base change map read on global sections, for an arbitrary g : X ⟶ X'

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crisSheafBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MS: the canonical base change map**

`L(S ⟶ S')^* Rτ_{X'/S', *}F' ⟶ Rτ_{X/S, *}F`   in `D(𝒪_S)`,

for an `𝒪_{X'/S'}`-module `F'`, its pullback `F = f_cris^*F'` (`crisModuleInverseImage`), and an
arbitrary morphism `g : X ⟶ X'` over a morphism of divided power bases `f` — the situation of
[Stacks, Tag 07MJ].  As the source's hint prescribes, it is the base change map of
[Stacks, Tag 07A7] for the square `structureSquareTwoIso`, followed by `Rτ_{X/S, *}` of the
canonical map `Lf_cris^*F' ⟶ f_cris^*F' = F`.
declarations.statement:
def crisSheafBaseChangeMap (F' : ModuleSheaf S') :
    (derivedPullback (X := zariskiRingedTopos S.S.scheme) (Y := zariskiRingedTopos S'.S.scheme)
        (zariskiRingedHom f.hom)).obj (tauDerivedDirectImage S' F') ⟶
      tauDerivedDirectImage S ((crisModuleInverseImage f g h).obj F')
declarations.comment:
the canonical base change map L(S ⟶ S')^* Rτ_{X'/S',*} F' ⟶ Rτ_{X/S,*} F in D(O_S),
F = f_cris^* F', for an arbitrary morphism g : X ⟶ X', built as the hint prescribes

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.crisModuleInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**`f_cris^{-1}` on sheaves of modules, in the generality of [Stacks, Tag 07MJ]**: no
hypothesis whatever on `g : X ⟶ X'`, in particular not that it is an open immersion, so this
covers the hypothesis `X = X' ×_{S'₀} S₀` of [Stacks, Tag 07MU](4).

It is the composite of the two legs of [Stacks, Tag 07IK]'s
`f_cris = π_{X'} ∘ f_CRIS ∘ i_X`: the module-level `i_{X', !}` of [Stacks, Tag 07IJ] carries a
sheaf of `𝒪_{X'/S'}`-modules on `Cris(X'/S')` to the big site `CRIS(X'/S')`, and
`...SmallSite.crisModulePullback` restricts it along `Cris(X/S) ⥤ CRIS(X/S) ⥤ CRIS(X'/S')`, a
functor of sites that exists for every `g`.

Where `...SmallSite.smallChangeBaseModulePullback` applies — that is, for `g` an open immersion,
the generality of [Stacks, Tag 07KL] — the two agree, by
`crisModuleInverseImageIsoSmallChangeBase`.

This is the pullback `F = f_cris^*F'` of [Stacks, Tag 07MS]; the base change map of that tag,
`L(S ⟶ S')^*Rτ_{X'/S', *}F' ⟶ Rτ_{X/S, *}F`, is `...SmallSite.crisSheafBaseChangeMap`, and on
global sections `...SmallSite.crisGlobalBaseChangeMap`.
declarations.comment:
the pullback F = f_cris^* F' of an O_{X'/S'}-module F', for an arbitrary
morphism g : X ⟶ X'

declarations.name: Crystalline.exists_forall_isPAdicLevel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  For a divided power ring `(A, I, γ)` with `A` an algebra over
`ℤ_(p)` and `p` nilpotent in `A/I`, every sufficiently large exponent `e` has `(p^e) ⊆ I`
preserved by `γ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_forall_isPAdicLevel [Fact p.Prime]
    [Algebra (DividedPowers.IntegersAtPrime p) A]
    (hp : IsNilpotent (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (p : A))) :
    ∃ N, ∀ e, N ≤ e → IsPAdicLevel I γ p e
declarations.comment: for e ≫ 0 the ideal (p^e) ⊆ I is preserved by γ

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  The divided power ring `(A/p^eA, I/p^eA, γ̄)` at a finite
divided power level `e`, of which the base `S_e = Spec(A/p^eA)` of the remark is the spectrum.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pAdicLevelRing {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) : DividedPowerRing.{u}
declarations.comment: the divided power ring A/p^eA whose spectrum is the base S_e = Spec(A/p^eA)

declarations.name: Crystalline.preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  Restriction of abelian sheaves from `Cris(X/S)` to a finite
divided power level `Cris(X/S_e)` carries injective abelian sheaves to injective abelian sheaves.

This is the first half of the hint of the remark.  The functor of levels is change of divided
power base at the pair `(S_e ⟶ S, 𝟙 X)`, so this is
`...SmallSite.preservesInjectiveObjects_smallChangeBaseAbelianRestriction`:
the left adjoint of restriction is the abelian lower shriek, which is exact by
[Stacks, Tag 00X4] because `Cris(X/S_e)` has fibre products and equalizers and change of base
preserves them, hence preserves monomorphisms, and a right adjoint of a
monomorphism-preserving functor preserves injective objects, [Stacks, Tag 015Z].
declarations.statement:
instance preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction {e : ℕ}
    (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (pAdicLevelSheafRestriction I γ p he X toCF hX).PreservesInjectiveObjects
declarations.comment: restriction of abelian sheaves to a finite level carries injectives to injectives, the first half of the remark's hint

declarations.name: Crystalline.preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  Restriction of abelian sheaves between two finite divided
power levels `Cris(X/S_e) ⟶ Cris(X/S_m)`, for `m ≤ e`, carries injective abelian sheaves to
injective abelian sheaves.  This is the same argument as
`Crystalline.preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction` at the pair
`(S_m ⟶ S_e, 𝟙 X)`.
declarations.statement:
instance preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction {m e : ℕ}
    (hm : IsPAdicLevel I γ p m) (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (hme : m ≤ e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction I γ p hm he hme X toCF hX).PreservesInjectiveObjects
declarations.comment: restriction of abelian sheaves between two finite levels carries injectives to injectives

declarations.name: Crystalline.rightAcyclic_globalSections_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  Restriction to a finite divided power level carries an
injective abelian sheaf to one with **acyclic global sections**: this is
`Crystalline.preservesInjectiveObjects_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction` followed by
`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightAcyclic_of_injective`, an injective object being right acyclic for
every additive functor whose bounded below right derived functor exists.

This is verbatim the hypothesis `hg` of
`Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.derivedGlobalSectionsCompIso`, and so the
first half of the hint of the remark.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightAcyclic_globalSections_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction_of_injective {e : ℕ}
    (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w''} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}] :
    ∀ F : Sheaf (smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      Injective F → (globalSections (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX)).rightAcyclic
        ((pAdicLevelSheafRestriction I γ p he X toCF hX).obj F)
declarations.comment: restriction to a finite level carries an injective abelian sheaf to one with acyclic global sections, the acyclicity hypothesis of (015M); NOT the tower and NOT the remark's conclusion

declarations.name: Crystalline.rightAcyclic_globalSections_pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  The transition-functor form of
`Crystalline.rightAcyclic_globalSections_pAdicLevelSheafRestriction_of_injective`: restriction
from `Cris(X/S_e)` to `Cris(X/S_m)`, `m ≤ e`, carries an injective abelian sheaf to one with
acyclic global sections.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightAcyclic_globalSections_pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction_of_injective {m e : ℕ}
    (hm : IsPAdicLevel I γ p m) (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (hme : m ≤ e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p hm X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w''} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}] :
    ∀ F : Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1},
      Injective F → (globalSections (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p hm X toCF hX)).rightAcyclic
        ((pAdicLevelStepSheafRestriction I γ p hm he hme X toCF hX).obj F)
declarations.comment: restriction between two finite levels carries an injective abelian sheaf to one with acyclic global sections, the acyclicity hypothesis of (015M) for the tower's arrows

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelScheme
declarations.doc:
The divided power base `S_e = Spec(A/p^eA)` at a finite divided power level `e`: the spectrum
of the divided power ring `Crystalline.pAdicLevelRing`.
declarations.statement: def pAdicLevelScheme {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) : DividedPowerScheme.{u}
declarations.comment: S_e = Spec(A/p^eA) is a divided power base, for e a finite divided power level

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelClosedFiberIso
declarations.doc:
The closed fibre of `S_e = Spec(A/p^eA)` is the closed fibre `S_0 = Spec(A/I)` of `S`. Both
are the spectrum of a double quotient of `A`, and the two double quotients agree because
`(p^e) ⊆ I`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelClosedFiberIso {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) :
    closedFiber (pAdicLevelScheme I γ p he) ≅ closedFiber (specBase I γ)
declarations.comment: S_e has the same closed fibre S₀ = Spec(A/I) as S, since (p^e) ⊆ I

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelSituation
declarations.doc:
The global crystalline situation `X/S_e` at a finite divided power level `e`, on the *same*
scheme `X`: the structure morphism `X ⟶ S_0` of the situation `X/S` is read in the closed fibre
of `S_e` through the identification `Crystalline.pAdicLevelClosedFiberIso` of the two closed
fibres.
declarations.comment: X/S_e is a global crystalline situation on the same X, so Cris(X/S_e) is defined

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtend
declarations.doc:
The functor `Cris(X/S_e) ⥤ Cris(X/S)`: change of divided power base along the projection
`S_e ⟶ S` and the identity of `X`. An object of `Cris(X/S_e)` is a divided power thickening of `X`
relative to `S_e`, which composed with `S_e ⟶ S` is one relative to `S`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelExtend {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening
        (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX) ⥤
      GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)
declarations.comment: the functor Cris(X/S_e) ⥤ Cris(X/S)

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtendFullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
`Cris(X/S_e)` is a full subcategory of `Cris(X/S)`: change of divided power base along
`S_e ⟶ S` and `𝟙 X` is fully faithful, the projection `S_e ⟶ S` being a closed immersion and
hence a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelExtendFullyFaithful {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (pAdicLevelExtend I γ p he X toCF hX).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: Cris(X/S_e) is a full subcategory of Cris(X/S)

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
The restriction `F_e` of a presheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on `Cris(X/S)` to a presheaf of
`𝒪_{X/S_e}`-modules on `Cris(X/S_e)`. No comparison of structure presheaves is needed: the
restriction of `𝒪_{X/S}` along the functor is `𝒪_{X/S_e}` itself, by
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtend_op_comp_crisRing`.
declarations.comment: F_e, the restriction of an 𝒪_{X/S}-module F to Cris(X/S_e), as a presheaf of modules

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepExtend
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  The transition functor `Cris(X/S_m) ⥤ Cris(X/S_e)` of the tower
of finite divided power levels, for `m ≤ e`: change of divided power base along the closed
immersion `S_m ⟶ S_e` and the identity of `X`.  This is the arrow of the tower whose inverse
limit the remark takes; `Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtend` is its colimit end, the functor
to `Cris(X/S)` itself.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelStepExtend {m e : ℕ} (hm : IsPAdicLevel I γ p m) (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e)
    (hme : m ≤ e) (X : Scheme.{u}) (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening
        (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p hm X toCF hX) ⥤
      GlobalCrystallineSituation.CrystallineThickening
        (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX)
declarations.comment: the transition functor Cris(X/S_m) ⥤ Cris(X/S_e) of the tower of finite levels

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepExtendFullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  `Cris(X/S_m)` is a full subcategory of `Cris(X/S_e)` for
`m ≤ e`: the transition `S_m ⟶ S_e` is a closed immersion, hence a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelStepExtendFullyFaithful {m e : ℕ} (hm : IsPAdicLevel I γ p m)
    (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (hme : m ≤ e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (pAdicLevelStepExtend I γ p hm he hme X toCF hX).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: Cris(X/S_m) is a full subcategory of Cris(X/S_e) for m ≤ e

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelSmallModuleRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  `F_e`, the restriction of a sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules on the
small crystalline site `Cris(X/S)` to a sheaf of `𝒪_{X/S_e}`-modules on `Cris(X/S_e)`.

This is the `F_e` of the remark.  It is the restriction itself, not a sheafification of it: that
rests on the continuity of `Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtend`, and no comparison of structure sheaves
is needed because the restriction of `𝒪_{X/S}` along the functor *is* `𝒪_{X/S_e}`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelSmallModuleRestriction {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    SheafOfModules.{u} (GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.structureSheaf
        (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.structureSheaf
        (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX))
declarations.comment: F_e as a sheaf of 𝒪_{X/S_e}-modules on the small site Cris(X/S_e), by restriction

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  `RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e)`, the term at level `e` of the tower
whose derived inverse limit the remark takes: derived global sections on the small crystalline
site of `X/S_e` applied to the restriction `F_e` of an abelian sheaf `F` on `Cris(X/S)`.

This is an object of `D⁺(Ab)`, and it is the restriction `F_e` itself — not a sheafification of
it — that is being evaluated, by the continuity of `Crystalline.pAdicLevelExtend`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Sheaf (GlobalCrystallineSituation.smallTopology
      (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (F : Sheaf (GlobalCrystallineSituation.smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    DerivedCategory.Plus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
declarations.comment: the individual terms RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e) of the remark's R lim, for F an abelian sheaf; NOT the tower (its arrows are missing) and NOT the conclusion

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepDerivedGlobalSectionsMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  **The arrow
`RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e) ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S_m), F_m)` of the tower of finite divided power levels**, for
`m ≤ e`.

Four inputs from the library and no hypothesis.  The underived comparison
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepGlobalSectionsTrans` is derived by
`Stacks.DerivedIndexing.rightDerivedFunctorPlusNatTrans`; its target, the derived functor of the
composite `ρ ⋙ Γ(Cris(X/S_m), -)`, is split by
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepDerivedGlobalSectionsCompIso`, which is [Stacks, Tag 015M] and is
unconditional because restriction to a level preserves injectives;
`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleIso` replaces `Rρ(F_e[0])` by
`ρ(F_e)[0]`, restriction to a level being exact; and
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepSheafRestrictionCompIso` identifies `ρ(F_e)` with `F_m`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelStepDerivedGlobalSectionsMap {m e : ℕ} (hm : IsPAdicLevel I γ p m)
    (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (hme : m ≤ e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p hm X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w''} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (F : Sheaf (smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections I γ p he X toCF hX F ⟶
      pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections I γ p hm X toCF hX F
declarations.comment: the arrow RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e) ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S_m), F_m) of the remark's tower, for m ≤ e

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSectionsTower
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  **The tower `n ↦ RΓ(Cris(X/S_{N+n}), F_{N+n})` of the remark,
as a functor `ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D⁺(Ab)`.**

The terms are `Crystalline.pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections` and the arrows are
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepDerivedGlobalSectionsMap` at the successive pairs `N + n ≤ N + n + 1`.
`CategoryTheory.Functor.ofOpSequence` asks for no more than those successive steps, which is why
no coherence between three levels is needed.  The threshold `N` is the one of
`Crystalline.exists_forall_isPAdicLevel`: the remark's exponents are the levels, and `e ≫ 0` is
the hypothesis `hN`.

This is the tower whose derived limit the remark asserts is `RΓ(Cris(X/S), F)`.  **That
assertion is not proved**: nothing below compares the tower with `RΓ(Cris(X/S), F)`.
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSectionsTower {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ e, N ≤ e → IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w''} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (F : Sheaf (smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory.Plus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
declarations.comment: the tower e ↦ RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e) of the remark, as a functor ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ D⁺(Ab); NOT the remark's conclusion, that RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) is its derived limit

declarations.name: Crystalline.pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSectionsConeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MV.**  **The arrow `RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e)`** from
derived global sections on `Cris(X/S)` to the term of the remark's tower at the finite divided
power level `e`.

It is assembled exactly as `Crystalline.pAdicLevelStepDerivedGlobalSectionsMap` is, from four
proved inputs and no hypothesis.  The underived restriction
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelGlobalSectionsTrans` is derived by
`Stacks.DerivedIndexing.rightDerivedFunctorPlusNatTrans`; its target, the derived functor of the
composite `ρ_e ⋙ Γ(Cris(X/S_e), -)`, is split by
`Crystalline.pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSectionsCompIso`, which is [Stacks, Tag 015M] and is
unconditional because restriction to a level preserves injectives; and
`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleIso` replaces `Rρ_e(F[0])` by `F_e[0]`,
restriction to a level being exact.  Unlike the step map no further identification is needed:
the sheaf being restricted is `F` itself.

**This is the comparison whose being a derived limit presentation is the conclusion of the
remark; that it is one is not proved.**
declarations.statement:
def pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSectionsConeMap {e : ℕ} (he : IsPAdicLevel I γ p e) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (toCF : X ⟶ DividedPowerScheme.closedFiber (specBase I γ))
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsNilpotent (p : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (Sheaf (smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (Sheaf (smallTopology (pAdicLevelSituation I γ p he X toCF hX))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w''} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    (F : Sheaf (smallTopology (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (derivedGlobalSections (specSituation I γ p X toCF hX)).obj F ⟶
      pAdicLevelDerivedGlobalSections I γ p he X toCF hX F
declarations.comment: the arrow RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) ⟶ RΓ(Cris(X/S_e), F_e) comparing derived global sections with the remark's tower; NOT the remark's conclusion, that RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) is the derived limit

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.Situation07MW.moduleWithConnection
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07MW] part (2): the restriction `F_Y` of a crystal in quasi-coherent
`𝒪_{X/S}`-modules to the smooth lifting `(X, Y, γ)` carries a canonical integrable connection.**
The module is `F_Y`, the connection is `moduleConnection`, the twisted de Rham differential is
`twistedDeRhamDifferential` (the restriction to `Y` of the de Rham complex of
[Stacks, Tag 07LM]), and integrability is `twistedDeRhamDifferential_isComplex` in degree zero.
That the connection is the canonical one of [Stacks, Tag 07J6] is
`moduleWithConnection_connection_d_eq_canonical`.
declarations.statement: def moduleWithConnection : ModuleWithConnection T.toBase
declarations.comment: (2): the restriction F_Y of a crystal F in quasi-coherent O_{X/S}-modules comes endowed with a canonical integrable connection F_Y ⟶ F_Y ⊗ Ω_{Y/S}, the restriction of the 07J6 connection, with its twisted de Rham complex

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.SmallSite.Situation07MW.deRhamComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07MW, part (3).**  Let `p` be a prime, `(A, I, γ)` a divided power
ring with `p` nilpotent in `A`, `S = Spec(A)`, `Y` a smooth `S`-scheme and `X = Y ×_S S₀`, and let
`F` be a crystal in quasi-coherent `𝒪_{X/S}`-modules.  Then

`RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) = RΓ(Y, F_Y ⊗_{𝒪_Y} Ω^•_{Y/S})` in `D(A)`,

where `F_Y` carries the canonical integrable connection of part (2),
`Situation07MW.moduleWithConnection`, and the right hand side is the cohomology of its twisted de
Rham complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem deRhamComparison {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf S)}
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    Nonempty (moduleULiftDerivedGlobalSections S F ≅
      derivedBaseGlobalSections T.toBase (T.moduleWithConnection hF).complex)
declarations.comment: (3): RΓ(Cris(X/S), F) = RΓ(Y, F_Y ⊗ Ω^•_{Y/S}) in D(A), for every crystal F in quasi-coherent O_{X/S}-modules, F_Y with the canonical integrable connection of (2)

declarations.name: Crystalline.GlobalCrystallineSituation.smoothLiftingCrystallineThickening
