declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.exists_isPushout_isPullback_isThickening_of_isFiniteOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT for a finite-order thickening, on an explicitly constructed
apex.**  For a finite-order thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` there is
a scheme `Q` with maps `A : X' ⟶ Q` and `B : Y ⟶ Q` whose square is cocartesian, is
simultaneously cartesian, and has `B` a thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPushout_isPullback_isThickening_of_isFiniteOrderThickening (i : X ⟶ X')
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    ∃ (Q : Scheme.{u}) (A : X' ⟶ Q) (B : Y ⟶ Q),
      IsPushout i f A B ∧ IsPullback i f A B ∧ IsThickening B
declarations.comment: the existence of the pushout, that Y ⊂ Y' is a thickening and that the square is cartesian; for a thickening of finite order

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.hasPushout_of_isFiniteOrderThickening_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, first assertion, for a finite-order thickening.**  A finite-order
thickening and an affine morphism have a pushout in the category of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPushout_of_isFiniteOrderThickening_of_isAffineHom (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] : HasPushout i f
declarations.comment: the existence of the pushout, for a thickening of finite order

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.isPullback_pushout_of_isFiniteOrderThickening_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, third assertion, for a finite-order thickening.**  The pushout
square of a finite-order thickening and an affine morphism is also cartesian, that is,
`X = Y ×_{Y'} X'`; stated for Mathlib's canonical pushout.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_pushout_of_isFiniteOrderThickening_of_isAffineHom (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] [HasPushout i f] :
    IsPullback i f (pushout.inl i f) (pushout.inr i f)
declarations.comment: that the square is cartesian, X = Y ×_{Y'} X'; for a thickening of finite order

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.pushout_inr_isThickening_of_isFiniteOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, second assertion, for a finite-order thickening.**  The map from
`Y` into the pushout of a finite-order thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`
is again a thickening; stated for Mathlib's canonical pushout.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_inr_isThickening_of_isFiniteOrderThickening (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] [HasPushout i f] :
    IsThickening (pushout.inr i f)
declarations.comment: that Y ⊂ Y' is a thickening, for a thickening of finite order

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.pushout_structureSheaf_isPullback_of_isFiniteOrderThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, fourth assertion, for a finite-order thickening.**  On every open
`U` of the pushout of a finite-order thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`
the ring of sections is the fibre product of the rings of sections over the two preimages of `U`
in `Y` and `X'` above the ring of sections over their common preimage in `X`; this is
`𝒪_{Y'} = 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_structureSheaf_isPullback_of_isFiniteOrderThickening (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] [HasPushout i f] (U : (pushout i f).Opens) :
    IsPullback ((pushout.inr i f).app U) ((pushout.inl i f).app U)
      (f.app (pushout.inr i f ⁻¹ᵁ U))
      (i.app (pushout.inl i f ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun V : X.Opens ↦ Γ(X, V))
        (congrArg (fun g : X ⟶ pushout i f ↦ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (pushout.condition (f := i) (g := f)))))
declarations.comment: the description of 𝒪_{Y'} as 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}; for a thickening of finite order

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.exists_isPushout_isPullback_isThickening_of_isThickening
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT for an arbitrary thickening, on an explicitly constructed apex.**
For a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` there is a scheme `Q` with maps
`A : X' ⟶ Q` and `B : Y ⟶ Q` whose square is cocartesian, is simultaneously cartesian, and has
`B` a thickening.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPushout_isPullback_isThickening_of_isThickening (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    ∃ (Q : Scheme.{u}) (A : X' ⟶ Q) (B : Y ⟶ Q),
      IsPushout i f A B ∧ IsPullback i f A B ∧ IsThickening B
declarations.comment: the existence of the pushout, that Y ⊂ Y' is a thickening and that the square is cartesian, X = Y ×_{Y'} X'

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, first assertion.**  A thickening and an affine morphism have a
pushout in the category of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom' (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] : HasPushout i f
declarations.comment: the existence of the pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.pushout_inr_isThickening'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, second assertion.**  The map from `Y` into the pushout of a
thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is again a thickening; stated for
Mathlib's canonical pushout.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_inr_isThickening' (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasPushout i f] : IsThickening (pushout.inr i f)
declarations.comment: that Y ⊂ Y' is a thickening

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.isPullback_pushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, third assertion.**  The pushout square of a thickening and an
affine morphism is also cartesian, that is, `X = Y ×_{Y'} X'`; stated for Mathlib's canonical
pushout.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_pushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom' (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] [HasPushout i f] :
    IsPullback i f (pushout.inl i f) (pushout.inr i f)
declarations.comment: that the square is cartesian, X = Y ×_{Y'} X'

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.pushout_structureSheaf_isPullback'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RT, fourth assertion.**  On every open `U` of the pushout of a
thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` the ring of sections is the fibre
product of the rings of sections over the two preimages of `U` in `Y` and `X'` above the ring of
sections over their common preimage in `X`; this is `𝒪_{Y'} = 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_structureSheaf_isPullback' (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : IsThickening i)
    [IsAffineHom f] [HasPushout i f] (U : (pushout i f).Opens) :
    IsPullback ((pushout.inr i f).app U) ((pushout.inl i f).app U)
      (f.app (pushout.inr i f ⁻¹ᵁ U))
      (i.app (pushout.inl i f ⁻¹ᵁ U) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun V : X.Opens ↦ Γ(X, V))
        (congrArg (fun g : X ⟶ pushout i f ↦ g ⁻¹ᵁ U)
          (pushout.condition (f := i) (g := f)))))
declarations.comment: the description of 𝒪_{Y'} as 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}

declarations.name: MilnorPatching.compatiblePairsRightAdjoint_counit_isIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RU.** For a fibre product `B' = B ×_A A'` with `A' → A`
surjective, the compatible-pairs construction is right adjoint to extension of scalars from
`B'`.  The counit is an isomorphism, so scalar extension of the compatible-pairs module to
`B` and to `A'` canonically recovers the original two modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem compatiblePairsRightAdjoint_counit_isIso
    {A A' B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B]
    (toBase : B →+* A) (surjection : A' →+* A) (I : Ideal A')
    (s : RingFibreProduct.Situation toBase surjection I) :
    let toB : s.fibreProduct →+* B := s.pullbackCone.fst.hom
    let toA' : s.fibreProduct →+* A' := s.pullbackCone.snd.hom
    let comm : toBase.comp toB = surjection.comp toA' := by
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom s.pullbackCone.condition
    ∃ (F : CategoricalPullback (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} toBase)
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} surjection) ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct)
      (e : ∀ X, F.obj X ≃ CompatiblePairs toBase surjection X)
      (adj : extensionOfScalarsToPullback toB toA' toBase surjection comm ⊣ F),
      (∀ (L : ModuleCat.{u} s.fibreProduct) (X) (h : L ⟶ F.obj X) (l : L),
          (e X (h l)).1.1 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).fst
                ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[s.fibreProduct,toB] l) ∧
            (e X (h l)).1.2 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).snd
                ((1 : A') ⊗ₜ[s.fibreProduct,toA'] l)) ∧
        IsIso adj.counit

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.baseChangeFunctor
declarations.doc:
Base change from schemes over the pushout to compatible schemes over
its two constituent pieces.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeFunctor {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    Over (pushout i f) ⥤ gluingData i f
declarations.comment: the base-change functor F

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.gluingFunctor
declarations.doc:
Gluing compatible schemes over `Y` and `X'` to a scheme over their
pushout. Its objectwise pushout property is stated below.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gluingFunctor {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    gluingData i f ⥤ Over (pushout i f)
declarations.comment: the left adjoint G

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.gluingFunctor_obj_isPushout
declarations.doc:
The glued scheme is the pushout of its two components along their
identified restrictions to `X`, with the induced map to the ambient pushout.
declarations.statement:
theorem gluingFunctor_obj_isPushout {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f]
    (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    ∃ (v : T.obj.left.left ⟶ ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).left)
      (u' : T.obj.right.left ⟶ ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).left),
      IsPushout (gluingSourceMap i f T) (pullback.fst T.obj.right.hom i) v u' ∧
      v ≫ ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom =
        T.obj.left.hom ≫ pushout.inr i f ∧
      u' ≫ ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom =
        T.obj.right.hom ≫ pushout.inl i f
declarations.comment: the left adjoint sends a triple to the pushout V ⨿_{V ×_Y X} U'

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.gluingAdjunction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RV, the adjunction.**  Gluing is left adjoint to
base change: a morphism from the glued scheme `V ⨿_U U'` to a scheme `Z` over `Y'` is the same
thing as a morphism of compatible pairs from `(V, U', φ)` to the base change of `Z`.

The bijection is the universal property of the pushout on one side and of the two fibre products
on the other.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gluingAdjunction {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    gluingFunctor i f hi ⊣ baseChangeFunctor i f hi
declarations.comment: the adjunction G ⊣ F

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.gluingCompBaseChangeIsoId
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RV, the last assertion.**  The composition of
gluing with base change is isomorphic to the identity functor: a compatible pair `(V, U', φ)` is
recovered from the glued scheme `V ⨿_{V ×_Y X} U'` by base change along `Y ⟶ Y'` and
`X' ⟶ Y'`.

The isomorphism is the unit of `Stacks.Pushout.gluingAdjunction`, which is exactly the
comparison map of the source.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gluingCompBaseChangeIsoId {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    gluingFunctor i f hi ⋙ baseChangeFunctor i f hi ≅ 𝟭 (gluingData i f)
declarations.comment: the composition F ∘ G is isomorphic to the identity functor

declarations.name: MilnorPatching.relativelyFlatModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RW.** In a relative fibre-product situation, compatible pairs
whose components are flat over the original rings glue to a module flat over the original
fibre-product ring. Every relatively flat module is canonically reconstructed from its scalar
extensions, and these operations induce an equivalence of the corresponding full
subcategories.

Relative flatness, canonical reconstruction, and gluing of relatively flat modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativelyFlatModulesEquivalenceOverFibreProduct
    {A A' B D' : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing A'] [CommRing B] [CommRing D']
    {toBase : B →+* A} {surjection : A' →+* A} {I : Ideal A'}
    {base : RingFibreProduct.Situation toBase surjection I}
    (s : RelativeModuleFibreProductSituation (D' := D') base) :
    let E := (letI : Algebra base.fibreProduct D' := s.toD'.toAlgebra
       letI : Algebra base.fibreProduct B := (toBase.pullbackFst surjection).toAlgebra
       letI : Algebra base.fibreProduct A' := (toBase.pullbackSnd surjection).toAlgebra
       letI : Algebra base.fibreProduct A := (toBase.comp (toBase.pullbackFst surjection)).toAlgebra
       extensionOfScalarsToTensorProductPullback (D' := D')
         ({ toBase with commutes' := fun _ => rfl } : B →ₐ[base.fibreProduct] A)
         ({ surjection with commutes' := fun r => r.property.symm } : A' →ₐ[base.fibreProduct] A))
    let flatSource : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} D') :=
      fun L ↦ Module.Flat base.fibreProduct
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u, u, u} s.toD').obj L)
    let flatTarget : ObjectProperty
        (RelativeModuleFibreProductSituation.CompatibleModules s) :=
      fun X ↦
        Module.Flat B ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u, u, u} s.BtoD).obj X.fst) ∧
          Module.Flat A'
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u, u, u} s.A'toC').obj X.snd)
    ∃ (F : RelativeModuleFibreProductSituation.CompatibleModules s ⥤
          ModuleCat.{u} D')
      (e : ∀ X, F.obj X ≃ₗ[D']
          compatiblePairsModule.{u} s.toD s.toC' s.DtoC s.C'toC s.relativeSquare_comm X)
      (adj : E ⊣ F),
      (∀ (L : ModuleCat.{u} D') (X) (h : L ⟶ F.obj X) (l : L),
          (e X (h l)).1.1 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).fst
                ((1 : s.D) ⊗ₜ[D',s.toD] l) ∧
            (e X (h l)).1.2 =
              ((adj.homEquiv L X).symm h).snd
                ((1 : s.C') ⊗ₜ[D',s.toC'] l)) ∧
        (∀ {X Y} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : F.obj X),
          (e Y (F.map f p)).1.1 = f.fst (e X p).1.1 ∧
            (e Y (F.map f p)).1.2 = f.snd (e X p).1.2) ∧
        IsIso adj.counit ∧
        (∀ X, flatTarget X → flatSource (F.obj X)) ∧
        (∀ L, flatSource L → IsIso (adj.unit.app L)) ∧
        ∃ q : flatSource.FullSubcategory ≌ flatTarget.FullSubcategory,
          Nonempty (flatSource.ι ⋙ E ≅ q.functor ⋙ flatTarget.ι) ∧
            Nonempty (flatTarget.ι ⋙ F ≅ q.inverse ⋙ flatSource.ι)

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.gluingAdjunction_counit_app_isIso_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], the closing paragraph, first assertion.**  If `W'` is flat over the
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, then
the adjunction mapping `G(F(W')) ⟶ W'` is an isomorphism: `W'` is glued from its two base
changes to `Y` and to `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem gluingAdjunction_counit_app_isIso_of_flat (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    ∀ W' : Over (pushout i f), Flat W'.hom →
      IsIso ((gluingAdjunction i f hi).counit.app W')
declarations.comment: the closing paragraph: the counit G(F(W')) ⟶ W' is an isomorphism for W' flat over Y', for the adjunction of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.flatGluingEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], the closing paragraph, second assertion.**  For the pushout
`Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, the functors `F`
and `G` of [Stacks Project, Tag 07RV] are mutually quasi-inverse between the category of schemes
flat over `Y'` and the category of triples `(V, U', φ)` with `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` flat.

Both functors restrict to those subcategories, so the adjunction of Tag 07RV does; its unit is
invertible by the last assertion of that tag and its counit by
`Stacks.Pushout.gluingAdjunction_counit_app_isIso_of_flat`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def flatGluingEquivalence (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y) (hi : IsThickening i)
    [IsAffineHom f] :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    FlatGluingEquivalenceData i f hi
declarations.comment: the closing paragraph: F and G are mutually quasi-inverse between the schemes flat over Y' and the triples with both components flat, for Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.etale_gluingFunctor_obj_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07RX, clause (5).** The glued scheme of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout is
étale over the pushout exactly when both of its pieces are étale over their bases.
declarations.statement:
theorem etale_gluingFunctor_obj_iff {X X' Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    Etale ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom ↔
      (Etale T.obj.left.hom ∧ Etale T.obj.right.hom)
declarations.comment: clause (5): étale, for the gluing functor of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.locallyOfFiniteType_gluingFunctor_obj_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], clause (1).**  The scheme glued from a triple `(V, U', φ)` across the
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is
locally of finite type over `Y'` if and only if both `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` are.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFiniteType_gluingFunctor_obj_iff (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    LocallyOfFiniteType ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom ↔
      (LocallyOfFiniteType T.obj.left.hom ∧ LocallyOfFiniteType T.obj.right.hom)
declarations.comment: clause (1): locally of finite type, for the gluing functor of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.flat_gluingFunctor_obj_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], clause (2).**  The scheme glued from a triple `(V, U', φ)` across the
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is flat
over `Y'` if and only if both `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` are flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_gluingFunctor_obj_iff (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    Flat ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom ↔
      (Flat T.obj.left.hom ∧ Flat T.obj.right.hom)
declarations.comment: clause (2): flat, for the gluing functor of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.flat_and_locallyOfFinitePresentation_gluingFunctor_obj_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], clause (3).**  The scheme glued from a triple `(V, U', φ)` across the
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is flat
and locally of finite presentation over `Y'` if and only if both `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` are.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_and_locallyOfFinitePresentation_gluingFunctor_obj_iff (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    (Flat ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom ∧
        LocallyOfFinitePresentation ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom) ↔
      ((Flat T.obj.left.hom ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.obj.left.hom) ∧
        (Flat T.obj.right.hom ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation T.obj.right.hom))
declarations.comment: clause (3): flat and locally of finite presentation, for the gluing functor of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.Pushout.smooth_gluingFunctor_obj_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07RX], clause (4).**  The scheme glued from a triple `(V, U', φ)` across the
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of a thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` is
smooth over `Y'` if and only if both `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` are smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem smooth_gluingFunctor_obj_iff (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickening i) [IsAffineHom f] (T : gluingData i f) :
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening i f hi
    Smooth ((gluingFunctor i f hi).obj T).hom ↔
      (Smooth T.obj.left.hom ∧ Smooth T.obj.right.hom)
declarations.comment: clause (4): smooth, for the gluing functor of Tag 07RV over Mathlib's canonical pushout

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_closed_filtration_characterizing_finiteLocallyFree_rank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RY.** A separated, flat, locally finitely presented, locally
quasi-finite morphism with universally bounded fibres admits a finite closed filtration whose
strata universally characterize finite locally free base changes of each degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_closed_filtration_characterizing_finiteLocallyFree_rank
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyQuasiFinite f] (hbounded : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers f) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Z : Fin (n + 2) → Set S),
      (∀ i, IsClosed (Z i)) ∧
        Z 0 = ∅ ∧
        Z (Fin.last (n + 1)) = Set.univ ∧
        (∀ i : Fin (n + 1), Z i.castSucc ⊆ Z i.succ) ∧
        ∀ (r : Fin (n + 1)) (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S),
          IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.snd f g) r.val ↔
            Set.range g.base ⊆ Z r.succ \ Z r.castSucc

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasiCompact_stratification_of_finiteLocallyFree_rank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07RZ.** A flat, locally finitely presented, separated and quasi-finite
morphism admits an increasing sequence of closed subsets of its target whose successive
differences are quasi-compactly immersed and are characterised by the degree of the finite
locally free base changes of the morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_quasiCompact_stratification_of_finiteLocallyFree_rank
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyQuasiFinite f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    ∃ (Z : ℕ → Set S) (Y : ℕ → Scheme.{u}) (i : (r : ℕ) → Y r ⟶ S),
      (∀ r, IsClosed (Z r)) ∧
        Z 0 = ∅ ∧
        (∀ r, Z r ⊆ Z (r + 1)) ∧
        (⋃ r, Z r) = Set.univ ∧
        (∀ r, IsImmersion (i r)) ∧
        (∀ r, QuasiCompact (i r)) ∧
        (∀ r, Set.range (i r).base = Z (r + 1) \ Z r) ∧
        ∀ (r : ℕ) (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S),
          IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (pullback.snd f g) r ↔
            Set.range g.base ⊆ Z (r + 1) \ Z r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAffineOpen_containing_finite_of_locallyQuasiFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07S0.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a separated quasi-finite morphism of
schemes with affine target. Then every finite set of points of `X` is contained in a single
affine open of `X`.

Cover the finite set by finitely many affine opens and let `U` be their union. Then `U` is
quasi-compact, so `U.ι ≫ f` is quasi-compact, and it is still separated and quasi-finite; hence
it is quasi-affine by Stacks 02LR. Taking the affine open `⊤` of `S` shows that `U` itself is a
quasi-affine scheme, and Stacks 01ZY part (1) puts the finite set into an affine open of `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAffineOpen_containing_finite_of_locallyQuasiFinite [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyQuasiFinite f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsAffine S] {E : Set X} (hE : E.Finite) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ E ⊆ U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsFreeAction
declarations.doc: A group object acts freely on `X` if its action on `T`-points is free for every object `T`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsFreeAction {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [CartesianMonoidalCategory C]
    (G X : C) [GrpObj G] [ModObj G X] : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFreeAction_iff_mono_leftSMul
declarations.doc: A group action is free if and only if `(g, x) ↦ (g • x, x)` is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
lemma isFreeAction_iff_mono_leftSMul {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    [CartesianMonoidalCategory C] (G X : C) [GrpObj G] [ModObj G X] :
    IsFreeAction G X ↔ Mono (ModObj.leftSMul G X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_toQuotientSheaf_overTopology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07S3.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `(r, f)` be a morphism of equivalence
relations `j : R ⟶ U ×_S U` and `j' : R' ⟶ U' ×_S U'` over `S` whose square on source maps is
cartesian. Then for each of the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic and fppf topologies the
square formed by the two quotient maps and by `f` is a fibre product square of `τ`-sheaves:
`U` is the fibre product of `U'` and `U/R` over `U'/R'`.

The topology is quantified over `AlgebraicGeometry.CoveringTopology`, so the single statement
is the five of the source. The two schemes of objects `U` and `U'` are the schemes presented
by objects of the site; the two schemes of relations are arbitrary schemes over `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_toQuotientSheaf_overTopology (τ : CoveringTopology) (B : BigSite.{u} τ)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : S.size < cutoff τ B)
    {R R' : CategoryTheory.Over S} {U U' : CategoryTheory.Over (base B S hS)}
    (j : PreRelation R ((overToSlice τ B S hS).obj U))
    (j' : PreRelation R' ((overToSlice τ B S hS).obj U'))
    [IsEquivalenceRelation j.target j.source] [IsEquivalenceRelation j'.target j'.source]
    (r : R ⟶ R')
    (f : (overToSlice τ B S hS).obj U ⟶ (overToSlice τ B S hS).obj U')
    (hs : r ≫ j'.source = j.source ≫ f) (ht : r ≫ j'.target = j.target ≫ f)
    (hcart : IsPullback r j.source j'.source f) :
    IsPullback (toQuotientSheaf (overTopology τ B S hS) (overToSlice τ B S hS) j)
      ((overToSlice τ B S hS).op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map f))
      (quotientSheafMap (overTopology τ B S hS) (overToSlice τ B S hS) j j' r f hs ht).hom
      (toQuotientSheaf (overTopology τ B S hS) (overToSlice τ B S hS) j')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiSeparated_of_etaleAtlas_quasiCompact_projection
declarations.doc:
An algebraic space over `S` which admits a surjective étale morphism `q` from an object of
the site whose underlying scheme is quasi-separated, and one of whose two kernel-pair
projections `pullback.fst q q`, `pullback.snd q q` is quasi-compact, is quasi-separated over the
terminal scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_of_etaleAtlas_quasiCompact_projection
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hAtlas : ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
        (q : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X),
      QuasiSeparatedSpace ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) q ∧
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) q ∧
      ((MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@QuasiCompact.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) (pullback.fst q q) ∨
       (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@QuasiCompact.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) (pullback.snd q q))) :
    IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GroupoidScheme.exists_schemeQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07S6.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid scheme over `S` with `s` and `t` finite
locally free, with `(t, s)` an equivalence relation, and such that every nonempty closed subset
of `U` contains a point whose `R`-equivalence class lies in an affine open.  Then there is a
scheme `M` over `S`, no larger than `U`, and a finite locally free surjection `p : U ⟶ M`,
whose kernel pair is `(t, s)` and which represents the fppf quotient sheaf `U/R`.

The invariant affine opens cover `U` (Stacks 03JE), the quotient of the restriction of the
groupoid to each of them is affine (Stacks 03BM) and is an open subspace of `U/R`
(Stacks 02WU), and those open subspaces jointly cover `U/R` because `U` covers it; glueing
them (Stacks 01JJ) gives `M`.  Finite local freeness, surjectivity and the size bound transfer
from the charts to `p` because they are local on the target, and the kernel-pair square is the
identification of `R` with the kernel pair of the projection of `U` onto `U/R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_schemeQuotient (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)] (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source] (hU : B.Contains G.objects.left)
    (h3 : HasAffineOrbitInEveryClosed G) :
    ∃ (M : Over S) (p : G.objects ⟶ M)
      (hp : (groupoidPreRelation G).target ≫ p = (groupoidPreRelation G).source ≫ p)
      (hM : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
        (points (Over.post B.inclusion) M)),
      M.left.size ≤ G.objects.left.size ∧ IsFiniteLocallyFree p.left ∧ Surjective p.left ∧
        IsPullback G.target G.source p p ∧
        IsIso (quotientSheafToPoints (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Over.post B.inclusion)
          (groupoidPreRelation G) p hp hM)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_quotientSheaf_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover
declarations.doc:
**The fppf quotient sheaf of a finite locally free groupoid covered by invariant affine opens
is representable.** For a groupoid scheme over `S` with finite locally free source and target whose
pre-relation is an equivalence relation, and whose object scheme is covered by `R`-invariant affine
opens indexed by a type below the site's cutoff, the quotient sheaf `U/R` is representable on the
big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_quotientSheaf_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S) [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left]
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left] [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hU : B.Contains G.objects.left)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    {ι : Type u} (hι : #ι < B.cutoff) (V : ι → G.objects.left.Opens)
    (hVinv : ∀ i, IsInvariantOpen G (V i)) (hVaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    (hcov : ⨆ i, V i = ⊤) :
    let F : BigFppfOver B S hS ⥤ Over S := Over.post B.inclusion
    let J := BigFppfOver.topology B S hS
    (quotientSheaf J F (groupoidPreRelation G)).obj.IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: representability of the quotient sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quotientMap_isRepresented_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover
declarations.doc:
**The quotient scheme and the quotient morphism, on a given big fppf site.** Under the
hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_quotientSheaf_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover` there
are a scheme `M` over `S` belonging to the big fppf site and a morphism `f : U ⟶ M` of `S`-schemes
which is finite locally free and surjective, whose kernel pair is the given pair `(t, s)` — that is
`R = U ×_M U` — and under which the restricted functor of points of `M` is a sheaf representing the
quotient sheaf `U/R` compatibly with `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quotientMap_isRepresented_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hU : B.Contains G.objects.left)
    (hR : B.Contains G.arrows.left)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    {ι : Type u} (hι : #ι < B.cutoff) (V : ι → G.objects.left.Opens)
    (hVinv : ∀ i, IsInvariantOpen G (V i)) (hVaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (V i))
    (hcov : ⨆ i, V i = ⊤) :
    let F : BigFppfOver B S hS ⥤ Over S := Over.post B.inclusion
    let J := BigFppfOver.topology B S hS
    ∃ (M : Over S) (f : G.objects ⟶ M), B.Contains M.left ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree f.left ∧ Surjective f.left ∧
      IsPullback G.target G.source f f ∧
      ∃ hM : Presheaf.IsSheaf J (Stacks.Groupoids.points F M),
        ∃ q : quotientSheaf J F (groupoidPreRelation G) ⟶
            (⟨Stacks.Groupoids.points F M, hM⟩ : Sheaf J (Type u)),
          IsIso q ∧ toQuotientSheaf J F (groupoidPreRelation G) ≫ q.hom =
            F.op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map f)
declarations.comment: the quotient scheme and the three conclusion clauses, on a given site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quotientMap_isRepresented_of_affineOrbits
declarations.doc:
**The quotient scheme and the quotient morphism for a groupoid with affine orbits, on a given
big fppf site.** The same conclusion as
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quotientMap_isRepresented_of_isInvariantOpen_isAffineOpen_cover`
with the covering by invariant affine opens replaced by the condition that every nonempty closed
subset of `U` contains a point whose `R`-equivalence class `t(s⁻¹({u}))` lies in an affine open of
`U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quotientMap_isRepresented_of_affineOrbits {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hU : B.Contains G.objects.left)
    (hR : B.Contains G.arrows.left)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    (horbit : ∀ Z : Set G.objects.left, IsClosed Z → Z.Nonempty →
      ∃ u ∈ Z, ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧
        G.target.left.base '' (G.source.left.base ⁻¹' {u}) ⊆ (W : Set G.objects.left)) :
    let F : BigFppfOver B S hS ⥤ Over S := Over.post B.inclusion
    let J := BigFppfOver.topology B S hS
    ∃ (M : Over S) (f : G.objects ⟶ M), B.Contains M.left ∧
      IsFiniteLocallyFree f.left ∧ Surjective f.left ∧
      IsPullback G.target G.source f f ∧
      ∃ hM : Presheaf.IsSheaf J (Stacks.Groupoids.points F M),
        ∃ q : quotientSheaf J F (groupoidPreRelation G) ⟶
            (⟨Stacks.Groupoids.points F M, hM⟩ : Sheaf J (Type u)),
          IsIso q ∧ toQuotientSheaf J F (groupoidPreRelation G) ≫ q.hom =
            F.op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map f)
declarations.comment: the three conclusion clauses from the affine-orbit condition, on a given site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_of_affineOrbits_of_bigFppfSite
declarations.doc:
**A finite flat quotient of a groupoid with affine orbits, given a big fppf site.** Let
`(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid scheme over `S` with `s` and `t` finite locally free and with
`(t, s)` an equivalence relation, such that every nonempty closed subset of `U` contains a point
whose `R`-equivalence class lies in an affine open, and suppose given a big fppf site of `S`
containing `S`, `U` and `R`. Then the groupoid has a finite flat quotient in the sense of
`Stacks.Groupoids.FiniteFlatQuotient`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_of_affineOrbits_of_bigFppfSite {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) (hU : B.Contains G.objects.left)
    (hR : B.Contains G.arrows.left)
    (horbit : ∀ Z : Set G.objects.left, IsClosed Z → Z.Nonempty →
      ∃ u ∈ Z, ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧
        G.target.left.base '' (G.source.left.base ⁻¹' {u}) ⊆ (W : Set G.objects.left)) :
    Nonempty (FiniteFlatQuotient G)
declarations.comment: the finite flat quotient, given a big fppf site containing the groupoid

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_of_affineOrbits
declarations.doc:
**Finite flat quotients of groupoids with affine orbits.** Let `(U, R, s, t, c)` be a groupoid
scheme over a scheme `S` such that

1. `s, t : R ⟶ U` are finite locally free,
2. `j = (t, s)` is an equivalence relation, and
3. every nonempty closed subset `Z` of `U` contains a point `u` whose `R`-equivalence class
   `t(s⁻¹({u}))` is contained in an affine open of `U`.

Then there is a finite locally free morphism `U ⟶ M` of schemes over `S` with `R = U ×_M U` and
with `M` representing the quotient sheaf `U/R` in the fppf topology — that is, the groupoid has a
finite flat quotient in the sense of `Stacks.Groupoids.FiniteFlatQuotient`, which also records that
`U ⟶ M` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_of_affineOrbits {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : GroupoidScheme S)
    [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.source.left] [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.target.left]
    [IsEquivalenceRelation G.target G.source]
    (horbit : ∀ Z : Set G.objects.left, IsClosed Z → Z.Nonempty →
      ∃ u ∈ Z, ∃ W : G.objects.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W ∧
        G.target.left.base '' (G.source.left.base ⁻¹' {u}) ⊆ (W : Set G.objects.left)) :
    Nonempty (FiniteFlatQuotient G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_actionGroupoid_of_geometry
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, `G ⟶ S` a group scheme, `X ⟶ S` a
morphism of schemes and `a : G ×_S X ⟶ X` an action. Assume that `G ⟶ S` is finite locally
free, that the action is free, and that `X ⟶ S` is affine, or quasi-affine, or projective, or
quasi-projective, or `X` admits an immersion into an affine scheme, or an immersion into
`Proj A` for a graded ring `A`, or `G ⟶ S` is radicial. Then the fppf quotient sheaf `X/G` is a
scheme: the action groupoid has a finite flat quotient, so there is a scheme `M` over `S`
representing `X/G` on every big fppf site, with `X ⟶ M` surjective and finite locally free and
with kernel pair `G ×_S X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_finiteFlatQuotient_actionGroupoid_of_geometry [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.hom]
    (hfree : IsFreeAction G X)
    (hgeom : IsAffineHom X.hom ∨ IsQuasiAffineHom X.hom ∨ IsProjective X.hom ∨
      IsQuasiProjective X.hom ∨ HasImmersionToAffine X.left ∨ HasImmersionToProj X.left ∨
      UniversallyInjective G.hom) :
    Nonempty (FiniteFlatQuotient (actionGroupoid (Over.mk (𝟙 S)) G X))
declarations.comment: the quotient sheaf is a scheme; all seven alternatives of condition (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFppfTorsor_quotientMap
declarations.doc:
For a finite flat quotient `M = X/G` of the action groupoid, the morphism
`G ×_S X ⟶ X ×_M X` sending `(g, x)` to `(g · x, x)` is an isomorphism, and `X ⟶ M` is itself an
fppf covering of `M` over which `X ⟶ M` has a section, namely the diagonal. These are the two
conditions for `X ⟶ X/G` to be an fppf `G`-torsor.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFppfTorsor_quotientMap [IsFiniteLocallyFree G.hom]
    (Q : FiniteFlatQuotient (actionGroupoid (Over.mk (𝟙 S)) G X)) :
    (∃ e : (G ⊗ X).left ≅ pullback Q.quotientMap.left Q.quotientMap.left,
        e.hom ≫ pullback.fst Q.quotientMap.left Q.quotientMap.left = (γ[G, X]).left ∧
          e.hom ≫ pullback.snd Q.quotientMap.left Q.quotientMap.left = (snd G X).left) ∧
      Presieve.singleton Q.quotientMap.left ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage Q.space.left ∧
      ∃ s : X.left ⟶ pullback Q.quotientMap.left Q.quotientMap.left,
        s ≫ pullback.fst Q.quotientMap.left Q.quotientMap.left = 𝟙 X.left
declarations.comment: the fppf torsor clause: shear isomorphism and fppf-local sections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_closedChain_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07S8.** A flat, locally finitely presented, separated, locally
quasi-finite morphism from a scheme to an algebraic space with universally bounded fibres induces
a finite increasing chain of closed subsets of the point set, from `∅` to the whole point set,
whose strata are the loci over which the base change of the morphism is finite locally free of a
fixed degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_closedChain_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank
    (X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (W : BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (g : yoneda.obj W ⟶ X) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hflat : IsFlat B S hS g) (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS g) (hlqf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS g)
    (hbound : HasUniversallyBoundedFibers B S hS W g) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Z : ℕ → Set (points B S hS X)), Z 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ r, IsClosed (Z r)) ∧ Monotone Z ∧
      Z (n + 1) = Set.univ ∧
      ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n → ∀ (T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hm : T ⟶ X),
        IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T →
        ∀ (Pp : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (pr₁ : Pp ⟶ yoneda.obj W) (pr₂ : Pp ⟶ T),
          IsPullback pr₁ pr₂ g hm →
          ((MorphismProperty.inverseImage (IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.property.{u} r)
              (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf pr₂ ↔
            Set.range (pointsMap B S hS T hm) ⊆ Z (r + 1) \ Z r)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_finiteFiltration_of_isReasonableSpace
declarations.doc:
A quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space has a finite filtration by open
subspaces such that every reduced stratum has a separated scheme as an étale
neighborhood, isomorphic above the stratum.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteFiltration_of_isReasonableSpace
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqc : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X)
    (hr : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : ℕ → Subfunctor X),
      0 < n ∧
      U 0 = ⊤ ∧
      U n = (⊥ : Subfunctor X).sheafify
        (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      (∀ p ≤ n, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsOpenSubspace B S hS (U p)) ∧
      (∀ p < n, U (p + 1) ≤ U p) ∧
      ∃ (T : (p : Fin n) → Subfunctor (U p.val).toFunctor)
        (V : Fin n → AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
        (f : ∀ p : Fin n, yoneda.obj (V p) ⟶ (U p.val).toFunctor),
        ∀ p : Fin n,
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsClosedSubspace B S hS (T p)) ∧
          (Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (T p).toFunctor
            ((T p).ι ≫ (U p.val).ι)) =
              Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (U p.val).toFunctor
                (U p.val).ι) \
              Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (U (p.val + 1)).toFunctor
                (U (p.val + 1)).ι)) ∧
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (T p).toFunctor
            (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)) ∧
          Scheme.IsSeparated ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj (V p)) ∧
          (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
            (@Surjective.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
            (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).presheaf (f p) ∧
          AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsEtale B S hS (f p) ∧
          IsIso (pullback.fst (T p).ι (f p))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_finiteFiltration_isRepresentable_strata
declarations.doc:
A quasi-compact reasonable algebraic space has a finite filtration by open
subspaces whose reduced strata are schemes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_finiteFiltration_isRepresentable_strata
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqc : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X)
    (hr : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsReasonableSpace B S hS X) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : ℕ → Subfunctor X),
      0 < n ∧
      U 0 = ⊤ ∧
      U n = (⊥ : Subfunctor X).sheafify
        (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      (∀ p ≤ n, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsOpenSubspace B S hS (U p)) ∧
      (∀ p < n, U (p + 1) ≤ U p) ∧
      ∃ T : (p : Fin n) → Subfunctor (U p.val).toFunctor,
        ∀ p : Fin n,
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsClosedSubspace B S hS (T p)) ∧
          (Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (T p).toFunctor
            ((T p).ι ≫ (U p.val).ι)) =
              Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (U p.val).toFunctor
                (U p.val).ι) \
              Set.range (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pointsMap B S hS (U (p.val + 1)).toFunctor
                (U (p.val + 1)).ι)) ∧
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (T p).toFunctor
            (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced Y)) ∧
          (T p).toFunctor.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_and_isAffineHom_limitπ_of_limitInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SE.** Let `D` be a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces over `S` whose
transition morphisms are affine. Then the inverse limit of `D`, computed as a presheaf (hence as
an fppf sheaf), is an algebraic space over `S`; every projection from it to a stage is affine;
and for every stage `i` and every morphism `g : T ⟶ D i` the base change of the limit along `g`
is the limit of the base changes along `g` of the stages over `i`.

This is the description of limits of algebraic spaces which the section sets up and uses in
the rest of the chapter, under the chapter's standing convention (Stacks 07SD). The three
conclusions are Stacks 07SF: its existence assertion is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_limitInSite`, part (1) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits`, and part (2),
which is also Stacks 07SH, is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLimitPullbackLimitOverPost`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_limit_and_isAffineHom_limitπ_of_limitInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS),
      (W ⋙ yoneda ≅ (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
        Over.forget (yoneda.obj Z)) → BigFppfOver.LimitInSite W)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (limit D) ∧ (∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (limit.π D i)) ∧
      ∀ (i : I) {T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : T ⟶ D.obj i),
        Nonempty (IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone
          ((Over.pullback g).mapCone ((limit.cone D).overPost i))))
declarations.comment: the description of limits of algebraic spaces the section sets up: a cofiltered limit of algebraic spaces with affine transitions is an algebraic space with affine projections, and base change commutes with it; its numbered results are 07SF (existence, parts (1) and (2)), 07SG (the presentation U/R of the limit), 07SH, 0CUH, 0CUI and 0CP4, each registered on its own declaration

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_isAffineHom_app_of_limitInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SE, systems affine over a base.** The inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse
system of algebraic spaces over `S`, each affine over one fixed algebraic space `T`, is an
algebraic space over `S`, under the chapter's standing convention (Stacks 07SD).

The transition morphisms are affine by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_map_of_isAffineHom_app`, so Stacks 07SF applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_isAffineHom_app_of_limitInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS),
      (W ⋙ yoneda ≅ (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
        Over.forget (yoneda.obj Z)) → BigFppfOver.LimitInSite W)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i)) (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T)
    (hτ : ∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (τ.app i)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (limit D)
declarations.comment: a cofiltered limit of algebraic spaces affine over a fixed algebraic space is an algebraic space, the form in which the section is cited in the proof of 08K6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ_comp_app_of_limitInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SE, systems affine over a base.** The structure morphism to `T` of the inverse
limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces, each affine over one fixed algebraic
space `T`, is affine, under the chapter's standing convention (Stacks 07SD).

It factors as the projection to a stage, which is affine by Stacks 07SF, part (1), followed by
the structure morphism of that stage; a composite of affine morphisms is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_limitπ_comp_app_of_limitInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS),
      (W ⋙ yoneda ≅ (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
        Over.forget (yoneda.obj Z)) → BigFppfOver.LimitInSite W)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i)) (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T)
    (hτ : ∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (τ.app i)) (i : I) :
    IsAffineHom B S hS (limit.π D i ≫ τ.app i)
declarations.comment: the structure morphism of a cofiltered limit of algebraic spaces affine over a fixed algebraic space is affine, the form in which the section is cited in the proof of 08K6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAffine_representation_limit_of_limitInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SE, over an affine base.** The inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of
algebraic spaces over `S`, each affine over one fixed affine object `Z` of the site, is
represented by an affine object of the site, by an isomorphism carrying the structure morphism
of the limit to a morphism of the site, under the chapter's standing convention (Stacks 07SD).

The structure morphism of the limit is affine by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ_comp_app_of_limitInSite`, so its base change along
the identity of `yoneda Z` is represented by an affine object of the site; a base change along
an identity is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAffine_representation_limit_of_limitInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS),
      (W ⋙ yoneda ≅ (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
        Over.forget (yoneda.obj Z)) → BigFppfOver.LimitInSite W)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hτ : ∀ i, IsAffineHom B S hS (τ.app i)) (i₀ : I) :
    ∃ (W : BigAffineFppf B S hS)
      (e : yoneda.obj ((BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W) ≅ limit D)
      (q : (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj W ⟶
        (BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z),
      e.hom ≫ limit.π D i₀ ≫ τ.app i₀ = yoneda.map q
declarations.comment: a cofiltered limit of algebraic spaces affine over an affine scheme is an affine scheme, the form in which the section is cited, together with Limits, Section 01YV, in the proof of 08K6

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SF, existence.** The inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic
spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms is an algebraic space over `S`, provided the
index category is small enough for the site: its object type and all of its morphism types
have cardinality below the cofinality of the site's size cutoff.

The limit is a sheaf by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_limit`, and the remaining two
conditions of Stacks 025Y follow from Stacks 02WY applied to the projection to any one stage,
which is relatively representable by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_limitπ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_limit (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (limit D)
declarations.comment: existence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_isSiteSmall
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SF, existence.** The inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic
spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms is an algebraic space over `S`, provided the
system is small for the site: either its index category is small compared with the cofinality
of the site's size cutoff, its object type and all of its morphism types, or its transition
morphisms are monomorphisms. See `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSiteSmall`.

The limit is a sheaf by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSheaf_limit`, and the remaining two
conditions of Stacks 025Y follow from Stacks 02WY applied to the projection to any one stage,
which is relatively representable by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_limitπ_of_isSiteSmall`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_isSiteSmall (hb : IsSiteSmall B S hS D)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (limit D)
declarations.comment: existence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_limitInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SF, existence, under the chapter's standing convention.** The inverse limit of a
cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms is an
algebraic space over `S`.

This is the faithful statement of the tag. The source states no condition on the index: it
assumes only the convention of Section 70.2 that every ring considered has its spectrum in the
big fppf site, which for this proof says that each limit of a diagram of base changes, to a
test object of the site, of the stages over one stage lies in the site. That is
`AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.LimitInSite` of a lift of such a diagram through the Yoneda
embedding. The proof is the one of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_isSiteSmall`,
which
proves the same conclusion from the strictly stronger `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSiteSmall`,
with the appeal to smallness replaced by the convention at the stage, test object and point in
hand.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_limit_of_limitInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj Z ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS),
      (W ⋙ yoneda ≅ (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
        Over.forget (yoneda.obj Z)) → BigFppfOver.LimitInSite W)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (limit D)
declarations.comment: existence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLimitPullbackLimitOverPost
declarations.doc:
For a cofiltered inverse system `D` of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`, a stage `i`
and a morphism `g : T ⟶ D i`, the base changes of the stages over `i` along `g` form an inverse
system whose limit is the base change of `limit D` along `g`. The cone is the limit cone of `D`,
restricted to the stages over `i` and base changed along `g`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isLimitPullbackLimitOverPost (i : I)
    {T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : T ⟶ D.obj i) :
    IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone
      ((Over.pullback g).mapCone ((limit.cone D).overPost i)))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ
declarations.doc:
Every projection from the inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces
with affine transition morphisms is affine, provided the index category is small enough for the
site: its object type and all of its morphism types have cardinality below the cofinality of the
site's size cutoff.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_limitπ (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (i : I) : IsAffineHom B S hS (limit.π D i)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits
declarations.doc:
Every projection from the inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces
with affine transition morphisms is affine, provided the system satisfies
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_limitπ_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits
    (hconv : SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits B S hS D)
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (i : I) : IsAffineHom B S hS (limit.π D i)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineHom_limitπ_of_isSiteSmall
declarations.doc:
Every projection from the inverse limit of a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces
with affine transition morphisms is affine, provided the system is small for the site in the
sense of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSiteSmall`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_limitπ_of_isSiteSmall (hb : IsSiteSmall B S hS D)
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (i : I) : IsAffineHom B S hS (limit.π D i)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.AffineChartSystem.limitBridge
declarations.doc:
**The limit of a chart system.** A chart system indexed by a slice of a sufficiently small
index category has a limit in the big fppf site of `S`, whose underlying scheme is a limit of
the underlying schemes of the charts and which represents the base change of `limit.π D i₀`
along `f₀`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def limitBridge [IsCofiltered I] (C : AffineChartSystem B S hS i₀ D U₀ f₀)
    (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof) (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof) :
    LimitBridge C
declarations.comment: limit of the affine charts at a stage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.AffineChartSystem.limitBridgeOfLimitInSite
declarations.doc:
**The limit of a chart system whose limit of charts lies in the site.** A chart system whose
limit of charts lies in the site has a limit in the big fppf site of `S`, whose underlying

noncomputable def limitBridgeOfLimitInSite [IsCofiltered I]

declarations.comment: limit of the affine charts at a stage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.AffineChartSystem.limitBridgeOfIsSiteSmall
declarations.doc:
**The limit of a chart system of a system small for the site.** A chart system of a system
which is small for the site has a limit in the big fppf site of `S`, whose underlying scheme is
a limit of the underlying schemes of the charts and which represents the base change of
`limit.π D i₀` along `f₀`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def limitBridgeOfIsSiteSmall [IsCofiltered I]
    (C : AffineChartSystem B S hS i₀ D U₀ f₀)

    LimitBridge C
declarations.comment: limit of the affine charts at a stage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_quotient_presentation_of_affine_transition
declarations.doc:
Let `D` be a cofiltered inverse system of algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition
morphisms and `p₀ : U₀ ⟶ D i₀` a surjective étale atlas of one stage. Then there are a scheme
`U` over `S` with `f : U ⟶ U₀` and `q : U ⟶ lim D` making `U = U₀ ×_{D i₀} lim D`, and an étale
equivalence relation `R` on `U` that is the kernel pair of `q`, such that the canonical map from
`U/R` to the limit of the inverse system is an isomorphism of fppf sheaves.

The atlas `U₀` is required to be one of the site's schemes (`hU₀mem`), as in Stacks 07SG, which
chooses a scheme `U₀` together with a surjective étale morphism `U₀ → X₀`; an atlas of an
algebraic space is an object of the site by construction, cf.
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.exists_atlas`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_quotient_presentation_of_affine_transition
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u))
    [HasLimit D] [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) (Type u)]
    (hD : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i).obj)
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f).hom)
    (i₀ : I) (U₀ : Over S) (hU₀mem : B.Contains U₀.left)
    (hU₀ : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
      (Stacks.Groupoids.points (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) U₀))
    (p₀ : representedSheaf B S hS U₀ hU₀ ⟶ D.obj i₀)
    (hp₀ : Epi p₀)
    (hp₀Etale :
      (MorphismProperty.presheaf (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
        (@Etale.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
        (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS))) p₀.hom)
    : ∃ (U : Over S)
        (hU : Presheaf.IsSheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS)
          (Stacks.Groupoids.points (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) U))
        (R : Over S) (j : Stacks.Groupoids.PreRelation R U)
        (q : representedSheaf B S hS U hU ⟶ limit D)
        (f : U ⟶ U₀),
        IsPullback
          ((BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS).op.whiskerLeft (yoneda.map f))
          q.hom p₀.hom (limit.π D i₀).hom ∧
        ∃ (hq : Stacks.Groupoids.sourceMap (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) j ≫ q.hom =
            Stacks.Groupoids.targetMap (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) j ≫ q.hom),
          IsPullback
            (Stacks.Groupoids.sourceMap (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) j)
            (Stacks.Groupoids.targetMap (BigFppfOver.toOver B S hS) j)
            q.hom q.hom ∧
          Stacks.Groupoids.IsEtaleEquivalenceRelation j ∧
          IsIso (canonicalQuotientToLimit B S hS D j hU q hq)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLimitPullbackLimitOverPost
declarations.doc:
For a cofiltered inverse system `D` of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`, a stage `i`
and a morphism `g : T ⟶ D i`, the base changes of the stages over `i` along `g` form an inverse
system whose limit is the base change of `limit D` along `g`. The cone is the limit cone of `D`,
restricted to the stages over `i` and base changed along `g`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def isLimitPullbackLimitOverPost (i : I)
    {T : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (g : T ⟶ D.obj i) :
    IsLimit ((Over.forget T).mapCone
      ((Over.pullback g).mapCone ((limit.cone D).overPost i)))
declarations.comment: base change of the limit is the limit of the base changes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LimitSituation.isSectionsColimit
declarations.doc:
Let `ℱ₀` be a quasi-coherent module on `X₀`, and set `ℱᵢ = f_{0i}^*ℱ₀` and `ℱ = f_0^*ℱ₀`.
Then `Γ(X, ℱ) = colim_{i ≥ 0} Γ(Xᵢ, ℱᵢ)`, in the elementwise form
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LimitSituation.IsSectionsColimit`, for an index set below the
cofinality of the site's size cutoff.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSectionsColimit (hI : #A.I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (F₀ : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (A.stage A.base).obj (A.stage A.base).property)
    (hF₀ : F₀.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    A.IsSectionsColimit F₀ (A.isAlgebraicSpace_of_mk_lt hI)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LimitSituation.isSectionsColimit_of_baseChangeSizeBounded
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SI.**  In Situation 084R, let `ℱ₀` be a quasi-coherent module on `X₀`, and set
`ℱᵢ = f_{0i}^*ℱ₀` and `ℱ = f_0^*ℱ₀`.  Then `Γ(X, ℱ) = colim_{i ≥ 0} Γ(Xᵢ, ℱᵢ)`, in the
elementwise form `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.LimitSituation.IsSectionsColimit`.

The size condition, an index set below the cutoff with uniformly bounded base changes, is how the
bounded site reads the size conventions of the source (Tag 07SD); with no size condition the
statement is false, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Refute07SI.not_forall_isSectionsColimit`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSectionsColimit_of_baseChangeSizeBounded (hI : #A.I < B.cutoff)
    (hB : BaseChangeSizeBounded B S hS A.system) (hF₀ : F₀.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    A.IsSectionsColimit F₀ (A.isAlgebraicSpace_of_baseChangeSizeBounded hI hB)
declarations.comment: Situation 084R on the bounded site, with the size conventions of Tag 07SD read as an index set below the cutoff with uniformly bounded base changes of the stages; with no size condition the statement is false, Refute07SI.not_forall_isSectionsColimit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_morphism_after_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A morphism between base changes of finite-presentation algebraic spaces
is defined at a sufficiently late stage.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_morphism_after_baseChange
    (i : I) (Yᵢ Zᵢ : Over (D.obj i))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left)
    (hZ' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Zᵢ.left)
    (hYfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom)
    (hZfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Zᵢ.hom)
    (f : (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ ⟶
      (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Zᵢ) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i)
      (g : (Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ ⟶
        (Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ)
      (α : (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).obj
          ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ) ≅
        (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ)
      (β : (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).obj
          ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ) ≅
        (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Zᵢ),
      (α.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst Yᵢ.hom (limit.π D i) =
        pullback.fst ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ).hom (limit.π D j) ≫
          pullback.fst Yᵢ.hom (D.map e)) ∧
      (β.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst Zᵢ.hom (limit.π D i) =
        pullback.fst ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ).hom (limit.π D j) ≫
          pullback.fst Zᵢ.hom (D.map e)) ∧
      α.hom ≫ f = (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).map g ≫ β.hom
declarations.comment: fullness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq
declarations.doc:
Two finite-stage morphisms that agree over the limit agree at a sufficiently
late stage.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq
    (i : I) (Yᵢ Zᵢ : Over (D.obj i))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left)
    (hZ' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Zᵢ.left)
    (hYfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom)
    (hZfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Zᵢ.hom)
    (f g : Yᵢ ⟶ Zᵢ)
    (hfg : (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).map f =
      (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).map g) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i),
      (Over.pullback (D.map e)).map f =
        (Over.pullback (D.map e)).map g
declarations.comment: faithfulness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_model_of_finitePresentation
declarations.doc:
Every algebraic space of finite presentation over the limit descends to a
finite stage.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_model_of_finitePresentation
    (Y : Over (limit D))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y.left)
    (hFp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Y.hom) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Yᵢ : Over (D.obj i)),
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom ∧
        Nonempty (Y ≅ (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ)
declarations.comment: essential surjectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_morphism_after_baseChange_of_chartLimitsInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SK, fullness, with no bound on the index.** A morphism between the base changes
to the limit of two algebraic spaces of finite presentation over a stage comes from a morphism
at a later stage.

This strengthens `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_morphism_after_baseChange`: the cardinality
bounds on the index category are replaced by `hconv`. `hconv` is the convention 07SD of the
chapter: the limits of the base changes of the stages to the affine objects of the site lie in
the site. It is not an assumption beyond the source. It is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits` unfolded, and the index bounds imply it.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_morphism_after_baseChange_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits`
without the hypothesis that the limit is an algebraic space, which Stacks 07SF under the
convention supplies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_morphism_after_baseChange_of_chartLimitsInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS)
      (g : yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z) ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS),
      (W ⋙ (AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS ⋙ yoneda) ≅
        (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
          Over.forget (yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z))) →
      ∀ c : Cone (((W ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS) ⋙
          AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.forget B S hS) ⋙ B.inclusion),
        IsLimit c → B.Contains c.pt)
    (hD : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hQc : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hQs : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ (D.obj i))
    (i : I) (Yᵢ Zᵢ : Over (D.obj i))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left)
    (hZ' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Zᵢ.left)
    (hYfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom)
    (hZfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Zᵢ.hom)
    (f : (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ ⟶
      (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Zᵢ) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i)
      (g : (Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ ⟶
        (Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ)
      (α : (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).obj
          ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ) ≅
        (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ)
      (β : (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).obj
          ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ) ≅
        (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Zᵢ),
      (α.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst Yᵢ.hom (limit.π D i) =
        pullback.fst ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Yᵢ).hom (limit.π D j) ≫
          pullback.fst Yᵢ.hom (D.map e)) ∧
      (β.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst Zᵢ.hom (limit.π D i) =
        pullback.fst ((Over.pullback (D.map e)).obj Zᵢ).hom (limit.π D j) ≫
          pullback.fst Zᵢ.hom (D.map e)) ∧
      α.hom ≫ f = (Over.pullback (limit.π D j)).map g ≫ β.hom
declarations.comment: fullness, with no bound on the index: the 07SD convention in place of the cardinality bounds of exists_morphism_after_baseChange

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq_of_chartLimitsInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SK, faithfulness, with no bound on the index.** Two morphisms between
algebraic spaces of finite presentation over a stage whose base changes to the limit agree
already agree at a later stage.

This strengthens `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq`: the cardinality
bounds on the index category are replaced by `hconv`. `hconv` is the convention 07SD of the
chapter: the limits of the base changes of the stages to the affine objects of the site lie in
the site. It is not an assumption beyond the source. It is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits` unfolded, and the index bounds imply it.
Without it the statement is false; see the notes opening this section.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits`
with the convention written out.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq_of_chartLimitsInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS)
      (g : yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z) ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS),
      (W ⋙ (AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS ⋙ yoneda) ≅
        (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
          Over.forget (yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z))) →
      ∀ c : Cone (((W ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS) ⋙
          AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.forget B S hS) ⋙ B.inclusion),
        IsLimit c → B.Contains c.pt)
    (hD : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hQc : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (i : I) (Yᵢ Zᵢ : Over (D.obj i))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left)
    (hZ' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Zᵢ.left)
    (hYfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom)
    (hZfp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Zᵢ.hom)
    (f g : Yᵢ ⟶ Zᵢ)
    (hfg : (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).map f =
      (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).map g) :
    ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i),
      (Over.pullback (D.map e)).map f =
        (Over.pullback (D.map e)).map g
declarations.comment: faithfulness, with no bound on the index: the 07SD convention in place of the cardinality bounds of eventually_eq_of_baseChange_eq

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_model_of_finitePresentation_of_chartLimitsInSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SK, essential surjectivity, with no bound on the index.** Every algebraic space
of finite presentation over the limit is the base change of an algebraic space of finite
presentation over some stage.

This strengthens `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_model_of_finitePresentation`: the cardinality
bounds on the index category are replaced by `hconv`. `hconv` is the convention 07SD of the
chapter: the limits of the base changes of the stages to the affine objects of the site lie in
the site. It is not an assumption beyond the source. It is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits` unfolded, and the index bounds imply it.

It is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_model_of_finitePresentation_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits`
without the hypothesis that the limit is an algebraic space, which Stacks 07SF under the
convention supplies.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_model_of_finitePresentation_of_chartLimitsInSite
    (hconv : ∀ (i : I) (Z : AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS)
      (g : yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z) ⟶ D.obj i)
      (W : Over i ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf B S hS),
      (W ⋙ (AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS ⋙ yoneda) ≅
        (Over.post (X := i) D ⋙ Over.pullback g) ⋙
          Over.forget (yoneda.obj ((AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS).obj Z))) →
      ∀ c : Cone (((W ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.BigAffineFppf.inclusion B S hS) ⋙
          AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.forget B S hS) ⋙ B.inclusion),
        IsLimit c → B.Contains c.pt)
    (hD : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hQc : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hQs : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ (D.obj i))
    (Y : Over (limit D))
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y.left)
    (hFp : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Y.hom) :
    ∃ (i : I) (Yᵢ : Over (D.obj i)),
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Yᵢ.left ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsFinitePresentation B S hS Yᵢ.hom ∧
        Nonempty (Y ≅ (Over.pullback (limit.π D i)).obj Yᵢ)
declarations.comment: essential surjectivity, with no bound on the index: the 07SD convention in place of the cardinality bounds of exists_model_of_finitePresentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.MorphismDescentSystem.exists_isEtale_mapAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SL.** In the situation of Stacks 084W, if the base change `f` of `f₀` to the
limit `B` is étale and `f₀` is locally of finite presentation, then the base change `f_i` of
`f₀` to some stage `B_i` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isEtale_mapAt (D : MorphismDescentSystem B S hS hZ I)
    (etale : IsEtale B S hS D.mapLimit) (fp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS D.map₀) :
    ∃ (i : I) (le : D.initial ≤ i), IsEtale B S hS (D.mapAt i le)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.MorphismDescentSituation.exists_mono_mapAt_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SM.** In Situation 084W, under the chapter's convention of Section 70.2 (tag
07SD), if the base change `f` of `f₀` to the limit `B` is a monomorphism and `f₀` is locally of
finite type, then the base change `f_i` of `f₀` to some stage `B_i` is a monomorphism.

The convention of Section 70.2, that every scheme considered lies in the big fppf site, is
`hconv`: the limits of the base changes of the system to affine objects of the site lie in the
site. Nothing is asked of the size of the index.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mono_mapAt_of_siteContainsBaseChangeLimits (hconv : SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits B S
    hS D.base) (hf : Mono D.mapLimit)
    (hf₀ : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS D.map₀) :
    ∃ (i : I) (hi : D.initial ≤ i), Mono (D.mapAt i hi)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.MorphismDescentSystem.exists_isSurjective_mapAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SN.** In the situation of Stacks 084W, if the base change `f` of `f₀` to the
limit `B` is surjective and `f₀` is locally of finite presentation, then the base change `f_i`
of `f₀` to some stage `B_i` is surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isSurjective_mapAt
    (D : MorphismDescentSystem B S hS hZ I) (surjective : IsSurjective B S hS D.mapLimit)
    (fp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS D.map₀) :
    ∃ (i : I) (le : D.initial ≤ i), IsSurjective B S hS (D.mapAt i le)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DescentSituation.exists_isAffineSpace_system_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07SQ.** In the situation of Stacks 084R over a scheme `S` — a directed inverse
system of quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition
morphisms, with a chosen limit `X` and a chosen index `0` — if `X` is affine then so is some stage
`X_i` with `0 ≤ i`.

The index set may live in any universe; its cardinality is asked to be below the cofinality of
the size cutoff of the site, which is how the standing convention of Section 70.2 of the source
(every ring considered has its spectrum in the site) reads in this size model. Without it the
statement fails here: for fields `F_a` (`a` below the cofinality) of sizes cofinal in the
cutoff, the system `P¹_{F_a}` has no point over any object of the site, so its limit is the
empty, affine, scheme while no stage is affine.

The index set is replaced by an order-isomorphic one in the universe of the site,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DescentSituation.exists_orderIso_of_lift_mk_lt`, along which the
situation is reindexed, and the case of an index set in that universe is
