    (hf : IsAffineHom T.site T.base T.containsBase f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} T.site T.base T.containsBase X'.1 X'.2)
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    have := enoughInjectives_modules T.site T.base T.containsBase X'.1 X'.2
    IsZero (((globalSectionsFunctor.{u + 1, u, u, u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
      (smallEtaleRingedSite T.site T.base T.containsBase X'.1 X'.2).O)).rightDerived 1).obj F)
declarations.comment: part (1); cohomology of modules at the universe of the structure sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isAffineHom_of_isPullback_toSpecGlobalFunctions
declarations.doc:
**The affineness assertion of clause (2) of Stacks 07V0.** Let `X` be as in Stacks 07UY, let
`A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`, and let `A'` be an `A`-algebra, presented by a morphism `q : W ⟶ V` of affine
objects of the site over the presentation of `Spec A`.  Then the projection
`X' = X ×_{Spec A} Spec A' ⟶ X` is affine.

A morphism of affine objects of the site is an affine morphism of algebraic spaces, and affine
morphisms are stable under base change, which is Stacks 03WI.
declarations.comment:
clause (2), the affineness assertion only: the projection
X ×_{Spec A} Spec A' → X is affine. The computation Γ(X', 𝒪_{X'}) = A' of the same clause is
NOT proved -- it needs the pushforward-computation assertion of Stacks 07U8, which the library's
form of that tag does not carry. See this file's implementation notes, and for clause (1) see
StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/CohomologyVanishingAffine.lean

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isAffineHom_and_bijective_of_isPullback_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers
declarations.doc:
**Clause (2) of Stacks 07V0.** Let `X` be as in Stacks 07UY, let `A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`, and let `A'`
be an `A`-algebra, presented by a morphism `q : W ⟶ V` of affine objects of the site over the
presentation `V` of `Spec A`.  Then the projection `X' = X ×_{Spec A} Spec A' ⟶ X` is affine and
the canonical map `A' = Γ(W, 𝒪_W) ⟶ Γ(X', 𝒪_{X'})` is a bijection.
declarations.comment: part (2); `Spec A'` is an affine object `W` of the site over the presentation `V` of `Spec A`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_sub_one_mem_vanishingIdeal_of_disjoint
declarations.doc:
**Two disjoint closed subsets of an affine scheme are separated by a global function.**
The vanishing ideals of the two sets are comaximal, because the support of their join is the
intersection of the two sets, so `1` is a sum `a + b` with `a` vanishing on the first set and
`b` on the second; then `a - 1 = -b` vanishes on the second.
declarations.comment: the conclusion for an affine scheme, with the two closed subsets taken in the scheme rather than in the points of an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.exists_subset_compl_sectionSupport_of_disjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V1 for an algebraic space.** In the situation of Stacks 07UY, two disjoint closed
subsets `Z₀, Z₁` of the points of `X` are separated by a global regular function: there is
`a ∈ A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` with `Z₀ ⊆ V(a)` and `Z₁ ⊆ V(a - 1)`. The vanishing locus `V(-)` is the
complement of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionSupport`, the set of points at which a global
function does not vanish.

The function is produced by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.exists_mem_definingIdealAt_and_sub_one_mem`
applied to the reduced closed subspaces of Stacks 03IQ on `Z₀`, on `Z₁` and on `Z₀ ∪ Z₁`. Its two
hypotheses are exactly the two statements about the defining ideal sheaves of reduced closed
subspaces proved in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/ReducedClosedSubspaceDefiningIdeal.lean`: the defining
ideals of the subspaces on two *disjoint* closed sets are comaximal on every affine chart, and the
defining ideal sheaves of the subspaces on `Z₀` and on `Z₁` meet in that of the subspace on
`Z₀ ∪ Z₁`. The passage from the resulting ideal memberships to the point-set conclusion is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.subset_compl_sectionSupport_of_forall_mem_definingIdealAt`.

The situation is one at the module universe of the structure sheaf — see the implementation
notes — because that is the form in which the lifting statement
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.surjective_sectionsMap_of_epi` is
available.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_subset_compl_sectionSupport_of_disjoint
    {Z₀ Z₁ : Set (points T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1)}
    (hZ₀ : IsClosed Z₀) (hZ₁ : IsClosed Z₁) (hdisj : Disjoint Z₀ Z₁) :
    ∃ a : _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Space.globalFunctions
        T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1,
      Z₀ ⊆ (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionSupport
          T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1 a)ᶜ ∧
        Z₁ ⊆ (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Space.sectionSupport
          T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1 (a - 1))ᶜ
declarations.comment: the conclusion for an algebraic space, with the cohomology-vanishing hypothesis of Situation 07UY imposed at the module universe of the structure sheaf rather than at a general module universe

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.pointsToScheme_pointsMap_toSpecGlobalFunctions_ne_of_isClosed_of_ne
declarations.doc:
**The canonical morphism to `Spec A` separates the closed points of `|X|`.** In the
situation of Stacks 07UY, two distinct closed points of `|X|` have distinct images in `Spec A`
under `p : X ⟶ Spec A`, where `Spec A` is presented by an affine object `V` of the site through
a ring isomorphism `Γ(V, 𝒪_V) ≅ A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.

Stacks 07V1 supplies `a ∈ A` vanishing at the first point and taking the value `1` at the
second; if the two images agreed, that point of `Spec A` would lie in neither the nonvanishing
locus of `a` nor that of `a - 1`, which no point of a scheme does.
declarations.statement:
theorem pointsToScheme_pointsMap_toSpecGlobalFunctions_ne_of_isClosed_of_ne
    {x y : points T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1}
    (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set (points T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1)))
    (hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set (points T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1)))
    (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    pointsToScheme T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase V
        (pointsMap T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1
          (toSpecGlobalFunctions T' hterminal V e).hom x) ≠
      pointsToScheme T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase V
        (pointsMap T'.site T'.base T'.containsBase T'.space.1
          (toSpecGlobalFunctions T' hterminal V e).hom y)
declarations.comment: the final step of the source proof only: in Situation 07UY the morphism p : X -> Spec A separates the closed points of |X|, two distinct closed points of |X| having distinct images. Universal injectivity of p, which is the assertion of the tag, is NOT proved by this declaration, and neither is injectivity of p on all of |X|; see universallyInjective_toSpecGlobalFunctions in this same file, which does state universal injectivity and carries the two steps that are missing. The source reaches universal injectivity from this step by three reductions, none of them available in this development. Clause (2) of Stacks 07V0 reduces to the case of a field A, but its library form -- isAffineHom_of_isPullback_toSpecGlobalFunctions -- carries the affineness assertion only and not the computation Gamma(X', O_X') = A' that the reduction needs. Stacks 0488 then replaces the field by a large algebraically closed extension and Stacks 07U5 makes the resulting field-valued points closed points of |X|, but the library's 07U5 -- isClosed_singleton_class_of_isAlgebraic_residueField -- requires the field of the point to be algebraic over the residue field at a closed point of the base, which is exactly what the first reduction would have arranged. And the source's passage from one point of |X| to one field-valued point of X is left implicit there. IsTerminal T'.base, the affine object V and the isomorphism e are inherited from the signature of toSpecGlobalFunctions, as for the neighbouring Stacks 07V5

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.universallyInjective_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V4.** In the situation of Stacks 07UY, over an arbitrary base scheme `S`, the
canonical morphism `p : X ⟶ Spec A` is universally injective.  As in the source, `p` is the
morphism of Stacks 05Z1 formed after regarding `X` as an algebraic space over `Spec ℤ`, and
`Spec A` is presented by an affine object `V` of the site through a ring isomorphism
`Γ(V, 𝒪_V) ≅ A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.

The view of `X` over `Spec ℤ` has the same small étale ringed site, hence the same global
functions and right exact global sections, and it is quasi-compact and quasi-separated; the
statement is then
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyInjective_of_surjective_pullbackToGlobalFunctions`.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyInjective_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers :
    _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Space.UniversallyInjective T.site (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) T.containsTerminal
      (toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers T V e).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isSeparated_toSpecGlobalFunctions
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V5.** In the situation of Stacks 07UY, the canonical morphism
`p : X ⟶ Spec Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` is separated, `Spec Γ(X, 𝒪_X)` being presented by an affine object `V`
of the site through a ring isomorphism `Γ(V, 𝒪_V) ≅ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.

`X` is a separated algebraic space,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isAbsolutelySeparated`, so it is separated
over the base, and a morphism out of a space separated over the base is separated: `p` followed
by the morphism to the terminal presheaf is the structure morphism of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_toSpecGlobalFunctions :
    IsSeparated T.site T.base T.containsBase
      (toSpecGlobalFunctions T hterminal V e).hom
declarations.comment:
the situation is taken at the module universe of the structure sheaf; the base
of the situation is the terminal scheme, as the canonical morphism toSpecGlobalFunctions is
formed over it; over an arbitrary base see isSeparated_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isSeparated_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V5.** In the situation of Stacks 07UY, over an arbitrary base scheme `S`, the
canonical morphism `p : X ⟶ Spec A` is separated.  As in the source, `p` is the morphism of
Stacks 05Z1 formed after regarding `X` as an algebraic space over `Spec ℤ`, and `Spec A` is
presented by an affine object `V` of the site through a ring isomorphism
`Γ(V, 𝒪_V) ≅ A = Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`.

The view of `X` over `Spec ℤ` has right exact global sections on quasi-coherent modules and is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and every global function on it is pulled back along `p`;
the statement is then
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_surjective_pullbackToGlobalFunctions`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers :
    IsSeparated T.site (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) T.containsTerminal
      (toSpecGlobalFunctionsOverIntegers T V e).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologyVanishingSituation.isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V6, more precisely.** An algebraic space in the situation of Stacks 07UY is an
affine scheme: it is represented by an object of the site over the base whose underlying scheme
is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineSpace (T : CohomologyVanishingSituation.{u, u}) :
    IsAffineSpace T.site T.base T.containsBase T.space.1
declarations.comment: more precisely: an algebraic space as in Situation 07UY is an affine scheme

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineSpace_iff_forall_isZero_rightDerived
registrations.comment: first sentence: a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space is affine iff the higher cohomology of its quasi-coherent modules vanishes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finitePresentationModule_isColimit_of_isLimit_of_baseChangeLimits
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V7.** Let `X = lim X_i` be the limit of a cofiltered inverse system of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms:
`X = c.pt` for a cone `c` over the system that is limiting in presheaves on the big fppf site of
`S`, the affine charts `X_j ×_{X_i} U` of the system having their limits, in schemes, inside the
site (the chapter's convention, Stacks 07SD). Then `X` is an algebraic space
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_conePt_of_isLimit`, Stacks 07SF), and the category of
finitely presented `𝒪_X`-modules is the colimit of the categories of finitely presented
`𝒪_{X_i}`-modules: inverse image along the projections `X ⟶ X_i` is

1. faithful in the colimit sense: two morphisms on a stage with equal inverse images to `X` have
   equal inverse images to a later stage;
2. full in the colimit sense: a morphism between inverse images to `X` is, at a later stage, the
   restriction along `X ⟶ X_j` of a morphism between the inverse images to `X_j`;
3. essentially surjective in the colimit sense: every finitely presented `𝒪_X`-module is the
   inverse image of a finitely presented module on some stage.

The index category is any cofiltered category in the universe of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem finitePresentationModule_isColimit_of_isLimit_of_baseChangeLimits
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hQc : ∀ i, IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hQs : ∀ i, IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ (D.obj i))
    (hc : IsLimit c) (hL : SiteContainsBaseChangeLimits B S hS D) :
    let hX := isAlgebraicSpace_conePt_of_isLimit B S hS D hD c hAffine hQc hc hL
    (∀ (i : I) (M N : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).1
        (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).2),
      M.IsFinitePresentationOnSite → N.IsFinitePresentationOnSite → ∀ φ ψ : M ⟶ N,
        (modulePullback B S hS (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX i)).map φ =
          (modulePullback B S hS (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX i)).map ψ →
        ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i),
          (modulePullback B S hS (stageTransition B S hS D hD e)).map φ =
            (modulePullback B S hS (stageTransition B S hS D hD e)).map ψ) ∧
    (∀ (i : I) (M N : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).1
        (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD i).2),
      M.IsFinitePresentationOnSite → N.IsFinitePresentationOnSite →
      ∀ φ : (modulePullback B S hS (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX i)).obj M ⟶
        (modulePullback B S hS (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX i)).obj N,
        ∃ (j : I) (e : j ⟶ i)
          (ψ : (modulePullback B S hS (stageTransition B S hS D hD e)).obj M ⟶
            (modulePullback B S hS (stageTransition B S hS D hD e)).obj N),
          moduleHomRestrict M N (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX j)
            (stageTransition B S hS D hD e) (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX i)
            (coneProjection_comp B S hS D hD c hX e) ψ = φ) ∧
    (∀ P : Modules.{u, u} B S hS c.pt hX, P.IsFinitePresentationOnSite →
        ∃ (k : I) (Q : Modules.{u, u} B S hS (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD k).1
            (stageAlgebraicSpace B S hS D hD k).2),
          Q.IsFinitePresentationOnSite ∧
            Nonempty (P ≅ (modulePullback B S hS (coneProjection B S hS D hD c hX k)).obj Q))
declarations.comment: the category of finitely presented modules on the limit is the colimit of the categories of finitely presented modules on the stages: faithfulness, fullness through the canonical identification of iterated inverse images, and essential surjectivity of the comparison; for any limiting cone over the system, its cone point being an algebraic space by Stacks 07SF, indexed by any cofiltered category in the universe of the site, under the chapter's standing convention 07SD that the limits of its affine charts lie in the site; without that convention the statement fails in a size-bounded site (see the notes of ChartLimitsInSite)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isFilteredColimit_isFinitePresentationOnSite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V9.**  Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over a scheme
`S`.  Then every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F` is a filtered colimit of `𝒪_X`-modules of
finite presentation: there is a small filtered category `I`, a diagram `D` of `𝒪_X`-modules of
finite presentation indexed by it and a colimit cocone on `D` with vertex `F`.

The hypotheses are the source's.  The proof does not use absolute Noetherian approximation; it
follows the route the source indicates, through the filtration of Decent Spaces, Lemma 07ST, in
the form of the induction principle of Stacks 08GP.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isFinitePresentationOnSite
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X) (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (inst : SmallCategory I),
      let _ := inst
      ∃ (_ : IsFiltered I) (D : I ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
        (φ : D ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj F),
        (∀ i, (D.obj i).IsFinitePresentationOnSite) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F φ))
declarations.comment: with a small filtered index category and finite presentation in the on-site rendering of Stacks 03DL(7)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isFilteredColimit_isFinitePresentation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07V9**, in the conclusion shape of the conditional statement
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFilteredColimit_isFinitePresentation_of_isQuasiCompactSpace` (an index
category with objects in `Type (u + 1)` and morphisms in `Type u`, finite presentation in the
sense of Mathlib's `SheafOfModules.IsFinitePresentation`), with none of its carried inputs.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isFilteredColimit_isFinitePresentation
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X) (hqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS hZ X)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    ∃ (K : Type (u + 1)) (inst : Category.{u} K),
      let _ := inst
      ∃ (_ : IsFiltered K) (D : K ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X hX)
        (φ : D ⟶ (Functor.const K).obj F),
        (∀ k, (D.obj k).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk F φ))
declarations.comment: in the rendering by Mathlib's finite presentation predicate

declarations.name: finite_fibre_connectedComponents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VB.** If `f : X → Y` is a continuous open and closed map between nonempty
topological spaces, `Y` is connected, and some fibre `f ⁻¹' {y}` is finite, then `X` has finitely
many connected components and their number is at most the cardinality of the fibre.
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_fibre_connectedComponents
    {X Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
    (f : X → Y)
    (hY_conn : ConnectedSpace Y)
    (hf_open : IsOpenMap f) (hf_closed : IsClosedMap f)
    (y : Y) (hy_fin : (f ⁻¹' {y}).Finite) :
    Finite (ConnectedComponents X) ∧
      Nat.card (ConnectedComponents X) ≤ (f ⁻¹' {y}).ncard

declarations.name: connectedComponent_clopen_and_image_eq_univ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VB**, corollary. Under the hypotheses of `finite_fibre_connectedComponents`, every
connected component `T` of `X` is open and closed in `X`, its image `f '' T` is a nonempty open and
closed subset of `Y`, and hence equals all of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem connectedComponent_clopen_and_image_eq_univ
    {X Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
    (f : X → Y)
    (hY_conn : ConnectedSpace Y)
    (hf_open : IsOpenMap f) (hf_closed : IsClosedMap f)
    (y : Y) (hy_fin : (f ⁻¹' {y}).Finite)
    (T : Set X) (hT : ∃ x : X, T = connectedComponent x) :
    IsOpen T ∧ IsClosed T ∧ (f '' T).Nonempty ∧ IsOpen (f '' T) ∧
      IsClosed (f '' T) ∧ f '' T = Set.univ
declarations.comment: corollary

declarations.name: NaiveCotangent.towerChainMap_homotopic_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VC.** The composition `NL_{B/A} ⟶ NL_{C/A} ⟶ NL_{C/B}` of the two
functoriality maps of the naive cotangent complex is homotopic to the zero chain map.
declarations.statement:
public theorem towerChainMap_homotopic_zero :
    Homotopic (towerChainMap A B C)
      (ChainMap.zero (nlRestrict B (Generators.self A B))
        (nlRestrict B (Generators.self B C)))
declarations.comment: the composition is homotopy equivalent to zero

declarations.name: NaiveCotangent.towerNullHomotopy_spec
declarations.doc:
The two homotopy relations satisfied by `towerNullHomotopy`: it is a null homotopy of the
composition `NL_{B/A} ⟶ NL_{C/A} ⟶ NL_{C/B}`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem towerNullHomotopy_spec :
    (towerChainMap A B C).f₁ = towerNullHomotopy A B C ∘ₗ
        (nlRestrict B (Generators.self A B)).d ∧
      (towerChainMap A B C).f₀ =
        (nlRestrict B (Generators.self B C)).d ∘ₗ towerNullHomotopy A B C
declarations.comment: the displayed map is an explicit homotopy

declarations.name: NaiveCotangent.towerNullHomotopy_cotangentSpaceBasis
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VC.** The homotopy sends the basis element `d[b]` of
`Ω_{A[B]/A} ⊗_{A[B]} B` to the class of `[φ(b)] - b` in `J/J²`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem towerNullHomotopy_cotangentSpaceBasis (b : B) :
    towerNullHomotopy A B C ((Generators.self A B).cotangentSpaceBasis b) =
      Extension.Cotangent.mk
        ⟨X (algebraMap B C b) - MvPolynomial.C b, X_sub_C_mem_ker B C b⟩
declarations.comment: the value of the homotopy on the basis element d[b]

declarations.name: artinRees_stability
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VE**.
Let `A` be Noetherian and `I ⊆ rad(A)`. Let `L --f--> M --g--> N` and `L --f'--> M --g'--> N` be
two complexes of `A`-modules with `M` finite, and `c ≥ 0` such that `c` works for `f` and `g` in
the Artin-Rees lemma, the first complex is exact, `f' ≡ f (mod I^{c+1})` and
`g' ≡ g (mod I^{c+1})`. Then `c` works for `g'` in the Artin-Rees lemma and the second complex
is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem artinRees_stability {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I ≤ (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson) {L M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup L] [AddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A L] [Module A M] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A M]
    (f f' : L →ₗ[A] M) (g g' : M →ₗ[A] N) (c : ℕ) (hS'c : g'.comp f' = 0)
    (hf : IsArtinReesConstant I f c) (hg : IsArtinReesConstant I g c)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker g = LinearMap.range f)
    (hff' : CongruentModPow I f f' (c + 1)) (hgg' : CongruentModPow I g g' (c + 1)) :
    IsArtinReesConstant I g' c ∧ LinearMap.ker g' = LinearMap.range f'

declarations.name: associatedGraded_coker_equiv_of_congr
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VF.** With the hypotheses of `artinRees_stability`, the cokernels of the two
nearby maps `g` and `g'` have isomorphic associated graded modules over the associated graded
ring of `I`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def associatedGraded_coker_equiv_of_congr
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (hI : I ≤ (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson)
    {L : Type v} {M : Type w} {N : Type x}
    [AddCommGroup L] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module A L] [Module A M] [Module A N]
    [Module.Finite A L] [Module.Finite A M] [Module.Finite A N]
    (f : L →ₗ[A] M) (g : M →ₗ[A] N) (f' : L →ₗ[A] M) (g' : M →ₗ[A] N)
    (c : ℕ)
    (hS'c : g'.comp f' = 0)
    (hf : IsArtinReesConstant I f c) (hg : IsArtinReesConstant I g c)
    (hexact : LinearMap.ker g = LinearMap.range f)
    (hff' : CongruentModPow I f f' (c + 1)) (hgg' : CongruentModPow I g g' (c + 1)) :
    AssociatedGraded.GradedLinearEquiv I
      (N ⧸ LinearMap.range g) (N ⧸ LinearMap.range g')

declarations.name: artinRees_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VG**.
Let `A → B` be a flat ring homomorphism, `I ⊆ A` an ideal, and `f : M → N` a map of `A`-modules.
If `c` works for `f` in the Artin-Rees lemma with respect to `I`, then `c` works for the base
change `B ⊗[A] M → B ⊗[A] N` with respect to the ideal `IB`.
declarations.statement:
theorem artinRees_baseChange {A : Type*} (B : Type*) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.Flat A B] (I : Ideal A) {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module A M] [Module A N] (f : M →ₗ[A] N) (c : ℕ)
    (hf : IsArtinReesConstant I f c) :
    IsArtinReesConstant (Ideal.map (algebraMap A B) I) (LinearMap.baseChange B f) c

declarations.name: smoothAt_iff_formallySmoothNAdic_localization
declarations.doc:
Let `A → B` be a finite type map with `A` Noetherian, and let the prime
`q ⊆ B` lie over the prime `p ⊆ A`. Then the map is smooth at `q` if and
only if the canonical local map `A_p → B_q` is formally smooth for the
maximal-ideal-adic topology on `B_q`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem smoothAt_iff_formallySmoothNAdic_localization.{u, v}
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra.FiniteType A B]
    (p : Ideal A) (q : Ideal B) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] :
    Algebra.SmoothAt A B q ↔
      RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max u v, u, v}
        (@algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) _ _
          (Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver p q))
        (maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPerfect_derivedDual_and_naturalIsos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VI.** Let `A` be a ring and let `K` be a perfect object of `D(A)`. Then the derived
dual `Kᵛ = RHom_A(K, A)` is perfect, the canonical morphism `K ⟶ (Kᵛ)ᵛ` is an isomorphism, the
canonical comparison `L ⊗_A^L Kᵛ ⟶ RHom_A(K, L)` is an isomorphism functorially in `L`, and
`H⁰(L ⊗_A^L Kᵛ) = Ext⁰_A(K, L)` functorially in `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_derivedDual_and_naturalIsos
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (ULift.{v} R))) (hK : IsPerfect K) :
    PerfectDerivedDuality K

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperFlatGlobalSections.isPerfect_derivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07VK] (1).** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f : X ⟶ Spec A` be proper and
let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `Spec A`. Then `RΓ(X, F)` is a perfect object of
`D(A)`.

The proof is the source's. Properness makes `X` quasi-compact, so the affine open cover of `X` has
a finite subcover `𝒰`; properness also makes `f` separated, so the finite intersections of members
of `𝒰` are affine. The alternating Čech complex of `𝒰` therefore computes `RΓ(X, F)`
([Stacks, Tag 01FM] and [Stacks, Tag 01ET]), is bounded, and is termwise flat over `A`
([Stacks, Tag 01U4]) — which is finite Tor dimension. Its cohomology modules are finite over `A`,
which is [Stacks, Tag 02O6], so it is pseudo-coherent ([Stacks, Tag 066E]); [Stacks, Tag 0658]
concludes.

**Unconditional.** The finiteness input — the affine-base case of [Stacks, Tag 02O5], carried
through the lemmas above as the `Prop`
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherentImage.HigherDirectImageIsCoherentOverAffineBase` — is supplied
here by `AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherentOverAffineBase`, the
hypothesis-free form of that tag. The finite-Tor-dimension half,
`hasFlatRepresentative_derivedGlobalSectionsOverBase`, never needed it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_derivedGlobalSections [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsProper f] [F.IsCoherent]
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (derivedGlobalSectionsOverBase f F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperFlatGlobalSections.isPerfect_and_isIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07VK].** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring, let `f : X ⟶ Spec A` be a proper
morphism of schemes and let `F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `Spec A`. Then

1. `RΓ(X, F)` is a perfect object of `D(A)`, and
2. for every ring map `φ : A ⟶ A'` and every cartesian square exhibiting `X'` (with
   `g : X' ⟶ X` and `f' : X' ⟶ Spec A'`) as `X_{A'} = X ×_{Spec A} Spec A'`, the base change of
   `RΓ(X, F)` to `A'` is `RΓ(X', g^* F)`:
   * the canonical base-change map `L(Spec φ)^* Rf_* F ⟶ Rf'_* g^* F` (the map of
     [Stacks, Tag 08HY] followed by `Rf'_*` of `L(g)^* F ⟶ g^* F`) is an isomorphism, and
   * for every finite affine open cover `U` of `X` with affine finite intersections, the
     base-change map `RΓ(X, F) ⊗^L_A A' ⟶ RΓ(X', g^* F)` in `D(A')` computed on the alternating
     Čech complex of `U`, `derivedGlobalSectionsBaseChangeMap`, is an isomorphism.

The proof is the source's: the alternating Čech complex of a finite affine cover computes
`RΓ(X, F)`, is bounded and termwise flat over `A`, and has finite cohomology modules, which gives
clause (1) by [Stacks, Tag 0658] and the Čech form of clause (2) because derived and ordinary
extension of scalars agree on it ([Stacks, Tag 06XY]).
declarations.statement:
theorem isPerfect_and_isIso_baseChange [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsProper f] [F.IsCoherent]
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (derivedGlobalSectionsOverBase f F) ∧
      ∀ {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') {X' : Scheme.{u}}
        {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {g : X' ⟶ X}
        (hsq : IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))),
        IsIso (derivedBaseChangeComp f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) f' g hsq.w
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (singleDegreeComplex F))
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              ((pullbackComplex g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (singleDegreeComplex F)))
            ((derivedPullbackNatTrans g.toLRSHom.toShHom).app (singleDegreeComplex F))) ∧
          ∀ {I : Type u} [Finite I] [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens)
            (hU : (⊤ : X.Opens) = ⨆ i, U i) (hUaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
            (haff : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin (r + 1) → I), IsAffineOpen (⨅ k, U (s k))),
            haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent :=
              (CoherentTFAE.isQuasicoherent_isFiniteType_of_isCoherent F).1
            IsIso (derivedGlobalSectionsBaseChangeMap φ hsq F U hU hUaff haff)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperFlatGlobalSections.exists_finiteProjectiveModel_homology_iso_functorial
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 07VL], Remark 30.22.2, both clauses.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring,
`f : X ⟶ Spec A` a proper morphism of schemes and `F` a coherent `𝒪_X`-module flat over `A`. Then
there is a bounded complex `M` of finite projective `A`-modules, a finite affine open cover of `X`
whose finite intersections are affine, and a family of chain-level comparisons

`Θ(φ, square) : M ⊗_A A' ⟶ Č_alt(g⁻¹U, g^* F)`

indexed by a ring map `φ : A ⟶ A'` and a cartesian square exhibiting `X'` as the base change of
`X` along `Spec A' ⟶ Spec A`, together with a family of identifications

`c(φ, square, i) : Hⁱ(X', g^* F) ≅ Hⁱ(M ⊗_A A')`

indexed also by the degree, such that

* every `Θ(φ, square)` is a quasi-isomorphism;
* `c(φ, square, i)` is the identification `Θ(φ, square)` induces on homology, so the family has a
  single origin over `A` and is not a choice per `A'`;
* **the comparisons are functorial in `A'`**: for a second ring map `ψ : A' ⟶ A''` and a second
  cartesian square, the extension of scalars along `ψ` of `Θ(φ, square)`, followed by the Čech
  base-change isomorphism for `ψ` and by the identification of the model of `g'^* (g^* F)` with
  that of `(g' ≫ g)^* F`, is `Θ(ψ ∘ φ, pasted square)` read through
  `(M ⊗_A A') ⊗_{A'} A'' ≅ M ⊗_A A''`.

The conditions are exactly the source's. Separatedness and quasi-coherence follow:
properness gives the first and coherence the second. The cover is not an input either — it is
bound inside the existential and produced by `exists_finiteAffineCover_of_isProper` — so the
statement is about `f` and `F` alone.

The source's closing sentence, that flatness of `F` over `A` is essential with a reference to
Hartshorne, has been ruled remark-level: it is a citation rather than a clause owing a theorem,
and the module docstring records it as such.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_finiteProjectiveModel_homology_iso_functorial [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsProper f]
    [F.IsCoherent] (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) :
    haveI : F.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent F
    ∃ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
      M.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ M.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (M.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (M.X i)) ∧
        ∃ (I : Type u) (hIfin : Finite I) (hIlin : LinearOrder I) (U : I → X.Opens)
          (hU : (⊤ : X.Opens) = ⨆ i, U i) (hUaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)),
          haveI : Finite I := hIfin
          letI : LinearOrder I := hIlin
          ∃ (_haff : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin (r + 1) → I), IsAffineOpen (⨅ k, U (s k)))
            (Θ : ∀ {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') {X' : Scheme.{u}}
                {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {g : X' ⟶ X},
                IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) →
                  (extendScalarsComplex φ M ⟶
                    baseAlternatingCechComplex f' (fun j => g ⁻¹ᵁ U j)
                      (top_eq_iSup_preimage g U hU) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F)))
            (c : ∀ {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') {X' : Scheme.{u}}
                {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {g : X' ⟶ X}
                (_hsq : IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) (i : ℤ),
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A') i).obj
                    (derivedGlobalSectionsOverBase f' ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F)) ≅
                  (extendScalarsComplex φ M).homology i)),
            (∀ {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') {X' : Scheme.{u}}
                {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {g : X' ⟶ X}
                (hsq : IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))),
                QuasiIso (Θ φ hsq)) ∧
              (∀ {A' : Type u} [CommRing A'] (φ : A →+* A') {X' : Scheme.{u}}
                  {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {g : X' ⟶ X}
                  (hsq : IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))) (i : ℤ),
                  (c φ hsq i).inv =
                    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} A') i).inv.app
                        (extendScalarsComplex φ M) ≫
                      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A') i).map
                        (DerivedCategory.Q.map (Θ φ hsq) ≫
                          (alternatingCechIsoDerivedGlobalSectionsOverBase f'
                            (fun j => g ⁻¹ᵁ U j) (top_eq_iSup_preimage g U hU)
                            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F)
                            (iInf_preimage_isAffineOpen φ hsq U hUaff)).hom)) ∧
              (∀ {A' A'' : Type u} [CommRing A'] [CommRing A''] (φ : A →+* A') (ψ : A' →+* A'')
                  {X' X'' : Scheme.{u}} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of A')} {f'' : X'' ⟶ Spec (.of A'')}
                  {g : X' ⟶ X} {g' : X'' ⟶ X'}
                  (hsq : IsPullback g f' f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)))
                  (hsq' : IsPullback g' f'' f' (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ))),
                  haveI : IsSeparated f' := isSeparated_of_isPullback φ hsq
                  ((ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} ψ).mapHomologicalComplex
                          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (Θ φ hsq) ≫
                      (baseAlternatingCechComplexBaseChangeIso ψ hsq'
                          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj F) (fun j => g ⁻¹ᵁ U j)
                          (top_eq_iSup_preimage g U hU)
                          (isAffineOpen_preimage φ hsq U hUaff)).hom ≫
                      (baseAlternatingCechComplexMapIso f'' (fun j => (g' ≫ g) ⁻¹ᵁ U j)
                        (top_eq_iSup_preimage (g' ≫ g) U hU)
                        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' g).app F)).hom =
                    (extendScalarsComplexCompIso φ ψ).hom.app M ≫
                      Θ (ψ.comp φ)
                        (Stacks.Cech.isPullback_comp_specMap φ ψ f f' f'' g g' hsq hsq'))
declarations.comment: Remark 30.22.2 in full: one bounded complex M of finite projective A-modules, the identification H^i(X_{A'}, F_{A'}) = H^i(M ⊗_A A') for every base change given as a family of isomorphisms indexed by the ring map, the cartesian square and the degree and pinned to the single chain-level model over A, and the functoriality in A' as the cocycle square for a second base change A' ⟶ A''; under exactly the source's conditions — A Noetherian, f proper, F coherent and flat over A — with the finite affine cover bound inside the existential and supplied by properness. The closing citation to Hartshorne that flatness is essential is remark-level and appears as documentation in the module docstring.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.baseChange_image_connectedComponent_eq_connectedComponent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07VM.** Let `K/k` be a finite extension of fields and let `X` be a
scheme over `k`. The projection `X_K → X` sends every connected component of `X_K` onto a
connected component of `X`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem baseChange_image_connectedComponent_eq_connectedComponent
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [FiniteDimensional k K]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (t : ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))) :
    (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base ''
        connectedComponent t =
      connectedComponent
        ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base t)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_integralFiniteSystem_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VR.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite morphism of algebraic
spaces over `S`, with `Y` quasi-compact and quasi-separated.  Then `X` is the limit of a directed
inverse system of algebraic spaces `X_i`, finite and of finite presentation over `Y`, whose
transition morphisms are closed immersions.

The direct-image algebra `f_* 𝒪_X` is a finite quasi-coherent `𝒪_Y`-algebra
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_pushforwardAlgebra_of_isFinite`); Stacks 086Z
(`Space.exists_directed_isFinite_isFinitePresentation_locallySurjective_of_isFinite`)
writes it as a directed colimit of finite algebras of finite presentation with surjective
transition maps; and `X_i = \underline{Spec}_Y(𝒜_i)` is the limit presentation by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_integralFiniteSystem_of_isFinite_of_presentation`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_integralFiniteSystem_of_isFinite {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hfin : IsFinite B S hS f)
    (hYqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y)
    (hYqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal Y) :
    ∃ s : IntegralFiniteSystem B S hS f,
      letI := s.indexPreorder
      ∀ (i j : s.indexType) (h : i ≤ j),
        IsClosedImmersion B S hS (s.diagram.map (homOfLE h).op)
declarations.comment: finite X ⟶ Y, Y qcqs: X = lim of finite f.p. X_i ⟶ Y, closed immersion transitions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineSpace_target_of_isFinite_of_isSurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VS.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S`. Assume that `f` is surjective and finite, and that `X` is affine. Then `Y` is affine.

The proof is the source's. `Y` is separated by Stacks 05Z2 and quasi-compact, `X` being so. By
Stacks 07VR, `X` is the limit of a directed system of algebraic spaces `X_a`, finite and of finite
presentation over `Y`, with closed immersions as transition morphisms; such a system satisfies the
chapter's convention (tag 07SD), its transition morphisms being monomorphisms, so by Stacks 07SQ
some `X_a` is affine. As `f` factors through `X_a ⟶ Y`, the latter is surjective, and the case of a
morphism of finite presentation,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineSpace_of_isFinite_of_isFinitePresentation_of_isSurjective`, which
runs through Stacks 07SU, 07SK, 084Z, 07SN, 07SQ and 07VP, concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineSpace_target_of_isFinite_of_isSurjective
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hfin : IsFinite B S hS f)
    (haff : IsAffineSpace B S hS X) :
    IsAffineSpace B S hS Y
declarations.comment: the target of a finite surjection from an affine algebraic space is affine

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAffineSpace_of_isSurjective_of_universallyClosed_of_isAffineSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VT.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S`. Assume that `X` is affine and that `f` is surjective and universally closed. Then `Y` is
affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineSpace_of_isSurjective_of_universallyClosed_of_isAffineSpace (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f) (hclosed : UniversallyClosed B S hS f)
    (haff : IsAffineSpace B S hS X) :
    IsAffineSpace B S hS Y
declarations.comment: target of a universally closed surjection from an affine algebraic space is affine

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.isRepresentable_of_isRepresentable_reduction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 049D, Stacks 07VU.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `X` be an algebraic space over
`S`. If `X_red` is a scheme, then `X` is a scheme.

The inclusion of the reduction is a closed immersion bijective on points, so
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_isClosedImmersion_of_bijective` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_of_isRepresentable_reduction {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hred : (reduction B S hS X hX).toFunctor.IsRepresentable) :
    X.IsRepresentable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_iff_isRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom_of_bijective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VV.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S`. Assume `f` is integral and induces a bijection `|X| → |Y|`. Then `X` is a scheme if
and only if `Y` is a scheme.

The implication from the source is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_target_of_isIntegralHom_of_bijective`, through Stacks
07VT, and the implication from the target is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom`, which needs no bijectivity.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRepresentable_iff_isRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom_of_bijective
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G) (f : F ⟶ G)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f) (hbij : Function.Bijective (pointsMap B S hS F f)) :
    F.IsRepresentable ↔ G.IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: for an integral morphism of algebraic spaces bijective on points, the source is a scheme if and only if the target is

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, the base-change functor on the étale schemes.** For an integral morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`, base change `V ↦ X ×_Y V` carries the small étale
site of `Y` to that of `X`.

It is the restriction of base change on the spaces-étale sites along the fully faithful
comparison functors of Stacks 03G1 — see
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackComparisonIso` — which exists because the base change
of a scheme étale over `Y` is a scheme, by the implication of Stacks 07VV from the target.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtalePullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) :
    SmallEtale B S hS Y.1 ⥤ SmallEtale B S hS X.1
declarations.comment: the base-change functor on the étale schemes, which needs only integrality of `f`; the two equivalences are stated separately

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackComparisonIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, canonicity of the base-change functor on the étale schemes.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullback` is the restriction of base change on the
spaces-étale sites: composing it with the comparison functor of `X` recovers base change applied
to the comparison functor of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def smallEtalePullbackComparisonIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) :
    smallEtalePullback B S hS f hf ⋙ comparisonFunctor B S hS X ≅
      comparisonFunctor B S hS Y ⋙ (spacesBaseChange B S hS f).functor
declarations.comment: the restriction to the étale schemes is the spaces-étale base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineEtalePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, the base-change functor on the affine étale schemes.** For an integral
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S`, base change `V ↦ X ×_Y V` carries the affine
étale site of `Y` to that of `X`: a base change of an affine chart is affine, because the
projection is integral and an integral morphism with affine target has affine source.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def affineEtalePullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) :
    AffineEtale B S hS Y.1 ⥤ AffineEtale B S hS X.1
declarations.comment: the base-change functor on the affine étale schemes, which needs only integrality of `f`; the two equivalences are stated separately

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineEtalePullbackInclusionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, canonicity of the base-change functor on the affine étale schemes.**
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineEtalePullback` is the restriction of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullback` to the affine charts.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def affineEtalePullbackInclusionIso (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) :
    affineEtalePullback B S hS f hf ⋙ AffineEtale.inclusion B S hS X.1 ≅
      AffineEtale.inclusion B S hS Y.1 ⋙ smallEtalePullback B S hS f hf
declarations.comment: the restriction to the affine étale schemes is the small étale base change

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_smallEtalePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, on the étale schemes.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an integral, universally injective
and surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`. Then base change `V ↦ X ×_Y V` is an
equivalence from the small étale site of `Y` to that of `X`; it is the restriction of the
equivalence of Stacks 05ZH on the spaces-étale sites
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackComparisonIso`).

The equivalence of Stacks 05ZH restricts along the fully faithful comparison functors of Stacks
03G1 because, for `V` étale over `Y`, `V` is a scheme exactly when `X ×_Y V` is: the projection
`X ×_Y V ⟶ V` is integral and bijective on points, so Stacks 07VV applies in both directions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_smallEtalePullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom)
    (hinj : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom) :
    (smallEtalePullback B S hS f hf).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the equivalence `Y_étale ⟶ X_étale` of small étale sites, the restriction of the equivalence of Stacks 05ZH on spaces-étale sites (that it is the restriction is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackComparisonIso`)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isEquivalence_affineEtalePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VW, on the affine étale schemes.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an integral, universally
injective and surjective morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`. Then base change `V ↦ X ×_Y V` is
an equivalence from the affine étale site of `Y` to that of `X`; it is the restriction of the
equivalence on the small étale sites (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineEtalePullbackInclusionIso`).

For `V` étale over `Y` and a scheme, `V` is affine exactly when `X ×_Y V` is: the projection is
integral, so an affine `V` has affine base change, and it is surjective and universally closed,
so an affine base change forces `V` affine by Stacks 07VT.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_affineEtalePullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom)
    (hinj : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS f.hom) :
    (affineEtalePullback B S hS f hf).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the equivalence `Y_affine,étale ⟶ X_affine,étale` of affine étale sites, the restriction of the equivalence on the small étale sites (that it is the restriction is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affineEtalePullbackInclusionIso`)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_hasPushout_isThickeningHom_inr_isPullback_appTop
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VX.**  Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening and `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism of
algebraic spaces over `S`.  Then

1. there is a pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` in the category of algebraic spaces over `S`;
2. `Y ⟶ Y'` is a thickening, so `Y'` is a thickening of `Y`;
3. `𝒪_{Y'} = 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}` as sheaves on `Y_étale = (Y')_étale`, evaluated on each
   of its objects: for a scheme `W` étale over `Y'` with base changes `W₁` to `X'`, `W₂` to `Y`
   and `W₀` to `X`, the ring `Γ(W, 𝒪)` is the fibre product of `Γ(W₂, 𝒪)` and `Γ(W₁, 𝒪)` over
   `Γ(W₀, 𝒪)`.

The objects of the small étale site of `Y'` are the schemes étale over `Y'`, and the sections over
`W` of `𝒪_Y`, `f_*𝒪_X` and `f'_*𝒪_{X'}` are the rings of functions on `W₂`, `W₀` and `W₁`.  Limits
of sheaves are computed objectwise, so the objectwise statement (3) is the equality of sheaves of
the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_hasPushout_isThickeningHom_inr_isPullback_appTop
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) :
    ∃ _ : HasPushout i f,
      IsThickeningHom B S hS (pushout.inr i f) ∧
      ∀ {W W₁ W₂ W₀ : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ (pushout i f).1)
        (_hwE : IsEtale B S hS w)
        {u₁ : W₁ ⟶ W} {p₁ : yoneda.obj W₁ ⟶ X'.1}
        (_h₁ : IsPullback (yoneda.map u₁) p₁ w (pushout.inl i f).hom)
        {u₂ : W₂ ⟶ W} {p₂ : yoneda.obj W₂ ⟶ Y.1}
        (_h₂ : IsPullback (yoneda.map u₂) p₂ w (pushout.inr i f).hom)
        {iW : W₀ ⟶ W₁} {fW : W₀ ⟶ W₂} {p₀ : yoneda.obj W₀ ⟶ X.1}
        (_h₀₁ : IsPullback (yoneda.map iW) p₀ p₁ i.hom)
        (_h₀₂ : IsPullback (yoneda.map fW) p₀ p₂ f.hom)
        (hw₀ : iW ≫ u₁ = fW ≫ u₂),
        let Φ := BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS
        IsPullback ((Φ.map u₂).app ⊤) ((Φ.map u₁).app ⊤) ((Φ.map fW).app ((Φ.map u₂) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤))
          ((Φ.map iW).app ((Φ.map u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun O ↦ Γ(Φ.obj W₀, O))
            (congrArg (fun k : Φ.obj W₀ ⟶ Φ.obj W ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)
              (show Φ.map iW ≫ Φ.map u₁ = Φ.map fW ≫ Φ.map u₂ by
                rw [← Φ.map_comp, ← Φ.map_comp, hw₀]))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushout_spec_of_isThickeningHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07VX].** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over
`S` and `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism. The pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` exists in the category of
algebraic spaces over `S`, the morphism `Y ⟶ Y'` is a thickening, and
`𝒪_{Y'} = 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}` as sheaves on the small étale site of `Y'`: over every
object `W ⟶ Y'` of that site — indeed over every scheme `W` flat over `Y'` — the ring of
functions on `W` is the fibre product of the rings of functions on `W ×_{Y'} Y` and on
`W ×_{Y'} X'` over the ring of functions on `W ×_{Y'} X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_spec_of_isThickeningHom :
    let hatlas : HasThickeningAffineAtlases B S hS :=
      hasThickeningAffineAtlases_of_chartLift B S hS (hasEtaleChartLifts B S hS)
    HasPushout i f ∧
      (letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom B S hS hatlas i f hi hf
      IsThickeningHom B S hS (pushout.inr i f) ∧
      ∀ {W WX' WY WX : BigFppfOver B S hS} {cX' : WX' ⟶ W} {cY : WY ⟶ W} {jX' : WX ⟶ WX'}
        {jY : WX ⟶ WY} {w : schemeSpace W ⟶ pushout i f} {pX' : schemeSpace WX' ⟶ X'}
        {pY : schemeSpace WY ⟶ Y} {pX : schemeSpace WX ⟶ X}, IsFlat B S hS w.hom →
        IsPullback (schemeSpaceMap cX') pX' w (pushout.inl i f) →
        IsPullback (schemeSpaceMap cY) pY w (pushout.inr i f) →
        IsPullback (schemeSpaceMap jY) pX pY f → schemeSpaceMap jX' ≫ pX' = pX ≫ i →
        jY ≫ cY = jX' ≫ cX' →
        IsPullback (Scheme.Γ.map ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map cY).op)
          (Scheme.Γ.map ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map cX').op)
          (Scheme.Γ.map ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map jY).op)
          (Scheme.Γ.map ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map jX').op))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.hasPushout_of_isThickeningHom_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VX, existence.** A thickening `i : X ⟶ X'` and an affine morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of
algebraic spaces over `S` have a pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` in the category of algebraic spaces over
`S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPushout_of_isThickeningHom_of_isAffineHom
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) : HasPushout i f
declarations.comment: existence of the pushout

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushout_inr_isThickeningHom
declarations.doc: **Stacks 07VX, `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` is a thickening of `Y`.**
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_inr_isThickeningHom
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) [HasPushout i f] :
    IsThickeningHom B S hS (pushout.inr i f)
declarations.comment: the pushout is a thickening of Y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushout_isPullback_appTop
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VX, the structure sheaf.** `𝒪_{Y'} = 𝒪_Y ×_{f_*𝒪_X} f'_*𝒪_{X'}` as sheaves on the
small étale site of `Y'`, evaluated on each of its objects: for a scheme `W` étale over `Y'`
with base changes `W₁` to `X'`, `W₂` to `Y` and `W₀` to `X`, the ring `Γ(W, 𝒪)` is the fibre
product of `Γ(W₂, 𝒪)` and `Γ(W₁, 𝒪)` over `Γ(W₀, 𝒪)`.

The objects of the small étale site of `Y'` are the schemes étale over `Y'`, and the sections over
`W` of `𝒪_Y`, `f_*𝒪_X` and `f'_*𝒪_{X'}` are the rings of functions on `W₂`, `W₀` and `W₁`. Limits
of sheaves are computed objectwise, so this objectwise statement is the same as the equality of
sheaves of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushout_isPullback_appTop
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) [HasPushout i f]
    {W W₁ W₂ W₀ : BigFppfOver B S hS} (w : yoneda.obj W ⟶ (pushout i f).1)
    (hwE : IsEtale B S hS w)
    {u₁ : W₁ ⟶ W} {p₁ : yoneda.obj W₁ ⟶ X'.1}
    (h₁ : IsPullback (yoneda.map u₁) p₁ w (pushout.inl i f).hom)
    {u₂ : W₂ ⟶ W} {p₂ : yoneda.obj W₂ ⟶ Y.1}
    (h₂ : IsPullback (yoneda.map u₂) p₂ w (pushout.inr i f).hom)
    {iW : W₀ ⟶ W₁} {fW : W₀ ⟶ W₂} {p₀ : yoneda.obj W₀ ⟶ X.1}
    (h₀₁ : IsPullback (yoneda.map iW) p₀ p₁ i.hom) (h₀₂ : IsPullback (yoneda.map fW) p₀ p₂ f.hom)
    (hw₀ : iW ≫ u₁ = fW ≫ u₂) :
    let Φ := BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS
    IsPullback ((Φ.map u₂).app ⊤) ((Φ.map u₁).app ⊤) ((Φ.map fW).app ((Φ.map u₂) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤))
      ((Φ.map iW).app ((Φ.map u₁) ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (fun O ↦ Γ(Φ.obj W₀, O))
        (congrArg (fun k : Φ.obj W₀ ⟶ Φ.obj W ↦ k ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤)
          (show Φ.map iW ≫ Φ.map u₁ = Φ.map fW ≫ Φ.map u₂ by
            rw [← Φ.map_comp, ← Φ.map_comp, hw₀]))))
declarations.comment: the structure sheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushoutGluing_spec_of_isThickeningHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07VY].** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over
`S`, `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism and `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'`. The base-change functor
`F : V' ↦ (V' ×_{Y'} Y, V' ×_{Y'} X', 1)` sends schemes over `Y'` to pairs of schemes; it has
the left adjoint `G`, which sends a triple `(V, U', φ)` to the pushout `V ⨿_{V ×_Y X} U'` with
its structure morphism to `Y'`; and `G` sends pairs of schemes to schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushoutGluing_spec_of_isThickeningHom :
    let hatlas : HasThickeningAffineAtlases B S hS :=
      hasThickeningAffineAtlases_of_chartLift B S hS (hasEtaleChartLifts B S hS)
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom B S hS hatlas i f hi hf
    (∀ Z : Over (pushout i f), Z.left.1.IsRepresentable →
        ((pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj Z).obj.left.left.1.IsRepresentable ∧
        ((pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj
          Z).obj.right.left.1.IsRepresentable) ∧
      Nonempty (pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf ⊣
        pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf) ∧
      (∀ T : pushoutGluingData B S hS i f,
        ∃ (v : T.obj.left.left ⟶ ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).left)
          (u' : T.obj.right.left ⟶ ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).left),
          IsPushout (CategoryTheory.PushoutGluing.sourceMap i f T)
              (pullback.fst T.obj.right.hom i) v u' ∧
            v ≫ ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom =
              T.obj.left.hom ≫ pushout.inr i f ∧
            u' ≫ ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom =
              T.obj.right.hom ≫ pushout.inl i f) ∧
      (∀ T : pushoutGluingData B S hS i f, T.obj.left.left.1.IsRepresentable →
        T.obj.right.left.1.IsRepresentable →
        ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).left.1.IsRepresentable)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPullback_right_of_isPullback_of_surjective_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07VZ.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `A, B, C, D, E, F` be algebraic spaces over `S`
sitting in a commutative diagram with rows `A ⟶ C ⟶ E` and `B ⟶ D ⟶ F` and vertical maps
`A ⟶ B`, `C ⟶ D`, `E ⟶ F`. If the square `A, B, C, D` and the outer rectangle `A, B, E, F` are
cartesian and `B ⟶ D` is surjective and étale, then the square `C, D, E, F` is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_right_of_isPullback_of_surjective_etale
    (_hA : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS A) (hB : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS B)
    (hC : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS C) (hD : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS D)
    (hE : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS E) (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B₀ S hS F)
    (hcomm : cE ≫ eF = cD ≫ dF)
    (hleft : IsPullback aC aB cD bD)
    (houter : IsPullback (aC ≫ cE) aB eF (bD ≫ dF))
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B₀ S hS bD) (hetale : IsEtale B₀ S hS bD) :
    IsPullback cE cD eF dF

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_pushoutGluingAdjunction_unit_of_isThickeningHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07W0].** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over
`S`, `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism, `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'`, and let `G ⊣ F` be the gluing adjunction
of [Stacks Project, Tag 07VY], with `F : V' ↦ (V' ×_{Y'} Y, V' ×_{Y'} X', 1)` and `G` sending a
triple `(V, U', φ)` to `V ⨿_{V ×_Y X} U'`. Then `F ∘ G` is isomorphic to the identity functor
of the category of triples; indeed the unit `𝟭 ⟶ G ⋙ F` of the adjunction is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_pushoutGluingAdjunction_unit_of_isThickeningHom :
    let hatlas : HasThickeningAffineAtlases B S hS :=
      hasThickeningAffineAtlases_of_chartLift B S hS (hasEtaleChartLifts B S hS)
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom B S hS hatlas i f hi hf
    IsIso (pushoutGluingAdjunction B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).unit ∧
      Nonempty (pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf ⋙
          pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf ≅
        𝟭 (pushoutGluingData B S hS i f))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleChartCube
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07W1]**, equation 81.6.5.1 of the proof of Stacks 07W0. Let
`i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over `S` and `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism.
There is a cube whose back square is the pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of algebraic spaces and whose
front square is the pushout `P = V ⨿_U U'` of étale scheme charts, with `U ⟶ U'` a thickening
and `U ⟶ V` affine, whose four lateral squares are cartesian and whose four northeast arrows
are surjective and étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleChartCube
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom) :
    ∃ (U U' V P : BigFppfOver B S hS) (Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
      (aY : X' ⟶ Y') (bY : Y ⟶ Y') (k : U ⟶ U') (g : U ⟶ V) (aP : U' ⟶ P) (bP : V ⟶ P)
      (p : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.1) (p' : yoneda.obj U' ⟶ X'.1) (q : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y.1)
      (r : yoneda.obj P ⟶ Y'.1),
      IsPushout i f aY bY ∧
      IsPushout ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map k) ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g)
        ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map aP) ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map bP) ∧
      Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map k) ∧
      _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g) ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map k) p p' i.hom ∧
      IsPullback p (yoneda.map g) f.hom q ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map aP) p' r aY.hom ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map bP) q r bY.hom ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS p' ∧ IsEtale B S hS p' ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS q ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS r ∧ IsEtale B S hS r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etaleChartCube_gluingData
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07W2]**, equation 81.6.5.2 of the proof of Stacks 07W0. Let
`i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over `S`, `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism and
`(V, U', φ)` a triple over the span. There is a cube over the span `U' ⟵ U ⟶ V` of the triple
whose back square is the pushout `G(V, U', φ) = V ⨿_U U'` of algebraic spaces and whose front
square is the pushout `G₁ = V₁ ⨿_{U₁} U₁'` of étale scheme charts, whose four lateral squares
are cartesian and whose four northeast arrows are surjective and étale; in particular
`G₁ ⟶ G(V, U', φ)` is surjective étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleChartCube_gluingData
    {X X' Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (i : X ⟶ X') (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hi : IsThickeningHom B S hS i) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (T : pushoutGluingData B S hS i f) :
    ∃ (U₁ U₁' V₁ G₁ : BigFppfOver B S hS) (G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
      (aG : T.obj.right.left ⟶ G) (bG : T.obj.left.left ⟶ G) (k : U₁ ⟶ U₁') (g : U₁ ⟶ V₁)
      (aG₁ : U₁' ⟶ G₁) (bG₁ : V₁ ⟶ G₁)
      (p : yoneda.obj U₁ ⟶ (pullback T.obj.right.hom i).1)
      (p' : yoneda.obj U₁' ⟶ T.obj.right.left.1)
      (q : yoneda.obj V₁ ⟶ T.obj.left.left.1) (r : yoneda.obj G₁ ⟶ G.1),
      IsPushout (pullback.fst T.obj.right.hom i)
        (CategoryTheory.PushoutGluing.sourceMap i f T) aG bG ∧
      IsPushout ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map k) ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g)
        ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map aG₁) ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map bG₁) ∧
      Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map k) ∧
      _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g) ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map k) p p' (pullback.fst T.obj.right.hom i).hom ∧
      IsPullback p (yoneda.map g)
        (CategoryTheory.PushoutGluing.sourceMap i f T).hom q ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map aG₁) p' r aG.hom ∧
      IsPullback (yoneda.map bG₁) q r bG.hom ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS p ∧ IsEtale B S hS p ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS p' ∧ IsEtale B S hS p' ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS q ∧ IsEtale B S hS q ∧
      IsSurjective B S hS r ∧ IsEtale B S hS r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushoutGluing_flat_of_isThickeningHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 07W3].** Let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a thickening of algebraic spaces over
`S`, `f : X ⟶ Y` an affine morphism, `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` and `G ⊣ F` the gluing adjunction of
[Stacks Project, Tag 07VY]. For a triple `(V, U', φ)`, the glued space `G(V, U', φ) ⟶ Y'` is
(1) locally of finite type, (2) flat, (3) flat and locally of finite presentation, (4) smooth,
(5) étale, if and only if both `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'` are. If `W'` is flat over `Y'` the counit
`G(F(W')) ⟶ W'` is an isomorphism; the unit is an isomorphism; `F` sends spaces flat over `Y'`
to flat triples and `G` sends flat triples to spaces flat over `Y'`; so `F` and `G` are mutually
quasi-inverse between the spaces flat over `Y'` and the triples with `V ⟶ Y` and `U' ⟶ X'`
flat.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushoutGluing_flat_of_isThickeningHom :
    let hatlas : HasThickeningAffineAtlases B S hS :=
      hasThickeningAffineAtlases_of_chartLift B S hS (hasEtaleChartLifts B S hS)
    letI := hasPushout_of_isThickening_of_isAffineHom B S hS hatlas i f hi hf
    (∀ T : pushoutGluingData B S hS i f,
      (IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS
          ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom ↔
        IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom ∧
          IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom) ∧
      (IsFlat B S hS ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom ↔
        IsFlat B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom ∧ IsFlat B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom) ∧
      ((IsFlat B S hS ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom ∧
          IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS
            ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom) ↔
        ((IsFlat B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom ∧
            IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom) ∧
          (IsFlat B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom ∧
            IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom))) ∧
      (IsSmooth B S hS ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom ↔
        IsSmooth B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom ∧ IsSmooth B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom) ∧
      (IsEtale B S hS ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom ↔
        IsEtale B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom ∧ IsEtale B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom)) ∧
    (∀ Z : Over (pushout i f), IsFlat B S hS Z.hom.hom →
      IsIso ((pushoutGluingAdjunction B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).counit.app Z)) ∧
    IsIso (pushoutGluingAdjunction B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).unit ∧
    (∀ Z : Over (pushout i f), IsFlat B S hS Z.hom.hom →
      IsFlat B S hS ((pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj Z).obj.left.hom.hom ∧
        IsFlat B S hS
          ((pushoutBaseChangeFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj Z).obj.right.hom.hom) ∧
    (∀ T : pushoutGluingData B S hS i f,
      IsFlat B S hS T.obj.left.hom.hom → IsFlat B S hS T.obj.right.hom.hom →
        IsFlat B S hS ((pushoutGluingFunctor B S hS hatlas i f hi hf).obj T).hom.hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dense_setOf_class_finiteSeparable_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07W4.** Let `k` be a field and let `X` be an algebraic space over `Spec k` which is
smooth over `Spec k`. The points of `|X|` represented by a morphism `Spec k' ⟶ X` over `Spec k`
with `k'` a finite separable extension of `k` are dense in `|X|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dense_setOf_class_finiteSeparable_of_isSmooth
    {X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of k)) hk)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hk))))
    (hf : IsSmooth B (Spec (.of k)) hk f) :
    Dense {x : points B (Spec (.of k)) hk X |
      ∃ p : FieldValuedPoint B (Spec (.of k)) hk X,
        p.class B (Spec (.of k)) hk X = x ∧
          ∃ alg : Algebra k p.carrier,
            letI := alg
            Module.Finite k p.carrier ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable k p.carrier ∧
              p.toBase = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k p.carrier))}

declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07W6.** A morphism of categories cofibered in groupoids over `𝒞_Λ`

declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def inducedInfinitesimalLinearMap (hp : SatisfiesRS (Φ ⋙ q))
    (hq : SatisfiesRS q) :
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup Q hq

declarations.name: Deformation.exists_inducedInfinitesimalLinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07W6.** Presented with a morphism as a functor commuting with the
two projections: it induces a `k`-linear map on infinitesimal automorphisms, pinned by the
comparison of dual-number pushforwards.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_inducedInfinitesimalLinearMap
    {p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, w} Λ k} (hw : Φ ⋙ q = p) (hp : SatisfiesRS p)
    (hq : SatisfiesRS q) (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x₀)
    (Q : ChosenPushforwardsAt q (Φ.obj x₀)) :
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hp
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup Q hq
    letI := naturalLocalizedTangentModule Q hq
    ∃ T : localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P →ₗ[k] localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q,
      ∃ H : (Q.obj (dualNumbersUnder (p := q) (x := Φ.obj x₀))).1 ⟶
          Φ.obj (P.obj (dualNumbersUnder (p := p) (x := x₀))).1,
        q.IsHomLift (𝟙 (dualNumbersUnder (p := q) (x := Φ.obj x₀)).right) H ∧
          Q.inclusion (dualNumbersUnder (p := q) (x := Φ.obj x₀)) ≫ H =
            Φ.map (P.inclusion (dualNumbersUnder (p := p) (x := x₀))) ∧
          ∀ a, (localizedTangentEquivKernel Q (T a)).1.asIso.hom.val ≫ H =
            H ≫ Φ.map (localizedTangentEquivKernel P a).1.asIso.hom.val
declarations.comment:
the morphism presented as a functor commuting with the two projections, with the
  map pinned by the dual-number comparison

declarations.name: Deformation.changeOfFieldsIsoClassMap_naturality
declarations.doc:
Naturality of the canonical identification on representative classes: a
coCartesian pushforward and the change-of-fields fiber inclusion commute on
isomorphism classes. This formulation allows the total category to live in
an arbitrary universe.
declarations.statement:
public theorem changeOfFieldsIsoClassMap_naturality
    (S : ChangeOfFieldsSituation.{u, v, w})
    {F : Type y} [Category.{z} F]
    (p : F ⥤ ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max x v, v} S.Λ S.k)
    (hp : IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    {B C : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, x, w} S.Λ S.l}
    (f : B ⟶ C)
    (a : p.Fiber ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.obj B)) :
    letI : p.op.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    letI : (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op.IsFibered :=
      (changeOfFieldsProjection_isCofiberedInGroupoids S p hp).isFibered
    let a' : p.Fiber ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.obj C) :=
      ⟨(CategoryTheory.Functor.pullbackFiber p.op
        (⟨Opposite.op a.1, congrArg Opposite.op a.2⟩ :
          p.op.Fiber (Opposite.op ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.obj B)))
        ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.map f).op).1.unop,
        congrArg Opposite.unop (CategoryTheory.Functor.pullbackFiber p.op
          (⟨Opposite.op a.1, congrArg Opposite.op a.2⟩ :
            p.op.Fiber (Opposite.op ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.obj B)))
          ((comparisonFunctor S).functor.map f).op).2⟩
    (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op.isoClassPresheaf.map f.op.op
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.isoClassMk (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op
        (⟨Opposite.op ((changeOfFieldsFiberInclusion S p B).obj a).1,
          congrArg Opposite.op ((changeOfFieldsFiberInclusion S p B).obj a).2⟩ :
          (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op.Fiber (Opposite.op B))) =
      CategoryTheory.Functor.isoClassMk (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op
        (⟨Opposite.op ((changeOfFieldsFiberInclusion S p C).obj a').1,
          congrArg Opposite.op ((changeOfFieldsFiberInclusion S p C).obj a').2⟩ :
          (changeOfFieldsProjection S p).op.Fiber (Opposite.op C))
declarations.comment: isomorphism_classes

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceChangeOfFields
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def tangentSpaceChangeOfFields
    (S : ChangeOfFieldsSituation.{u, v, v})
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{z, y} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, v} S.Λ S.k))
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (Functor.Elements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered))) :
    let q := changeOfFieldsProjection.{u, v, v, v, y, z} S 𝓕.p
    let hq := changeOfFieldsProjection_isPredeformationCategory
      S 𝓕.p hp
    let 𝓖 : BasedCategory.{max v z, max (max u (v + 1)) y}
        (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, v} S.Λ S.l) :=
      ⟨ChangeOfFieldsCategory S 𝓕.p, inferInstance, q⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hp⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (Functor.Elements.π (isomorphismClasses
        𝓕 hp.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓖.p) := ⟨hq⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (Functor.Elements.π (isomorphismClasses
        𝓖 hq.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨associatedSchlessingerConditionS2_changeOfFields S 𝓕 hp hS2⟩
    letI : AddCommGroup (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroupUnlifted 𝓕
    letI : Module S.k (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceModuleUnlifted 𝓕
    letI : AddCommGroup (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.l
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 hq.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroupUnlifted 𝓖
    letI : Module S.l (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.l
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 hq.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceModuleUnlifted 𝓖
    TensorProduct S.k S.l
      (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)) ≃ₗ[S.l]
      artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.l
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓖 hq.cofibered)

declarations.name: Deformation.tangentSpaceChangeOfFields_tmul_one
declarations.doc:
The scalar-extension equivalence sends a tangent vector tensored with `1`
to its image under the canonical map on square-zero extensions and the
change-of-field identification of fibrewise isomorphism classes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tangentSpaceChangeOfFields_tmul_one
    (S : ChangeOfFieldsSituation.{u, v, v})
    (𝓕 : BasedCategory.{z, y} (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, v} S.Λ S.k))
    (hp : IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p)
    (hS2 : SchlessingerConditionS2
      (Functor.Elements.π (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered))) :
    let q := changeOfFieldsProjection.{u, v, v, v, y, z} S 𝓕.p
    let hq := changeOfFieldsProjection_isPredeformationCategory
      S 𝓕.p hp
    let 𝓖 : BasedCategory.{max v z, max (max u (v + 1)) y}
        (ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, v, v} S.Λ S.l) :=
      ⟨ChangeOfFieldsCategory S 𝓕.p, inferInstance, q⟩
    let A := (artinianSquareZeroExtensionFunctor S.Λ S.k).obj
      (FGModuleCat.of S.k S.k)
    let B := (artinianSquareZeroExtensionFunctor S.Λ S.l).obj
      (FGModuleCat.of S.l S.l)
    let C := (comparisonFunctor S).functor.obj B
    let j : A ⟶ C := (canonicalDualNumberInclusion S).val
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hp⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2
      (Functor.Elements.π (isomorphismClasses
        𝓕 hp.cofibered))) := ⟨hS2⟩
    letI : AddCommGroup (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroupUnlifted 𝓕
    letI : Module S.k (artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)) :=
      associatedTangentSpaceModuleUnlifted 𝓕
    ∀ (t : artinianTangentSpace S.Λ S.k
        (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered)),
      (tangentSpaceChangeOfFields S 𝓕 hp hS2) (1 ⊗ₜ[S.k] t) =
        cast (isomorphismClasses_obj 𝓖 hq.cofibered B).symm
          (changeOfFieldsIsoClassMap S 𝓕.p B
            (cast (isomorphismClasses_obj 𝓕 hp.cofibered C)
              ((isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hp.cofibered).map j t)))
declarations.comment: canonical pure-tensor formula

declarations.name: Deformation.existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsChangeOfFields
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07WC.** For a deformation category over the residue field `k`, the
space of infinitesimal automorphisms extends by scalars along `k → l` to the space of
infinitesimal automorphisms of the change of residue field. The equivalence is pinned by its
action on dual-number automorphisms, read through a comparison of pushforwards whose base
morphism has the prescribed pullback coordinates.
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_infinitesimalAutomorphismsChangeOfFields
    (S : Deformation.ChangeOfFieldsSituation.{u, v, w})
    {F : Type y} [Category.{z} F]
    (p : F ⥤ Deformation.ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, max v w, v} S.Λ S.k)
    (hp : Deformation.IsDeformationCategory p)
    (x₀ : p.Fiber (residueFieldObject.{u, w, v} S.Λ S.k))
    (P : ChosenPushforwardsAt p x₀.1)
    (xₗ : (Deformation.changeOfFieldsProjection S p).Fiber
      (residueFieldObject.{u, v, w} S.Λ S.l))
    (Q : ChosenPushforwardsAt
      (Deformation.changeOfFieldsProjection S p) xₗ.1) :
    let hq := changeOfFieldsProjection_satisfiesRS
      S p hp.satisfiesRS
    letI : AddCommGroup (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P) :=
      naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup P hp.satisfiesRS
    letI : Module S.k (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P) :=
      naturalLocalizedTangentModule P hp.satisfiesRS
    letI : AddCommGroup (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q) :=
      naturalLocalizedTangentAddCommGroup Q hq
    letI : Module S.l (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q) :=
      naturalLocalizedTangentModule Q hq
    let Uε := dualNumbersUnder (p := p) (x := x₀.1)
    let Vε := dualNumbersUnder
      (p := Deformation.changeOfFieldsProjection S p) (x := xₗ.1)
    ∃! E : TensorProduct S.k S.l
        (localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P) ≃ₗ[S.l]
        localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent Q,
      ∃ (j : x₀.1 ⟶ xₗ.1.fst) (h : (P.obj Uε).1 ⟶ (Q.obj Vε).1.fst),
        let b : Uε.right ⟶
            (Deformation.comparisonFunctor.{u, v, w, max v w} S).functor.obj Vε.right :=
          eqToHom (P.obj Uε).2.symm ≫ p.map h ≫ (Q.obj Vε).1.iso.hom ≫
            (Deformation.comparisonFunctor.{u, v, w, max v w} S).functor.map (eqToHom (Q.obj Vε).2)
        (P.inclusion Uε ≫ h = j ≫ (Q.inclusion Vε).fst) ∧
        (∀ a : Uε.right,
          ((((Deformation.comparisonFunctor.{u, v, w, max v w} S).pullbackEquiv
              Vε.right) (b.hom a)).val.1).fst = algebraMap S.k S.l a.fst ∧
          ((((Deformation.comparisonFunctor.{u, v, w, max v w} S).pullbackEquiv
              Vε.right) (b.hom a)).val.1).snd =
            ULift.up (algebraMap S.k S.l a.snd.down) ∧
          (((Deformation.comparisonFunctor.{u, v, w, max v w} S).pullbackEquiv
              Vε.right) (b.hom a)).val.2 = a.fst) ∧
        (∀ t : localizedAutomorphismFunctorTangent P,
          (localizedTangentEquivKernel P t).1.asIso.hom.val ≫ h =
            h ≫ (localizedTangentEquivKernel Q
              (E (1 ⊗ₜ[S.k] t))).1.asIso.hom.val.fst)
