    [IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)) H] :
    HasApproximationProperty H ∧ IsGRing H
declarations.comment: the approximation property of the henselization `Λ_𝔪^h` and, by Rotthaus' theorem (the reference the source leaves missing), that `Λ_𝔪^h` is a G-ring

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.GRingNecessity.isGRing_of_forall_algebraizationConclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Example 98.12.8 (Tag 07XI).** Let `Λ` be a Noetherian ring and `𝔪` a maximal ideal
of `Λ`. If for every finite type `Λ`-algebra `C` and every `Λ`-algebra map `φ : C → Λ_𝔪^∧` the
conclusion of Lemma 98.12.7 (Tag 07XH) holds for the category `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` fibred in sets over the
big fppf site of `S = Spec Λ` attached to `S' = (S ∖ {𝔪}) ⨿ Spec C` and its effective versal formal
object `ξ` over `Λ_𝔪^∧`, then `Λ_𝔪` is a G-ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGRing_of_forall_algebraizationConclusion
    (h : ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra Λ C], Algebra.FiniteType Λ C →
      ∀ φ : C →ₐ[Λ] Completion 𝔪,
        AlgebraizationConclusion B (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of Λ)) hS
          (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS) (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS)) :
    IsGRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)
declarations.comment: the conclusion of the Example: if the conclusion of Lemma 98.12.7 (07XH) holds for every `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` as above, then `Λ_𝔪` is a G-ring; the conclusion of 07XH is `AlgebraizationConclusion`, copied verbatim from the formalization of 07XH

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.GRingNecessity.isGRing_of_forall_algebraizationLemmaHolds
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Example 98.12.8 (Tag 07XI), with Lemma 98.12.7 assumed in lemma form.** If for
every finite type `Λ`-algebra `C` the statement of Lemma 98.12.7 (Tag 07XH) without its G-ring
hypothesis holds for the category `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` of the Example (`AlgebraizationLemmaHolds`), then
`Λ_𝔪` is a G-ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGRing_of_forall_algebraizationLemmaHolds
    (h : ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra Λ C], Algebra.FiniteType Λ C →
      AlgebraizationLemmaHolds 𝔪 B hS C) :
    IsGRing (Localization.AtPrime 𝔪)
declarations.comment: with Lemma 98.12.7 assumed in lemma form (for every formal object of `𝒳` satisfying its hypotheses other than the G-ring hypothesis): `Λ_𝔪` is a G-ring

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.GRingNecessity.exists_lift_smallExtension_of_algebraizationConclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Example 98.12.8, from the conclusion of Stacks 07XH to the datum.** Let `C` be a
finite type `Λ`-algebra (as in the source; the proof does not use this) and `φ : C → Λ_𝔪^∧` a
`Λ`-algebra map. If the conclusion of Stacks Lemma 98.12.7 holds for the category `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` and
the formal object `ξ` of the Example, then there are a finite type `Λ`-algebra `A` and a maximal
ideal `𝔪_A` of `A` lying over `𝔪`, with `κ(𝔪) → κ(𝔪_A)` bijective and `Λ → A`, `𝔪_A` satisfying
condition (4) of Stacks 02HT (the last condition of `Algebra.isSmoothAt_tfae`), together with a
`Λ`-algebra map `C → A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_smallExtension_of_algebraizationConclusion [Algebra.FiniteType Λ C]
    (h : AlgebraizationConclusion B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS)
      (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS)) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : Algebra Λ A), Algebra.FiniteType Λ A ∧
      ∃ (mA : Ideal A) (_ : mA.IsMaximal) (hmA : 𝔪 = mA.comap (algebraMap Λ A)),
        Function.Bijective (Ideal.ResidueField.map 𝔪 mA (algebraMap Λ A) hmA) ∧
        (∀ (T₂ T₁ : Type u) [CommRing T₂] [CommRing T₁] [IsLocalRing T₂] [IsLocalRing T₁]
          [IsArtinianRing T₂] [IsArtinianRing T₁] [Algebra Λ T₂] [Algebra Λ T₁]
          (e : T₂ →ₐ[Λ] T₁), Function.Surjective e →
          IsSimpleModule T₂ (RingHom.ker (e : T₂ →+* T₁)) →
          ∀ (g : A →ₐ[Λ] T₁) (hq : (maximalIdeal T₁).comap (g : A →+* T₁) = mA),
            Function.Surjective (Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ mA (maximalIdeal T₁) g hq.symm) →
            ∃ g' : A →ₐ[Λ] T₂, e.comp g' = g) ∧
        Nonempty (C →ₐ[Λ] A)
declarations.comment: the datum read off the conclusion of 07XH: `A` of finite type, `𝔪_A` over `𝔪` with `κ(𝔪) = κ(𝔪_A)`, condition (4) of 02HT for `Λ → A` at `𝔪_A`, and `C → A`

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.GRingNecessity.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_and_formalObject_isEffective_isVersal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Example 98.12.8 (Tag 07XI), the properties of `𝒳` and `ξ`.** Let `C` be a finite
type `Λ`-algebra and `φ : C → Λ_𝔪^∧` a `Λ`-algebra map. The category `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` fibred in sets
over the big fppf site of `S = Spec Λ` is limit preserving on objects, and `ξ` is a formal object
of `𝒳` over `R = Λ_𝔪^∧` (its base is isomorphic to `R` over `S`) which is effective and versal.
Versality holds over the local ring `𝒪_{S,s}` of `S` at any point `s`, for every algebra
structure of the base of `ξ` over `𝒪_{S,s}` compatible with the structure morphisms, and such a
structure exists at the image `formalObjectPoint` of the closed point of the base, where the
versality hypothesis of Lemma 98.12.7 is formulated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_and_formalObject_isEffective_isVersal
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra Λ C] [Algebra.FiniteType Λ C]
    (φ : C →ₐ[Λ] Completion 𝔪) :
    BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u, u, u + 1} B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS
        (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS)
        (Approximation.baseFiberedCategory B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS)
        (Approximation.structureMorphism B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS)) ∧
      IsCompletionBase 𝔪 (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base ∧
      FormalObject.IsEffective B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS).val.p
        (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS).property (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS) ∧
      (∃ _ : Algebra ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk (formalObjectPoint 𝔪 C B hS φ) : Type u)
          (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.R,
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
            ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk (formalObjectPoint 𝔪 C B hS φ) : Type u)
            (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.R)) ≫
          (Spec (.of Λ)).fromSpecStalk (formalObjectPoint 𝔪 C B hS φ) =
        (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.toS) ∧
      ∀ (s : Spec (.of Λ))
        [Algebra ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk s : Type u) (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.R]
        (iΛ : Spec (.of ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk s : Type u)) ⟶ Spec (.of Λ))
        (_ : iΛ = (Spec (.of Λ)).fromSpecStalk s)
        (hΛ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap
            ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk s : Type u) (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.R)) ≫ iΛ =
          (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS).base.toS),
        FormalObject.IsVersal B (Spec (.of Λ)) hS (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS).val.p
          (factorizationCategory 𝔪 C B hS).property (formalObject 𝔪 C φ B hS)
          ((Spec (.of Λ)).presheaf.stalk s : Type u) iΛ hΛ
declarations.comment: first assertion of the Example: `𝒳 = 𝒮_F` is limit preserving on objects and has an effective, versal formal object `ξ` over `R = Λ_𝔪^∧`

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving
declarations.doc:
A category fibred in groupoids is limit preserving if for every directed inverse
limit of affine schemes the canonical comparison `colim 𝒳_{Tᵢ} ⥤ 𝒳_T` is an equivalence
of categories.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsLimitPreserving
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, vX, u + 1, uX}
      (BigFppfOver B S hS)) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreserving_twoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XM, part (2).** If `𝒳`, `𝒴` and `𝒵` are limit preserving categories fibred in
groupoids over `(Sch/S)_{fppf}`, then so is the 2-fibre product `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵`: for every directed
inverse system of affine schemes with limit `T`, the canonical comparison from the colimit of the
fibre categories over the stages to the fibre category over `T` is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreserving_twoFibreProduct
    (h𝒳 : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒳)
    (h𝒴 : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒴)
    (h𝒵 : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒵) :
    Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS
      (BigFppfOver.twoFibreProduct.{u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 pf qf)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_toTerminalCFG_twoFibreProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XM, part (1).** If the structure morphisms of `𝒳` and of `𝒵` to `(Sch/S)_{fppf}`
are limit preserving on objects and `𝒴` is limit preserving, then the structure morphism of the
2-fibre product `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵` to `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` is limit preserving on objects.

Part (2) of Stacks 07XM, that `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵` is limit preserving when `𝒳`, `𝒴` and `𝒵` are, is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreserving_twoFibreProduct`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLimitPreservingOnObjects_toTerminalCFG_twoFibreProduct
    (h𝒳 : BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳
      (terminalCFG B S hS) (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒳)))
    (h𝒵 : BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒵
      (terminalCFG B S hS) (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒵)))
    (h𝒴 : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒴) :
    BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w, u, u + 1} B S hS
      (BigFppfOver.twoFibreProduct.{u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 pf qf) (terminalCFG B S hS)
      (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS
        (BigFppfOver.twoFibreProduct.{u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 𝒵 pf qf)))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInSetoids_and_isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinPres
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XN, the implication (3) ⟹ (1).** A category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` which is representable by an algebraic space locally of finite presentation over `S`
is a stack in setoids whose structure morphism to `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` is limit preserving on
objects.

The setoid clause is the implication (3) ⟹ (1) of Stacks 04SZ, and the limit-preservation clause
is Stacks 06CX read at the structure morphism. Neither algebraicity nor any cited hypothesis is
used.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInSetoids_and_isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinPres
    (h : IsRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS 𝒳) :
    𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳
        (terminalCFG B S hS)
        (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒳))
declarations.comment: the implication (3) ⟹ (1), with condition (3) read as `IsRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinitePresentation` and limit preservation on objects for cofiltered index categories in the universe of the schemes, which is the scope of the library's form of Tag 06CX that the proof uses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInSetoids_isLimitPreserving_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XN.** For an algebraic stack `𝒳` over the big fppf site of a scheme `S` the
following are equivalent:

1. `𝒳` is a stack in setoids and its structure morphism `𝒳 ⟶ (Sch/S)_{fppf}` is limit preserving
   on objects in the sense of Stacks 06CU;
2. `𝒳` is a stack in setoids and is limit preserving in the sense of Stacks 07XL;
3. `𝒳` is representable by an algebraic space over `S` which is locally of finite presentation
   over `S`, i.e. `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinitePresentation`.

The three implications proved are the cycle (1) ⟹ (3) ⟹ (2) ⟹ (1). Inverse systems are indexed
by categories in the universe `u` of the schemes, which is the size the source's directed inverse
systems have and the size at which the inputs of the two nontrivial implications are available.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInSetoids_isLimitPreserving_tfae
    (halg : IsAlgebraicStack.{u, t} B S hS 𝒳.val) :
    List.TFAE
      [𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
          BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳
            (terminalCFG B S hS) (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒳)),
        𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
          Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒳,
        IsRepresentableBySpaceLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS 𝒳]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isStackInSetoids_and_isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isLimitPreserving
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XN, the implication (2) ⟹ (1).** A category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf
site of `S` which is a stack in setoids and is limit preserving is a stack in setoids whose
structure morphism to `(Sch/S)_{fppf}` is limit preserving on objects.

The stack-in-setoids clause is common to the two conditions, and the limit-preservation clause
weakens from an equivalence of categories to essential surjectivity. The remaining implications of
Stacks 07XN are not proved here; see the implementation notes of this module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInSetoids_and_isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_isLimitPreserving
    (h : 𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, v, w, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒳) :
    𝒳.val.p.IsStackInSetoids (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, v, w, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳
        (terminalCFG B S hS)
        (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒳))
declarations.comment: the implication (2) ⟹ (1)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.IsOpenVersalityOverSite
declarations.doc:
**Openness of versality** (Stacks 07XQ (1)). Let `p : X ⥤ (Sch/S)_{fppf}` be a category
fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site `B` of `S`. Then `X` satisfies openness of versality if
for every scheme `U` locally of finite type over `S`, every object `x` of `X` over `U` and every
finite type point `u₀ ∈ U` such that `x` is versal at `u₀`, there is an open neighbourhood
`u₀ ∈ U' ⊆ U` such that `x` is versal at every finite type point of `U'`.

Versality is read through `q = p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion`, the structure functor to all schemes
over `S`; the objects of `X` lie over schemes of the site, so quantifying over every scheme `U`
over `S` with an object `x` over it is quantifying over the schemes of the site. The definition
does not use that `S` is locally Noetherian, the standing assumption of Stacks 07XQ.
declarations.comment:
part (1): openness of versality of a category fibred in groupoids over
  `(Sch/S)_{fppf}`

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.IsOpenVersalityMorphismOverSite
declarations.doc:
**Openness of versality of a 1-morphism** (Stacks 07XQ (2)). Let `F : X ⥤ Y` be a
1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids `pX`, `pY` over the big fppf site `B` of `S`. Then
`F` satisfies openness of versality if for every scheme `V` of the site locally of finite type
over `S` and every object `y` of `Y` over `V`, the 2-fibre product
`(Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_{y, Y, F} X` satisfies openness of versality, as a category over the big fppf
site of `V`.

The object `y` of `Y` over `V` enters, as in Stacks, through the 1-morphism
`(Sch/V)_{fppf} ⥤ Y` it defines: a functor `y` with `y ⋙ pY = Over.map V.hom`. The
first projection of the 2-fibre product is fibred in groupoids
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.fst_isFiberedInGroupoids_overMap`), so the condition is
`Deformation.Artin.IsOpenVersalityOverSite` for it, written out. The definition does not use
that `S` is locally Noetherian, the standing assumption of Stacks 07XQ.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsOpenVersalityMorphismOverSite (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X : Type vX} [Category.{wX} X] {Y : Type vY} [Category.{wY} Y]
    (pX : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (pY : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (F : X ⥤ Y)
    (_hpX : pX.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (_hpY : pY.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (_hF : F ⋙ pY = pX) : Prop
declarations.comment:
part (2): openness of versality of a 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids
  over `(Sch/S)_{fppf}`

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.artinAxiomsFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor which assigns a singleton to an admissible `k[s,t]`-algebra
and the empty set to every other algebra.
declarations.statement:
public def artinAxiomsFunctor (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    CommAlgCat.{v, u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ⥤ Type v
declarations.comment: functor

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
The full subcategory of schemes over `Spec k[s,t]` admitting an affine open
cover on which the functor of Tag 07XR has its unique value.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev artinAxiomsCategory (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))))
declarations.comment: category

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.nonempty_artinAxiomsFunctor_iff_exists_isCompact_open
declarations.doc:
The functor of Tag 07XR has its unique value on `A` if and only if
`V(s,t) ⊆ Spec(A)` has a quasi-compact open neighbourhood on which `s`
vanishes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_artinAxiomsFunctor_iff_exists_isCompact_open
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (A : CommAlgCat.{v, u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) :
    Nonempty ((artinAxiomsFunctor k).obj A) ↔
      ∃ W : Set (PrimeSpectrum A),
        IsOpen W ∧ IsCompact W ∧
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
              ({algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) A (MvPolynomial.X 0),
                algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) A (MvPolynomial.X 1)} : Set A) ⊆ W ∧
          ∀ x ∈ W,
            algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime x.asIdeal)
                (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) A (MvPolynomial.X 0)) = 0
declarations.comment: geometric_criterion

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isVersalAt_sliceObject
declarations.doc: **The slice is versal at the origin.**
declarations.statement:
public theorem isVersalAt_sliceObject (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))) :
    IsVersalAt (Over.mk (sliceImmersion k)) (artinAxiomsOver B hS) (slicePoint k)
      (sliceObject B hS) (by delta sliceObject; rfl)
declarations.comment: the object x over U = Spec(k[s,t]/(s)) is versal at u_0 = (s,t)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.not_isVersalAt_sliceObject
declarations.doc: **The slice is versal at no point other than the origin.**
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_isVersalAt_sliceObject (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))))
    (hu : (u : PrimeSpectrum (sliceRing k)) ≠ slicePoint k) :
    ¬ IsVersalAt (Over.mk (sliceImmersion k)) (artinAxiomsOver B hS) u
      (sliceObject B hS) (by delta sliceObject; rfl)
declarations.comment: x is versal at no other point of U

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.not_isOpenVersality_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
**Openness of versality fails for the category of Tag 07XR**, written out: the slice is
versal at the origin, which is a finite-type point, but every open neighbourhood of the
origin contains a closed point at which it is not versal. Axiom [5] asks openness of
versality of the category and of its diagonal, so this is the failure of axiom [5].
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_isOpenVersality_artinAxiomsCategory (B : BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))) :
    ¬ ∀ (U : Over (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))), LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom →
        ∀ (x : artinAxiomsCategory k B hS)
          (hx : (artinAxiomsOver B hS).obj x = U) (u₀ : ↥U.left),
          IsFiniteTypePoint u₀ →
          IsVersalAt U (artinAxiomsOver B hS) u₀ x hx →
          ∃ V : U.left.Opens, u₀ ∈ V.1 ∧
            ∀ u ∈ V.1, IsFiniteTypePoint u →
              IsVersalAt U (artinAxiomsOver B hS) u x hx
declarations.comment: openness of versality fails for the category, hence axiom [5] fails

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isStackInGroupoids_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of the full subcategory `IsArtinAxiomsObject` is a stack in groupoids for the
fppf topology of the big fppf site over `Spec k[s,t]`.
declarations.comment: axiom [0]: the category is a stack in groupoids, for the fppf topology

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.satisfiesRS_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
The inclusion of the full subcategory `IsArtinAxiomsObject` satisfies condition (RS): for a
pushout `Y' = Y ⨿_X X'` of finite type local Artinian schemes along a closed immersion `X → X'`,
the comparison from the fibre over `Y'` to the
two-fibre product of the fibres over `Y` and `X'` is an equivalence.
declarations.comment: axiom [2]: the category satisfies the Rim-Schlessinger condition (RS)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isLimitPreserving_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
The category fibred in groupoids `artinAxiomsCFG` is limit preserving: for a directed
inverse system of affine schemes `Tᵢ` over `Spec k[s,t]` with limit `T`, the comparison
`colim 𝒳_{Tᵢ} ⥤ 𝒳_T` is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLimitPreserving_artinAxiomsCategory :
    IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u + 1, u} B _ hS (artinAxiomsCFG B hS)
declarations.comment: axiom [1]: the category is limit preserving, for inverse systems indexed by a category in the universe of the schemes

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_infinitesimalAutomorphisms_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
For every finite-type field-valued point `x₀` of `artinAxiomsCategory`, the tangent space
`T𝓕_{𝒳,k,x₀}` of its predeformation category is finite dimensional for its canonical vector space
structure, and so is the group of infinitesimal automorphisms along every split pair
`A₀ → A_ε → A₀`, for every vector space structure on it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finiteDimensional_tangentSpace_infinitesimalAutomorphisms_artinAxiomsCategory
    {Λ K : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field K] [Algebra Λ K]
    (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))) (x₀ : artinAxiomsCategory k B hS)
    (hx₀ : (ObjectProperty.ι (IsArtinAxiomsObject k B hS) ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ K)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hfin : LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ K)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hqc : QuasiCompact (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ K)) ≫ iΛ)) :
    let D := predeformationCategory iΛ
      (ObjectProperty.ι (IsArtinAxiomsObject k B hS) ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) x₀ hx₀
    letI := D.category
    let 𝓕 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor D.projection
    let hD : Deformation.IsDeformationCategory D.projection :=
      isDeformationCategory_predeformationCategory B _ hS _
        (isFiberedInGroupoids_artinAxiomsCategory B hS) (satisfiesRS_artinAxiomsCategory B hS)
        iΛ x₀ hx₀ hfin hqc
    letI : Fact (IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) := ⟨hD.predeformation⟩
    letI : Fact (SchlessingerConditionS2 (Functor.Elements.π
      (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered))) :=
      ⟨schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_of_isDeformationCategory 𝓕 hD⟩
    FiniteDimensional K
        (artinianTangentSpace Λ K (isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered)) ∧
      ∀ {A₀ Aε : ArtinianLocalAlgCat.{u, u, u} Λ K} {z₀ : D.projection.Fiber A₀}
        {zε : D.projection.Fiber Aε} (g : A₀ ⟶ Aε) (e : Aε ⟶ A₀) (hge : g ≫ e = 𝟙 A₀)
        (i : z₀.1 ⟶ zε.1) (hi : D.projection.IsHomLift g i)
        [AddCommGroup ↥(infinitesimalAutomorphismsAlongSplitPair
          hD.predeformation.cofibered g e hge i hi)]
        [Module K ↥(infinitesimalAutomorphismsAlongSplitPair
          hD.predeformation.cofibered g e hge i hi)],
        FiniteDimensional K ↥(infinitesimalAutomorphismsAlongSplitPair
          hD.predeformation.cofibered g e hge i hi)
declarations.comment: axiom [3]: the tangent spaces and the spaces of infinitesimal automorphisms of the predeformation categories are finite dimensional

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isEquivalence_approximationFunctor_artinAxiomsCategory
declarations.doc:
**The category of the openness-of-versality example satisfies axiom [4]**: the functor of
Stacks 07X6, from objects over the spectra of Noetherian complete local rings to formal objects,
is an equivalence.
declarations.comment: axiom [4]: the functor of Stacks 07X6 from objects over Noetherian complete local rings to formal objects is an equivalence

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories
declarations.doc:
Smoothness of the induced map on predeformation categories at every
finite-type field-valued point of the source.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v₁} [Category.{w₁} X]
    {Y : Type v₂} [Category.{w₂} Y]
    (pX : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (pY : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : F ⋙ pY = pX) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_sliceFunctor_of_isVersalAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XT.** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of a
locally Noetherian scheme `S`, let `U` be a scheme locally of finite type over `S`, and let
`x` be an object of `𝒳` over `U`. If `x` is versal at every finite type point of `U` and
`𝒳` satisfies (RS), then the 1-morphism `x : (Sch/U)_fppf ⟶ 𝒳` satisfies the smoothness
condition of Tag 07XS on predeformation categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_sliceFunctor_of_isVersalAt
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hU : LocallyOfFiniteType ((p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).hom)
    (hversal : ∀ u₀ : ((p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).left,
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u₀ →
        IsVersalAt ((p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x)
          (p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u₀ x rfl)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS B S hS p hp) :
    letI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS (Over.forget (p.obj x)) p
      (p.chosenPullbacks.sliceFunctor (⟨x, rfl⟩ : p.Fiber (p.obj x)))
      (p.chosenPullbacks.sliceFunctor_comp (⟨x, rfl⟩ : p.Fiber (p.obj x)))

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_comp
declarations.doc:
The composite of two morphisms smooth on predeformation categories is
smooth on predeformation categories.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_comp
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type v₁} [Category.{w₁} X]
    {Y : Type v₂} [Category.{w₂} Y]
    {Z : Type v₃} [Category.{w₃} Z]
    (pX : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (pY : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (pZ : Z ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (G : Y ⥤ Z)
    (hF : F ⋙ pY = pX) (hG : G ⋙ pZ = pY)
    (hSmoothF : IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS pX pY F hF)
    (hSmoothG : IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS pY pZ G hG) :
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS pX pZ (F ⋙ G)
      (by rw [Functor.assoc, hG, hF])

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_twoFibreProductSnd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XV.** Smoothness on predeformation categories is stable under base change of
categories fibred in groupoids: if `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` is smooth on predeformation categories, so is
the projection `𝒳 ×_𝒴 𝒵 ⟶ 𝒵`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_twoFibreProductSnd
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {X : Type vX} [Category.{wX} X] {Y : Type vY} [Category.{wY} Y]
    {Z : Type vZ} [Category.{wZ} Z]
    (pX : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (pY : Y ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (pZ : Z ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS) (f : X ⥤ Y) (g : Z ⥤ Y)
    (_hpX : pX.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hpY : pY.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (_hpZ : pZ.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hf : f ⋙ pY = pX) (hg : g ⋙ pY = pZ)
    (h : IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS pX pY f hf) :
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS
      (TwoFibreProductOver.structureFunctor pX pZ pY f g) pZ
      (TwoFibreProductOver.snd pX pZ pY f g)
      (by exact TwoFibreProductOver.snd_comp_eq)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isRelativelySmooth'
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XW, the representable-and-smooth clause.** A 1-morphism of categories fibred in
groupoids over the big fppf category of a locally Noetherian scheme `S` which is representable by
algebraic spaces and smooth induces a smooth functor of predeformation categories at every finite
type field-valued point of the source; that is, it satisfies the condition of Stacks 07XS.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isRelativelySmooth'
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hsmooth : Stack.IsRelativelySmooth B S hS p) :
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p p)
declarations.comment: the representable-and-smooth clause: representable by algebraic spaces and smooth implies smooth on predeformation categories

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isRelativelySmooth_of_representable
declarations.doc:
A 1-morphism `p` of categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf category of a locally
Noetherian scheme `S` which is representable by algebraic spaces and smooth, and such that each
algebraic space representing a base change of `p` along a scheme-valued point of the target is
representable by schemes (`hrep`), induces a smooth functor of predeformation categories at every
finite type field-valued point of the source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isRelativelySmooth_of_representable
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hsmooth : Stack.IsRelativelySmooth B S hS p)
    (hrep : ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS)
      (y : BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2 ⥤ 𝒴.val.obj)
      (_hy : y ⋙ 𝒴.val.p = Over.map U.hom)
      (F : (BigFppfOver B U.left.1 U.left.2)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (_hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B U.left.1 U.left.2 F),
      Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
        (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map U.hom) 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p y
          (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p))
        (presheafOfCategories (F ⋙ typeToCat)).p) →
      yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (OverShriek.relocalizeToYoneda U.hom F)) :
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p p)
declarations.comment:
the representable-and-smooth clause, for a 1-morphism whose base changes along
scheme-valued points of the target are representable by schemes

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07WK**, case (1). A 1-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over the big
fppf category of `S` which is formally smooth on objects induces a smooth functor of
predeformation categories at every finite type field-valued point of the source.

This is also the formally-smooth-on-objects clause of Stacks 07XW — the condition the
openness-of-versality statement is about — so both tags are registered here, on the declaration
that carries the proof.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories_of_isFormallySmoothOnObjects
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {𝒳 𝒴 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, v, u + 1, w} (BigFppfOver B S hS)} (p : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴)
    (hp : Stack.IsFormallySmoothOnObjects B S hS 𝒳 𝒴 p) :
    IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor p)
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p p)
declarations.comment: the formally-smooth-on-objects clause: formally smooth on objects implies smooth on predeformation categories

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRelativelySmooth_of_isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XX.** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme and `f : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒴` a 1-morphism of
categories fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`. If (1) `f` is representable by
algebraic spaces, (2) `f` satisfies the deformation-theoretic smoothness condition of
**Stacks 07XS**, (3) the structure morphism `𝒳 ⟶ (Sch/S)_{fppf}` is limit preserving on objects
in the sense of **Stacks 06CU**, and (4) `𝒴` is limit preserving in the sense of **Stacks 07XL**,
then `f` is smooth.

`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.IsRelativelySmooth` bundles the representability witness with the
relative property of Stacks 03YK at the smooth property, which is what "smooth" means for a
1-morphism, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRelativeProperty_smooth_of_isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories` paired
with `hfrep`. Condition (3) enters only through the cancellation for Stacks 06CU,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isLimitPreservingOnObjects_of_toTerminalCFG`.

The case of a 1-morphism induced by a morphism of schemes — the key ingredient, where the
appeal to More on Morphisms is made — is
`Deformation.Artin.smooth_of_isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelySmooth_of_isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories
    (hfrep : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f.hom)
    (hlimX : BigFppfOver.IsLimitPreservingOnObjects.{u, u, u, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳
      (terminalCFG B S hS) (Bicategory.InducedBicategory.mkHom (toTerminalCFG B S hS 𝒳)))
    (hlimY : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒴)
    (hf : Deformation.Artin.IsSmoothOnPredeformationCategories B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒴.val.p
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f) (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor_comp_p f)) :
    IsRelativelySmooth B S hS f
declarations.comment: f representable by algebraic spaces, satisfying 07XS, 𝒳 limit preserving on objects, 𝒴 limit preserving, S locally Noetherian; then f is smooth. smooth_of_isSmoothOnPredeformationCategories is the case of a morphism of schemes

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_smooth_finiteType_neighborhood
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07XY.** Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of a
locally Noetherian scheme `S` whose diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces, which is
limit preserving (axiom [1]), satisfies (RS) (axiom [2]) and has finite-dimensional tangent
spaces (the tangent-space half of axiom [3]), all of whose formal objects are effective, for
which versality is open, and let `x₀` be an object of `𝒳` over a quasi-compact finite-type
field point `i₀ : Spec k ⟶ S` whose image is a point `s` at which the local ring of `S` is a
G-ring.

Then there is a base `U = 𝒳.val.p.obj x` of finite type over `S` — locally of finite type and
quasi-compact — an object `x` of `𝒳` over it, and a finite type point `u₀` of `U` with residue
field `k`, such that `x` restricts to `x₀` at `u₀` along a Cartesian arrow `r : x₀ ⟶ x`
realizing that identification of residue fields, and the 1-morphism
`(Sch/U)_{fppf} ⟶ 𝒳` attached to `x` by the 2-Yoneda lemma is smooth.

The proof is the proof of the source: the versal finite-type point of Stacks 07XH, shrunk by
openness of versality, carries a smooth 2-Yoneda 1-morphism by Stacks 0CXM.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_smooth_finiteType_neighborhood
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (u + 1) v w}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (i₀ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (x₀ : 𝒳.val.obj)
    (hx₀ : (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x₀ = Over.mk i₀)
    (hfinite₀ : LocallyOfFiniteType i₀) (hqc₀ : QuasiCompact i₀)
    (s : S) (hs : i₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = s)
    (hdiag : AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS 𝒳)
    (hlimit : IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, max (u + 1) v w, max u v} B S hS 𝒳)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRS B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property)
    (htangent :
      ∀ (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra Λ k]
        (_ : Λ = S.presheaf.stalk s)
        (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ S)
        (_ : HEq iΛ (S.fromSpecStalk s))
        (hbase : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ = i₀),
        let hx : (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
          Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ) :=
          hx₀.trans (congrArg Over.mk hbase.symm)
        let D := predeformationCategory iΛ
          (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) x₀ hx
        letI : Category D.carrier := D.category
        ∀ hD : Deformation.IsDeformationCategory D.projection,
          let 𝓕 := BasedCategory.ofFunctor D.projection
          let hS2 := schlessingerConditionS2_isomorphismClasses_of_isDeformationCategory 𝓕 hD
          letI : Fact (Deformation.IsPredeformationCategory 𝓕.p) :=
            ⟨hD.predeformation⟩
          letI : Fact (Deformation.SchlessingerConditionS2
            (Functor.Elements.π
              (Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered))) :=
            ⟨hS2⟩
          let F := Deformation.isomorphismClasses 𝓕 hD.predeformation.cofibered
          let T := Deformation.artinianTangentSpace Λ k F
          letI : AddCommGroup T := Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceAddCommGroupUnlifted 𝓕
          letI : Module k T := Deformation.associatedTangentSpaceModuleUnlifted 𝓕
          FiniteDimensional k T)
    (heffective : ∀ ξ : FormalObject B S hS 𝒳.val.p,
      FormalObject.IsEffective B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property ξ)
    (hopen : ∀ U : Over S, LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom →
      ∀ (y : 𝒳.val.obj) (hy : (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj y = U) (u : U.left),
        AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u →
        IsVersalAt U (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u y hy →
        ∃ V : U.left.Opens, u ∈ V.1 ∧
          ∀ u' : U.left, u' ∈ V.1 →
            AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u' →
            IsVersalAt U (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u' y hy)
    (hG : IsGRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    ∃ (x : 𝒳.val.obj)
      (u₀ : ((𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).left)
      (e : ((𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).left.residueField u₀ ≃+* k)
      (r : x₀ ⟶ x)
      (f : (AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.schemeFibredCategory B S hS
        (𝒳.val.p.obj x)).val ⥤ᵇ 𝒳.val),
      LocallyOfFiniteType ((𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).hom ∧
      QuasiCompact ((𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).hom ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u₀ ∧
      𝒳.val.p.IsCartesian (𝒳.val.p.map r) r ∧
      (eqToHom hx₀.symm ≫ (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).map r).left =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e.toRingHom) ≫
          ((𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x).left.fromSpecResidueField u₀ ∧
      Nonempty ((Functor.twoYonedaEvaluation 𝒳.val.p (𝒳.val.p.obj x)).obj f ≅
        (⟨x, rfl⟩ : 𝒳.val.p.Fiber (𝒳.val.p.obj x))) ∧
      (∃ hf : AlgebraicGeometry.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS f,
        AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.HasRelativePropertyBased.{u, u, u + 1,
            max u v, max (u + 1) v w, u} B S hS
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smoothMorphismProperty B S hS) f hf)
declarations.comment: the finite-type base, the object over it, its finite type point with residue field k, the restriction of that object to x₀ there, and smoothness of the 2-Yoneda morphism attached to it

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_of_artinAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y1 (Artin's axioms for algebraic spaces).** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme
and `F` a set-valued functor on the big fppf site of `S`. Assume that

1. the diagonal `Δ : F ⟶ F × F` is representable by algebraic spaces,
2. `F` satisfies Artin's axioms of Section 07XZ: [-1] the cardinalities `|F(Spec k)|`, for `k`
   running over the finite type fields over `S`, are bounded by the size of one object of the
   site; [0] `F` is a sheaf for the étale topology; [1] `F` is limit preserving (Stacks 049J);
   [2] `F` satisfies the Rim–Schlessinger condition; [3] every tangent space of `F` at a finite
   type field-valued point is finite dimensional; [4] every formal object of `F` is effective;
   [5] `F` satisfies openness of versality — axioms [2]–[5] read, as in Section 07XZ, on the
   category fibred in sets `𝒮_F`, and
3. the local rings `𝒪_{S,s}` at the finite type points `s` of `S` are G-rings.

Then `F` is an algebraic space.

Axiom [5] is written out rather than through `AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenVersality`, which asks its
fibred category to be fibred in groupoids over all schemes over `S` and so cannot hold for a
category over the bounded big fppf site; the written-out form is the source's definition.

The proof is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAlgebraicSpace_isoClassPresheafModel_of_artinAxioms` for
`𝒮_F`, whose presheaf of isomorphism classes is `F`, after the translations of Section 07XZ.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_artinAxioms [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (F : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hdiag : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS (diag F))
    (hsize : ∃ T : BigFppfOver B S hS,
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (k : Type u) [Field k],
        U.left.1 = Spec (.of k) → Deformation.Artin.IsFiniteTypeOver B S hS U →
          Cardinal.mk (F.obj (op U)) ≤ T.left.1.size)
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((AlgebraicGeometry.etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS)) F)
    (hlimit : AlgebraicGeometry.LimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u} (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) F)
    (hRS : Deformation.Artin.SatisfiesRS B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p
      (fibredCategory B S hS F).property)
    (htangent : HasFiniteDimensionalTangentSpaces B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F))
    (heffective : ∀ ξ : Deformation.Artin.FormalObject B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p,
      Deformation.Artin.FormalObject.IsEffective B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p
        (fibredCategory B S hS F).property ξ)
    (hopen : ∀ U : Over S, LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom →
      ∀ (y : (fibredCategory B S hS F).val.obj)
        (hy : ((fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj y = U)
        (u : U.left),
        AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u →
        Deformation.Artin.IsVersalAt U ((fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion)
          u y hy →
        ∃ V : U.left.Opens, u ∈ V.1 ∧
          ∀ u' : U.left, u' ∈ V.1 →
            AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u' →
            Deformation.Artin.IsVersalAt U
              ((fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u' y hy)
    (hG : ∀ s : S, AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint s → IsGRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isAlgebraicSpace_of_injective_of_artinAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y2.** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme and `a : F ⟶ G` a transformation of
functors `(Sch/S)_{fppf}^{opp} ⟶ Sets`. Assume that

1. `a` is injective;
2. `F` satisfies axioms [0] (`F` is an étale sheaf), [1] (`F` is limit preserving), [2]
   (condition (RS) for `F`), [4] (every formal object of `𝒮_F` is effective) and [5]
   (openness of versality for `𝒮_F`);
3. `𝒪_{S,s}` is a G-ring for every finite type point `s` of `S`;
4. `G` is an algebraic space locally of finite type over `S`.

Then `F` is an algebraic space.

As in the source, the proof applies Stacks 07Y1 to `F`: the diagonal of `F` is the base change of
the diagonal of `G` along `a × a`, hence representable; axiom [3] holds for `F` because
`a` induces fully faithful maps of predeformation categories into those of `𝒮_G`, whose tangent
spaces are finite-dimensional by Stacks 07X1; and the set-theoretic condition [-1] holds for `F`
because it holds for the algebraic space `G` and `F(U) ⟶ G(U)` is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicSpace_of_injective_of_artinAxioms [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    {F G : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (a : F ⟶ G)
    (ha : ∀ U, Function.Injective (a.app U))
    (hF : Presheaf.IsSheaf ((etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS)) F)
    (hlim : LimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u, u + 1} (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS) F)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRSFunctor B S hS F)
    (heff : ∀ ξ : FormalObject B S hS (Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p,
      FormalObject.IsEffective B S hS (Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p
        (Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).property ξ)
    (hopen : ∀ (U : Over S), LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom →
      ∀ (x : (Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.obj)
        (hx : ((Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x = U)
        (u₀ : U.left), IsFiniteTypePoint u₀ →
        IsVersalAt U ((Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u₀ x hx →
        ∃ W : U.left.Opens, u₀ ∈ W.1 ∧ ∀ u : U.left, u ∈ W.1 → IsFiniteTypePoint u →
          IsVersalAt U ((Stack.fibredCategory B S hS F).val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u x hx)
    (hGring : ∀ s : S, IsFiniteTypePoint s → IsGRing (S.presheaf.stalk s))
    (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hGft : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (terminal.from G)) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_artinAxioms
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y4 (Artin's criterion).** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme and let `𝒳` be a
category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`. Assume that

1. the diagonal `Δ : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 × 𝒳` is representable by algebraic spaces,
2. `𝒳` satisfies axioms [-1], [0], [1], [2] and [3]: the set-theoretic bound of Stacks 07Y3
   (`hsize`), the stack condition for the étale topology (`hstack`), limit preservation
   (`hlimit`), the Rim–Schlessinger condition (`hRS`) and finite dimensionality of tangent spaces
   (`htangent`),
3. every formal object of `𝒳` is effective,
4. `𝒳` satisfies openness of versality, and
5. `𝒪_{S, s}` is a G-ring for all finite type points `s` of `S`.

Then `𝒳` is an algebraic stack.

Axiom [0] is the source's: `𝒳` is a stack in groupoids for the étale topology. The proof is the
source's: Stacks 07XY produces, through every finite type field-valued object, a smooth finite type
neighbourhood; `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_hasSmoothFiniteTypeNeighborhoods`
assembles them into a surjective smooth atlas; and Stacks 076V
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_isStackInGroupoids_etale_of_smooth`), where the
étale stack condition of axiom [0] is used, makes `𝒳` an fppf stack and hence an algebraic stack.

Of axiom [3] only the tangent-space half is asked for, which is all Stacks 07XY uses; the index
universe of the stack condition in the conclusion is free.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAlgebraicStack_of_artinAxioms [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, max u v, u + 1, max (u + 1) v w}
      (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (hdiag : HasRepresentableDiagonal B S hS 𝒳)
    (hsize : IsSizeBounded B S hS 𝒳)
    (hstack : 𝒳.val.p.IsStackInGroupoids.{u + 1}
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS)))
    (hlimit : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, max (u + 1) v w, max u v} B S hS 𝒳)
    (hRS : Deformation.Artin.SatisfiesRS B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property)
    (htangent : HasFiniteDimensionalTangentSpaces B S hS 𝒳)
    (heffective : ∀ ξ : Deformation.Artin.FormalObject B S hS 𝒳.val.p,
      Deformation.Artin.FormalObject.IsEffective B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property ξ)
    (hopen : ∀ U : Over S, LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom →
      ∀ (y : 𝒳.val.obj) (hy : (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj y = U) (u : U.left),
        AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u →
        Deformation.Artin.IsVersalAt U (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u y hy →
        ∃ V : U.left.Opens, u ∈ V.1 ∧
          ∀ u' : U.left, u' ∈ V.1 →
            AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint u' →
            Deformation.Artin.IsVersalAt U (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) u' y hy)
    (hG : ∀ s : S, AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint s → IsGRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, z, max u v, max (u + 1) v w} B S hS 𝒳.val

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAlgebraicStack_of_artinAxioms_of_secondDiagonal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y5 (Artin's axioms, second diagonal form).** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian
scheme and `𝒳` a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`. Assume that

1. the second diagonal `Δ_Δ : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 ×_{𝒳 × 𝒳} 𝒳` is representable by algebraic spaces,
2. `𝒳` satisfies Artin's axioms of Section 07XJ: [-1] the cardinalities of the sets of
   isomorphism classes of objects and of the sets of arrows of the fibres of `𝒳` over the finite
   type fields over `S` are bounded by the size of one object of the site; [0] `𝒳` is a stack
   in groupoids for the étale topology; [1] `𝒳` is limit preserving; [2] `𝒳` satisfies the
   Rim–Schlessinger condition; [3] the tangent spaces and the infinitesimal automorphism spaces
   of `𝒳` at the finite type field-valued points are finite dimensional; [4] the functor of
   Stacks 07X6 from objects over complete local bases to formal objects is an equivalence;
   [5] `𝒳` and `Δ : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳 × 𝒳` satisfy openness of versality (Stacks 07XQ: for `Δ`, for every
   scheme `V` locally of finite type over `S` and every point `y` of `𝒳 × 𝒳` over `V`, the
   2-fibre product `(Sch/V)_{fppf} ×_{y, 𝒳 × 𝒳, Δ} 𝒳` has openness of versality), and
3. the local rings `𝒪_{S,s}` at the finite type points `s` of `S` are G-rings.

Then `𝒳` is an algebraic stack.

Openness of versality is written out (`Deformation.Artin.HasOpenVersality`) rather than through
`Deformation.Artin.IsOpenVersality`, whose fibred-in-groupoids hypothesis over all schemes over
`S` cannot hold for a category over the bounded big fppf site. A point `y` of `𝒳 × 𝒳` over `V` is
given, by the 2-Yoneda lemma, as a 1-morphism `(Sch/V)_{fppf} ⟶ 𝒳 × 𝒳` over the site.

The proof is the source's:
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasRepresentableDiagonal_of_artinAxioms_of_secondDiagonal` makes the
diagonal representable (Stacks 07WH, 07WG and Proposition 07Y1 for the functors `Y`), and
Lemma 07Y4 concludes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAlgebraicStack_of_artinAxioms_of_secondDiagonal [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (𝒳 : CatFiberedInGroupoids.{u, u, u + 1, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (hΔΔ : IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces B S hS
      (relativeDiagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳 (CatFiberedInGroupoids.product 𝒳 𝒳)
        (diagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳)))
    (hsize : ∃ T : BigFppfOver B S hS,
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (k : Type u) [Field k],
        U.left.1 = Spec (.of k) → Deformation.Artin.IsFiniteTypeOver B S hS U →
        Cardinal.lift.{u, u + 1}
            (Cardinal.mk (Quotient (isIsomorphicSetoid (𝒳.val.p.Fiber U)))) ≤
          Cardinal.lift.{u + 1, u} T.left.1.size ∧
        Cardinal.lift.{u, u + 1} (Cardinal.mk (Σ a b : 𝒳.val.p.Fiber U, a ⟶ b)) ≤
          Cardinal.lift.{u + 1, u} T.left.1.size)
    (hstack : 𝒳.val.p.IsStackInGroupoids.{u + 1}
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.etaleTopology B).over (B.obj hS)))
    (hlimit : Deformation.Artin.IsLimitPreserving.{u, u, u, u + 1, u} B S hS 𝒳)
    (hRS : Deformation.Artin.SatisfiesRS B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property)
    (htangent : HasFiniteDimensionalTangentSpaces B S hS 𝒳)
    (hInf : Deformation.Artin.HasFiniteDimensionalInfinitesimalAutomorphismsOf B S hS 𝒳.val.p)
    (happrox : (Deformation.Artin.approximationFunctor B S hS 𝒳.val.p 𝒳.property).IsEquivalence)
    (hopen : Deformation.Artin.HasOpenVersality (𝒳.val.p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion))
    (hopenΔ : ∀ V : BigFppfOver B S hS, LocallyOfFiniteType (B.inclusion.map V.hom) →
      ∀ (y : BigFppfOver B V.left.1 V.left.2 ⥤ (CatFiberedInGroupoids.product 𝒳 𝒳).val.obj),
        y ⋙ (CatFiberedInGroupoids.product 𝒳 𝒳).val.p = Over.map V.hom →
        Deformation.Artin.HasOpenVersality
          (TwoFibreProductOver.fst (Over.map V.hom) 𝒳.val.p
            (CatFiberedInGroupoids.product 𝒳 𝒳).val.p y
            (diagonalBasedFunctor B S hS 𝒳).toFunctor ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion))
    (hG : ∀ s : S, AlgebraicGeometry.IsFiniteTypePoint s → IsGRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    IsAlgebraicStack.{u, z, u, u + 1} B S hS 𝒳.val

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.liftOutFunctorOfPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y7.** Let `F : X ⥤ Y` be a `1`-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over
`C`, let `b ≫ a = d ≫ c` be a commutative square of the base with `a : U ⟶ U'`, `b : V ⟶ U`,
`c : V' ⟶ U'` and `d : V ⟶ V'`, let `x` lie over `U`, let `y` lie over `V`, and let `φ` be a
morphism `F(x)|_V ⟶ y` of the fibre over `V`. Then there is a canonical functor from the lifts
of `x` along `a` to the lifts of `y` along `d`: a lift `x ⟶ x'` is carried to the chosen
pullback of `F x'` along `c`, whose structure arrow out of `y` is the factorization of
`y ⟶ F x ⟶ F x'` through that cartesian arrow.

Over the big fppf site this is the source's `Lift(x, A') ⟶ Lift(y, B')` for the commutative
diagram of `S`-algebras with rows `A' ⟶ A`, `B' ⟶ B` and columns `A' ⟶ B'`, `A ⟶ B`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def liftOutFunctorOfPullback (p : X ⥤ C) (q : Y ⥤ C)
    (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (F : X ⥤ Y) (hF : F ⋙ q = p)
    {U U' V V' : C} (a : U ⟶ U') (b : V ⟶ U) (c : V' ⟶ U') (d : V ⟶ V')
    (hsq : b ≫ a = d ≫ c) (x : X) (hx : p.obj x = U)
    (y : Y) (hy : q.obj y = V) (e : q.ChoiceOfPullbacks)
    (φ : (e.pullbackFunctor b).obj (imageFiber p q F hF x hx) ⟶ ⟨y, hy⟩) :
    LiftOutFunctor p q F a b c d x hx y hy
      (pullbackComparison p q hq F hF b x hx y hy e φ)
declarations.comment: the functor, on the source's Lift(x, A'), lifts out of the base

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.liftOutFunctor_unique
declarations.doc:
Two constructions satisfying the cartesian-square specification are uniquely isomorphic by
an isomorphism commuting with their comparison maps. In particular, the direct functor for a
composite of morphisms of fibred groupoids agrees canonically with the composite of the induced
lift functors.
declarations.statement:
public theorem liftOutFunctor_unique (p : X ⥤ C) (q : Y ⥤ C) (F : X ⥤ Y)
    {U U' V V' : C} (a : U ⟶ U') (b : V ⟶ U) (c : V' ⟶ U') (d : V ⟶ V')
    (x : X) (hx : p.obj x = U) (y : Y) (hy : q.obj y = V)
    (φ : y ⟶ F.obj x)
    (L M : LiftOutFunctor p q F a b c d x hx y hy φ) :
    ∃! η : L.toFunctor ≅ M.toFunctor,
      ∀ t : LiftOut p a x hx,
        (η.hom.app t).1.right ≫ M.comparison t = L.comparison t
declarations.comment: uniqueness, on the source's Lift(x, A'), lifts out of the base

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.liftFunctorOfHom_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y7, compatibility with composition.** The construction is compatible with
composition of `1`-morphisms of categories fibred in groupoids: the functor on lifts induced
by `F` and `φ`, followed by the functor on lifts induced by `G` and `ψ` over the identity
square at `d`, is canonically isomorphic to the functor on lifts induced by `F ⋙ G` and the
composite arrow `ψ ≫ G φ`, by the unique isomorphism commuting with the cartesian comparison
arrows.

All three functors here are built, not assumed to satisfy the specification: each is, by
definition, a functor `Deformation.Artin.liftOutFunctorOfPullback` builds from the datum
`Deformation.Artin.pullbackDatum` attaches to the given arrow. The source's data are covered
because a morphism out of the chosen pullback gives such an arrow, by
`Deformation.Artin.pullbackComparison` and
`Deformation.Artin.pullbackComparison_isHomLift`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def liftFunctorOfHom_comp {Z : Type*} [Category Z]
    (p : X ⥤ C) (q : Y ⥤ C) (r : Z ⥤ C)
    (hq : q.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hr : r.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (F : X ⥤ Y) (G : Y ⥤ Z) (hF : F ⋙ q = p) (hG : G ⋙ r = q)
    {U U' V V' : C} (a : U ⟶ U') (b : V ⟶ U) (c : V' ⟶ U') (d : V ⟶ V')
    (hsq : b ≫ a = d ≫ c) (x : X) (hx : p.obj x = U)
    (y : Y) (hy : q.obj y = V) (z : Z) (hz : r.obj z = V)
    (eY : q.ChoiceOfPullbacks) (eZ : r.ChoiceOfPullbacks)
    (φ : y ⟶ F.obj x) (hφ : q.IsHomLift b φ)
    (ψ : z ⟶ G.obj y) (hψ : r.IsHomLift (𝟙 V) ψ) :
    {η : (liftFunctorOfHom p q hq F hF a b c d hsq x hx y hy eY φ hφ).toFunctor ⋙
          (liftFunctorOfHom q r hr G hG d (𝟙 V) (𝟙 V') d (id_comp_square d) y hy z hz
            eZ ψ hψ).toFunctor ≅
        (liftFunctorOfHom p r hr (F ⋙ G) (comp_over_base hF hG) a b c d hsq x hx z hz eZ
          (ψ ≫ G.map φ)
          (comp_comparison_isHomLift q r F G hG b x y z φ hφ ψ hψ)).toFunctor //
      ∀ t : LiftOut p a x hx,
        (η.hom.app t).1.right ≫
            (liftFunctorOfHom p r hr (F ⋙ G) (comp_over_base hF hG) a b c d hsq x hx z hz eZ
              (ψ ≫ G.map φ)
              (comp_comparison_isHomLift q r F G hG b x y z φ hφ ψ hψ)).comparison t =
          (liftFunctorOfHom q r hr G hG d (𝟙 V) (𝟙 V') d (id_comp_square d) y hy z hz
              eZ ψ hψ).comparison
            ((liftFunctorOfHom p q hq F hF a b c d hsq x hx y hy eY φ hφ).toFunctor.obj t) ≫
            G.map ((liftFunctorOfHom p q hq F hF a b c d hsq x hx y hy eY φ hφ).comparison t)}
declarations.comment: compatibility with composition, on the source's Lift(x, A'), lifts out of the base

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isDeformationCategory_predeformationCategory_of_satisfiesRSStar
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 07Y8.** The predeformation category of a finite-type field-valued
point in a fibred category satisfying (RS*) is a deformation category; only the square-zero
squares that (RS*) quantifies over are needed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isDeformationCategory_predeformationCategory_of_satisfiesRSStar
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} 𝒳]
    (p : 𝒳 ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    {Λ k : Type u} [CommRing Λ] [Field k] [Algebra Λ k]
    (iΛ : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ S)
    (x₀ : 𝒳)
    (hx₀ : (p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion).obj x₀ =
      Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hfinite : LocallyOfFiniteType
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ))
    (hqc : QuasiCompact
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ k)) ≫ iΛ)) :
    let D := predeformationCategory iΛ
      (p ⋙ Over.post B.inclusion) x₀ hx₀
    letI := D.category
    Deformation.IsDeformationCategory D.projection
declarations.comment: condition (RS*) gives a deformation category

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.SatisfiesRSStar
declarations.doc:
Condition (RS*): for every fibre-product square of `S`-algebras in the big affine fppf
site, with one map surjective with square-zero kernel, the canonical functor from the fibre
over the pullback algebra to the two-fibre product of the other three fibres is an
equivalence.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev SatisfiesRSStar
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X : Type w} [Category X]
    (p : X ⥤ BigFppfOver B S hS)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) : Prop

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_infComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y9 part (1).** For `𝒳` satisfying (RS*), a deformation situation `A' → A`
with square-zero kernel `I` whose source lies in the chosen site, and a lift `x'` of `x`
over `Spec A'`, the value of the `A`-linear functor `Inf_x` at `I` is isomorphic, as a
group, to the infinitesimal automorphisms of `x'`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def exists_infComparison (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    (Inf : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp)
    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (hA' : B.Contains (Spec (.of A')))
    (toS' : B.obj hA' ⟶ B.obj hS) (q : A' →+* A) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hsq : RingHom.ker q ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (g : algebraOver A B S hS toS hA ⟶ (Over.mk toS' : BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (hg : B.inclusion.map g.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom q))
    (x' : (Under.post p).Fiber (Under.mk (eqToHom hx ≫ g))) :
    InfComparisonData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp Inf A' hA' toS' q hq hsq g x'
declarations.comment: part (1), the comparison of Inf_x(I) with Inf(x'/x)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_actionOnLifts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y9 part (2)(b).** The difference-transport action of the tangent module
`T_x(I)` on the isomorphism classes of lifts of `x` over a square-zero deformation `A' → A`
with kernel `I`. Every orbit map is bijective, so the action is simply transitive whenever
there is a lift.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def exists_actionOnLifts
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A']
    (hA' : B.Contains (Spec (.of A')))
    (toS' : B.obj hA' ⟶ B.obj hS)
    (q : A' →+* A)
    (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hsq : (RingHom.ker q) ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (g : algebraOver A B S hS toS hA ⟶
      (Over.mk toS' : BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (hg : B.inclusion.map g.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom q)) :
    ActionOnLiftsData A B S hS toS hA p x hx
      (tangentFunctor A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp hRS)
      A' hA' toS' q hq hsq g
declarations.comment: part (2)(b), the action of T_x(I) on the lifts over A'

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_infinitesimalAutomorphismFunctor
declarations.doc:
For `𝒳` satisfying (RS*), the infinitesimal automorphisms of the trivial deformations of
`x` over the trivial square-zero extensions `A[M]` are the underlying sets of an `A`-linear
functor of `M`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_infinitesimalAutomorphismFunctor (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp) :
    Nonempty (InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp)
declarations.comment: part (1), the A-linear functor Inf_x on trivial square-zero extensions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.exists_tangentFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07Y9 part (2)(a), the tangent functor.** For `𝒳` satisfying (RS*), the
isomorphism classes of lifts of `x` over the trivial square-zero extensions `A[M]` are the
underlying sets of an `A`-linear functor of `M`.
declarations.comment: part (2)(a), the A-linear tangent functor T_x

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isLinearMap_tangentBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Remark 07YA for the tangent functor.** For a ring map `f : A ⟶ C`, the restriction
`y = x|_{Spec C}` and an `f`-semilinear map `M ⟶ N` of coefficients, the induced map
`T_x(M) ⟶ T_y(N)` is `A`-linear, where `T_y(N)` is viewed as an `A`-module by restriction of
scalars along `f`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLinearMap_tangentBaseChangeMap {M : SiteModule A B} {N : SiteModule C B}
    (ψ : M.obj ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).obj N.obj) :
    letI : Module A ((Ty.functor.obj N : Type (max (u + 1) v w))) := Module.compHom _ f
    IsLinearMap A
      (tangentBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp Tx Ty ψ)
declarations.comment: the A-linear map T_x(M) → T_y(N)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.isLinearMap_infBaseChangeMap_tangentBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YA, the maps.** Let `𝒳` satisfy (RS*), let `f : A ⟶ C` be a map of
`S`-algebras, `y = x|_{Spec C}` (the arrow `φ₀ : y ⟶ x` over `Spec C ⟶ Spec A`), `M` an
`A`-module, `N` a `C`-module and `ψ : M ⟶ N` an `A`-linear map. The pullback functor on lifts
along `Spec C[N] ⟶ Spec A[M]` induces maps `Inf_x(M) ⟶ Inf_y(N)` and `T_x(M) ⟶ T_y(N)` on the
functors of Stacks 07Y9, and both are `A`-linear (with `A` acting on the targets through `f`).
That the maps are induced by the pullback functor is the transition relation each of them
realizes: `Deformation.Artin.IsSiteInfinitesimalAutomorphismBaseChange` and
`Deformation.Artin.IsSiteSquareZeroLiftBaseChange`. The statement holds for every choice of
the functors `Inf_x`, `Inf_y`, `T_x`, `T_y` of Stacks 07Y9.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isLinearMap_infBaseChangeMap_tangentBaseChangeMap
    (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    (Tx : TangentFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx)
    (Ty : TangentFunctorData C B S hS toSC hC p y hy)
    {M : SiteModule A B} {N : SiteModule C B}
    (ψ : M.obj ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).obj N.obj) :
    letI : Module A (Inf'.functor.obj N : Type w) := Module.compHom _ f
    letI : Module A ((Ty.functor.obj N : Type (max (u + 1) v w))) := Module.compHom _ f
    IsLinearMap A (infBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp Inf Inf'
        ψ) ∧
      (∀ a, IsSiteInfinitesimalAutomorphismBaseChange B S hS toS hA toSC hC p x y hx hy φ₀ f ψ hp
        (Inf.autEquiv M a)
        (Inf'.autEquiv N (infBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp
          Inf Inf' ψ a))) ∧
      IsLinearMap A (tangentBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp
        Tx Ty ψ) ∧
      (∀ a, IsSiteSquareZeroLiftBaseChange B S hS toS hA toSC hC p x y hx hy φ₀ f ψ
        (Tx.liftEquiv M a)
        (Ty.liftEquiv N (tangentBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hf p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp
          Tx Ty ψ a)))
declarations.comment: the A-linear maps Inf_x(M) → Inf_y(N) and T_x(M) → T_y(N) induced by pullback

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.infComparison_restrict_and_action_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YA, the two squares.** Let `𝒳` satisfy (RS*) and let `(y, C' → C) ⟶ (x, A' → A)`
be a morphism of deformation situations: `f' : A' → C'` over `f : A → C`, compatibly with the
structure morphisms to `S`, and `φ₀ : y ⟶ x` over `Spec C ⟶ Spec A`. Let `I = Ker(A' → A)`,
`J = Ker(C' → C)`, with the map `I ⟶ J` induced by `f'`.

* For a lift `x'` of `x` to `A'` and its restriction `y'` to `C'` (any lift of `y` with an
  arrow `y' ⟶ x'` over `Spec C' ⟶ Spec A'` compatible with `φ₀`), the square
  `Inf_x(I) ⟶ Inf(x'/x) ⟶ Inf(y'/y)` = `Inf_x(I) ⟶ Inf_y(J) ⟶ Inf(y'/y)` commutes.
* The square `T_x(I) × Lift(x, A') ⟶ Lift(x, A') ⟶ Lift(y, C')` =
  `T_x(I) × Lift(x, A') ⟶ T_y(J) × Lift(y, C') ⟶ Lift(y, C')` commutes.

The horizontal maps are the comparisons and the actions of Stacks 07Y9, the vertical ones the
maps of Remark 07YA and the pullback of lifts along `Spec C' ⟶ Spec A'`. All the data of
Stacks 07Y9 (the functors `Inf`, `T`, the comparisons and the actions) are arbitrary: each is
pinned by its geometric difference, which is what the proof restricts.
declarations.statement:
public theorem infComparison_restrict_and_action_restrict (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    (Infx : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp)
    (Infy : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData C B S hS toSC hC p y hy hp)
    (x' : (Under.post p).Fiber (Under.mk (eqToHom hx ≫ gA)))
    (y' : (Under.post p).Fiber (Under.mk (eqToHom hy ≫ gC)))
    (φ : y'.1.right ⟶ x'.1.right)
    (hφ : p.IsHomLift (deformationSituationMap B S hS hA' toS' hC' toSC' f' hf') φ)
    (hφc : y'.1.hom ≫ φ = φ₀ ≫ x'.1.hom)
    (Cx : InfComparisonData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp Infx A' hA' toS' q hq hsq gA x')
    (Cy : InfComparisonData C B S hS toSC hC p y hy hp Infy C' hC' toSC' qC hqC hsqC gC y')
    (Tx : TangentFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx)
    (Ty : TangentFunctorData C B S hS toSC hC p y hy)
    (Dx : ActionOnLiftsData A B S hS toS hA p x hx Tx A' hA' toS' q hq hsq gA)
    (Dy : ActionOnLiftsData C B S hS toSC hC p y hy Ty C' hC' toSC' qC hqC hsqC gC) :
    letI : Module A (RingHom.ker q) := Stacks.Smooth.kerModule hq hsq
    letI : Module C (RingHom.ker qC) := Stacks.Smooth.kerModule hqC hsqC
    (∀ a : (Infx.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), Cx.kernelIsSiteModule⟩ : Type w),
      Cy.equiv (infBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC
          (specMap_comp_eq_of_deformationSituation f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hA' toS' q gA hgA hC'
          toSC' qC gC hgC f' hff hf') p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp Infx Infy
          (M := ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), Cx.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
          (N := ⟨ModuleCat.of C (RingHom.ker qC), Cy.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
          (kernelBaseChange hq hsq hqC hsqC hff) a) =
        liftEndRestrict p hp φ₀ φ hφ hφc (Cx.equiv a)) ∧
    (∀ (a : (Tx.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), Dx.kernelIsSiteModule⟩ : Type _))
      (z : liftClassesOver A B S hS toS hA p x hx gA),
      liftClassesRestrict p hp φ₀ _ hφ₀
          (algebraOverMap_comp_deformationSituation f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hA' toS' q gA hgA
            hC' toSC' qC gC hgC f' hff hf') (Dx.action a z) =
        Dy.action (tangentBaseChangeMap f B S hS toS hA toSC hC
          (specMap_comp_eq_of_deformationSituation f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hA' toS' q gA hgA hC'
          toSC' qC gC hgC f' hff hf') p x y hx hy φ₀ hφ₀ hp Tx Ty
          (M := ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), Dx.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
          (N := ⟨ModuleCat.of C (RingHom.ker qC), Dy.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
          (kernelBaseChange hq hsq hqC hsqC hff) a)
          (liftClassesRestrict p hp φ₀ _ hφ₀
            (algebraOverMap_comp_deformationSituation f B S hS toS hA toSC hC hA' toS' q gA hgA
              hC' toSC' qC gC hgC f' hff hf') z))
declarations.comment: the two commutative squares for a morphism of deformation situations

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.existsUnique_tangentBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YA on tangent modules.** Let `x` be an object over `Spec A` of a category fibred
in groupoids over the big fppf site of `S`, let `f : A ⟶ C` be a homomorphism of `S`-algebras
and let `y ⟶ x` be a morphism lying over `Spec C ⟶ Spec A`, so that `y = x|_{Spec C}`. For
`M ∈ Mod_A`, `N ∈ Mod_C` and an `A`-linear map `M ⟶ N` there is exactly one `A`-linear map
`T_x(M) ⟶ T_y(N)` — written as an `f`-semilinear map — carrying each class of lifts of `x`
over `Spec A[M]` to the class of its pullback along `Spec C[N] ⟶ Spec A[M]`.

The tangent functors `T_x`, `T_y` are arbitrary members of
`Deformation.Artin.TangentFunctorData`, which (RS*) supplies by Stacks 07Y9 (2)(a).
declarations.statement:
public theorem existsUnique_tangentBaseChange {M : SiteModule A B} {N : SiteModule C B}
    (ψ : M.obj ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars f).obj N.obj) :
    ∃! τ : ↥(F.functor.obj M) →ₛₗ[f] ↥(G.functor.obj N),
      ∀ z, G.liftEquiv N (τ z) = liftClassPullback f hf hp φ hφ ψ (F.liftEquiv M z)
declarations.comment: tangent_base_change

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.compositionMap
declarations.doc:
Composition with relative infinitesimal automorphisms on both sides of a
morphism of lifts.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def compositionMap
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x) :
    ((infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁ × (t₁ ⟶ t₂)) ×
      infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₂) → (t₁ ⟶ t₂)
declarations.comment: composition_map

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.leftCompositionAction
declarations.doc:
The left action of relative infinitesimal automorphisms of the source lift
on morphisms of lifts, by inverse precomposition.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def leftCompositionAction
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (a : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁) (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) : t₁ ⟶ t₂
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.rightCompositionAction
declarations.doc:
The right action of relative infinitesimal automorphisms of the target lift
on morphisms of lifts, by inverse postcomposition.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def rightCompositionAction
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) (b : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₂) : t₁ ⟶ t₂
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.leftComposition_one
declarations.doc: The identity automorphism acts trivially on the left.
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.leftComposition_mul
declarations.doc: The left action is compatible with multiplication of automorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem leftComposition_mul (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (a b : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁) (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    leftCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ (a * b) f =
      leftCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ a (leftCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ b f)
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.rightComposition_one
declarations.doc: The identity automorphism acts trivially on the right.
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.rightComposition_mul
declarations.doc: The right action is compatible with multiplication of automorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem rightComposition_mul (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (a b : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₂) (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    rightCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ (rightCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ f a) b =
      rightCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ f (a * b)
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.leftComposition_bijective
declarations.doc: At each morphism of lifts, the orbit map for the left action is a bijection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem leftComposition_bijective
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    Function.Bijective (fun a : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁ =>
      leftCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ a f)
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.rightComposition_bijective
declarations.doc: At each morphism of lifts, the orbit map for the right action is a bijection.
declarations.statement:
public theorem rightComposition_bijective
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    Function.Bijective (fun b : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₂ =>
      rightCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ f b)
declarations.comment: groupoid_actions

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.InfComparisonData.actions_agree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YB.** Let `𝒳` satisfy (RS*), let `(x, A' → A)` be a deformation situation with
kernel `I`, and let `x'`, `x''` be lifts of `x` to `Spec A'`. Composition gives a map
`Inf(x'/x) × Mor(x', x'') × Inf(x''/x) → Mor(x', x'')`, and since the lifts form a groupoid it
defines, at every morphism, simply transitive actions of `Inf(x'/x)` (by precomposition) and of
`Inf(x''/x)` (by postcomposition). Let `C'` and `C''` be the comparisons of Stacks 07Y9,
`Inf_x(I) ≅ Inf(x'/x)` and `Inf_x(I) ≅ Inf(x''/x)`. Then the two actions agree via these
identifications: `C'(a) ≫ f = f ≫ C''(a)` for every `a ∈ Inf_x(I)` and every morphism
`f : x' ⟶ x''`. In particular `Inf_x(I)` acts on `Mor(x', x'')`, and the action is simply
transitive as soon as `Mor(x', x'')` is nonempty: every orbit map is a bijection.

The agreement holds for *every* pair of comparisons in the sense of
`Deformation.Artin.InfComparisonData`, which pins a comparison geometrically. The proof shows
that this pin determines the comparison and is natural for isomorphisms of lifts
(`Deformation.Artin.IsGeometricInfDifference.conj`), using (RS*) and the commutativity of
`Inf(x'/x)` and of `Inf_x(I)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem InfComparisonData.actions_agree (hRS : SatisfiesRSStar B S hS p hp)
    (Inf : InfinitesimalAutomorphismFunctorData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp)
    (A' : Type u) [CommRing A'] (hA' : B.Contains (Spec (.of A')))
    (toS' : B.obj hA' ⟶ B.obj hS) (q : A' →+* A) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hsq : RingHom.ker q ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (g : algebraOver A B S hS toS hA ⟶ (Over.mk toS' : BigFppfOver B S hS))
    (hg : B.inclusion.map g.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom q))
    {x' x'' : (Under.post p).Fiber (Under.mk (eqToHom hx ≫ g))}
    (C' : InfComparisonData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp Inf A' hA' toS' q hq hsq g x')
    (C'' : InfComparisonData A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp Inf A' hA' toS' q hq hsq g x'') :
    letI := Stacks.Smooth.kerModule hq hsq
    (∀ f : x' ⟶ x'', Function.Bijective (fun α : x' ⟶ x' => α ≫ f)) ∧
      (∀ f : x' ⟶ x'', Function.Bijective (fun β : x'' ⟶ x'' => f ≫ β)) ∧
      (∀ (a : Inf.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), C'.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
        (f : x' ⟶ x''), C'.equiv a ≫ f = f ≫ C''.equiv a) ∧
      (∀ f : x' ⟶ x'', C'.equiv 0 ≫ f = f) ∧
      (∀ (a b : Inf.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), C'.kernelIsSiteModule⟩)
        (f : x' ⟶ x''), C'.equiv (a + b) ≫ f = C'.equiv a ≫ C'.equiv b ≫ f) ∧
      (∀ f : x' ⟶ x'', Function.Bijective
        (fun a : Inf.functor.obj ⟨ModuleCat.of A (RingHom.ker q), C'.kernelIsSiteModule⟩ =>
          C'.equiv a ≫ f))
declarations.comment: actions on Mor(x', x'') agree via Inf(x'/x) = Inf_x(I) = Inf(x''/x)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.infinitesimalAutTransport
declarations.doc:
**The identification of the two groups of relative infinitesimal automorphisms.** A
morphism of lifts identifies the relative infinitesimal automorphisms of its source with
those of its target, by conjugation.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def infinitesimalAutTransport
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x) (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁ ≃* infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₂
declarations.comment: actions_agree

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.leftCompositionAction_eq_rightCompositionAction
declarations.doc:
**The two actions agree.** The left action of a relative infinitesimal automorphism of the
source lift on a morphism of lifts is the right action, on the same morphism, of the
corresponding relative infinitesimal automorphism of the target lift.
declarations.statement:
public theorem leftCompositionAction_eq_rightCompositionAction
    (hp : Deformation.IsCofiberedInGroupoids p)
    (t₁ t₂ : Deformation.Lift p g x)
    (a : infinitesimalAutomorphisms hp t₁) (f : t₁ ⟶ t₂) :
    leftCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ a f =
      rightCompositionAction hp t₁ t₂ f (infinitesimalAutTransport hp t₁ t₂ f a)
declarations.comment: actions_agree

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.canonicalDeformationElement
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YC.** The canonical element of `T_x(Ω_{A/Λ})` attached to the universal
derivation `d : A → Ω_{A/Λ}`.
declarations.statement:
public def canonicalDeformationElement (baseMap : Spec (.of Λ) ⟶ S)
    (baseFactorization :
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap Λ A)) ≫ baseMap = toS) :
    CanonicalDeformationData Λ A B S hS toS hA p x hx hp hRS hΩ
declarations.comment: canonical_deformation_element

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.canonicalTangentMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YC.** The map on tangent spaces induced by the family `x` over `Spec A`: a
`Λ`-derivation of `A` with values in `k`, written as an `A`-linear map `Ω_{A/Λ} → k`, carries
the canonical element to an element of `T_x(k)`.
declarations.comment: the tangent-space map

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.canonicalTangentMap_eq_familyTangentMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 07YC: the canonical element produces the map on tangent spaces induced by `x`.**

Let `𝒳` be a category fibred in groupoids over the big fppf site of a locally Noetherian `S`,
satisfying (RS*), let `Spec Λ ⊂ S` be an affine open through which `U = Spec A ⟶ S` factors,
with `A` of finite type over `Λ`, let `x` be an object of `𝒳` over `U`, and let `k` be the
residue field of a finite type point `u₀` of `U`, with `x₀ = x|_{u₀}`. Then:
